pmid-40199596.summary_en: A case report of bilateral malignant struma ovarii with concurrent thyroid carcinoma.

pmid-40480741.summary_ja: 本症例は前縦隔奇形腫を有する22歳男性を報告した。右心房血栓と両側肺塞栓が合併し、最初の手術介入を阻止した。経皮的技術により外科的危険が軽減され、腫瘤の安全な切除が可能となった。本症例は良性胚細胞腫瘍の珍しい血管合併症を示し、奇形腫切除に関連する周術期血栓塞栓事象の多分野管理戦略を強調している。
pmid-40480741.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal teratoma complicated by a right atrial thrombus-in-transit and bilateral pulmonary emboli. Percutaneous techniques reduced perioperative surgical risk, enabling safe resection of the mediastinal mass. The case illustrates a rare vascular complication of an otherwise benign germ cell tumor and highlights multidisciplinary management strategies for perioperative thromboembolic events associated with teratoma resection.

pmid-40478614.summary_ja: 本研究はSEERデータベースを用い、妊娠性絨毛癌(719例)と非妊娠性絨毛癌(200例)を比較した。NGCC患者はより高い年齢、より進行した疾患、および悪い生存率を示した。化学療法はNGCCの生存を改善したが、GCCでは限定的効果を示した。著者は個別化治療を支援する5年生存予測ノモグラムとウェブベースツールを開発・検証した。
pmid-40478614.summary_en: This SEER-based retrospective cohort study compared gestational (GCC, n=719) and non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGCC, n=200), finding NGCC patients were older, had more advanced disease, and worse survival. Chemotherapy improved survival in NGCC but had limited benefit in GCC, while radiotherapy was associated with worse outcomes. The authors developed and validated a nomogram and web-based tool for predicting 5-year survival to guide personalized treatment.

pmid-40464080.summary_ja: 胎盤絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株をモデルとして、バルプロ酸とその誘導体SPDが葉酸輸送体発現と経胎盤葉酸輸送に与える影響を検討した薬理学研究。輸送体発現の変化だけでは葉酸輸送動態を十分に説明できないことが示された。抗てんかん薬の催奇形性リスク評価を目的とし、胚細胞腫瘍そのものを対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-40464080.summary_en: This pharmacology study used the BeWo placental choriocarcinoma cell line as an in vitro model to examine how valproic acid and its amide derivative SPD alter folate transporter expression (FOLR1, SLC19A1, ABCG2) and transplacental folate transfer. Findings suggest transporter expression changes do not fully predict folate transfer kinetics, informing future teratogenicity risk assessment of antiseizure medications. The focus is placental drug transport, not germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-40462788.summary_ja: 31歳女性の全胞状奇胎が急速に肺転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛癌へ進展した症例報告。著しいhCG上昇を認めEMA/CO療法と子宮摘出術により完全奏効を得た。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の急激な進行例を示すが、胚細胞腫瘍ではなく妊娠性絨毛性疾患を扱った内容である。
pmid-40462788.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman whose complete molar pregnancy rapidly progressed to gestational choriocarcinoma with pulmonary metastases and extremely elevated hCG, treated with EMA/CO chemotherapy and hysterectomy achieving complete response. It highlights the aggressive potential of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia after molar pregnancy and the need for further research into high-risk disease trajectories, but addresses gestational trophoblastic disease rather than germ cell tumors.

pmid-40462411.summary_ja: 51例を対象に、子宮内膜症性嚢胞、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)、漿液性/粘液性嚢胞腺腫における腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術後の卵巣予備能(AMH・FSH)を比較検討した研究。奇形腫群・子宮内膜症群ともに術後AMHが有意に低下し、特に子宮内膜症群で低下が顕著だった。奇形腫手術における卵巣予備能温存の重要性を示唆する。
pmid-40462411.summary_en: This study compared ovarian reserve (AMH, FSH) before and after 3D laparoscopic cystectomy across endometriomas, mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts), and serous/mucinous cystadenomas in 51 women. Both endometrioma and dermoid cyst excision significantly reduced postoperative AMH levels, with a more pronounced decline for endometriomas, while cystadenoma removal showed no significant effect. Findings inform counseling on fertility-preserving surgical approaches for ovarian teratoma.

pmid-40457795.summary_ja: 本研究は妊娠性絨毛性疾患に関連する異型胎盤部結節(APSN)の症例集積と37症例の文献レビューを行った。治療には子宮拡張搔爬術または子宮鏡下手術が用いられ、フォローアップ中に2症例がトロホブラスト腫瘍に進行したが、悪性転化の因果性は不明である。
pmid-40457795.summary_en: This case series and literature review examined 5 patients with atypical placental site nodules (APSN), a rare gestational trophoblastic lesion, describing clinical course, treatment (curettage/hysteroscopy), and follow-up. Pooled analysis of 37 reported cases found 2 progressed to trophoblastic tumors, though causal transformation remains unproven. The study concerns gestational trophoblastic disease rather than germ cell tumors.

pmid-40451233.summary_ja: 精巣癌、特にその95%を占める精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する包括的総説。疫学、臨床像、病期分類、セミノーマ/非セミノーマ別の病期ごとの治療方針、論争点、再発後の救済療法、経過観察までを網羅し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の最新知見と今後の展望を臨床医・研究者向けに提供している。
pmid-40451233.summary_en: This Lancet Seminar provides a comprehensive review of testicular cancer, focusing on testicular germ cell tumors, which comprise about 95% of cases. It covers epidemiology, clinical presentation, staging, distinct management approaches for seminoma versus non-seminoma across clinical stages, controversies, salvage therapy after relapse, and follow-up strategies, offering clinicians an up-to-date synthesis of current evidence and future directions in testicular GCT care.

pmid-40448328.summary_ja: 25歳男性の転移性奇形腫内に体細胞型悪性腫瘍として高悪性度神経内分泌腫瘍が発生した稀な症例報告。思春期後型非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の奇形腫から非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍が生じる現象はまれであり、特に神経内分泌腫瘍としての発生は極めて稀。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の正確な診断・管理における認識の重要性を強調する。
pmid-40448328.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with a high-grade neuroendocrine tumor arising as a somatic-type malignancy within a metastatic teratoma, an extremely rare transformation of a postpubertal-type nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The authors highlight that non-germ cell malignancies, though rarely neuroendocrine, can arise within teratomas, underscoring the importance of recognizing this phenomenon for accurate diagnosis and management of metastatic germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-40448114.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)由来の細胞外小胞(EV)を細胞株・組織・血漿検体から単離し、miR-371-373クラスターとlet-7eの発現を検討した研究。奇形腫を除くTGCT検体でEV由来miR-371-373が上昇し、分化に伴い発現が変化した。臨床バイオマーカーとして用いられるmiR-371-373の多くがEVを介して分泌され、腫瘍細胞間コミュニケーションに関与することが示唆された。
pmid-40448114.summary_en: This study characterized extracellular vesicles (EVs) from testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cell lines, tissue, and patient plasma, examining miR-371-373 cluster and let-7e expression. EV-derived miR-371-373 was elevated in TGCT samples except teratoma, and levels changed with differentiation. The findings suggest circulating miR-371-373 used clinically as a TGCT biomarker is largely EV-secreted, implicating these microRNAs in intercellular communication and differentiation of germ cell tumors.

pmid-40446359.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に対するvNOTESと従来の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術(各21例)を比較した症例対照研究。vNOTES群で手術時間・在院時間の短縮、疼痛軽減、オピオイド使用減少、活動再開の早さ、腹腔内漏出の少なさ、費用削減が認められた。vNOTESが卵巣奇形腫手術の有用な低侵襲代替法であると結論している。
pmid-40446359.summary_en: This case-control study compared vNOTES with conventional laparoscopic cystectomy for ovarian teratoma (dermoid cysts) in 21 patients per group. vNOTES showed shorter operative time, shorter hospital stay, lower pain scores, less opioid use, faster return to activity, less intraperitoneal spillage, and lower cost than laparoscopy. The authors conclude vNOTES is a viable, cost-effective minimally invasive alternative for surgical management of ovarian teratoma.

pmid-40444095.summary_ja: 単胚葉性奇形腫の一種である卵巣性甲状腺腫(struma ovarii)40例を対象に、臨床病理および超音波・造影超音波・MRIによる多モダリティ画像所見を検討した後方視的研究。純粋型・混合型に分類し3例の悪性例(甲状腺カルチノイド)を認めた。嚢胞性・充実嚢胞混合性・充実性の画像パターンと特徴的所見を示し、稀な奇形腫亜型の診断に資する。
pmid-40444095.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed clinicopathological and multimodal imaging features (ultrasound, CEUS, MRI) of struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma, in 40 patients from a single center. Tumors were classified as pure or mixed struma ovarii, with three malignant cases (thyroid carcinoid); imaging patterns included cystic, cystic-solid, and solid types with characteristic enhancement and MRI signal features to aid diagnosis of this rare teratoma variant.

pmid-40443865.summary_ja: VACTERL連合の家族内発症例(男児)を報告した症例報告で、稀な合併症として仙尾部奇形腫を伴っていた。母方叔母にも同様の特徴があり乳児期に死亡していた。出生前の詳細な形態スキャンや遺伝学的検査による早期診断が管理方針決定に有用であるとし、稀な胚細胞腫瘍を含む先天異常の理解に寄与する。
pmid-40443865.summary_en: This case report describes a familial occurrence of VACTERL association in a male infant, notable for a rare co-occurring sacrococcygeal teratoma, alongside a maternal aunt with similar features who died in infancy. The authors emphasize that prenatal detection via detailed anomaly scans and genetic sequencing could improve early diagnosis and management counseling for families with VACTERL-associated congenital anomalies, including this rare germ cell tumor.

pmid-40443838.summary_ja: 22歳男性における縦隔原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(PMNSGCT)とクラインフェルター症候群の合併例。VIP療法後の手術切除で病理学的完全奏効が得られ追加化学療法は不要となり、性腺機能低下症にはテストステロン補充療法を実施した。PMNSGCTとクラインフェルター症候群の関連について文献的考察を行っている。
pmid-40443838.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man diagnosed with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (PMNSGCT) concurrently with Klinefelter syndrome. He was treated with VIP chemotherapy achieving complete pathologic response after surgical resection, avoiding adjuvant therapy, plus testosterone replacement for hypogonadism. The authors discuss the underrecognized association between PMNSGCT and Klinefelter syndrome and review evaluation and management approaches for this rare germ cell tumor presentation.

pmid-40442915.summary_ja: 10歳の思春期前女児に発生した非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌(NGOC)の症例報告と文献レビュー。腹痛・性器出血とhCGの著明高値を認め、画像で大きな不均一多血性付属器腫瘤を確認、病理学的にNGOCと診断された。性交渉のない若年女性でのhCG著明高値と付属器腫瘤はこの稀な卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を疑うべきと強調している。
pmid-40442915.summary_en: This case report and literature review describe a 10-year-old prepubertal girl with non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma (NGOC), presenting with abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, and markedly elevated hCG. Imaging showed a large heterogeneous hypervascular adnexal mass; surgical pathology confirmed NGOC with characteristic immunohistochemistry. The authors emphasize that markedly elevated hCG with adnexal mass in a sexually inactive young female should raise suspicion for this rare, aggressive ovarian germ cell tumor.

pmid-40437404.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍65例を対象に、MRIの見かけの拡散係数(ADC)値とヒストグラム解析による組織型(セミノーマ・非セミノーマ・悪性リンパ腫)鑑別能を検討した後方視的研究。非セミノーマはセミノーマ・リンパ腫よりADC比が有意に高く、セミノーマ・リンパ腫は尖度・歪度が高かった。術前MRIによる組織型予測が治療計画立案に有用と示唆している。
pmid-40437404.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated whether MRI apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values and histogram analysis could differentiate testicular tumor histological subtypes (seminoma, non-seminoma, malignant lymphoma) in 65 patients. Non-seminomas showed significantly higher ADC ratios than seminomas and lymphomas, while seminomas and lymphomas exhibited higher kurtosis and skewness than non-seminomas. The findings support preoperative MRI-based subtype prediction to guide counseling and treatment planning for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-40435996.summary_ja: 脳形成異常や学習障害などの多発異常を伴うセミノーマ患者の症例報告。全エクソーム解析でPDE11A遺伝子のフレームシフト変異が同定され、AlphaFold3による予測ではタンパク質機能への大きな影響が示唆された。この変異が多発異常とセミノーマ発症双方の説明因子となりうるとし、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における遺伝的要因の理解に寄与する。
pmid-40435996.summary_en: This case report describes a testicular seminoma patient with multiple abnormalities (brain dysplasia, social difficulties, learning impairment) in whom exome sequencing identified a PDE11A frameshift variant, predicted by AlphaFold3 to significantly affect protein function. The authors propose this variant as a possible unifying genetic explanation for both the patient's neurodevelopmental abnormalities and seminoma development, contributing to understanding of genetic risk factors in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-40434062.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来と考えられる後腹膜原発粘液性癌からの卵巣転移を来した66歳女性の症例報告。KRAS変異に加え本疾患では初となるERBB3変異が同定された。後腹膜粘液性癌が奇形腫から発生しうるという仮説を分子的に裏付けた初の報告であり、胚細胞腫瘍内での体細胞型悪性転化への新たな知見を提供する。
pmid-40434062.summary_en: This case report describes a 66-year-old woman with ovarian metastases from a primary retroperitoneal mucinous carcinoma that arose from a mature cystic teratoma, harboring a KRAS mutation and a novel ERBB3 mutation. This is the first molecularly characterized case supporting the theory that such rare retroperitoneal mucinous carcinomas can develop from teratoma, similar to their ovarian counterparts, contributing new insight into somatic malignant transformation arising within germ cell tumors.

pmid-40429559.summary_ja: 23歳男性の転移性精巣混合性胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ・胎児性癌・奇形腫成分)で、下大静脈から右房への稀な心内進展を来した症例報告。肺・肝・リンパ節転移も認めたが、根治的精巣摘除術とBEP化学療法によって心内腫瘤と腫瘍マーカーが著明に縮小した。稀な転移パターンを示す精巣胚細胞腫瘍の集学的管理の有効性を示す。
pmid-40429559.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma components) with rare intracardiac extension into the right atrium via the inferior vena cava, alongside pulmonary, liver, and lymph node metastases. Treatment with orchiectomy and BEP chemotherapy achieved significant reduction in cardiac mass and tumor markers, illustrating effective management of this rare metastatic presentation of testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-40428242.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を背景に発生した卵巣ストルーマカルチノイドの40歳女性例。形態学的・免疫組織化学的所見(新規の単細胞増殖パターンを含む)により、カルチノイド成分が甲状腺濾胞上皮の神経内分泌分化に由来するという仮説を支持した。稀な単胚葉性奇形腫亜型の組織発生に関する新知見を提供し、正確な鑑別診断に資する。
pmid-40428242.summary_en: This case report and literature review describe a 40-year-old woman with an ovarian strumal carcinoid arising within a mature cystic teratoma. Morphological and immunohistochemical findings, including a novel single-cell growth pattern, support the hypothesis that the carcinoid component originates from thyroid follicular epithelium undergoing neuroendocrine differentiation, offering new insight into the histogenesis of this rare monodermal teratoma variant important for accurate diagnosis.

pmid-40427134.summary_ja: 小児生殖腺腫瘍、特にGCTと奇形腫の診断における高次高調波生成顕微鏡の有用性評価。HHGMは腫瘍検出で75%の精度を達成し、従来の組織学の89%と比較された。
pmid-40427134.summary_en: Evaluation of higher harmonic generation microscopy (HHGM) as rapid imaging technique for assessing pediatric gonadal tumors including germ cell tumors and teratomas. HHGM achieved 75% accuracy for tumor detection versus 89% for conventional histology, showing promise for sample assessment in rare tumor population.

pmid-40425355.summary_ja: 腎移植後に発生する精巣がん（GCT）の医学的レビュー。セミノーマGCTが最も一般的。リスク3倍増加、典型的に45歳、移植後5年で診断される。化学療法が放射線療法より好まれる。
pmid-40425355.summary_en: Narrative review of testicular cancer (GCT) developing after renal transplantation. Seminomatous GCTs are most common histologic subtype. Discusses 3-fold increased risk, typical diagnosis around age 45 and 5 years post-transplant, and management challenges favoring chemotherapy over radiotherapy in immunosuppressed patients.

pmid-40425215.summary_ja: 新生児の眼窩から前頭洞に拡張した大きな皮様嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の症例報告。外科的摘出と皮膚脂肪移植により良好な整容結果が得られた。
pmid-40425215.summary_en: Case report of congenital microphthalmos with large orbital dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) extending to frontal sinus in newborn. Surgical removal and orbital reconstruction with dermis-fat graft achieved good cosmetic outcome with no recurrence; rudimentary globe was enucleated.

pmid-40424566.summary_ja: 15年間にわたる85名の小児卵巣腫瘤患者の後方視的研究。胚細胞腫瘍が最も一般的(67.1%)、上皮性腫瘍が続く(22.4%)。32.9%に化学療法施行；生存率98%で優れた転帰、未熟奇形腫での再発は1例のみ。
pmid-40424566.summary_en: Retrospective study of 85 pediatric patients with ovarian masses over 15 years. Germ cell tumors were most common (67.1%), followed by epithelial tumors (22.4%). Chemotherapy administered to 32.9%; excellent outcomes with 98% survival rate and only one recurrence among immature teratomas.

pmid-40419115.summary_ja: 放射線療法で治療されたセミノーマ患者における第二次原発がんリスクのシステマティックレビュー。膵臓、腎臓、胃および膀胱の一貫した過剰リスクを記録。60年間の治療プロトコール進化を概説し、線量を30～40Gyから20～26Gyに低下させ、病期Iでの積極的監視への転換、陽子線療法は臓器リスク線量削減の可能性を示す。
pmid-40419115.summary_en: Systematic review of secondary primary cancer risks in seminoma patients treated with radiotherapy. Documents consistent excess risks for pancreas, kidney, stomach, and bladder after RT. Reviews 60-year evolution of protocols including dose reduction from 30-40 to 20-26 Gy and shift toward active surveillance for stage I, with proton therapy showing potential OAR dose reduction.

pmid-40416211.summary_ja: 急性呼吸困難で発症した新生児の後縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告。CT検査で固形および嚢胞性成分を含む大きな腫瘤を確認。外科的摘出で成熟奇形腫と確定診断された。
pmid-40416211.summary_en: Case report of mature teratoma of posterior mediastinum in 9-day-old female newborn presenting with acute respiratory distress and respiratory failure. CT confirmed large mass with solid and cystic components; surgical removal confirmed mature teratoma on pathology with smooth postoperative recovery.

pmid-40414312.summary_ja: 絨毛癌とその他のGCTにおけるTROP2とネクチン-4発現の評価。抗体薬物複合体の治療標的としての可能性を検討。絨毛癌はコントロール群より有意に高いネクチン-4発現を示した。
pmid-40414312.summary_en: Assessment of TROP2 and nectin-4 expression in choriocarcinoma and other germ cell tumors to evaluate antibody-drug conjugate therapeutic potential. Choriocarcinomas showed significantly higher nectin-4 expression (median 60) compared to control GCT types, with 27.8% showing H-scores >200.

pmid-40413529.summary_ja: 子宮外栄養膜腫瘍(稀な妊娠性絨毛性疾患)が結腸に生じた症例報告。下腹痛および左腸骨窩腫瘤として呈示。病理組織学的および免疫組織化学分析で診断確認；患者は診断後1カ月で死亡。
pmid-40413529.summary_en: Case report of extrauterine epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (rare gestational trophoblastic disease) arising in colon, presenting as lower abdominal pain and palpable mass in left iliac fossa. Histopathological and immunohistochemical analysis confirmed diagnosis; patient died one month after diagnosis.

pmid-40398907.summary_ja: 帝王切開瘢痕異所妊娠として初期治療された絨毛癌（GTD）の症例報告。膣出血で初期妊娠期に発症。病理学的検査で絨毛癌と確定診断された。
pmid-40398907.summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic disease (choriocarcinoma) presenting as cesarean-scar ectopic pregnancy with vaginal bleeding in early pregnancy. Initially managed as ectopic pregnancy; histology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Highlights importance of excluding GTD in early pregnancy bleeding evaluation.

pmid-40395359.summary_ja: 造影超音波(CEUS)を用いた精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の診断における有用性の症例報告。CEUSは実時間灌流特性を提供し、従来の超音波を超えて良性および悪性腫瘍の鑑別に寄与する。
pmid-40395359.summary_en: Case report demonstrating utility of contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) in diagnosing testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. CEUS provides superior real-time perfusion characterization of testicular masses, aiding differentiation between benign and malignant neoplasms beyond conventional ultrasound.

pmid-40393258.summary_ja: 精巣切除後に積極的監視で管理される病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍における再発検出法のシステマティックレビュー。11,414患者中2,232再発の分析で、60%が画像検査のみで検出、24%が腫瘍マーカーで、身体診察のみは1.5%で、必須の身体診察なしでの安全な積極的監視を支持。
pmid-40393258.summary_en: Systematic review of relapse detection methods in stage I testicular germ cell tumors managed with active surveillance after orchidectomy. Analysis of 2,232 relapses among 11,414 patients shows 60% detected by imaging alone, 24% by tumor markers, and only 1.5% by physical examination, supporting safe AS without mandatory physical examination.

pmid-40390953.summary_ja: 妊娠中の持続的な付属器腫瘤に関する後方視的研究。成熟奇形腫が最も一般的な組織学的所見(32%)で、90%が良性、10%が悪性腫瘍。良性所見の腫瘤は分娩まで保存的管理で可能であり、母体胎児転帰に悪影響なし。
pmid-40390953.summary_en: Retrospective study of 63 pregnant women with persistent adnexal masses. Mature teratoma was most common histology (32%), with 90% benign and 10% malignant. Supports conservative management of imaging-benign masses until delivery without adverse feto-maternal outcomes.

pmid-40390944.summary_ja: 卵巣における3つの異なる腫瘍の同時存在の珍しい症例報告：内膜症性嚢胞、線維腫、および成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。完全摘出と卵巣保存を達成した。
pmid-40390944.summary_en: Case report of rare coexistence of three distinct ovarian tumors: endometriotic cyst and fibroma in one ovary, and mature cystic teratoma in the other. Combined laparoscopic and laparotomy approach used to completely remove tumors while preserving healthy ovarian tissue.

pmid-40390927.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫と悪性ブレンナー腫瘍の衝突腫瘍についての症例報告。両方の組織型の正確な診断が管理と予後の決定に重要である。
pmid-40390927.summary_en: Case report of rare ovarian collision tumor combining mature teratoma with malignant Brenner tumor. Immunohistochemical examination essential for accurate diagnosis of both distinct histological components; diagnosis determines further management and disease prognosis.

pmid-40390880.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の悪性転化の予後バイオマーカーとしての免疫組織化学マーカー評価。27症例の追跡で、p53過剰発現が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍への進行と相関し、NM23は正常な回帰に対する高い陰性予測値を示した。
pmid-40390880.summary_en: Study evaluating immunohistochemical markers (p53, EGFR, HER2, NM23) as prognostic biomarkers for malignant transformation of hydatidiform moles (GTD). Follow-up of 27 molar pregnancies found p53 overexpression correlated with progression to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia; NM23 showed high negative predictive value for normal regression.

pmid-40387112.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の超音波診断における子宮動脈ドップラー拍動指数の価値評価。PSTTで他の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と比較してより高い平均UtA-PIと低い内膜血管性を認め、新規な鑑別診断マーカーを提供する。
pmid-40387112.summary_en: Prospective cohort study evaluating uterine artery Doppler pulsatility index (UtA-PI) for ultrasound diagnosis of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a form of GTD. Higher mean UtA-PI and lower endometrial vascularity in PSTT compared to other GTN forms provide novel differential diagnostic markers.

pmid-40387041.summary_ja: IGCCCG良好予後転移性セミノーマに対するデエスカレーション化学療法(エトポシド/シスプラチン3サイクル)と標準療法の比較。デエスカレーション群で同等の生存転帰と軽微な有害事象低下を認め、転移腫瘍負荷が低い患者での減量化学療法を支持する。
pmid-40387041.summary_en: Single-center retrospective study of de-escalation chemotherapy (three cycles etoposide/cisplatin) versus standard therapy in IGCCCG good prognosis metastatic seminoma. Comparable survival outcomes with slightly lower adverse event rates in de-escalation group, providing preliminary basis for reduced chemotherapy in selected patients with lower metastatic burden.

pmid-40385882.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫から生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例報告。腹痛を呈する46歳女性。手術で乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫が診断され、TSH抑制療法と長期フォローアップが必要。
pmid-40385882.summary_en: Case report of papillary thyroid carcinoma arising from malignant struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue). 46-year-old woman with abdominal pain; surgery revealed struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma requiring TSH suppression therapy and long-term surveillance.

pmid-40382859.summary_ja: 小さい精巣腫瘤（5-20mm）におけるGCT予測のための血清マイクロRNA 371の臨床試験。マイクロRNA 371はGCT検出の高い感度と陰性予測値を示し、スクリーニングバイオマーカーとして有用であった。
pmid-40382859.summary_en: Prospective clinical trial evaluating serum miRNA 371 for predicting germ cell tumors in small testicular masses (5-20 mm). Among 32 patients, 65.6% had GCTs (14 seminomas, 6 non-seminomas, 1 GCNIS). miRNA 371 showed 100% sensitivity and 100% NPV at RQ cutoff 5, supporting use as screening biomarker for small masses.

pmid-40381816.summary_ja: P19胚腫細胞株におけるANT2枯渇後の代謝リモデリングを検討。OXPHOS機構と僧帽体機能の障害、細胞増殖と球形成能の低下が認められ、ANT2が癌幹細胞生存の重要な調節因子であることが示唆された。
pmid-40381816.summary_en: This study examines metabolic reprogramming in P19 embryonal carcinoma stem cells after ANT2 depletion. Results show compromised OXPHOS machinery and mitochondrial dysfunction, with decreased cell growth and sphere-forming ability, identifying ANT2 as a key regulator of cancer stem cell survival.

pmid-40378498.summary_ja: 本単一施設研究は、標準化されたEAU報告ガイドラインを使用して、69人の精巣がん患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の周術期合併症を分析した。ほとんどの患者が合併症を経験(96%)し、貧血と消化管症状が最も一般的で、重篤な合併症は稀だが罹患率負担は有意であった。
pmid-40378498.summary_en: This single-center study analyzes perioperative complications of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 69 testicular cancer patients using standardized EAU reporting guidelines. Most patients experienced complications (96%), with anemia and gastrointestinal issues most common; major complications were rare but morbidity burden was significant.

pmid-40377623.summary_ja: 本症例集積は、血球貪食症候群を伴う原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍、消化管転移、骨転移、心臓血栓塞栓症、および高齢者のセルトリ・ライディヒ細胞腫瘍を含む胚細胞腫瘍の異常な提示を報告し、診断および治療上の課題を強調する。
pmid-40377623.summary_en: This case series presents unusual presentations of germ cell tumors including primary mediastinal GCT with hemophagocytosis, gastrointestinal involvement, bone metastases, cardiac thrombosis, and a rare Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor in an elderly patient, highlighting diagnostic and management challenges.

pmid-40376581.summary_ja: 本症例は、結腸に浸潤する成熟卵巣奇形腫により結腸重積症と閉塞を引き起こした40歳女性を報告した。腹腔鏡検査により卵巣奇形腫が原因と判明し、部分結腸切除術と卵巣摘出術が実施された。術後経過は良好であった。
pmid-40376581.summary_en: This case reports colonic intussusception and obstruction caused by a mature ovarian teratoma invading the colon in a 40-year-old female. Laparoscopic exploration revealed the teratoma as the cause, requiring partial colectomy and oophorectomy with good postoperative recovery.

pmid-40376475.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍および化学療法後残存腫瘤を有する33歳患者における単一体位仰臥位ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清術技術を記述し、より侵襲性が低く効率的なアプローチを提供する。
pmid-40376475.summary_en: This case report describes a single-position supine robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection technique for nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors and post-chemotherapy residual masses in a 33-year-old patient, offering a less invasive and more efficient approach.

pmid-40370908.summary_ja: 本症例は43歳女性の卵巣甲状腺腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌と、3年後に診断された甲状腺微小癌を記述した。転移性疾患と原発腫瘍の区別における診断上の課題が論じられた。
pmid-40370908.summary_en: This case describes papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii (monodermal ovarian teratoma) in a 43-year-old woman, with subsequent thyroid microcarcinoma diagnosis 3 years later. Diagnostic challenges in distinguishing metastatic disease from primary tumors are discussed.

pmid-40370905.summary_ja: 本症例は、水疱妊娠に続く消化管出血を呈する30歳患者の妊娠性絨毛癌の腸転移を報告した。極めて上昇したhCG値(>1,000,000 IU/mL)と画像検査により転移性疾患が確認された。合併症により化学療法にもかかわらず患者の死亡に至った。
pmid-40370905.summary_en: This case reports intestinal metastasis of gestational choriocarcinoma in a 30-year-old patient with gastrointestinal bleeding following molar pregnancy. Extremely elevated hCG levels (>1,000,000 IU/mL) and imaging confirmed metastatic disease. Complications led to patient death despite chemotherapy.

pmid-40370896.summary_ja: 本症例は、腹部膨満と熱を呈する出生後15日の新生児における原発性後腹膜奇形腫を記述した。出生前超音波検査は妊娠22～23週に嚢胞性病変を検出し、妊娠29～30週までに固形成分と石灰化を示すように進展した。外科的切除により出血性梗塞が確認された。
pmid-40370896.summary_en: This case describes a primary retroperitoneal teratoma in a 15-day-old neonate presenting with abdominal distension and fever. Prenatal ultrasound detected a cystic lesion that evolved to show solid components and calcifications. Surgical excision confirmed hemorrhagic infarction.

pmid-40370888.summary_ja: 23歳の若年女性に発症した卵巣未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合型胚細胞腫瘍症例(腫瘍サイズ36.5 x 27 x 23.9 cm、小腸・大網・腹膜転移)。病期分類手術とBEP化学療法(4サイクル)を施行したが、化学療法に反応せず、臨床試験での治療継続予定。
pmid-40370888.summary_en: This case report describes a mixed malignant ovarian germ cell tumor in a 23-year-old woman containing immature teratoma (60%) and yolk sac tumor (40%) with extensive metastases. Despite surgery and BEP chemotherapy, poor response was noted.

pmid-40369679.summary_ja: 25歳の若年成人における成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌(FIGO病期IIIA1とIC2)の2症例。両患者は妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法+PD-1阻害薬免疫療法を受け、完全奏効を達成し、14～16ヶ月間奏効を維持している。
pmid-40369679.summary_en: This case series reports squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratomas in two 25-year-old women (FIGO stage IIIA1 and IC2). Both underwent fertility-sparing surgery and received chemotherapy combined with PD-1 inhibitor immunotherapy, achieving complete response.

pmid-40367575.summary_ja: 本研究はTGCT組織と細胞株を用いてcircNOLC1の精巣胚細胞腫瘍進行における役割を調査し、circNOLC1の上昇がリンパ節転移と臨床病期と相関していることを明らかにした。circNOLC1はmiRNA-140-5pのスポンジとして機能し、IGF1R発現を上昇させることでTGCT進行を促進する。
pmid-40367575.summary_en: This study investigates circNOLC1's role in testicular germ cell tumor progression using TGCT tissues and cell lines. Elevated circNOLC1 correlates with lymph node metastasis and clinical stage. CircNOLC1 acts as miRNA-140-5p sponge to upregulate IGF1R, promoting TGCT progression.

pmid-40364866.summary_ja: デンマーク1952例の精巣がん患者と19,431例の対照者の登録ベースコホート研究。精巣がん患者は診断前に複数の健康領域で有意に高い罹病率を示し、精巣異形成症候群仮説では説明されない広範な疾患リスク増加を示唆している。
pmid-40364866.summary_en: This Danish registry-based cohort study of 1,952 testicular cancer patients and 19,431 controls found TC patients had significantly higher pre-existing morbidity across multiple health domains, challenging conventional hypotheses and highlighting broader health burden prior to diagnosis.

pmid-40361325.summary_ja: 本システマティックレビューは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における甲状腺機能亢進症を検討し、32例の絨毛癌および1例のPSTTを同定。甲状腺機能障害は、hCGが甲状腺刺激ホルモン交差反応性を介してを含む複数の経路を介して発生する。症状は通常治療後2-3週間以内に寛解する。
pmid-40361325.summary_en: This systematic review examines hyperthyroidism in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, identifying 32 choriocarcinomas and one PSTT. Thyroid dysfunction occurs via multiple pathways including hCG-mediated TSH cross-reactivity. Symptoms typically resolve within 2-3 weeks after treatment.

pmid-40358182.summary_ja: 二側性精巣GCT 38例（9例でゲノム解析）を全エクソーム解析とエピジェネティック解析で評価。セミノーマと非セミノーマは分子的に異なり、二側性腫瘍間での保存された変異は観察されず遺伝的ではなく細胞起源を示唆。
pmid-40358182.summary_en: This study evaluated 38 bilateral testicular GCT cases (9 with genomic analysis) using whole-exome sequencing and epigenetic analysis. Seminomas and non-seminomas were molecularly distinct. No conserved mutations between bilateral tumors suggested cellular rather than genetic origin.

pmid-40357676.summary_ja: 口底に伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫および関連する新生児口蓋裂の稀な症例報告。臨床的発現、画像特性、病理学的知見、およびこの稀な新生児頭頸部腫瘍の外科的管理戦略の包括的分析。
pmid-40357676.summary_en: This case reports a rare mature cystic teratoma of the floor of mouth with associated cleft palate in a newborn. Comprehensive analysis of clinical manifestations, imaging characteristics, pathological findings, and surgical management strategies for this uncommon neonatal head and neck tumor.

pmid-40355173.summary_ja: 32歳女性の二側性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と左セルトリ・ライディヒ細胞腫瘍の症例。高アンドロゲン血症と無月経で発症。腹腔鏡下腫瘍切除後にテストステロン値が有意に低下。妊孕性温存手術を施行した。
pmid-40355173.summary_en: This case describes a 32-year-old woman with bilateral mature cystic teratomas and left Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor presenting with hyperandrogenemia and amenorrhea. Laparoscopic tumor resection resulted in significant testosterone decrease. Fertility-sparing surgery was performed.

pmid-40352738.summary_ja: 先天性咽頭部奇形腫と両側口唇裂・口蓋裂の稀有な合併例。多臓器協働による早期診断と完全切除が重要。新生児の気道管理と外科的治療戦略を述べている。
pmid-40352738.summary_en: Case of large congenital oropharyngeal teratoma (germ cell tumor) in neonate with bilateral cleft lip and palate and imperforate anus. Highlights diagnostic and surgical challenges in managing complex craniofacial germ cell tumors. Successful outcome required early diagnosis, multidisciplinary collaboration, and complete surgical excision despite dense adhesions.

pmid-40352026.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣の既往を有する16歳における極めてまれな両側セミノーマの症例報告。病理学的特徴、治療(両側精巣摘除術)、病期Iの疾患分類について論じている。小児同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍における生殖能温存、ホルモンモニタリング、および長期フォローアップの重要性を強調する。
pmid-40352026.summary_en: Case report of rare bilateral seminoma in 16-year-old with history of bilateral cryptorchidism. Discusses pathological features, treatment (bilateral orchiectomy), stage I disease classification. Emphasizes importance of fertility preservation, hormonal monitoring, and long-term follow-up in pediatric synchronous bilateral germ cell tumors.

pmid-40348473.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（良性胚細胞腫瘍）と潜在的な悪性転化のレビュー。様々な転化タイプの臨床的および生物学的特徴、臨床的行動の差異および治療的アプローチについて論じている。良性と悪性MCTの間で管理戦略が大きく異なることを強調する。
pmid-40348473.summary_en: Review of mature cystic teratomas (benign germ cell tumors) and their potential malignant transformations. Discusses clinical and biological features of various transformation types, differences in clinical behavior and therapeutic approaches. Emphasizes that management strategies differ significantly between benign and malignant MCT.

pmid-40347919.summary_ja: 459例のセミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の後方視的研究において、極早期再発(<12ヶ月)は転移性疾患で高い転移負荷および悪いhCG/LDHレベルと関連し、全生存期間が有意に低下していた。治療医は治療強化の早期検討が必要。
pmid-40347919.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 459 seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients assessing very early relapse (VER, <12 months) versus later relapse patterns. VER in metastatic disease associated with higher tumor burden at diagnosis and significantly worse overall survival. Identifies HCG and LDH levels as prognostic markers to guide treatment intensification decisions.

pmid-40344740.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、混合型腫瘍)から腹膜液細胞診を用いた永続的細胞株の確立技術について述べている。細胞株は免疫蛍光顕微鏡検査およびフロー・サイトメトリーで特性化され、化学療法感受性パターンは臨床反応を反映し、個人化治療を実現する。
pmid-40344740.summary_en: Describes novel technique for establishing permanent cell lines from malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumor, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, mixed tumors) using peritoneal cytology. Cell lines characterized by immunofluorescence and flow cytometry with chemosensitivity patterns reflecting clinical responses, enabling functional studies and personalized treatment approaches.

pmid-40343905.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者のマイクロRNA(miR-371-3、miR-302/367)バイオマーカー研究。生存可能非奇形腫腫瘍は有意に上昇した血漿および組織マイクロRNAレベルを示し、疾患負荷および治療反応と相関し、臨床管理のための循環バイオマーカー化の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-40343905.summary_en: Study of microRNA biomarkers (miR-371-3, miR-302/367) in ovarian germ cell tumors comparing viable non-teratoma tumors (VNTGC) and immature teratoma (ITGC). VNTGC showed significantly elevated plasma and tissue miRNA levels, with kinetics correlating to disease burden and treatment response, suggesting potential as circulating biomarkers for clinical management.

pmid-40337054.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の大きな傍大静脈リンパ節塊および下大静脈-心房腫瘍栓の症例。体外循環、胸骨切開、血管再建、および完全腫瘍切除を必要とする複雑な外科的管理について記述。多面的画像診断と外科的専門技術の重要性を強調している。
pmid-40337054.summary_en: Case report of metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor with large paracaval lymph node mass and contiguous cavo-atrial thrombus extending to right atrium. Describes complex surgical management requiring cardiopulmonary bypass, vascular reconstruction, and complete tumor resection emphasizing importance of multimodal imaging and surgical expertise.

pmid-40336679.summary_ja: 生後10日の新生児に発症した極めてまれな高度未熟胃奇形腫（胚細胞腫瘍）の症例であり、緊急手術が必要であった。出生時に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著しく上昇していた。部分胃切除術による外科的切除は密な癒着にもかかわらず完全な縁辺を達成した。病理組織学的検査は悪性胚細胞成分を伴わないIII度未熟奇形腫を確認した。
pmid-40336679.summary_en: Case of rare high-grade immature gastric teratoma (germ cell tumor) in 10-day-old neonate requiring emergent surgery. Markedly elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) at birth. Surgical resection with partial gastrectomy achieved complete margins despite dense adhesions. Histopathology confirmed grade III immature teratoma without malignant germ cell components.

pmid-40330267.summary_ja: 大量陰嚢水腫と上昇したAFPを伴う精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者(45歳)。CT検査は両側精巣病変を示唆したが、術中所見と腫瘍マーカーにより単側病変と判明。診断における画像検査、病理組織学、および臨床判断の統合の重要性を示しています。
pmid-40330267.summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor (TMGCT) with seminoma component in 45-year-old with massive hydrocele and elevated AFP. CT imaging suggested bilateral disease but intraoperative findings and tumor markers led to appropriate histological interpretation. Demonstrates importance of integrating clinical judgment, intraoperative assessment, and tumor markers for accurate diagnosis.

pmid-40327914.summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の悪性転化症例。腹痛と体重減少で発症。病期分類開腹術で左卵巣腫瘤と腹水を確認。外科的切除と化学療法を施行しましたが、フォローアップの継続が困難で、遠隔地での治療継続の課題を示しています。
pmid-40327914.summary_en: Case of malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (germ cell tumor) to squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) in 25-year-old woman. Presents with abdominal pain and weight loss. Staging laparotomy and surgical resection performed. Case highlights rarity of malignant transformation in younger women and challenges of surveillance maintenance, emphasizing importance of follow-up compliance.

pmid-40324936.summary_ja: 皮膚筋炎として発症した精巣セミノーマの傍腫瘍症候群症例。患者は進行性近位筋弱力、高度なCK上昇、特徴的な皮膚所見を呈しました。包括的な悪性腫瘍検索でセミノーマが発見されました。傍腫瘍症候群としての皮膚筋炎の稀有性と悪性腫瘍検索の重要性を示しています。
pmid-40324936.summary_en: Case report of dermatomyositis (DM) as paraneoplastic manifestation of pure seminoma (testicular germ cell tumor). Patient presented with progressive proximal muscle weakness, elevated creatine kinase, and characteristic skin/periungual features. Underlying seminoma discovered during comprehensive malignancy workup. Case underscores importance of malignancy screening in paraneoplastic syndromes.

pmid-40324110.summary_ja: 精巣がん(主に胚細胞腫瘍)の多重療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法による優れた成績と、長期生存者の長期的健康障害を包括的にレビュー。内分泌機能障害、心血管疾患、二次悪性腫瘍、神経障害などの合併症、病期IIセミノーマなどの治療縮小戦略を討議。学際的アプローチによる生活の質向上を強調しました。
pmid-40324110.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular cancer (predominantly germ cell tumors) advances in multimodal therapy, cisplatin-based chemotherapy outcomes, and long-term survivorship issues. Discusses treatment-related complications (endocrine dysfunction, cardiovascular disease, secondary malignancies, neuropathy), de-escalation strategies for stage II seminoma, and multidisciplinary approach to optimize quality of life.

pmid-40323395.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の臨床管理と予後に関する集団ベース研究。MTX、EMA-CO治療の実臨床パターンと治療抵抗例を報告。
pmid-40323395.summary_en: Population-based registry analysis of 38 gestational choriocarcinoma patients in Germany (2015-2023). Documents real-world treatment patterns (MTX, EMA-CO regimens), outcomes, and adverse events. Reports treatment resistance in some cases requiring escalation. Emphasizes importance of individualized treatment and close monitoring for optimal management of this rare gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-40321316.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのマルチオミクス解析。SPTBN4が診断、予後、免疫抑制に関連する重要な分子バイオマーカーとして同定。化学療法感受性と関連。
pmid-40321316.summary_en: Multiomics study of testicular seminomas using single-cell RNA sequencing and weighted gene coexpression analysis. Identifies SPTBN4 as key biomarker associated with advanced disease, immunosuppressive microenvironment, and poor prognosis. Demonstrates increased chemotherapy sensitivity in SPTBN4-high tumors, providing potential therapeutic guidance and precision medicine strategy for seminoma management.

pmid-40316993.summary_ja: 27歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の悪性転化症例。術中凍結切片では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されたが、確定診断で扁平上皮癌と判明。凍結切片分析の限界と包括的評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-40316993.summary_en: Case of malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma (germ cell tumor) to squamous cell carcinoma in 27-year-old woman with chronic abdominal pain. Imaging suggested MCT with malignancy features but intraoperative frozen section initially misread as MCT. Definitive histopathology confirmed SCC, highlighting limitations of frozen section and need for comprehensive evaluation.

pmid-40313596.summary_ja: 17α-ヒドロキシラーゼ/17,20-リアーゼ欠損症の46,XY女性患者における精巣腫瘍(セミノーマおよび精巣内癌)の2例報告。CYP17A1病原性バリアントを同定。46,XY患者における悪性腫瘍危険性を強調し、予防的去勢の危険性と利益について検討しました。
pmid-40313596.summary_en: Two case reports of 46,XY female patients with 17α-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency who developed testicular tumors including seminoma and germ cell neoplasia in situ. Emphasizes increased malignant tumor risk in 46,XY patients with this endocrine condition, adding evidence to risk/benefit discussion of prophylactic gonadectomy. Pathogenic CYP17A1 variants identified.

pmid-40312843.summary_ja: フランスの152人の小児頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍患者(出生～17歳)を対象とした多施設後方視的研究。150例は成熟/未熟奇形腫、2例は悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍。悪性転化率は低く(1.3%)、新生児例では定期的臨床診察のみで長期腫瘍学的監視は不要。
pmid-40312843.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 152 pediatric head and neck germ cell tumor patients (birth-17 years) in France 2000-2021. Most (150/152) contained mature or immature teratoma; two were malignant yolk sac tumors. Surgery was primary treatment. Low malignant degeneration rate (1.3%) and excellent survival suggest conservative follow-up without systematic oncologic monitoring for neonatal MIT HN-GCT.

pmid-40311506.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者にシスプラチン化学療法中の悪心・嘔吐予防にオランザピンを追加する第III相試験。オランザピン群で完全奏効率が有意に高く（55.8% vs 36.3%）、毒性増加なし。
pmid-40311506.summary_en: Phase III trial evaluating olanzapine combined with triple antiemetic therapy for chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting in 77 germ cell tumor patients receiving 5-day cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Olanzapine group showed significantly higher complete response rates (55.8% vs 36.3%, P=0.03) with no increased toxicity.

pmid-40308496.summary_ja: 病期IIICの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、肺、腎臓、リンパ節への転移を伴い、下大静脈腫瘍栓が合併した症例を報告しました。多科的チームによる討議のもと、手術と補助化学療法を含む治療を行い、良好な治療転帰を得られました。
pmid-40308496.summary_en: Case report of stage IIIC mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumor with metastases to lungs, kidney, and lymph nodes, complicated by inferior vena cava tumor thrombus. Multidisciplinary management including surgery and chemotherapy resulted in optimal therapeutic outcomes.

pmid-40307627.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対するロボット支援下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の初期イギリス経験。対象は24患者で大多数が化学療法後でした。平均コンソール時間171分、出血量190mlの安全な手術でした。最も一般的な病理所見は奇形腫(70%)で、腫瘍学的転帰は良好でした。
pmid-40307627.summary_en: First UK case series of 24 robotic-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer, mostly post-chemotherapy. Safe procedure with mean console time 171 min and blood loss 190 ml. Most common pathology was teratoma (70%) with favorable oncological outcomes.

pmid-40304839.summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍31例の30年間の長期転帰。縦隔が59%で最多。化学療法後の奏効率81%、5・10年生存率70%。縦隔NSGCTの予後が最悪。
pmid-40304839.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 31 extragonadal germ cell tumor patients from 1994-2024. Most common sites: mediastinum (59%), retroperitoneum, and CNS. After chemotherapy, disease control rate was 81%. 5- and 10-year overall survival were 70%, with mediastinal NSGCT showing worst prognosis (34%).

pmid-40302085.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍190例。胚細胞腫瘍が50.79%、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が98%を占める。第2-3四半期の手術で18.75%が流産。
pmid-40302085.summary_en: Retrospective study of 190 ovarian tumors during pregnancy among 41,842 pregnant women (4.5 per 1,000 pregnancies). Germ cell tumors comprised 50.79% of surgical cases, with mature cystic teratoma in 98%. Most surgeries in 2nd-3rd trimester with 18.75% fetal loss rate.

pmid-40300267.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に関連した粘液性腫瘍50例の臨床病理学的研究。ほとんどはミューラー管/体腔上皮型でFIGO病期Iでした。粘液性癌は最も悪い転帰を示し、死亡3例と再発4例が報告されました。
pmid-40300267.summary_en: Clinicopathologic study of 50 mucinous neoplasms associated with ovarian mature cystic teratomas. Most were Müllerian/surface epithelial type (82%) and FIGO stage I. Mucinous carcinomas had worst outcomes with 3 deaths and 4 recurrences.

pmid-40295046.summary_ja: 117例の卵巣成熟奇形腫のPTENとリン酸化AKT発現の検討。PI3K/AKT経路の異常が発生に関与している可能性が示唆される。
pmid-40295046.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of PTEN and phosphorylated AKT expression in 117 mature ovarian teratomas. Elevated P-AKT and altered PTEN expression suggest involvement of PI3K/AKT pathway in teratoma pathogenesis, supporting role of signaling abnormalities in tumor development.

pmid-40288532.summary_ja: 分娩後に新生児男性患者で診断された頭頸部領域の先天性成熟奇形腫3症例。全例がGonzalez-Crussi分類G0。鼻咽頭部位の奇形腫は外科的切除が第一選択。画像検査と検査室検査を含む長期フォローアップが必要。
pmid-40288532.summary_en: Three cases of congenital head and neck mature teratomas diagnosed post-birth in newborn males. All classified as G0 (Gonzalez-Crussi grade 0). Nasopharyngeal-located teratomas required surgical resection as first-line treatment with long-term follow-up.

pmid-40282394.summary_ja: 母親由来第6染色体一親性ダイソミーの患者の仙尾部奇形腫。宮内発育不全、発達遅滞、自閉症スペクトラム障害を呈示。24例の既報例の文献検討。
pmid-40282394.summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma in female with maternal uniparental isodisomy of chromosome 6, presenting with intrauterine growth restriction, developmental delay, autism spectrum disorder, and dysmorphic features. Literature review of 24 confirmed UPD(6)mat cases identified frequent IUGR and neurodevelopmental issues.

pmid-40280586.summary_ja: 左未熟卵巣奇形腫（病期IC1）と診断された21歳女性の症例。妊孕性温存のため両側卵巣嚢腫切除術と化学療法を施行。その後growing teratoma syndromeで反復手術が必要。補助生殖技術で妊娠成功し、健康な男児を分娩。
pmid-40280586.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old with left immature ovarian teratoma (stage IC1) treated with cystectomy and chemotherapy for fertility preservation. Developed growing teratoma syndrome with repeated ovarian surgeries. Assisted reproduction resulted in successful healthy male delivery.

pmid-40279260.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴う微小石灰化の形成メカニズム。FGF23の異常な切断が関与。ミネラルホメオスタシスの局所的異常が骨様分化を誘導。
pmid-40279260.summary_en: Study of testicular microcalcifications in germ cell tumor development. FGF23 expressed in testicular germ cell neoplasia in situ and embryonal carcinoma undergoes aberrant cleavage. Local mineral homeostasis dysregulation and reduced mineralization inhibitors lead to osteogenic differentiation and hydroxyapatite deposition.

pmid-40277298.summary_ja: AFP高値の縦隔NUT癌がGCTを模倣した症例。血清miR-371a-3p陰性で診断疑い。全ゲノムシーケンシングでBRD4::NUTM1融合を確認。分子診断の有用性を示示。
pmid-40277298.summary_en: Case of mediastinal NUT carcinoma mimicking malignant non-seminomatous GCT due to elevated serum AFP and metastases. Serum miR-371a-3p negativity raised diagnostic suspicion. Whole genome sequencing identified BRD4::NUTM1 fusion, demonstrating importance of molecular testing.

pmid-40276387.summary_ja: 精神症状をきっかけに両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された12歳の症例報告。初期腹腔鏡下卵巣温存切除と1年後の再発に対する処置の後、フォローアップが途絶。複数再発で20歳時に両側卵管卵巣摘除術が必要になり早発閉経。思春期患者における定期的フォローアップの重要性を強調。
pmid-40276387.summary_en: Case of 12-year-old with bilateral mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) presenting with paraneoplastic encephalitis. After initial laparoscopic resection and recurrence management, developed multiple recurrences requiring bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy at age 20, resulting in premature menopause.

pmid-40276055.summary_ja: 精巣原発絨毛癌の脳転移による脳内出血症例。脳転移で初発。精巣原発絨毛癌の稀な発症と転移特性について文献考察を施行。
pmid-40276055.summary_en: Case of 65-year-old with testicular choriocarcinoma presenting with intracerebral hemorrhage from brain metastases. Literature review of male choriocarcinoma cases. Discusses characteristics of hidden onset, easy invasion and metastasis, with most cases having distant metastases at diagnosis.

pmid-40275685.summary_ja: 卵巣癌の約5％を占める悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の総合的なレビュー。若い女性が主な対象で、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫を含む。妊孕性温存手術、プラチナベース化学療法、新興標的療法について論じ、長期フォローアップと分子理解の必要性を強調。
pmid-40275685.summary_en: Review of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors accounting for ~5% of ovarian cancers, primarily in young women. Covers dysgerminomas, yolk sac tumors, immature teratomas with discussion of fertility-sparing surgery, platinum-based chemotherapy, and emerging targeted therapies.

pmid-40275494.summary_ja: 超音波検査で膀胱腫瘤と誤認された石灰化子宮頸部筋腫と偶発的な成熟卵巣奇形腫の症例。26歳女性が下腹部腫脹、尿閉、排尿困難を呈示。開腹手術で左卵巣腫瘤と巨大な石灰化骨盤腫瘤を確認。組織診で成熟卵巣奇形腫と筋腫と診断。
pmid-40275494.summary_en: Case of 26-year-old with calcified cervical fibroid and incidental mature ovarian teratoma initially mistaken for bladder mass on ultrasound. Laparotomy revealed left ovarian mass and huge calcified pelvic mass. Histology confirmed mature ovarian teratoma and cervical fibroid.

pmid-40273580.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連するNMDAR脳炎の症例報告。抗精神病薬治療に反応しなかった急性精神病患者がMRIで卵巣奇形腫を診断され、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術により症状が著明に改善した。本症例は奇形腫摘出がこの自己免疫疾患の治療に重要であることを示している。
pmid-40273580.summary_en: Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma in a young woman presenting with acute psychosis, catatonia, and mania. MRI identified a benign ovarian teratoma not detected on ultrasound. Complete symptom resolution occurred following laparoscopic left oophorectomy, demonstrating the critical role of gynecologic intervention in treating this autoimmune neurological condition.

pmid-40272656.summary_ja: 人間の胚性癌に由来するNT2/D1細胞は、がん幹細胞と腫瘍微小環境の相互作用をモデル化するために使用される。この総説では、GCT病態生理に重要なCSCとTME特性を検討し、GCT生物学の理解に有用なモデルとして確立している。
pmid-40272656.summary_en: NT2/D1 cells derived from human embryonal carcinoma serve as a biological model for studying cancer stem cells and tumor microenvironment interactions. Review examines CSC and TME characteristics in embryonal carcinoma cells relevant to understanding GCT pathology and developing targeted therapeutics.

pmid-40269769.summary_ja: 最も一般的な先天性腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫の16例後方視的研究。嚢胞性腫瘍形態と胎児心不全の兆候がないことが良好な転帰を予測。早期外科的切除による低い合併症発生率。詳細な出生前超音波が最適な予後評価に不可欠で出生前カウンセリングに有用。
pmid-40269769.summary_en: Sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most common congenital tumor with variable malignant potential. Retrospective study of 16 cases showed that cystic tumor morphology and absence of fetal cardiac failure predicted favorable outcomes. Early surgical resection resulted in low complication rates, with detailed prenatal ultrasound essential for optimal prognostic assessment.

pmid-40269311.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の単一細胞解析。ジスジェルミノーマは免疫活性化型、不成熟奇形腫は免疫砂漠型、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は免疫抑制型の異なった微小環境を示した。腫瘍サブタイプ別の免疫療法応答性の差を説明する知見である。
pmid-40269311.summary_en: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis revealed distinct tumor microenvironments in ovarian germ cell tumors. Dysgerminomas showed immune activation with exhausted PD-1+ T cells. Immature teratomas displayed immune-desert phenotype with minimal immune infiltration. Granulosa cell tumors exhibited immunosuppressive microenvironment with limited T cell expansion, explaining differential immunotherapy responses.

pmid-40261238.summary_ja: フランスの多施設研究で28例の胎児仙尾部奇形腫において、腫瘍体積増殖速度が不良な周産期転帰と有意に関連。増殖速度が18.01cm³/週を超え、体積が245cm³を超えた場合、胎児死亡または輸血が必要。増殖動態は出生前カウンセリングの重要な予後情報を提供。
pmid-40261238.summary_en: Tumor volume growth rate in fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma was significantly associated with poor perinatal outcomes in multicenter French study of 28 cases. Growth rate exceeding 18.01 cm³/week and volume exceeding 245 cm³ predicted fetal death or need for transfusions. Growth kinetics provide important prognostic information for prenatal counseling.

pmid-40260829.summary_ja: 睾丸胚細胞腫瘍患者の100例を含む後腹膜リンパ節郭清術の比較研究。ロボット支援と開放手術の間で無再発生存率と再発率が同等であり、ロボット支援法が入院期間短縮と低侵襲性の利点を示した。
pmid-40260829.summary_en: Matched-pair analysis comparing robot-assisted and open retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in 100 testicular germ cell tumor patients. Both approaches achieved similar progression-free survival and relapse rates. Robot-assisted RPLND offered advantages of shorter hospital stay and reduced morbidity while maintaining comparable oncologic outcomes.

pmid-40256970.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者2021人と照合したコントロール7595人の長期フォローアップ研究。精巣がん生存者は5年で17.0％、10年で27.8％の代謝症候群累積発生率を示し、コントロール（1.9％、2.8％）と比較して有意に高かった。化学療法と年齢が独立したリスク因子。代謝健康監視の重要性を強調。
pmid-40256970.summary_en: Long-term follow-up study of 2021 testicular germ cell tumor survivors versus 7595 matched controls. TC survivors showed significantly higher cumulative incidence of metabolic syndrome: 17.0% at 5 years and 27.8% at 10 years compared to controls (1.9% and 2.8%). Chemotherapy and age were independent risk factors. Study emphasizes importance of metabolic health monitoring.

pmid-40248274.summary_ja: キメラ核型46,XX/46,XYの両性具有にジスジェルミノーマ（卵巣胚細胞腫瘍）が合併した稀な症例。24歳女性がクリトリス肥大で来院し、右卵巣のジスジェルミノーマが確認され、右卵巣摘出術が行われた。成人の両性具有に胚細胞腫瘍が合併する稀有な症例である。
pmid-40248274.summary_en: Ovotesticular disorder of sex development with chimeric karyotype (46,XX/46,XY) complicated by dysgerminoma. 24-year-old patient presented with clitoral hypertrophy; histology confirmed dysgerminoma in right ovary. Right oophorectomy and external genitalia reconstruction performed. Case demonstrates rarity of adult ovotesticular DSD with germ cell tumor malignancy.

pmid-40247984.summary_ja: 10年間の縦隔成熟奇形腫35例の外科的転帰。完全外科的切除が主要な治療法。最も一般的な術後合併症は延長した空気漏出（14.3％）。破裂奇形腫は術後合併症の強い予測因子。腫瘍サイズ、位置、周囲構造を考慮したテーラーメイドアプローチの重要性を実証。
pmid-40247984.summary_en: Surgical outcomes in 35 mediastinal mature teratoma cases over 10 years. Complete surgical resection remains primary curative treatment. Most common postoperative complication was prolonged air leak (14.3%); ruptured teratoma strongly predicted complications. Study demonstrates importance of tailored surgical approach considering tumor size, location, and adjacent structures.

pmid-40246416.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する外科的切除術のレビュー。肺転移切除術がGCT患者の長期生存利益をもたらすことが示されており、化学放射線療法と多学科的評価による管理が推奨されている。
pmid-40246416.summary_en: Review of pulmonary metastasectomy in germ cell and thymic tumors. Evidence demonstrates long-term survival benefit with pulmonary metastasectomy in GCT patients. Surgical management of thoracic GCT recurrence combined with chemoradiation therapy and multidisciplinary assessment generally recommended for optimal outcomes.

pmid-40241724.summary_ja: 457例の睾丸胚細胞腫瘍を含む多施設研究でPRTFDC1が独立した予後予測バイオマーカーとして特定された。PRTFDC1高発現は不良予後を予測し、免疫関連経路を抑制し、CD8+ T細胞浸潤低下と免疫療法応答低下と関連している。
pmid-40241724.summary_en: PRTFDC1 identified as independent prognostic biomarker in testicular germ cell tumors across 457 TGCT samples. High PRTFDC1 expression predicts poor prognosis, suppresses immune pathways, and associates with low CD8+ T cell infiltration and reduced immunotherapy response. PRTFDC1 may serve as reliable predictor of TGCT prognosis and immunotherapy outcomes.

pmid-40241185.summary_ja: 274人の成人男性胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした改変-BEP化学療法(3週ごと、ブレオマイシン30 IU)の後方視的研究。治癒的設定での5年無増悪生存期間79.33%、全生存期間86.26%。良好リスク99.05%、中間92.84%、不良55.96%。標準的なBEP療法と比較して利便性が向上している。
pmid-40241185.summary_en: Retrospective study of 274 adult male GCT patients treated with modified-BEP chemotherapy (tri-weekly 30 IU bleomycin days 1, 3, 5 with etoposide and cisplatin). Curative setting achieved 5-year PFS rate 79.33% and OS rate 86.26%. Stratified outcomes: good-risk 99.05% OS, intermediate 92.84%, poor 55.96%. Study demonstrates efficacy and improved convenience.

pmid-40237005.summary_ja: 多剤耐性菌による腹膜透析関連腹膜炎が腹腔内奇形腫に由来する症例報告。抗菌薬治療に反応せず、腹腔内探査で奇形腫が発見され、摘出後に症状が改善。本症例は難治性腹膜炎の原因として奇形腫を考慮する重要性を示している。
pmid-40237005.summary_en: Case of peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis with multidrug-resistant organisms complicated by occult intra-abdominal teratoma. Despite initial antimicrobial therapy, peritonitis proved refractory until teratoma identified on exploration. Following adequate drainage, antibiotic therapy, and teratoma excision, patient successfully transitioned to hemodialysis.

pmid-40236903.summary_ja: 44歳患者の停留腹腔内精巣から発生した転移性セミノーマ症例。停留精巣と胚細胞腫瘍発症の強い関連性を示す。除精巣術後BEP化学療法で完全寛解達成。18ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。早期発見の重要性を強調。
pmid-40236903.summary_en: Metastatic seminoma from undescended intra-abdominal testis in 44-year-old patient. Case demonstrates strong link between cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumor development. Treatment with orchidectomy followed by BEP chemotherapy achieved complete remission with no recurrence at 18-month follow-up. Case emphasizes importance of early detection in cryptorchid patients.

pmid-40235470.summary_ja: 仙骨腫瘍に対する部分仙骨切除術の外科成績。対象にはコルドーマ8例、MPNST 4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例（胚細胞腫瘍）が含まれた。器械固定なしの部分切除でも選択症例で十分な安定性が得られることが示されている。若年活動的患者では固定が推奨される。
pmid-40235470.summary_en: Surgical outcomes of partial sacrectomy for 25 patients with various tumors: 8 chordomas, 4 MPNSTs, 2 yolk sac tumors, 2 undifferentiated sarcomas. Study demonstrates that non-instrumented partial sacrectomy provides sufficient stability in selected cases. Instrumentation primarily indicated in younger, more active patients. Yolk sac tumors are germ cell malignancies among indications.

pmid-40234993.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来奇形腫の転移メカニズムを検討する研究。一般的な異数性よりも特定の染色体の三倍体(特に6、8、11番)が転移を駆動する可能性を提案。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍における12番染色体三倍体との類似性を指摘し、胚細胞腫瘍研究および治療における臨床的関連性と実験モデルの意義を強調。
pmid-40234993.summary_en: Study examining chromosome-specific trisomies in mouse ESC-derived teratomas and their parallels with human germ cell tumors. Highlights that chromosome 12 trisomies in malignant human GCTs match those in aneuploid mESCs, suggesting common selection mechanisms underlying metastatic potential and clinical relevance for GCT research.

pmid-40228345.summary_ja: 9歳女児に発症した臍部穿孔を伴う成熟奇形腫の稀な症例。造影コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査で境界が明確で異質性の腫瘤と石灰化が確認され、完全な外科的切除が実施された。病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫が確認され、1年間のフォローアップで再発を認めなかった。
pmid-40228345.summary_en: Case report of 9-year-old with mature teratoma at unusual umbilical site presenting with progressive enlargement and perforation. Imaging revealed well-encapsulated heterogeneous mass; complete surgical excision confirmed histologically as mature teratoma with no recurrence during 1-year follow-up.

pmid-40226597.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫に対する補助化学療法後に成熟奇形腫が出現する growing teratoma syndrome 症例。腹膜神経膠腫症も同時に認められた。骨盤外転移も伴い、未熟奇形腫治療後の包括的な画像検査が重要。
pmid-40226597.summary_en: Case of growing teratoma syndrome with extrapelvic metastasis and gliomatosis peritonei. Condition occurs when mature teratomas develop in patients previously treated with chemotherapy for immature teratoma. Emphasizes importance of comprehensive imaging surveillance after immature teratoma treatment.

pmid-40225554.summary_ja: 子宮内膜悪性腫瘍のCNS転移に関する症例報告。1症例は子宮内膜yolk sac tumor（germ cell tumor）で、初診から数年後に脳転移を発症。子宮内膜がん患者が神経症状を発症した際のニューロイメージングの重要性を強調。
pmid-40225554.summary_en: Case series of CNS metastases in endometrial malignancies. One case features endometrial yolk sac tumor (a germ cell tumor) presenting with brain metastases years after primary diagnosis. Emphasizes importance of neuroimaging when endometrial cancer patients develop neurologic symptoms.

pmid-40185494.summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫に伴う偽Meigs症候群の症例報告。腹水と胸膜液を呈し転移性卵巣癌との鑑別が必要。手術による腫瘍摘出で症状完全寛解。卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断に重要。
pmid-40185494.summary_en: Case report of pseudo-Meigs syndrome presenting with ascites and benign ovarian teratoma. Condition mimics metastatic cancer but resolves following surgical removal of the germ cell tumor, illustrating importance of differential diagnosis in ovarian masses.

pmid-40182369.summary_ja: 30歳南アジア系男性の前縦隔一次性性腺外セミノーマ症例。上大静脈症候群で発症。精巣超音波検査で微小石灰化のみ認められた。シスプラチン併用化学療法で症状改善。精巣微小石灰化と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の関連性について述べた。
pmid-40182369.summary_en: Case of 30-year-old with primary extragonadal seminoma in anterior mediastinum causing superior vena cava obstruction. Associated with testicular microlithiasis, a premalignant condition linked to gonadal GCT. Patient showed symptomatic improvement with cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-40180806.summary_ja: ヨーロッパの100がん登録データを用いた大規模疫学研究EUROCARE-6。25の稀な女性生殖器癌の発症率と生存率を報告。卵巣の未熟奇形腫と妊娠性絨毛癌の生存率が特に改善。診療体制の充実と診断能の向上が生存改善に貢献。
pmid-40180806.summary_en: Large European epidemiological study (EUROCARE-6) examining incidence and survival of 25 rare female genital tract cancers. Includes malignant/immature teratomas of ovary and placental choriocarcinoma. Reports improving survival for immature teratomas and gestational choriocarcinoma over 2001-2013.

pmid-40177912.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の組織亜型を術前に予測する超音波検査ベースの臨床放射線学的ノモグラムを開発。精巣胚細胞腫瘍とセミノーマを非セミノーマ性腫瘍から高精度(AUC 0.89-0.93)で鑑別でき、非侵襲的診断が可能。
pmid-40177912.summary_en: Study developing ultrasound-based clinical-radiomic nomogram to preoperatively predict histologic subtypes of testicular tumors. Distinguishes testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) including seminomas from non-seminomatous tumors with high AUC values (0.89-0.93), enabling non-invasive discrimination of GCT subtypes.

pmid-40175160.summary_ja: 27歳女性が後腹膜発生の性腺外奇形腫による抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症。抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者の46%で腫瘍が認められ、94%が卵巣奇形腫だが、本症例は性腺外奇形腫であった。血漿交換で臨床症状が著明に改善。
pmid-40175160.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old woman with anti-NMDAR encephalitis caused by extragonadal teratoma from retroperitoneum. Highlights importance of systemic search for extra-ovarian teratomas in anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients, where 46% of female cases have associated tumors.

pmid-40169408.summary_ja: 両精巣が同じ陰嚢内にある横方向精巣異位と永続性ミューラー管症候群を伴う50歳男性の症例。異所性右精巣内にseminomaが認められ、精巣descent解剖学の理解に貢献。
pmid-40169408.summary_en: Case of 50-year-old with transverse testicular ectopia and persistent Müllerian duct syndrome. Histopathology revealed seminoma within ectopic right testis. Case illustrates rare testicular GCT presentation and contributes to understanding of testicular descent anatomy and GCT risk in cryptorchidism.

pmid-40168250.summary_ja: 52歳男性で未治療の停留精巣から発生した精巣絨毛癌症例。β-hCGが236,335 IU/Lと著明に上昇し、複数臓器への転移を認めた。新補助化学療法と除精巣術・補助化学療法を施行したが、脳転移により診断後10ヶ月で死亡。
pmid-40168250.summary_en: Case report of 52-year-old with untreated cryptorchidism and testicular choriocarcinoma, a rare non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (<1% of testicular malignancies). Markedly elevated β-hCG with metastases to multiple organs. Despite neoadjuvant chemotherapy and surgery, patient developed brain metastases and died.

pmid-40167983.summary_ja: ヨーロッパ9施設における腎移植受信者の精巣がん（seminomaおよび non-seminoma GCT）に関する多施設研究。先行悪性腫瘍の既往または家族歴がリスク因子として報告された6症例。早期に検出されて精巣摘除術で優れた予後。
pmid-40167983.summary_en: Multicenter study of testicular cancer (seminoma and non-seminoma GCTs) in kidney transplant recipients across 9 European centers. Reports 6 cases (0.14% incidence) with history of prior malignancy or family history as risk factors. Excellent outcomes when detected early with orchiectomy.

pmid-40167526.summary_ja: 化学療法耐性精巣germ cell tumor の代替治療として BRD9 阻害を検討する研究。BRD9阻害剤は多能性マーカーのダウンレギュレーションと上皮分化促進を伴いながらアポトーシスとG1期停止を誘導。多能性からの脱出を示唆。
pmid-40167526.summary_en: Study investigating BRD9 inhibition as alternative treatment for therapy-resistant testicular germ cell tumors. BRD9 inhibitor induces apoptosis and G1-phase arrest while downregulating pluripotency markers and promoting epithelial differentiation, suggesting exit from pluripotency as potential GCT response mechanism.

pmid-40166784.summary_ja: 両側卵巣奇形腫と抗NMDA受容体脳炎の28歳女性が3回の保存的手術と免疫療法で治療。卵管卵巣摘除術と嚢胞摘出術により妊孕性を温存し、2年後に出産達成。
pmid-40166784.summary_en: Case of 28-year-old woman with bilateral ovarian teratomas and anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Underwent three conservative surgeries (cystectomies) preserving fertility rather than oophorectomy. Successfully treated with immunotherapy and surgical management, achieving pregnancy and live birth.

pmid-40166779.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節転移による両側水腎症を伴う腹痛と精巣腫大で発症した精巣seminoma の症例報告。精巣seminoma の多様な臨床的プレゼンテーションをレビューし、多彩な臨床症状の認識の重要性を強調。
pmid-40166779.summary_en: Case report of 44-year-old with testicular seminoma presenting with abdominal pain, testicular swelling, and bilateral hydronephrosis from retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Reviews various presentations of testicular seminoma and importance of recognizing varied clinical manifestations.

pmid-40165030.summary_ja: 小児脊椎超音波の総合的レビュー。先天性腫瘍として仙骨尾骨teratoma（germ cell tumor）を含む適応症をカバー。小児脊椎病態、特にGCTの評価と管理のための詳細な超音波画像診断と超音波ガイド法を提供。
pmid-40165030.summary_en: Comprehensive review of pediatric spine ultrasound techniques and interpretation. Covers indications including congenital tumors like sacrococcygeal teratomas (germ cell tumors). Provides detailed sonographic anatomy and ultrasound-guided approaches for evaluating and managing pediatric spinal pathology including GCTs.

pmid-40163277.summary_ja: 血清カテプシンレベルと泌尿生殖器がんの因果関連性をメンデルランダム化法で調査。カテプシンBが精巣非セミノーマと正の関連を示す。UK Biobankで検証。
pmid-40163277.summary_en: This Mendelian randomization study investigates causal associations between serum cathepsin levels and genitourinary carcinomas. Cathepsin B is positively associated with testicular non-seminoma, while cathepsin L2 shows protective effects. Findings were validated using UK Biobank data of 36,225 individuals.

pmid-40161550.summary_ja: 進行期卵巣未熟奇形腫患者17例の後方視的研究。76.5%が妊孕性温存手術を、82%が補助化学療法を施行。中央値237ヶ月のフォローアップで全例無病生存、FSS例の46%が妊娠達成。
pmid-40161550.summary_en: Retrospective study of 17 patients with advanced-stage ovarian immature teratomas. Most underwent fertility-sparing surgery with adjuvant chemotherapy. Despite advanced disease, all patients survived without evidence of disease. Fertility-sparing surgery proved safe and effective, with 46% achieving pregnancy.

pmid-40161423.summary_ja: 38歳サウジアラビア女性の角部子宮外妊娠が類上皮栄養膜腫瘍と診断。メトトレキサート治療後も高β-hCGが続いたため、外科的切除と多剤化学療法で正常化達成。
pmid-40161423.summary_en: Case report of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), a rare form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasm, from cornual ectopic pregnancy. Despite initial methotrexate treatment, the patient required surgical intervention and multi-agent chemotherapy for β-hCG normalization, achieving successful treatment.

pmid-40160882.summary_ja: 17年前診断の卵巣成熟奇形腫が悪性転化し扁平上皮癌となった69歳女性。手術、パクリタキセル・カルボプラチン化学療法、ニラパリブ維持療法、ペムブロリズマブ免疫療法で治療され部分奏効達成。
pmid-40160882.summary_en: Case report of 69-year-old woman whose ovarian mature teratoma underwent malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma after 17 years. Treatment included surgery, chemotherapy (paclitaxel/carboplatin), niraparib, and pembrolizumab immunotherapy, demonstrating partial response.

pmid-40117798.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫由来腹膜偽粘液腫患者4例を減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法で治療した後方視的研究。最適減量未達成だが、高グレード例を除き良好な術後転帰を示した。
pmid-40117798.summary_en: Retrospective study of four patients with pseudomyxoma peritonei originating from ovarian mature teratomas treated with cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy. All underwent CRS with HIPEC; high-grade PMP showed poorer prognosis. CRS with HIPEC is safe and effective for this complication.

pmid-40115023.summary_ja: SMARCB1欠損の未分化精巣癌の初報告例。多剤治療にも関わらず予後不良。
pmid-40115023.summary_en: Case report of 36-year-old male with SMARCB1/INI1-deficient poorly differentiated testicular carcinoma showing mixed embryonal carcinoma or seminoma features. Despite multimodal therapy including chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and immunotherapy, patient died 11 months post-surgery.

pmid-40110269.summary_ja: 10歳女児の仙尾骨部奇形腫症例。進行性仙骨部腫脹で発症。手術で治癒。
pmid-40110269.summary_en: Case report of 10-year-old girl with sacrococcygeal teratoma presenting with progressive sacral swelling, fever, pain, and discharge for 2 weeks. MRI confirmed complex infra-coccygeal mass. Surgical resection performed with good outcome, highlighting importance of early diagnosis.

pmid-40109826.summary_ja: 24歳男性で両側停留精巣および左精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。偶然に遺残ミュラー管症候群が発見され、術後腫瘍マーカー正常化で6ヶ月後に再発なし。
pmid-40109826.summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old male with bilateral cryptorchidism and mixed germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor, seminoma, teratoma) of left testis. Incidental finding of persistent Müllerian duct syndrome. Post-operative tumor markers normalized within one month with no recurrence at six-month follow-up.

pmid-40107737.summary_ja: 40代男性の大型前縦隔セミノーマで左迷走神経麻痺を伴う症例。導入療法エトポシド/シスプラチン後の交互化学療法で病理学的完全奏効と完全切除を達成した。
pmid-40107737.summary_en: Case report of man in his 40s with large anterior mediastinal seminoma causing phrenic nerve involvement. Treated with induction etoposide/cisplatin followed by alternating PEB regimen, achieving pathological complete response after chemotherapy and complete surgical resection.

pmid-40105705.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する単一ポートロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の初例。病理検査で未熟奇形腫とリンパ節炎症が確認され、6ヶ月後に無病生存を達成した。
pmid-40105705.summary_en: First European case report of single-port robotic-assisted RPLND in 41-year-old with non-seminomatous testicular GCT. Pathology revealed immature teratoma and benign lymph nodes. Patient achieved disease-free status at six months with normal tumor markers and stable renal function.

pmid-40099632.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに関連するLUZP4-IgG関連傍腫瘍性神経症候群。化学療法後も免疫療法が必要で改善。
pmid-40099632.summary_en: Case report of 51-year-old with testicular seminoma and LUZP4-IgG seropositivity presenting with motor-predominant polyradiculoneuropathy. Despite orchiectomy and chemotherapy, patient required aggressive immunotherapy with cyclophosphamide, eventually showing significant improvement in hand strength.

pmid-40098231.summary_ja: GCT治療の臨床試験の再解析。高用量と標準用量シスプラチンの効果に差なし。
pmid-40098231.summary_en: Re-analysis of POG9049/CCG8882 trial examining high-dose versus standard-dose cisplatin-based chemotherapy for intermediate/poor-risk extracranial GCTs using updated MaGIC stratification. No significant difference in 5-year event-free or overall survival between treatment groups.

pmid-40093715.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者にペムブロリズマブとオラパリブで治療した初の症例報告。高PD-L1発現と高腫瘍遺伝子変異負荷に基づいて治療が選択された。ペムブロリズマブ開始4週以内にβ-hCGの顕著な低下が見られたが、その後再び増加し、免疫関連肺炎により患者は死亡した。
pmid-40093715.summary_en: First case report of cisplatin-refractory extragonadal non-seminomatous GCT (choriocarcinoma) treated with pembrolizumab and olaparib based on high PD-L1 expression and tumor mutational burden. Despite initial β-hCG decrease, patient developed immune-related pneumonitis with fatal outcome.

pmid-40092737.summary_ja: 膣出血で来院した27歳未産婦女性における子宮性腺外未熟奇形腫症例報告。卵巣保存を伴う全腹腔鏡下子宮摘出術および補助化学療法レジメン(BEP)で治療。胚細胞腫瘍に対する生殖保存的治療アプローチの成功例を示した。
pmid-40092737.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old nulliparous woman with extragonadal immature teratoma of uterus presenting with vaginal bleeding. Treated with total laparoscopic hysterectomy with ovarian preservation and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. Demonstrates successful fertility-sparing approach for extragonadal GCT.

pmid-40091773.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ25例の酸化ストレスマーカー（8-OHdG、Trx-1、Prx6）とチオレドキシンレベルを検討した免疫組織化学研究。セミノーマは正常精巣と異なるマーカー発現パターンを示した。Trx-1とTXNDC6過剰発現がセミノーマ生物学に関連の可能性。
pmid-40091773.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 25 testicular seminomas examining oxidative stress markers (8-OHdG, Trx-1, Prx6) and thioredoxin levels. Found distinct expression patterns in seminomas compared to normal testis. Trx-1 and TXNDC6 overexpression may be relevant to seminoma biology.

pmid-40088755.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における乳頭状甲状腺癌と甲状腺ストルマカルチノイドの同時悪性転化の稀な症例。次世代シーケンシング検査で両悪性成分にNRAS codon 61変異が認められた。単一奇形腫での両悪性腫瘍の共存は世界で6例目。
pmid-40088755.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma with simultaneous papillary thyroid carcinoma and strumal carcinoid transformation. NGS revealed NRAS codon 61 mutations in both malignant components. This is only sixth reported case of coexisting these two malignancies in single teratoma.

pmid-40084729.summary_ja: 潜在性消化管出血による重度の貧血を呈した新生児男児の胃未熟奇形腫症例。リンパ管腫と誤診されたが、石灰化と脂肪を含む大きな嚢胞固形腫瘤を確認。外科的切除を施行し、病理診断は1級未熟奇形腫。術後発達は良好で合併症なし。
pmid-40084729.summary_en: Case report of 28-day-old boy with neonatal gastric immature teratoma presenting with anemia from occult gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Large cystic-solid mass contained calcifications and fat. Surgical resection performed; pathology confirmed grade 1 immature teratoma. Post-operative development normal.

pmid-40082236.summary_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性性腺胚細胞腫瘍における免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の免疫機構および臨床有効性をまとめたレビュー。症例報告と臨床試験を検討し、免疫療法の有効性を評価し、臨床実践の参考資料を提供する。
pmid-40082236.summary_en: Review article summarizing immune mechanisms and clinical efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in relapsed and refractory gonadal germ cell tumors. Examines case reports and clinical trials to assess effectiveness of immunotherapy, providing reference for future clinical practice.

pmid-40078621.summary_ja: 新生児女児が鼻咽頭へ延伸した稀な成熟頭蓋前底部奇形腫の症例。胎児手術による準備、経鼻腔内切除、および2段階の形成再建手術を施行。3年のフォローアップで再発なく神経学的欠損も認めず、鼻唇領域の最適な美容的転帰を達成。
pmid-40078621.summary_en: Case report of neonatal girl with rare mature skull base teratoma extending into nasopharynx. Managed with fetal surgery preparation, endoscopic resection, and 2-stage plastic reconstruction. Three-year follow-up shows no recurrence and optimal cosmetic outcome without neurological deficits.

pmid-40078233.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ患者において胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法レジメンに用いられるエトポシド誘発性肺炎の稀な症例を報告。化学療法剤による肺毒性の診断は重要であり、化学療法中の急性呼吸不全を呈した患者では本疾患を鑑別診断に含めることの重要性を強調。
pmid-40078233.summary_en: Case report of etoposide-induced pneumonitis in metastatic seminoma patient. Documents rare pulmonary toxicity from chemotherapy agent used in germ cell tumor treatment, highlighting diagnostic importance during acute respiratory failure.

pmid-40073938.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清に関する大規模研究。病理学的予後、生存率を評価し、残存腫瘍サイズと原発腫瘍組織型が外科手術適応判定の予測因子であることを示した。
pmid-40073938.summary_en: Large-scale study of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in metastatic NSGCT. Evaluated pathologic outcomes, survival rates, and identified predictive factors including residual mass size and primary tumor histology for surgical decision-making.

pmid-40071092.summary_ja: 思春期後男性における転移性精巣成熟奇形腫の初報告。12p異常とGCNISを欠く成熟奇形腫が転移性を有する可能性があり、従来の分類パラダイムに反することを示唆している。
pmid-40071092.summary_en: First case report of metastatic mature testicular teratoma in postpubertal patient. Demonstrates that pure mature teratomas lacking chromosomal 12p abnormalities and GCNIS may possess metastatic potential, contrary to current classification paradigms.

pmid-40071091.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を含む卵巣悪性腫瘍のMRI診断研究。卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、未熟奇形腫など多様な組織型を対象に、超音波ベースのADNEXモデルで誤分類された症例におけるMRI画像特徴を分析し、診断精度の向上を検討した。
pmid-40071091.summary_en: MRI diagnostic study of ovarian malignancies including germ cell tumors (GCT, YST, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma). Analyzed imaging features in cases misclassified by ultrasound ADNEX model to improve diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-40070287.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞（胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株）におけるPGC7機能の検討。PGC7がAKT1を介したYBX1のリン酸化を増強することでNanog mRNA翻訳を促進し、胚細胞の幹細胞多能性を維持する分子メカニズムを明らかにした。これは胚細胞腫瘍生物学ならびに幹細胞多能性維持機構の理解に重要である。
pmid-40070287.summary_en: Study of PGC7 function in F9 embryonic carcinoma cells, a GCT-derived cell line. Investigated molecular mechanisms of pluripotency maintenance through Nanog translation regulation, relevant to understanding GCT biology.

pmid-40070286.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の二次性悪性腫瘍に関する大規模多施設研究。40例を分析し、進行期腫瘍で予後不良を示すことから、丁寧な組織採取と長期追跡の必要性を強調している。
pmid-40070286.summary_en: Large multi-institutional study of somatic malignancies arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas (MCT). Identified 40 cases with various histologies; poor outcomes primarily in advanced-stage tumors, emphasizing need for thorough sampling and long-term follow-up.

pmid-40066096.summary_ja: 臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍患者159例を対象とした後方視的研究。精巣摘除術後の全身炎症指数はリンパ管侵襲および腫瘍病期と関連し、リスク層別化を改善する可能性がある。予後バイオマーカーとしての新たな関連を初めて明らかに。
pmid-40066096.summary_en: Study of systemic inflammatory index (SII) and LDH as prognostic biomarkers in clinical stage I germ cell tumors. Identified associations with tumor characteristics and lymphovascular invasion, potentially improving risk stratification for adjuvant treatment decisions.

pmid-40065678.summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍の新規治療法に関するレビュー。チロシンキナーゼ阻害薬、CAR-T細胞療法、BiTE、抗体医薬複合体など、救援化学療法抵抗性患者への新規治療を概説している。
pmid-40065678.summary_en: Review of novel therapeutics in refractory germ cell tumors. Discusses emerging treatments including tyrosine kinase inhibitors, CAR-T cell therapies, BiTE, and antibody-drug conjugates for patients resistant to salvage chemotherapy.

pmid-40056550.summary_ja: 妊娠中の有機塩素系農薬とPCB曝露が精巣胚細胞癌リスクに及ぼす影響を調査した症例対照研究。妊娠血清中の化学物質濃度と後年のTGCC発症リスク間に有意な関連は認められなかった。
pmid-40056550.summary_en: Nested case-control study of 332 mother-son pairs investigating prenatal organochlorine pesticide and PCB exposure as risk factors for testicular GCC. Found no significant association between chemical exposure and TGCC development.

pmid-40056207.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療戦略としてメラトニンの効果を検討した統合生物学研究。TGCT、前立腺癌、男性不妊の共通遺伝子を同定し、メラトニンとDDX3Yの結合親和性が有望であることを示した。
pmid-40056207.summary_en: Integrated biology study exploring melatonin as therapeutic agent targeting common biomarkers in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT). Identified shared genes among TGCT, prostate cancer, and male infertility; melatonin showed promising binding to DDX3Y.

pmid-40051832.summary_ja: 4歳男児の多嚢胞性異形成腎内に発見された腎類皮嚢腫の症例報告。出生後の継続的な超音波検査で嚢腫の急速な増加を検出し、右上極腎摘除術を施行。腎内奇形腫などの稀な疾患検出における継続的な画像フォローアップの重要性。
pmid-40051832.summary_en: Case report of intrarenal dermoid cyst (teratoma) within segmental multicystic renal dysplasia in 4-year-old. Demonstrates importance of thorough imaging follow-up for detecting rare extragonadal teratomas requiring surgical intervention.

pmid-40041738.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた神経膠腫の稀な症例報告。腹腔鏡下卵巣切除により完全に切除され、12ヶ月フォローアップで良好な予後が得られた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の神経膠腫の発生は極めて稀であり、組織学的診断が重要。
pmid-40041738.summary_en: Rare case of ganglioglioma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma. First detailed description of neuroectodermal tumor within MCT showing favorable prognosis with surgical resection; highlights need for careful histologic evaluation of teratomas.

pmid-40041640.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。30歳の女性患者が精神病症状、感情不安定性、睡眠障害などの複雑な神経精神医学的症候群を呈し長期の集中治療が必要であった。脳脊髄液抗体検査により確定診断され、自己免疫性脳炎における腫瘍切除の診断および治療上の重要性を強調する。
pmid-40041640.summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma. Describes psychiatric and neurological presentation with diagnosis by CSF antibody testing and importance of teratoma removal in immune-mediated neurological disease.

pmid-40038215.summary_ja: 非造影CTを用いた卵巣腫瘍の石灰化パターン分析研究。胚細胞腫瘍は高い石灰化頻度を示す一方、転移性腫瘍は石灰化を示さない。未熟奇形腫は点状・線状・粗石灰化の混合パターンを特徴とする。組織型の鑑別診断に有用な画像所見。
pmid-40038215.summary_en: CT imaging study analyzing calcification patterns in ovarian tumors including germ cell tumors (GCT, YST, dysgerminoma, immature teratoma). Found GCTs showed higher calcification frequency than metastases; identifies diagnostic imaging features for tumor differentiation.

pmid-40037955.summary_ja: 初期化学療法への奏効後の早期再発（12ヶ月以内）を有する91名の転移性セミノーマ患者を対象とした7施設共同後方視的研究。救援化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を施行した患者は化学療法単独と比較して無増悪生存期間および全生存期間の有意な改善を示した。大量化学療法の役割は限定的であった。
pmid-40037955.summary_en: Study of 91 metastatic seminoma patients with early relapse (<12 months) after first-line chemotherapy. RPLND after salvage chemotherapy associated with improved progression-free and overall survival compared to chemotherapy alone.

pmid-40037278.summary_ja: Wilms腫瘍治療後8年で続発性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した11歳女児の症例報告。がん生存者における晩期続発性悪性腫瘍の発症の可能性を強調し、長期フォローアップの重要性を示唆している。標準的な5年を超える継続的な監視が必要。
pmid-40037278.summary_en: Case of secondary ovarian germ cell tumor developing 8 years after Wilms tumor treatment in 11-year-old girl. Highlights importance of long-term surveillance in cancer survivors for detecting late-onset secondary malignancies including GCTs.

pmid-40037273.summary_ja: 急性腹部症状で発症した混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と無性細胞腫）の症例報告。生殖機能温存を考慮した経腟的単側付属器摘出術とプラチナ製剤ベース化学療法を施行した。
pmid-40037273.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old female with mixed ovarian GCT (yolk sac tumor and dysgerminoma) presenting with acute abdominopelvic pain. Employed fertility-preserving transvaginal surgical approach with unilateral adnexectomy followed by platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-40034911.summary_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマからの精嚢転移の初の報告症例。患者は初回精巣摘除術後8年で左精嚢転移をMRIおよび針生検で診断され、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンの4サイクルを施行後、PET-CTで完全奏効を確認した。
pmid-40034911.summary_en: First reported case of seminal vesicle metastasis from bilateral testicular seminoma. Patient developed isolated left seminal vesicle metastasis 8 years after initial orchiectomy; treated with BEP chemotherapy with favorable response.

pmid-40034902.summary_ja: 精巣精巣摘除術48年後の著しく遠隔な再発のケースレポート。後腹膜リンパ節転移に化学療法を施行。セミノーマの最長遠隔再発例として重要である。
pmid-40034902.summary_en: Exceptionally rare case of seminoma recurrence 48 years after orchiectomy in 83-year-old man. Para-aortic lymph node metastasis treated with chemotherapy; represents longest known late relapse in seminom literature.

pmid-40034622.summary_ja: 両側卵巣奇形腫関連の抗NMDA受体脳炎の複雑例。7回のIVIG投与で改善を認めた。早期診断、自己抗体検査、奇形腫摘出の重要性を強調している。
pmid-40034622.summary_en: Complex case of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with bilateral ovarian teratomas. Required seven sessions of IVIG immunotherapy for symptom improvement; demonstrates importance of early diagnosis, autoantibody testing, and tumor resection in management.

pmid-40031424.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するペムブロリズマブの有効性を検討した15研究のメタ解析。ペムブロリズマブは症例の71.59%で完全持続寛解を達成。年齢、GTN組織型、免疫療法開始までの時間、化学療法併用の有無を問わず同様の有効性を示した。
pmid-40031424.summary_en: Meta-analysis of 15 studies examining pembrolizumab efficacy for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Pembrolizumab achieved complete sustained remission in 71.59% of cases, with similar performance across age groups, GTN histopathology subtypes, and chemotherapy combinations. Effective for high-risk, chemoresistant or relapsed disease including PSTT/ETT.

pmid-40026682.summary_ja: 胸膜腔への自然破裂を呈した小児縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例。成熟奇形腫の典型的な画像所見と胸膜腔への破裂などの合併症について解説。
pmid-40026682.summary_en: Case report of pediatric mature mediastinal teratoma with rare presentation of spontaneous rupture into pleural cavity. Article reviews typical radiological features of mature mediastinal teratomas and their complications on imaging.

pmid-40025812.summary_ja: SOX17誘導とWNT/TGF-beta/FGFシグナルによって胚胎癌から卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化が促進され、シスプラチン耐性が誘導される。YST形成は化学療法下での耐性獲得メカニズムを示唆。
pmid-40025812.summary_en: Study demonstrating that SOX17 induction with WNT/TGF-beta/FGF signaling drives embryonal carcinoma cells toward yolk sac tumor differentiation. YST-like cells show increased cisplatin resistance. Findings suggest YST formation serves as an escape mechanism during germ cell tumor therapy.

pmid-40024094.summary_ja: 卵巣癌患者（80%が胚細胞腫瘍）と良性腫瘍患者（45%が成熟奇形腫）を比較。悪性群は大きさ、固形成分、腹水、ドプラーフロー高値。成人と同じ画像所見が有用。
pmid-40024094.summary_en: Case-control study of 30 children and young adults with ovarian malignancy (80% germ cell tumors) vs. 60 with benign masses (45% mature teratomas). Malignant masses showed larger size, solid components, ascites, and high Doppler flow. Sonographic features for malignancy are valid in young patients but don't predict clinical course.

pmid-40020991.summary_ja: 7歳の非妊娠性卵巣絨毛膜癌患者が思春期早発で発症。β-hCG、AFP、CA125が高値。腫瘍切除後、ホルモン値が正常化し症状が消失。
pmid-40020991.summary_en: Case of 7-year-old with nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma presenting with precocious puberty. Laboratory tests showed elevated β-hCG, AFP, and CA125. Post-resection, hormone levels normalized and symptoms resolved, demonstrating successful treatment and importance of comprehensive endocrine evaluation in pediatric GCTs.

pmid-40013594.summary_ja: 一次後腹膜セミノーマの画像所見について説明するレビュー論文。全セミノーマの約1%を占め、身体の中心線周辺に通常発症する胚細胞腫瘍の稀な呈示を認識するための診断画像特性を検討。
pmid-40013594.summary_en: Review article describing imaging manifestations of primary retroperitoneal seminomas, representing approximately 1% of all seminomas and typically occurring along body midline. Discusses diagnostic imaging features to help clinicians recognize this rare presentation of germ cell tumors.

pmid-40011822.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における性ホルモン関連遺伝子クラスターを特定した研究。異なる遺伝子発現パターン、腫瘍型、臨床的行動を有する4つのクラスターを特定。クラスター割り当ては無増悪生存期間と様々な治療法への薬物感受性を予測。
