pmid-32965896.summary_en: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia includes malignant forms of gestational trophoblastic disease: choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. All these malignancies can metastasize and prove fatal without timely and effective treatment. Abnormal trophoblastic tissue becomes highly invasive and vascular through dysfunctional regulatory mechanisms, resulting in the development of invasive malignancies.

pmid-32809348.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマは最も治癒可能なGCTで、早期発見時の5年生存率は95%以上である。主に15-34歳の男性に発生し（人口10万対5例）。精巣、縦隔、後腹膜、または腺外部位に発生しうる。組織学的に純粋セミノーマと非セミノーマの区別が治療アルゴリズムを決定する。
pmid-32809348.summary_en: Testicular seminoma is a malignant germ cell tumor with excellent prognosis, achieving over 95% survival rate if diagnosed in early stages. Occurring in approximately 5 per 100,000 men, with peak incidence between 15-34 years. Seminomas can occur in testis, mediastinum, retroperitoneum, or other extragonadal sites. Histological distinction between pure seminoma and non-seminoma determines treatment algorithms.

pmid-32644667.summary_ja: 原始胚細胞から由来し、主に性腺（精巣および卵巣）に生じるが、稀に性腺外部位に生じる胚細胞腫瘍。臨床的にセミノーマと非セミノーマに分類。稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は全GCTの1～3%。ジャーミノーマは頭蓋内GCTのほぼ3分の2を占める。若い思春期に診断され、高い放射線感受性で90%以上の5年全生存期間。
pmid-32644667.summary_en: Germ cell tumors arise from primordial germ cells in gonads or, rarely, at extragonadal sites (1-3% of all GCTs). Clinically classified as seminomas or non-seminomas with significant prognostic implications. Germinoma, the intracranial counterpart of seminoma, comprises approximately two-thirds of intracranial germ cell tumors and generally has over 90% five-year survival rate due to radiosensitivity.

pmid-31536215.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤は胸部腫瘍の3%を占め、50%が前方に発生します。最も一般的な前方腫瘤は「4T's」の頭文字：胸腺腫、奇形腫、甲状腺組織、「恐ろしい」リンパ腫。胚細胞腫瘍、特に奇形腫は前縦隔での重要な考慮です。管理は臨床提示、放射線学的所見、組織学、分子技術を統合して最適な治療意思決定を行います。
pmid-31536215.summary_en: Anterior mediastinal masses comprise 3% of thoracic tumors, with 50% occurring anteriorly. The most common anterior masses follow the mnemonic "4T's": thymoma, teratoma, thyroid tissue, and "terrible" lymphoma. Germ cell tumors, specifically teratomas, are important considerations in the anterior mediastinum. Management integrates clinical presentation, radiological findings, histology, and molecular techniques for optimal therapeutic decision-making.

pmid-30571055.summary_ja: 絨毛癌はGTDの稀で攻撃的な亜型で、絨毛性と非絨毛性の2つの型があり、生物学的活動と予後が大きく異なる。主に女性に発生するが、男性では混合型GCTの成分として現れることがある。古くはヒポクラテスが400BC頃に記載したが、より正確に特徴付けられたのはその後である。
pmid-30571055.summary_en: Choriocarcinoma is a rare and aggressive subtype of gestational trophoblastic disease with two significant forms: gestational and non-gestational types showing very different biological behaviors and prognoses. While predominantly occurring in women, choriocarcinoma can also occur in men, typically as a component of mixed germ cell tumors. The disease has been recognized since ancient times but characterized more accurately in recent medical history.

pmid-29261918.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患は異常栄養膜増殖に由来する腫瘍群を包含し、胞状奇胎と栄養膜新生物の両方を含みます。悪性形態（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、上皮樣栄養膜腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍）は転移し、迅速な治療がなければ致命的になる可能性があります。これらの悪性腫瘍は任意の妊娠に続く数週間から数年後に発生する可能性があり、奇胎妊娠後に最も高い危険性があります。
pmid-29261918.summary_en: Gestational trophoblastic disease encompasses a group of tumors arising from abnormal trophoblastic proliferation, including both hydatidiform moles and trophoblastic neoplasms. Malignant forms (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, placental site trophoblastic tumor) can metastasize and become fatal without prompt treatment. These malignancies can develop weeks to years following any pregnancy, with highest risk after molar pregnancy.

pmid-29083593.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎は奇胎妊娠として一般に知られており、妊娠性絨毛性疾患に由来する希な妊娠異常です。異常受精に特徴付けられ、絨毛水腫および栄養膜増生をもたらし、完全または部分である可能性があります。通常良性ですが、胞状奇胎は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、上皮樣または胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍）に進行する可能性がある前悪性病変です。
pmid-29083593.summary_en: Hydatidiform mole, commonly known as molar pregnancy, is a rare pregnancy abnormality arising from gestational trophoblastic disease. Characterized by abnormal fertilization resulting in villous hydrops and trophoblastic hyperplasia, it can be complete or partial. Although typically benign, hydatidiform moles are premalignant lesions that can progress to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, epithelioid or placental site trophoblastic tumors).

pmid-28846234.summary_ja: 精巣がんは細胞由来に基づいて様々な組織型に分類され、セミノーマ性および非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が最も一般的です。セミノーマは全精巣胚細胞腫瘍悪性腫瘍の約3分の1を占め、最も治療可能なヒトがんの一つで、早期疾患では98～99%の生存率があります。全体的な発症率は比較的低いにもかかわらず、15～35歳の男性で最も一般的な悪性腫瘍です。
pmid-28846234.summary_en: Testicular cancers are classified by cell of origin into various histological types, with seminomatous and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors being the most common. Seminoma accounts for approximately one-third of all testicular germ cell malignancies and represents one of the most treatable human cancers, with 98-99% survival in early-stage disease. Despite relatively low overall incidence, it is the most common malignancy in males aged 15-35 years.

pmid-28613751.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマは精巣または卵巣から由来する胚細胞腫瘍であり、主に若い男性に生じる稀な悪性腫瘍である。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のほぼ70%が非セミノーマで、残り約30%がセミノーマ。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、絨毛癌が非セミノーマに含まれる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の唯一の周知されたリスク因子はクラインフェルター症候群。
pmid-28613751.summary_en: Mediastinal non-seminomas are germ cell tumors arising from testes, ovaries, or the mediastinum primarily in young males. Nearly 70% of mediastinal germ cell tumors are non-seminomas, including embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas, and choriocarcinomas, while approximately 30% are seminomas. Klinefelter syndrome remains the only well-known risk factor for extragonadal germ cell tumors. Symptoms typically appear only when tumors enlarge.

pmid-40406278.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫に伴う胎児下部尿路閉塞の症例報告(ケニア)。連続膀胱穿刺により管理した。
pmid-40406278.summary_en: Case report from Kenya of fetal lower urinary tract obstruction associated with sacrococcygeal teratoma, managed by serial vesicocentesis.

pmid-39701870.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における認知機能を評価した縦断的研究。
pmid-39701870.summary_en: Longitudinal study assessing cognitive function in survivors of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-39377884.summary_ja: 未分化胚細胞腫に伴う傍腫瘍性全身性エリテマトーデスの症例報告と文献レビュー。
pmid-39377884.summary_en: Case report and literature review on paraneoplastic systemic lupus erythematosus associated with dysgerminoma.

pmid-40144601.summary_ja: アスペルギローマと誤診された肺奇形腫の症例報告。
pmid-40144601.summary_en: Case report of a pulmonary teratoma initially misdiagnosed as aspergilloma.

pmid-40143878.summary_ja: 稀な胚細胞腫瘍4例の症例集積。
pmid-40143878.summary_en: A case series highlighting rare germ cell tumor presentations and their clinical management.

pmid-39370035.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるFcγR3A多型がアベルマブへの反応性に及ぼす影響に関する研究。
pmid-39370035.summary_en: Study on the impact of FcγR3A polymorphism on NK cell activation and response to avelumab in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-39054236.summary_ja: 小児原発性性腺外絨毛癌に関する単施設での検討。
pmid-39054236.summary_en: Institutional study on primary extragonadal choriocarcinoma in male pediatric patients.

pmid-38409507.summary_ja: 稀な卵巣絨毛癌の超音波所見に関する症例報告。
pmid-38409507.summary_en: Case report on the ultrasound evaluation of rare ovarian choriocarcinoma.

pmid-39389038.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大胎児頸部腫瘤における3次元モデリングの有用性の検討。
pmid-39389038.summary_en: Evaluation of 3D modeling for prenatal diagnosis and surgical planning of large fetal neck masses.

pmid-39039777.summary_ja: 頭蓋外悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する外科的アプローチの総説。
pmid-39039777.summary_en: Review of current surgical approaches in the management of extracranial malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-39708365.summary_ja: 両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の片側性腺癌転化の症例報告。
pmid-39708365.summary_en: A case report of unilateral malignant transformation to adenocarcinoma in bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-39680568.summary_ja: 精漿マイクロRNAによる精巣癌高リスク不妊男性の識別可能性に関する研究。
pmid-39680568.summary_en: Study on the potential of seminal plasma microRNAs to identify infertile men at risk of testicular cancer.

pmid-39522951.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるmiR-100-5p・miR-125b-5p補充の増殖抑制効果に関する研究。
pmid-39522951.summary_en: Research on the effect of miR-100-5p and miR-125b-5p replenishment in malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-40349199.summary_ja: 化学療法、手術、放射線療法に耐性を示す妊娠性絨毛癌患者2名がペムブロリズマブ免疫療法により長期寛解を達成した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患腫瘍のPD-L1強発現は免疫チェックポイント阻害薬治療の適応となり、化学療法耐性症例における有用な治療選択肢である。
pmid-40349199.summary_en: This case report describes two gestational choriocarcinoma patients with multidrug resistance to multiple lines of chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation therapy who achieved long-term remission after pembrolizumab immunotherapy. Strong PD-L1 expression in gestational trophoblastic disease tumors makes them suitable targets for immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, offering an alternative treatment strategy for chemorefractory cases.

pmid-40254451.summary_ja: Denys-Drash症候群に伴う胎児生殖母細胞腫の3症例が報告される。胎児生殖母細胞腫は高度に悪性の腺性腫瘍の前駆病変であり、性芽細胞腫を含む悪性腫瘍へ進行する重要な前駆病変である。両側性病変や6歳患者の性芽細胞腫（文献で最年少例の一つ）を含む。DDS患者での除睾タイミング決定は複雑である。
pmid-40254451.summary_en: Three cases of Denys-Drash syndrome with gonadoblastoma are presented, emphasizing the malignant potential of this germ cell tumor precursor. Gonadoblastoma serves as a crucial precursor to highly malignant gonadal tumors including dysgerminoma. Notable findings include bilateral involvement in some cases and a dysgerminoma diagnosis in a 6-year-old patient, among the youngest dysgerminoma cases reported. The timing for gonadectomy in DDS patients remains complex.

pmid-39902085.summary_ja: 32歳患者の稀な縦隔胚細胞腫瘍症例。心膜液ではなく腫瘍塊による直接的な心臓構造圧迫により、タンポナーデ様生理が生じた。血行動態不安定性を呈し、血行動態最適化と外科的介入による腫瘍塊除去を必要とした学際的アプローチが実施。
pmid-39902085.summary_en: Case report of mediastinal germ cell tumor causing tamponade-like physiology through direct tumor compression of cardiac structures rather than pericardial fluid. Unusual presentation in 32-year-old patient with hemodynamic instability requiring multidisciplinary approach for hemodynamic optimization and definitive mass removal through surgical intervention.

pmid-39867042.summary_ja: 69歳女性で初期検出10年後に診断された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌の症例。17cm大嚢胞で画像上悪性所見は最小限。組織診で扁平上皮癌原位置と部分的な間質浸潤を認めた。放射線学的安定性にもかかわらず卵巣奇形腫の遅延悪性転化の可能性を強調。
pmid-39867042.summary_en: Case of squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma 10 years after initial detection in 69-year-old woman. Large 17cm cyst with minimal imaging evidence of malignancy. Histopathology revealed squamous cell carcinoma in situ with partial stromal invasion. Highlights delayed malignant transformation potential of mature ovarian teratomas despite radiographic stability.

pmid-39850963.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)における腸内微生物-腸-精巣軸を探索するレビュー論文。若い男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍について議論。菌叢異常が免疫応答、炎症、ホルモンバランスに及ぼす影響を論じる。難治性患者における治療有効性改善と化学療法誘発毒性低減のための微生物バイオマーカーと微生物叢修飾戦略を提案する。
pmid-39850963.summary_en: Review article exploring the microbiome-gut-testis axis in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT), the most common malignancy in young men. Discusses dysbiosis effects on immune response, inflammation, and hormonal imbalances. Proposes microbial biomarkers and microbiota modulation strategies for improving treatment efficacy in refractory patients while reducing chemotherapy-induced toxicity.

pmid-39850104.summary_ja: 奇形腫に伴う眼球振盪筋クローヌス症候群の症例報告である。傍腫瘍症候群として眼球振盪、筋クローヌス、失調、行動異常と睡眠障害を呈した。当該症候群の診断経路と治療方針を論じ、腫瘍摘出が治療の基本であることを示唆。
pmid-39850104.summary_en: Case report of opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome (OMS) as paraneoplastic manifestation in 20-year-old female with teratoma. OMS is rare inflammatory neurological disease presenting with opsoclonus, myoclonus, ataxia, behavioral and sleep disturbances. Literature review demonstrates that tumor removal is the primary effective treatment for OMS syndrome associated with teratoma.

pmid-39839164.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に随伴した抗CASPR2抗体仲介の自己免疫性脳炎の最初の報告症例。腫瘍随伴性辺縁系脳炎として人格・行動変化、精神病、記憶喪失、けいれんなどの神経精神医学的後遺症を呈した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の稀な自己免疫学的発現と、交叉反応腫瘍抗体の重要性を示唆する症例である。
pmid-39839164.summary_en: First reported case of anti-CASPR2 antibody-mediated autoimmune encephalitis associated with testicular mixed germ cell tumor. Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis presented with neuropsychiatric sequelae including personality and behavioral changes, psychosis, memory loss, and seizures. Case highlights rare autoimmune manifestation of testicular germ cell tumors and importance of cross-reacting tumor antibodies.

pmid-39828346.summary_ja: 35歳男性のセミノーマの症例で、不妊症評価中に直径10mm精巣腫瘍と陰性の腫瘍マーカーで発見された。右精巣萎縮により迅速術中病理診断が実施されセミノーマが確認。根治的精巣摘除術と生殖能力温存のための術中精子採取を施行し、術後テストステロン補充療法を実施した。
pmid-39828346.summary_en: Case of 35-year-old male with seminoma discovered during infertility evaluation with 10mm testicular mass and negative tumor markers. Right testicular atrophy prompted rapid intraoperative pathology diagnosis confirming seminoma. Patient underwent radical orchiectomy with intraoperative sperm extraction for fertility preservation followed by testosterone replacement therapy post-operatively.

pmid-39822958.summary_ja: 陰嚢および精巣病変の磁気共鳴画像法による図解レビュー。特に超音波検査で不確実な所見を呈する場合において、精巣内・精巣外病変および腫瘍性・非腫瘍性病変の鑑別に優れた能力を有する。術前の腫瘍病期分類と臨床判断決定において重要な役割を果たし、外科的評価が必要な陰嚢病変患者のケアにおける放射線科医の重要な役割を強調する。
pmid-39822958.summary_en: Pictorial review of testicular and scrotal pathologies on magnetic resonance imaging with emphasis on differentiating intratesticular versus extratesticular lesions and neoplastic versus non-neoplastic pathologies. Highlights MRI's critical role in preoperative tumor staging and clinical decision-making for patients presenting with scrotal lesions requiring surgical evaluation.

pmid-39816550.summary_ja: 32歳女性の肺血栓塞栓症として疑われた肺動脈絨毛癌の症例。喀血と胸痛を伴う患者。生検により悪性トロフォブラスト細胞を認めた。化学療法の実施でβ-hCGの正常化とイメージング改善が確認され、1年間のフォローアップで寛解達成。
pmid-39816550.summary_en: Case of primary pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma presenting as suspected pulmonary thromboembolism in 32-year-old female with hemoptysis and chest pain. Diagnosed by biopsy revealing malignant trophoblastic cells. Patient achieved complete remission with chemotherapy, confirmed by normalized β-hCG and imaging improvement at 1-year follow-up.

pmid-39802950.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性対感受性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株におけるミトコンドリアゲノム突然変異を同定した研究。耐性細胞は複数のmtgene突然変異と解糖代謝の選好を示し、感受性細胞は酸化的リン酸化を好んだ。知見は耐性TGCT表現型を区別し、代謝標的治療戦略を示唆。
pmid-39802950.summary_en: Study identifying mitochondrial genome mutations in cisplatin-resistant versus cisplatin-sensitive testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Resistant cells showed mutations in multiple mt genes and preferential glycolysis metabolism, while sensitive cells preferred oxidative phosphorylation. Findings provide novel molecular biomarkers distinguishing resistant TGCT phenotype and suggesting metabolic-targeted therapeutic strategies.

pmid-39792418.summary_ja: SEER登録データを用いた精巣混合奇形腫・セミノーマ3296例の予後研究である。進行T分類、遠隔転移、大きな腫瘍サイズ、リンパ管侵襲が不良予後因子。遠隔転移とリンパ節郭清が独立予後因子として抽出された。
pmid-39792418.summary_en: Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database study of 3,296 patients with testicular mixed teratoma and seminoma (TMTS). Advanced T stage, lymph node and distant metastasis, large tumor size, and lymphovascular invasion predicted inferior overall and cancer-specific survival. Distant metastasis and regional lymph node resection emerged as independent prognostic factors.

pmid-39791094.summary_ja: 出生前に検出された後腹膜未熟奇形腫の新生児症例報告。左上腎部の大きな病変を画像で示す。血清AFP、β-hCG、MIBG シンチグラフィー結果は正常。出生後6日目の開腹術で悪性成分のない未熟奇形腫を確認。良性病理と一致したAFP軌跡で出生後35日目に退院。
pmid-39791094.summary_en: Case report of newborn with prenatal-detected retroperitoneal immature teratoma showing large left suprarenal mass on imaging. Serum AFP, β-hCG, and MIBG scintigraphy results were normal. Exploratory laparotomy on postnatal day 6 confirmed immature teratoma without malignant components. Patient discharged on day 35 with normal AFP trajectory consistent with benign pathology.

pmid-39790702.summary_ja: 大動脈下大静脈塊として発症した転移性セミノーマの症例である。複数の経皮的生検後に開放生検で診断。根治的精巣摘出とBEP化学療法（3コース）で治療。6ヶ月後のPET/CTで腫瘍ほぼ消失、β-hCGとLDH正常化。
pmid-39790702.summary_en: Unusual case of 56-year-old male with disseminated seminoma presenting as aortocaval mass. Diagnosis required open surgical biopsy after unsuccessful percutaneous attempts. Treated with radical orchiectomy and three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy. Six-month follow-up PET/CT showed near-complete mass resolution with normalization of β-hCG and lactate dehydrogenase.

pmid-39790263.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と転移リンパ節腺癌の症例報告である。化学療法後の腫瘍摘出で原発巣に生存細胞なく、転移リンパ節に腺癌を認めた。体細胞型固形悪性腫瘍への転化を示唆する稀な所見。
pmid-39790263.summary_en: Case of 41-year-old male with mediastinal yolk sac tumor presenting with adenocarcinoma in subcarinal lymph node metastases. Computed tomography revealed enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes and anterior mediastinal mass. After chemotherapy, tumor resection showed no viable cells in primary tumor but adenocarcinoma in metastatic nodes, demonstrating somatic-type solid malignancy transformation.

pmid-39768994.summary_ja: 同時性精巣セミノーマと腎細胞癌の症例報告に関する訂正通知。セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍は若年成人男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍であり、胚細胞腫瘍文献と高い関連性がある。稀な同時悪性腫瘍の管理について詳述。
pmid-39768994.summary_en: Correction notice to previously published case report of synchronous seminoma of testis and renal cell carcinoma. Seminomatous testicular tumors represent the most common malignancy in young adult males and are highly relevant to germ cell tumor literature. Original case report details the management of rare concurrent malignancies.

pmid-39768777.summary_ja: 精巣病変の多パラメトリック超音波評価の単施設11年研究である。CEUS感度93.8%、特異度85.2%。エラストグラフィで悪性腫瘍の高い組織硬度（77.8%）を検出。診断支援ツールとしての有用性を示唆。
pmid-39768777.summary_en: Eleven-year retrospective study of 342 patients with testicular lesions using multiparametric ultrasound including contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) and elastography. Of 84 surgically explored cases, malignancy confirmed in 48 (57.1%). CEUS demonstrated sensitivity 93.8% and specificity 85.2%. Elastography showed tissue stiffness in 77.8% of malignant versus 41.0% of benign tumors.

pmid-39768652.summary_ja: ストルマオバリ（卵巣奇形腫内の異所性甲状腺組織）由来の分化型甲状腺癌に関する系統的レビュー。甲状腺全摘出と放射性ヨード治療が多用されたが、大多数の患者では放射性核種療法が必須ではなかった。選別的治療の重要性を指摘。
pmid-39768652.summary_en: Systematic review of radioiodine therapy in differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) arising from struma ovarii, an ovarian teratoma containing ectopic thyroid tissue. Analysis of 11 studies showed most cases treated with total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, particularly with distant metastases. However, majority of patients did not require radiometabolic therapy, suggesting selective rather than universal treatment approach.

pmid-39767846.summary_ja: 小児外科腫瘍学における5症例の生体外蛍光共焦点顕微鏡(FCM)の予備的研究。悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌90%、卵黄嚢腫瘍10%）を含む症例でFCMが確定病理組織学的検査と高度な一致を示し、迅速な腫瘍特性化のための補助診断ツールとしての有望性を示唆。
pmid-39767846.summary_en: Preliminary study of ex vivo fluorescence confocal microscopy (FCM) for real-time pathological diagnosis in five pediatric surgical oncology cases including malignant mixed germ cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma 90%, yolk sac tumor 10%). FCM demonstrated high agreement with definitive histopathology. Shows promise as adjunctive diagnostic tool for rapid tumor characterization and intraoperative surgical guidance.

pmid-39766916.summary_ja: TCGA-TGCTデータベースの134患者における転写産物解析で、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、奇形腫の間での差別的なマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現パターンを同定。7つの上昇シグネチャーと7つの低下シグネチャーは鑑別診断と予後層別化で高い感度/特異度（0.94/1.0、0.97/0.94）を示し、AJCC病期および遠隔転移に関連。
pmid-39766916.summary_en: Transcriptomic analysis of 134 testicular germ cell tumor patients from TCGA database identifying differential miRNA expression patterns among seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, mixed GCT, and teratoma. Seven upregulated and seven downregulated miRNA signatures showed high sensitivity/specificity (0.94/1.0 and 0.97/0.94) for differential diagnosis and were associated with AJCC stage and distant metastasis.

pmid-39763076.summary_ja: 21歳男性の原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍で肺および脳への多発転移を有した症例。導入化学療法(4サイクルBEP)および救援化学療法(4サイクルTIP)で治療。後腹膜リンパ節郭清および肺転移切除後、残存癌細胞なし。
pmid-39763076.summary_en: Case of 21-year-old male with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumor with multiple lung and brain metastases. Treated with induction (four cycles BEP) and salvage chemotherapy (four cycles TIP). After gradual tumor marker decline, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and lung metastasis resection performed without residual cancer cells. Case demonstrates value of close monitoring post-chemotherapy to guide additional interventions.

pmid-39763075.summary_ja: 28歳男性の17×16×8cm前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で卵黄嚢成分を有し、右心圧迫と心原性ショックを引き起こした症例。BEP化学療法後、AFPが24,769 ng/mlで上昇。静脈-動脈体外膜酸素化支持が必要。腫瘍縮小手術後、心血管状態は急速に改善。
pmid-39763075.summary_en: Case of 28-year-old male with 17×16×8cm anterior mediastinal germ cell tumor with yolk sac component causing right heart compression and cardiogenic shock. Elevated AFP at 24,769ng/ml. After BEP chemotherapy, cardiac decompensation required veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support. Tumor debulking surgery performed; post-operative cardiovascular status improved rapidly. Demonstrates necessity of multidisciplinary collaboration.

pmid-39758576.summary_ja: 先天性エピグナトゥスの症例報告。稀な奇形腫で硬口蓋に由来し、発生率は生児出生35,000～200,000人に1人。超音波検査で31週間に出生前診断、MRIで35週間に確認。EXIT処置により塊摘除と気道開存を確保。
pmid-39758576.summary_en: Case report of congenital epignathus, a rare teratoma originating from hard palate (incidence 1 in 35,000-200,000 live births). Prenatal diagnosis established at 31 weeks by ultrasound and confirmed by MRI at 35 weeks. Extra-uterine intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure successfully performed to excise mass and ensure airway patency. Demonstrates importance of prenatal diagnosis and multidisciplinary delivery management.

pmid-39735155.summary_ja: 本論文は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から悪性転化した卵巣扁平上皮癌の症例と、その組織発生、診断、治療戦略についての文献レビューを提示しています。
pmid-39735155.summary_en: This case report presents squamous cell carcinoma arising from an ovarian dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma) in a 62-year-old woman. The paper discusses histogenesis, diagnostic approaches, and treatment strategies for this rare malignant transformation of mature teratoma.

pmid-39734811.summary_ja: この研究は孤立性下垂体茎肥厚を有する小児における増殖性疾患の予測因子を評価した。結果は35％が増殖性疾患を発症し、8例のジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）が同定され、進行性の茎肥厚が診断と関連していた。
pmid-39734811.summary_en: This study evaluates predictive factors for proliferative disease in children with isolated pituitary stalk thickening. Results show 35% developed proliferative disease, with eight germinomas identified, and progressive stalk thickening associated with germinoma diagnosis.

pmid-39734342.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫化学療法後のgrowing teratoma syndromeと腹膜神経膠腫症の稀な併発例。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン化学療法後に妊孕性温存手術施行。悪性成分と良性成分の区別の診断的課題を強調。
pmid-39734342.summary_en: This case report describes the rare coexistence of growing teratoma syndrome and gliomatosis peritonei following chemotherapy for ovarian immature teratoma. The paper emphasizes the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing benign from malignant components in post-treatment residual masses.

pmid-39727674.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の脊椎転移164症例のシステマティックレビュー。シスプラチン系化学療法および外科的介入を検討。全身および局所疾患管理における多学科ケアの重要性を強調している。
pmid-39727674.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates spinal metastases in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, analyzing 164 cases. It discusses chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy approaches, highlighting the importance of multidisciplinary care for managing both systemic and localized disease.

pmid-39726691.summary_ja: 75歳閉経後女性の破裂卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に腺癌が転化した症例。手術および組織検査で確認。カルボプラチンとパクリタキセル化学療法後、10か月のフォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39726691.summary_en: This case report presents adenocarcinoma transformation of a ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a 75-year-old postmenopausal woman. After partial rupture and surgery, histopathology confirmed adenocarcinoma, followed by chemotherapy with good long-term outcomes.

pmid-39723379.summary_ja: 54歳閉経後女性の成熟良性子宮奇形腫の症例報告および文献レビュー。子宮鏡手術により神経組織、骨、軟骨を含む成熟組織の腫瘤を切除。稀な子宮腫瘍の診断基準と治療戦略を提示している。
pmid-39723379.summary_en: This case report and review describe a mature benign uterine teratoma in a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman. Hysteroscopic surgery successfully removed the mass containing various mature tissues. The paper provides diagnostic criteria and treatment strategies for this rare uterine tumor.

pmid-39723313.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に発生した粘液性嚢胞腺腫の症例報告。化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘍における診断的課題を強調している。
pmid-39723313.summary_en: This case report describes mucinous cystadenoma arising from residual mass in a patient treated for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The unexpected histological finding highlights diagnostic challenges in post-chemotherapy residual masses.

pmid-39723237.summary_ja: 本論文は胚細胞腫瘍の5%未満である後腹膜セミノーマの稀な症例を報告しており、診断と多学科的治療アプローチについて論述しています。
pmid-39723237.summary_en: This case report presents primary retroperitoneal seminoma in a 40-year-old male, a rare germ cell tumor accounting for <5% of such tumors. Discusses diagnostic challenges, surgical management, and BEP chemotherapy, achieving complete response with multidisciplinary care.

pmid-39719389.summary_ja: 本論文は横紋筋肉腫様分化を示す精巣セミノーマの初報告です。この分化パターンは予後不良を示唆し、病理診断の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-39719389.summary_en: This case report describes the first documented case of a testicular seminoma with rhabdoid differentiation, a feature typically associated with poor prognosis in other malignancies. The report emphasizes the need for careful pathological review of this rare finding in seminoma.

pmid-39712678.summary_ja: 本論文は非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の稀な症例を報告しており、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の0.6%未満です。脳・肺転移を有し、β-HCG上昇を示していました。
pmid-39712678.summary_en: This case report presents non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with elevated β-HCG, an extremely rare germ cell tumor (<0.6% of ovarian GCTs). The patient presented with neurological symptoms from brain and lung metastases, with histopathology confirming non-gestational origin.

pmid-39711015.summary_ja: 本論文は精巣胚細胞腫瘍における代謝酵素の発現を調査し、胎児性癌が高いグリコリーシス活性を示すことを明らかにしており、MCT1阻害薬の治療可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-39711015.summary_en: This study investigates differential expression of metabolic enzymes (GLUT-1, MCT1, MCT4, LDHA, HIF-1α) across testicular germ cell tumor subtypes. Embryonal carcinomas show significantly higher glycolytic activity, suggesting potential therapeutic targets with MCT1 inhibitors.

pmid-39710843.summary_ja: 本症例報告は喀血および肺転移で呈現した精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(60%絨毛癌を伴う混合型NSGCT)の26歳男性を記述する。消化管出血を引き起こす小腸転移は部分的切除が必要であった。BEPおよびTIP化学療法後完全寛解が達成された。
pmid-39710843.summary_en: This case report documents a 26-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor (mixed NSGCT with 60% choriocarcinoma) presenting with hemoptysis and lung metastases. Small bowel metastasis causing gastrointestinal bleeding required partial resection; complete remission achieved after BEP and TIP chemotherapy.

pmid-39709518.summary_ja: 本症例報告は進行性増殖、音声障害および嚥下困難で呈現した13歳男児の舌下類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)を記述する。病理組織学的確認を伴う口内切除を通じた外科的切除は小児頭頸部奇形腫における診断的および管理的困難を実証する。
pmid-39709518.summary_en: This case report describes a sublingual dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) in a 13-year-old boy presenting with progressive growth, speech disorders, and swallowing difficulties. Surgical excision via intra-oral approach with histopathological confirmation demonstrates diagnostic and management challenges in pediatric head and neck teratomas.

pmid-39707517.summary_ja: 本症例報告は左半胸郭の広範な浸潤を有する2歳女児における巨大縦隔成熟奇形腫の外科的管理を呈示する。ECMO支援による正中胸骨切開を通じた完全切除は成功し、良性病理が確認され優れた回復が得られた。
pmid-39707517.summary_en: This case report presents surgical management of a huge mediastinal mature teratoma in a 2-year-old girl with extensive left hemithorax involvement. Complete resection via median sternotomy with ECMO support was successful, with benign pathology confirmed and excellent recovery.

pmid-39707031.summary_ja: 本スコーピングレビューは15,295の卵巣類皮嚢腫を25の研究全体で体系的に評価し、大きさに基づいて悪性転化リスクを決定する。悪性転化の>25%は<10cmであり、悪性リスク層別化のための10cmO-RADS閾値に異議を唱えている。
pmid-39707031.summary_en: This scoping review systematically evaluates 15,295 ovarian dermoid cysts across 25 studies to determine malignant transformation risk based on size. Finds that >25% of malignant transformations were <10 cm, questioning the 10 cm O-RADS threshold for malignancy risk stratification.

pmid-39706819.summary_ja: 本論文は精巣胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン耐性におけるmiR-371-3pの役割を調査し、miR-371阻害によりシスプラチン感受性が有意に向上することを示しています。
pmid-39706819.summary_en: This study investigates miRNA-371a-3p (miR-371) role in cisplatin resistance of testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Using antagomirs to inhibit miR-371 significantly increased cisplatin sensitivity, suggesting potential therapeutic strategy for cisplatin-resistant TGCTs.

pmid-39698441.summary_ja: 子宮奇形腫は稀な腫瘍で、発生起源は不明である。本症例は成熟嚢胞性子宮奇形腫を呈した44歳女性。STR遺伝子型検査は腫瘍と宿主組織の遺伝的類似性を示し、複数座位のヘテロ接合性喪失を認め、未受精卵や胎児組織ではなく、宿主の多能性幹細胞に由来することが示唆された。
pmid-39698441.summary_en: Uterine teratomas are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors with unclear developmental origins. This case presents a 44-year-old woman with mature cystic uterine teratoma. STR genotyping analysis showed genetic similarity between tumor and host tissues with loss of heterozygosity, suggesting origin from host pluripotent stem cells rather than nonfertilized ova or fetal tissue.

pmid-39697937.summary_ja: 精巣がんは若年男性に一般的であり、胚細胞腫瘍が優勢なタイプである。本症例は精巣捻転に続く攻撃的混合型NSGCT(胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫)の40歳男性を記述する。著しく上昇した腫瘍マーカー(AFP19,420ng/mL、β-hCG4,749mIU/mL)および急速な増殖はNSGCT初期介入の重要性を強調する。
pmid-39697937.summary_en: Testicular cancer is common in young men, with germ cell tumors being the predominant type. This case describes a 40-year-old male with aggressive mixed NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma) following testicular torsion. Markedly elevated tumor markers (AFP 19,420 ng/mL, HCG 4,749 mIU/mL) and rapid growth emphasize the importance of early intervention in NSGCTs.

pmid-39697723.summary_ja: セミノーマは精巣胚細胞腫瘍の50%以上を占める。根治的精巣摘除術後の現代的管理は腫瘍病期とリスク階層化に依存する。臨床病期I疾患では80~85%の再発なし率で監視が好まれる。進行例は放射線療法または化学療法、選択例ではRPLND、残存腫瘤の外科的切除が必要である。
pmid-39697723.summary_en: Seminoma comprises over half of all testicular germ cell neoplasms. Contemporary management after radical orchiectomy depends on tumor stage and risk stratification. Surveillance is preferred for early-stage disease with 80-85% relapse-free rates. Advanced cases require radiation or chemotherapy, with discussion of toxicities, RPLND in selected cases, and surgical resection for residual masses.

pmid-39691920.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘤は良性および悪性病変を含む。30人の小児の研究では83.3%が新生物を有し、33.3%が良性、10%が境界領域、40%が悪性であった。悪性腫瘍は無痛性腹部腫瘤で呈し、腫瘍マーカー(AFP、β-hCG 66.67%)が上昇していた。画像上の固形成分は悪性と相関していた。全患者は平均53.5ヶ月のフォローアップで無病生存を達成した。
pmid-39691920.summary_en: Pediatric ovarian masses include both benign and malignant lesions. This study of 30 children found 83.3% had neoplasms: 33.3% benign, 10% borderline, 40% malignant. Malignant tumors presented with painless abdominal masses and had elevated tumor markers (AFP, hCG in 66.67%). Solid components on imaging correlated with malignancy. All patients achieved disease-free survival at mean 53.5-month follow-up.

pmid-39687655.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍は稀で高度に悪性の胚細胞腫瘍で卵巣癌の約1%を占める。本症例は虫垂炎様症状で初期提示した6歳女性で、術中に大きな右卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた。早期診断、多学科的管理、および向上した認識は、この急速に進行する悪性腫瘍の最適な転帰に不可欠である。
pmid-39687655.summary_en: Ovarian yolk sac tumors (endodermal sinus tumors) are rare, highly malignant germ cell tumors accounting for ~1% of ovarian cancers. This case describes a 6-year-old girl initially presenting with appendicitis-like symptoms who was found to have a large right ovarian yolk sac tumor on surgery. Early diagnosis, multidisciplinary management, and heightened awareness are essential for optimal outcomes in this rapidly progressive malignancy.

pmid-39686951.summary_ja: 胃奇形腫は小児における極めて稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。本症例集積は全て1歳未満の4患者(75%男性)で、典型的画像特性と正常な腫瘍マーカーが診断に有効。手術が主要治療で成熟および未熟奇形腫の等しい分布。長期フォローアップで再発なく、自然史確立のためのより多くの症例報告の必要性を強調。
pmid-39686951.summary_en: Gastric teratomas are extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumors in children. This case series of four patients, all under 1 year old (75% male), showed typical imaging features and normal tumor markers aiding diagnosis. Surgery was the primary treatment with equal distribution of mature and immature histology. Long-term follow-up showed no recurrence, emphasizing the need for more case reports to establish natural history.

pmid-39685906.summary_ja: 若年成人精巣がんは優れた予後で、早期病変の生存率は99%に近い。AFP、β-hCG、LDHを含む腫瘍マーカーは診断と危険度分類に不可欠だが、感度は約50%で奇形腫を検出できない。miRNA-371a-3p（感度/特異度約90-92%/84-86%）などの新規バイオマーカーはGCT検出と管理の改善の可能性を示す。
pmid-39685906.summary_en: Testicular cancer in young adults has excellent prognosis with survival rates approaching 99% for early disease. Biomarkers including AFP, β-hCG, and LDH are essential for diagnosis and risk stratification but have limited sensitivity (~50%) and cannot detect teratoma. Novel biomarkers including miRNA-371a-3p (sensitivity/specificity ~90-92%/84-86%) show promise for improved detection and management of GCT.

pmid-39684459.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫は著しい炎症浸潤を有する高度に分化した胚細胞腫瘍である。自発的な奇形腫発症マウスを用いて、本研究はT細胞浸潤の2波を示す免疫細胞浸潤を特性化した。中等度および重度の拡大腫瘍はT細胞、単球/マクロファージおよびB細胞による進行性浸潤を示した。T細胞は免疫チェックポイント発現を伴う不活性状態を採用し、腫瘍成長を可能にした。
pmid-39684459.summary_en: Testicular teratomas are highly differentiated germ cell tumors with prominent inflammatory infiltrates. Using spontaneous teratoma-developing mice, this study characterized immune cell infiltration showing two waves of T-cell involvement. Moderate and severely enlarged tumors displayed progressive infiltration with T cells, monocytes/macrophages, and B cells. T cells adopted an inactive state with immune checkpoint expression, allowing tumor growth.

pmid-39682538.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は50%以上の甲状腺組織からなる卵巣成熟奇形腫の稀な亜型である。本システマティックレビューは14症例のハイブリッド画像法(PET/CT、SPECT/CT、PET/MRI)を診断評価のために検討。F-18 FDG PET/CTとI-131 NaI SPECT/CTは各々50%の症例に寄与。ハイブリッド画像法と他の検査法の組み合わせは初期診断とフォローアップに有用であった。
pmid-39682538.summary_en: Malignant struma ovarii (MSO) is a rare variant of ovarian mature teratoma composed of >50% thyroid tissue with malignant potential. This systematic review of 14 cases evaluated hybrid imaging (PET/CT, SPECT/CT, PET/MRI) for diagnostic assessment. F-18 FDG PET/CT and I-131 NaI SPECT/CT each contributed in 50% of cases. Hybrid imaging combined with other modalities proved valuable for initial diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-39678394.summary_ja: 奇形腫は3つの胚細胞層の誘導体から生じ、成熟奇形腫が最も一般的である。副腎への発生は稀である。本症例は妊娠30週に検出された18日齢女性の左副腎腫瘤で、コンピュータ断層撮影で9×7×5 cm大の明瞭な腫瘤を認めた。外科的切除と病理組織学的検査で多くの分化した組織を含む嚢胞性成熟奇形腫を確認。良好な経過フォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39678394.summary_en: Teratomas arise from derivatives of three germ cell layers, with mature teratomas being the most common subtype. Adrenal gland location is exceptionally rare. This case describes an 18-day-old girl with left suprarenal mass prenatally detected at 30 weeks gestation. Computed tomography showed a large, well-defined mass surgically resected measuring 9×7×5 cm. Histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma with well-differentiated tissues.

pmid-39677122.summary_ja: 高リスク因子を有する非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は治療の課題である。本症例は胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫を含む混合精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する36歳男性で、精巣摘除術後2年で転移性原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍への転化を示した。患者は積極的な化学療法と直列自家幹細胞移植を受け、有望な反応を示した。
pmid-39677122.summary_en: Nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) with high-risk features pose treatment challenges. This case reports a 36-year-old male with mixed testicular NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma) showing transformation to metastatic primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) two years post-orchiectomy. The patient received aggressive chemotherapy and tandem autologous stem cell transplantation with promising response.

pmid-39675903.summary_ja: 前縦隔類皮嚢腫は稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。本症例は低造影と増大傾向を示す31×21×25 mm前縦隔腫瘤を有する36歳女性。磁気共鳴画像法は不均質な信号強度を示した。外科的切除と病理組織学的検査で良性類皮嚢腫を確認、術後経過は良好であった。
pmid-39675903.summary_en: Anterior mediastinal dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) is a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. This case describes a 36-year-old woman with a 31×21×25 mm anterior mediastinal mass showing low contrast and expanding tendency. Magnetic resonance imaging showed heterogeneous signal intensity. Surgical resection with diagnostic histopathology confirmed benign dermoid cyst with uneventful postoperative course.

pmid-39672156.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における残存後腹膜腫瘤の病理組織学を予測することは個別化治療を指導する。本研究はラジオミック特性と血清マイクロRNAを組み合わせた統合機械学習モデルを開発し、前向き試験でAUC 0.91(0.80-0.99)を達成した。ウェブベースノモグラムは病理組織学的確率の迅速な計算を可能にする。
pmid-39672156.summary_en: Predicting histopathology of residual retroperitoneal masses in metastatic NSGCTs guides individualized treatment. This study develops an integrated machine learning model combining radiomic features and serum microRNAs, particularly miRNA-371, achieving AUC 0.91 (0.80-0.99) in prospective testing. The web-based nomogram enables swift calculation of histopathological probabilities for personalized treatment.

pmid-39671418.summary_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパルテート脳炎は卵巣奇形腫に関連する傍腫瘍症候群である。本症例は難治性不眠症、行動障害、精神症状を呈する22歳女性で、脳脊髄液検査で抗NMDAR抗体陽性、超音波検査で小さな卵巣内類皮嚢腫を認め、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘除術で成熟奇形腫を確認した。
pmid-39671418.summary_en: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis is a paraneoplastic syndrome predominantly affecting young women with ovarian teratomas. This case presents a 22-year-old female with refractory insomnia, behavioral disturbance, and psychiatric symptoms. CSF testing revealed anti-NMDAR antibodies. Endovaginal ultrasound identified a small atypical intraovarian dermoid cyst. Laparoscopic oophorectomy confirmed mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-39659389.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫(SO)は50%以上が甲状腺組織である稀な卵巣奇形腫で、悪性転化が起こり得る。腹膜甲状腺腫は現在、卵巣由来高分化濾胞癌(HDFCO)として分類され、低悪性度悪性可能性を示す。本症例は手術、甲状腺摘除術、ヨウ素-131で治療された再発性多焦点HDFCOを有する38歳女性について述べた。遺伝子検査で病原性DICER1変異が明らかになった。
pmid-39659389.summary_en: Struma ovarii (SO), a rare ovarian teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue, can undergo malignant transformation. Peritoneal strumosis, now classified as highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovarian origin (HDFCO), shows low-grade malignant potential. This case describes a 38-year-old woman with recurrent multifocal HDFCO treated with surgery, thyroidectomy, and iodine-131. Genetic testing revealed pathogenic DICER1 variant.

pmid-39650871.summary_ja: 胎児縦隔奇形腫は胎児水腫と子宮内胎児死亡を含む重篤な合併症を招く稀な腫瘍。超音波による早期出生前診断は患者カウンセリングと周産期計画に重要。本例は二絨毛膜二羊膜双胎妊娠の27歳女性で一児に縦隔奇形腫、胎児水腫発症し子宮内死亡。
pmid-39650871.summary_en: Fetal mediastinal teratomas are rare tumors that can cause serious complications including fetal hydrops and intrauterine fetal death. Early prenatal diagnosis via ultrasound is critical for counseling and postnatal planning. This case describes a 27-year-old woman in second trimester of dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy with mediastinal teratoma that developed hydrops and resulted in intrauterine fetal death.

pmid-39649900.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は若年男性の一般的な固形腫瘍で、精巣または性腺外から発生し得る。絨毛癌は稀で攻撃的なGCT亜型で、主に女性に影響を及ぼすが男性でも発生する。363例患者の集団ベース研究(精巣CC 74.4%、非精巣CC 25.6%)では、精巣CCは白人患者でより一般的で、5年全生存期間と癌特異的生存率が高かった。
pmid-39649900.summary_en: Germ cell tumors, common solid tumors in young men, can originate in testicles or extragonadal sites. Choriocarcinoma, a rare aggressive GCT subtype, primarily affects females but occurs in males. This population-based study of 363 patients (testicular CC 74.4%, nontesticular CC 25.6%) found testicular CC more common in white patients with higher 5-year overall and cancer-specific survival rates.

pmid-39644277.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(MSO)は卵巣奇形腫に由来する甲状腺がんで発生率は非常に低い。血清サイログロブリン(Tg)は高分化MSO を他の卵巣悪性腫瘍から鑑別するのに役立つ。正常血清Tgを示す54歳女性の本症例は、両側卵巣由来の高分化濾胞甲状腺癌で広範な腹膜転移を伴っていた。甲状腺摘除術とヨウ化物-131治療後、1年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-39644277.summary_en: Malignant struma ovarii (MSO) is thyroid cancer arising from ovarian teratomas with very low incidence. Serum thyroglobulin (Tg) helps differentiate highly differentiated MSO from other ovarian malignancies. This case of 54-year-old woman with normal serum Tg showed highly differentiated follicular thyroid carcinoma of bilateral ovarian origin with extensive peritoneal metastasis. After thyroidectomy and iodine-131 treatment, one-year follow-up showed no recurrence.

pmid-39640164.summary_ja: 精巣がんは若年男性で最も一般的な癌で予後は良好である。セミノーマは優位な胚細胞腫瘍亜型である。本症例は、大型の後腹膜および腹腔内腫瘤(左陰嚢腫瘤11.3cm)を示す転移性セミノーマを有する30歳ヒスパニック系男性を呈示する。患者は化学療法前に腫瘍崩解症候群基準と電解質異常を満たした。
pmid-39640164.summary_en: Testicular cancer is the most common cancer in young men with favorable outcomes. Seminoma is the predominant germ cell tumor subtype. This case presents a 30-year-old Hispanic male with metastatic seminoma showing large retroperitoneal and intraperitoneal masses (11.3 cm left scrotal mass). The patient met tumor lysis syndrome criteria with electrolyte derangements prior to chemotherapy.

pmid-39640112.summary_ja: 絨毛癌は悪性胚細胞腫瘍でβ-hCGを分泌し予後は不良である。リンパ節転移を伴う原発性肺絨毛癌は極めて稀である。32歳女性が外科治療後、エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンの3サイクル化学療法を受けた。治療後のPET/CTは無病を示した。
pmid-39640112.summary_en: Choriocarcinoma is a malignant germ cell tumor secreting beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG), often associated with poor prognosis. Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with lymph node metastasis is extremely rare. This case reports a 32-year-old woman treated surgically followed by three cycles of chemotherapy (etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, vincristine). Post-treatment PET/CT showed no evidence of disease.

pmid-39639286.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍患者80例の分析で、YST患者は若年で腫瘍サイズが大きく、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が著しく上昇し、MRI上主に充実性病変を示していた。信号強度、輝点サイン、肥厚した精索、上昇したAFP値が主要な診断指標であり、診断精度93.6%を達成した。
pmid-39639286.summary_en: 80 pediatric patients with testicular masses were analyzed to identify diagnostic features of yolk sac tumors. YST patients were younger with elevated AFP levels and larger solid tumors on MRI. Signal intensity, bright dot sign, thickened spermatic cord, and elevated AFP were key diagnostic indicators achieving 93.6% diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-39629066.summary_ja: 妊娠中に診断された悪性卵巣甲状腺腫で、11.2cm成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に乳頭状甲状腺癌成分を有する27歳患者。嚢胞切除術、後続する片側卵管卵巣摘出術、放射性ヨウ素治療により、初期診断から3年後も再発なし。
pmid-39629066.summary_en: A 27-year-old developed malignant struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma component within an 11.2 cm mature cystic teratoma during pregnancy. Managed with cystectomy, later completion salpingo-oophorectomy, and radioactive iodine therapy. Three years post-diagnosis, remains recurrence-free.

pmid-39628734.summary_ja: 出生前に検出された仙尾部奇形腫（II型）を有する新生児が生後4日に腸圧迫および血管盗流による壊死性腸炎を発症した。外科的切除により壊死性腸炎が解決し、仙尾部奇形腫を背景とした壊死性腸炎の初めての報告症例。
pmid-39628734.summary_en: A neonate with antenatally detected sacrococcygeal teratoma (Type II) developed necrotizing enterocolitis on day 4 of life due to bowel compression and vascular steal. Surgical excision resolved the necrotizing enterocolitis. First reported case of NEC in setting of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-39628710.summary_ja: 80歳女性の卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例。著しく上昇したαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値(246,720 ng/mL)、腹水、全身浮腫を呈した。YSTマーカーの免疫組織化学で確認。術後1年で再発なく良好な臨床状態。
pmid-39628710.summary_en: Rare case of ovarian yolk sac tumor in an 80-year-old woman with markedly elevated AFP (246,720 ng/mL), ascites, and anasarca. Immunohistochemistry confirmed YST markers. Literature review identified 11 postmenopausal YST cases; patient remains recurrence-free one year post-surgery without adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-39624212.summary_ja: 右心室単純奇形腫（甲状腺腫）を呈した50歳男性で、胸部絞扼感および労作時呼吸困難を認めた。心エコー図で58mm高エコー像が認められ、外科的切除により完全切除が達成され、病理は良性で2年予後良好。
pmid-39624212.summary_en: A 50-year-old man with right ventricular monodermal teratoma (goiter) presenting with chest tightness and exertional dyspnea. Echocardiography revealed 58 mm hyperechoic mass. Surgical resection achieved complete excision with benign pathology and favorable 2-year prognosis.

pmid-39618704.summary_ja: 25歳経産未婚女性の卵巣純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。YSTは悪性卵巣生殖細胞腫瘍の第2位（20%）。生殖年齢女性に好発し、化学療法感受性により予後良好。
pmid-39618704.summary_en: Case report of pure yolk sac tumor (YST) in a nulliparous 25-year-old woman with history of endometriotic cysts. YSTs are second most common malignant ovarian GCTs (20%), affecting women of reproductive age with favorable prognosis due to chemosensitivity.

pmid-39618635.summary_ja: 31ヶ月女児の卵巣成熟奇形腫（デルモイド嚢胞）偶発発見例。画像では脂肪と石灰化を含む大型嚢胞性腫瘤。手術切除で成熟奇形腫確認、毛髪・ゼラチン状物質・骨を含有。術後経過良好。
pmid-39618635.summary_en: A 31-month-old female with incidental suprapubic mature cystic teratoma/ovarian dermoid cyst. Imaging showed large cystic mass with fat and calcification. Surgical excision confirmed mature teratoma with hair, gelatinous material, and bone components. Uneventful recovery.

pmid-39610000.summary_ja: 下腹痛および月経困難症を有する27歳女性の左卵巣に2つの異なる嚢胞性病変が認められた。病理組織学的検査により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と子宮内膜症の稀な同時共存が確認された。複数の画像診断法を用いた術前診断の重要性が強調される。
pmid-39610000.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and dysmenorrhea found to have two distinct cystic lesions in left ovary. Histopathology confirmed coexistence of mature cystic teratoma and endometrioma, a rare simultaneous occurrence. Case highlights diagnostic challenges with multiple imaging modalities.

pmid-39606696.summary_ja: 小児119例から良性精巣腫瘍と卵黄嚢腫瘍を区別するノモグラム開発。年齢、AFP値、超音波血流パターンが予測因子。YST確率予測精度98%。46患者で検証。
pmid-39606696.summary_en: A nomogram was developed to distinguish benign testicular tumors from yolk sac tumors in 119 pediatric patients. Predictive factors included age, AFP levels, and ultrasound blood flow patterns. The nomogram achieved 98% accuracy in predicting YST probability, validated in 46 additional patients.

pmid-39605889.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマと初診された患者が標準化学療法後に手術。病理で体細胞型悪性腫瘍成分（黒色腫、平滑筋肉腫、PNET）を含む奇形腫と判明。黒色腫転移にチェックポイント阻害剤。
pmid-39605889.summary_en: A patient initially diagnosed with mediastinal seminoma received standard chemotherapy with partial response. Post-surgical histopathology revealed mediastinal teratoma with somatic-type malignancy (melanoma, leiomyosarcoma, PNET). Metastatic melanoma was treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

pmid-39600640.summary_ja: 39歳女性が膣出血とβ-HCG著上昇で発症、初診時は子宮頸部妊娠と誤診。病理で子宮頸部絨毛癌確定。選択的子宮動脈塞栓術で止血有効、不要な子宮摘出を回避。
pmid-39600640.summary_en: A 39-year-old woman presented with vaginal bleeding and β-HCG of 229,386 mIU/mL, initially misdiagnosed as cervical pregnancy. Pathological examination confirmed cervical choriocarcinoma. Selective uterine artery embolization proved effective in managing hemorrhage while avoiding unnecessary hysterectomy.

pmid-39596492.summary_ja: 8歳女児が呼吸困難で発症、脂肪・液体・石灰化を含む縦隔腫瘤。手術で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫とnephroblastoma焦点を確認。免疫組織化学で確定診断。術後経過良好。
pmid-39596492.summary_en: An 8-year-old female presented with respiratory distress and large anterior mediastinal mass containing fat, fluid, and calcification. Surgical resection confirmed mature cystic teratoma with foci of nephroblastoma (teratoid Wilms tumor variant). Immunohistochemistry confirmed diagnosis with excellent postoperative course.

pmid-39591572.summary_ja: 39例の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫（平均年齢23.5歳）の後方視的検討では、いずれの患者においても骨盤リンパ節転移は認められなかった。リンパ管転移は後腹膜リンパ節に限定され、外科的病期分類における骨盤リンパ節郭清は必要でないと考えられる。
pmid-39591572.summary_en: A retrospective study of 39 ovarian dysgerminoma cases (mean age 23.5 years) found that pelvic lymph node metastases did not occur in any patient. Lymphatic spread pattern was exclusively toward retroperitoneal (paracaval and paraaortic) nodes, suggesting pelvic lymphadenectomy is not necessary for staging.

pmid-39590141.summary_ja: 非常に悪性度の高い非セミノーマ性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍亜型である縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の外科的アプローチについての叙述的レビュー。治療はネオアジュバント シスプラチン併用化学療法の後に巩固手術が行われ、胸骨正中切開または側胸部切開による広範な切除が必要なことが多い。
pmid-39590141.summary_en: A narrative review of surgical approaches for mediastinal yolk sac tumors, a highly aggressive non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumor subtype. Treatment involves neoadjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by consolidation surgery, often requiring extensive resections via sternotomy or thoracotomy.

pmid-39588220.summary_ja: 13歳女性が骨盤症状で提示。画像検査から尾腸嚢胞が疑われたが、外科的探索により仙骨前成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が判明。病理組織学検査から線維血管壁、平滑筋、唾液腺様葉状構造、扁平上皮および呼吸器型上皮を特徴とする奇形腫を確認。
pmid-39588220.summary_en: A 13-year-old female with pelvic symptoms was initially suspected to have a tailgut cyst based on imaging, but surgical exploration revealed presacral mature cystic teratoma. Histopathology showed fibrovascular cyst wall with squamous and respiratory epithelium, smooth muscle, and salivary-type acini.

pmid-39581663.summary_ja: フランスAFU癌委員会ガイドライン(2024-2026更新版)：精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理についての診断(血清マーカー：AFP、hCG、LDH；画像検査)、病期I治療オプション、転移性疾患管理を網羅。生存率は優れており、病期I疾患で99%、転移性疾患で85%以上。
pmid-39581663.summary_en: French AFU Cancer Committee guidelines (2024-2026) for testicular germ cell tumor management covering diagnosis (serum markers: AFP, hCG, LDH; imaging), stage I treatment options, and metastatic disease management. Excellent survival rates: 99% for stage I, >85% for metastatic disease.

pmid-39580981.summary_ja: 2歳児が外傷後、急性腹症と腹膜炎で発症。手術で破裂した後腹膜奇形腫を確認、摘出。術後経過良好、予後良好。通常無症状の良性奇形腫も破裂時に急性腹症呈する。
pmid-39580981.summary_en: A 2-year-old with history of trauma presented with acute abdomen and peritonitis. Surgical exploration revealed ruptured retroperitoneal teratoma, which was successfully excised. Post-operative course stable with good prognosis. Illustrates that benign teratomas can present acutely if ruptured despite typically being asymptomatic.

pmid-39574183.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの予後と免疫療法反応を予測する免疫関連遺伝子シグネチャー（CTLA4、SNX17、TMX1）を同定。分子ドッキングで抗腫瘍活性化合物を特定。従来の予後因子を上回る予測精度。
pmid-39574183.summary_en: An immunology-focused study identified immune-related gene signatures (CTLA4, SNX17, TMX1) predicting testicular seminoma outcomes and immunotherapy response. Molecular docking identified potential compounds (Rutin, ICG-001, Doxorubicin) with anti-tumor activity. The signature predicts progression-free survival better than traditional prognostic factors.

pmid-39572455.summary_ja: 2004～2023年に治療された先天性口腔奇形腫12例の臨床シリーズ。エピナトスと真の奇形腫が主な病型で、外科的切除により良好な経過が得られた。再発1例も成功裏に治療された。口蓋裂が66%に併発。出生前診断と多学科的計画が治療成績を向上させた。
pmid-39572455.summary_en: Case series of 12 congenital oral teratomas treated 2004–2023, including epignathus, true teratomas, and teratoid variants. Most cases showed good surgical outcomes; one recurrence was successfully managed. Cleft palate was associated in 66% of cases. Prenatal diagnosis and multidisciplinary planning improved treatment success.

pmid-39561732.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における扁平上皮癌(SCC-MCT)のシステマティックレビューとメタ解析。654人の患者分析では、SCC-MCTは典型的に腫瘍径>10 cm以上の閉経後女性に発生。FIGO病期、年齢、腫瘍マーカーが予後を予測；外科的リンパ節郭清は生存を改善；化学療法や放射線療法は有益ではない。
pmid-39561732.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma (SCC-MCT). Analysis of 654 patients reveals SCC-MCT typically occurs postmenopausally in tumors >10 cm. FIGO stage, age, and tumor markers predict prognosis; surgical lymphadenectomy improves survival; chemotherapy/radiotherapy show no benefit.

pmid-39558421.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の核医学画像診断技術の総説。奇形腫と壊死組織の鑑別という臨床的課題を対象。NSGCTの診断改善のための分子イメージング放射トレーサーの進展を論述。
pmid-39558421.summary_en: Review of nuclear medicine imaging techniques for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Addresses unmet clinical need to differentiate teratoma from necrotic tissue in NSGCTs. Discusses past efforts and potential future advances in molecular imaging radiotracers for improved NSGCT diagnosis.

pmid-39555432.summary_ja: ステージIIIC非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における稀な腎自家移植症例。化学療法後の残存腫瘤が左腎血管を包囲。移植により腎機能を維持し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清に成功。
pmid-39555432.summary_en: Rare case of orthotopic renal autotransplantation in 24-year-old with Stage IIIC nonseminomatous GCT. Post-chemotherapy residual retroperitoneal mass encased left renal vessels but spared parenchyma. Autotransplantation maintained renal function, enabling successful retroperitoneal lymph node dissection without recurrence at 6-month follow-up.

pmid-39554378.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の破裂による慢性腹膜炎が悪性疾患を模倣する症例。腹膜炎治療の中心は手術洗浄。手術洗浄のみで不十分な場合、ステロイドを第二選択肢として検討。
pmid-39554378.summary_en: Case discussion of ruptured ovarian mature teratomas (dermoids) presenting with chronic peritonitis mimicking malignant disease. Surgical washout is the mainstay of treatment for chronic peritonitis from ruptured dermoids. Corticosteroids may be considered as second-line therapy when surgical washout alone proves insufficient.

pmid-39553367.summary_ja: 卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的臨床提示の症例報告。腹痛、高熱、呼吸困難、腹水と両側胸水を呈した。生殖能温存手術を実施、組織診断で混合型GCT確認。補助化学療法を施行。
pmid-39553367.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old female with ovarian mixed GCT presenting with atypical symptoms mimicking disseminated tuberculosis. Patient presented with abdominal pain, high-grade fever, dyspnea, and ascites with bilateral pleural effusion. Fertility-sparing surgery performed; histopathology confirmed mixed GCT; adjuvant chemotherapy administered.

pmid-39552994.summary_ja: 48歳男性がセミノーマと診断された6年後に後腹膜思春期後型奇形腫の晩期再発を来たした症例。画像診断と生検で神経内分泌腫瘍成分を含む奇形腫と診断。導入化学療法施行後に外科的切除を行い、病理組織学的検査で思春期後型奇形腫と神経内分泌腫瘍成分を確認。
pmid-39552994.summary_en: Case of 48-year-old with retroperitoneal postpubertal-type teratoma as late recurrence of testicular GCT initially diagnosed as seminoma. Imaging and biopsy showed neuroendocrine tumor. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy and surgical resection performed; histopathology confirmed postpubertal-type teratoma with neuroendocrine component.

pmid-39551650.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する化学療法後ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清173例の多施設後方視的研究。最終病理組織学的検査では壊死/線維化40%、奇形腫49%、実質的な胚細胞腫瘍11%。中央値フォローアップ22ヶ月における4年再発なし生存率は93%で、癌関連死は2例のみ。
pmid-39551650.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 173 patients undergoing robotic post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. Final pathology showed necrosis/fibrosis (40%), teratoma (49%), and viable tumor (11%). Four-year recurrence-free survival rate was 93% with minimal cancer-related deaths.

pmid-39550593.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマで補助的カルボプラチン(AUC 7)を投与された48歳男性の症例報告。カルボプラチン誘発性血尿と急性腎障害を発症。血液凝塊による尿流閉塞を保存的に管理し腎機能の完全寛解を達成。
pmid-39550593.summary_en: Case report of 48-year-old with stage I testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant carboplatin (AUC 7) experiencing carboplatin-induced hematuria and acute kidney injury. Post-void urine obstruction from blood clots managed conservatively. Complete resolution of renal function achieved; highlights rare adverse effects.

pmid-39548170.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍生存者における原発性性腺機能低下症の発症評価。参加者の28%が潜在性性腺機能低下症、25%が顕性性腺機能低下症。勃起不全50%、自覚症状63%に認められた。内分泌学的追跡の必要性を強調。
pmid-39548170.summary_en: Monocentric study evaluating primary hypogonadism development in male GCT survivors (2001–2019). Of 44 participants, 28% had latent hypogonadism and 25% had manifest hypogonadism. Erectile dysfunction observed in 50% and symptomatic affection in 63%. Standard questionnaires effectively detect gonadal damage.

pmid-39544263.summary_ja: セミノーマに伴う傍腫瘍性髄炎(MOGAD)の症例。COVID-19ワクチン接種後の亜急性脊髄炎で発症。ステロイド、血漿交換、セミノーマ化学療法で完全寛解。
pmid-39544263.summary_en: Case of paraneoplastic myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein-associated disorders (MOGAD) in patient with metastatic seminoma. Patient presented with subacute myelopathy after COVID-19 vaccine dose. Treated with steroids, plasma exchange, and chemotherapy for underlying seminoma with complete neurological resolution.

pmid-39541046.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるLINC00470の発現と機能に関する研究。LINC00470はTGCTで高発現し、EMT調節を通じてクローン形成と転移を促進。TGF-βとPI3K-AKT-mTORシグナルを活性化。シスプラチン感受性と逆相関。
pmid-39541046.summary_en: Study investigating LINC00470 lncRNA expression and function in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT). LINC00470 highly expressed in TGCT promotes cell clone formation and metastasis via TGF-β and PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling affecting epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Negatively correlates with cisplatin chemosensitivity.

pmid-39540580.summary_ja: 先天性頸部奇形腫を有する患児の症例報告。生後6日に腫瘍切除、先天性舌骨欠損に対し死体軟骨による舌骨再建施行。気管形成術と気管オンレイグラフトにより抜管成功。
pmid-39540580.summary_en: Case of 3-year-old with congenital cervical teratoma resected on day 6 of life, with congenital hyoid bone absence requiring tracheotomy. Novel hyoid reconstruction using cadaveric cartilage followed by tracheal onlay grafts achieved successful decannulation with improved pharyngeal and supraglottic airway function.

pmid-39539202.summary_ja: ステージIs混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者の局所再発症例。鼠蹊部と恥骨上領域に複数回の軟部組織再発。再発組織に不成熟組織を常に認める。医学文献では未報告のパターン。
pmid-39539202.summary_en: Case report of 40-year-old male with stage Is mixed GCT treated with inguinal orchiectomy (R0 resection) experiencing multiple inguinal and suprapubic soft tissue recurrences. Recurrences occurred early, invariably containing immature tissue on histopathology, previously undescribed in medical literature.

pmid-39532340.summary_ja: 中30代女性の侵入奇胎妊娠症例。極度に上昇したhCG(500,000 mIU/mL以上)によるフック効果で偽陰性結果を示した。出血、腹部腫瘤、高血圧、甲状腺機能亢進で発症。子宮全摘およびメトトレキサート化学療法で完全寛解。
pmid-39532340.summary_en: Case report of invasive molar pregnancy presenting with 'hook effect'—false negative hCG result due to extremely elevated levels exceeding 500,000 mIU/mL. Patient presented with bleeding, abdominal mass, hypertension, and hyperthyroidism. Hysterectomy and methotrexate chemotherapy performed with complete hCG normalization.

pmid-39528470.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍のSERPINB9の役割に関する単一細胞RNA解析研究。SERPINB9は胚細胞癌の幹性を駆動。ノックダウンで遊走能とシスプラチン耐性が低下、分化マーカーが上昇。ERK1/2とWNTシグナル調節を介する。
pmid-39528470.summary_en: Single-cell RNA sequencing study of non-seminomatous testicular GCT identifying SERPINB9 as key driver of stemness in embryonal carcinoma. SERPINB9 knockdown reduces migration, cisplatin resistance, and stemness markers while enhancing differentiation. Mechanistically regulates ERK1/2 and WNT signaling pathways.

pmid-39525133.summary_ja: 13歳女児における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。腹部腫瘤、疼痛、体重減少で発症。磁気共鳴画像法で検査し、病期分類開腹術、卵巣摘除術、リンパ節郭清、大網切除、化学療法を施行。病理組織学で診断確認。
pmid-39525133.summary_en: Case report of 13-year-old girl with ovarian yolk sac tumor (YST) presenting with abdominal mass, pain, weight loss, and fever. Imaging initially suggested uterine origin. Treatment included staging laparotomy with oophorectomy, lymph node dissection, omentectomy, and chemotherapy. Histopathology confirmed YST.

pmid-39518421.summary_ja: 絨毛上皮腫による大量胎児母体出血を呈する稀な胎盤部位絨毛上皮性疾患の症例報告と文献考察で、臨床管理と胎盤検査の重要性について述べています。
pmid-39518421.summary_en: Case report and literature review of intraplacental choriocarcinoma, a rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasia causing massive fetomaternal hemorrhage, with discussion of clinical management and importance of placental examination.

pmid-39502610.summary_ja: 22歳女性の両側性成熟卵巣奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の症例報告。腹腔鏡下嚢胞切除術により卵巣機能が成功裡に保持された。若い女性における卵巣機能温存の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-39502610.summary_en: Case report of bilateral mature ovarian teratomas (dermoid cysts) in a 22-year-old woman, with successful laparoscopic cystectomy and preservation of ovarian function, including management discussion.

pmid-39496873.summary_ja: 19歳女性の前縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例で、頸部への拡張と血管への高度な癒着のため手術困難であったが、正中胸骨切開による完全摘出に成功しました。
pmid-39496873.summary_en: Case report of anterior mediastinal mature teratoma extending into the neck in a 19-year-old female, requiring robot-assisted resection converted to median sternotomy due to vascular adhesions, with successful tumor excision.

pmid-39494392.summary_ja: 稀な消化管転移を伴う超高リスク絨毛上皮性疾患の症例報告で、化学療法耐性GTNにおけるPD-1阻害剤の併用療法の使用について述べています。
pmid-39494392.summary_en: Case report of ultra-high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with rare gastrointestinal metastases treated with combination PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor and chemotherapy, highlighting immunotherapy use in chemo-resistant GTN.

pmid-39493793.summary_ja: 心膜への稀な癒着を伴う成熟縦隔奇形腫の症例報告で、診断的課題と周囲組織保存を考慮した外科管理について述べています。
pmid-39493793.summary_en: Case report of mature mediastinal teratoma with rare adhesions to the pericardium, discussing diagnostic challenges and surgical management considerations for preserving adjacent structures.

pmid-39485878.summary_ja: 甲状腺がん治療後の131I全身スキャンで卵巣内の予期しない放射性ヨウ素取り込みを示した症例で、偶発的に発見された卵巣成熟奇形腫でした。
pmid-39485878.summary_en: Case report of unexpected radioiodine uptake in ovary on posttherapy 131I scan in a 23-year-old thyroid cancer patient, ultimately revealed to be an incidental mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-39483307.summary_ja: 小児仙尾部奇形腫29例の後方視的研究で、臨床的プレゼンテーション、仙骨的アプローチを含む手術的管理、卵黄嚢腫瘍や成熟奇形腫を含む病理組織学的所見、αフェトプロテインレベル、および周術期転帰を検討した。早期検出と早期紹介の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-39483307.summary_en: Retrospective study of 29 pediatric sacrococcygeal teratoma cases discussing clinical presentation, surgical management, histopathology including yolk sac tumors, AFP levels, and postoperative outcomes.

pmid-39482803.summary_ja: 孤立性仙尾部奇形腫を有する胎児55例の多施設後方視的研究では、腫瘍成長速度≥7 mm/週が不良周産期転帰（新生児死亡および重篤な障害を含む）の最良の予測因子であることが同定され、感度88%、特異度77%を示した。この結果は出生前管理と親への相談に有用である。
pmid-39482803.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 55 fetuses with isolated sacrococcygeal teratoma, identifying tumor growth velocity ≥7 mm/week as the best predictor of poor perinatal outcome with 88% sensitivity and 77% specificity.

pmid-39482699.summary_ja: KDM6A/KDM6B標的化によりシスプラチン感受性および耐性精巣GCTの両方がp53媒介転写の増強を通じて化学療法に感受化することを示した実験的研究です。
pmid-39482699.summary_en: Experimental study demonstrating that targeting polycomb demethylases KDM6A and KDM6B with GSK-J4 sensitizes both cisplatin-sensitive and -resistant testicular germ cell tumors to chemotherapy through p53-mediated transcription enhancement.

pmid-39482010.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された21歳女性がBEP化学療法後に薬物誘発性血栓性微小血管症を発症した稀な症例。血漿交換3回により改善し、補助化学療法は中止となったが17ヶ月間無病生存を達成。BEPレジメンによる稀な致命的合併症の診断と治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-39482010.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old woman with endodermal sinus tumor (ovarian yolk sac tumor) who developed drug-induced thrombotic microangiopathy after BEP chemotherapy, requiring plasma exchange with 17-month disease-free survival.

pmid-39479433.summary_ja: 頸部リンパ管腫を伴うエピグナタス（頭頸部有茎奇形腫）の症例報告で、気道閉塞を防ぐための早期外科摘出が必要な稀な臨床像について述べています。
pmid-39479433.summary_en: Case report of epignathus (pedunculated head-and-neck teratoma) with concurrent cervical lymphangioma, discussing management of this rare presentation requiring early surgical excision.

pmid-39479419.summary_ja: フェタス・イン・フェタス249例のシステマティックレビューで、臨床病理学的特性と手術的管理を分析した。成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫の両方がFIFに関連して稀に認められ、完全切除と詳細な病理組織学的検査が治療の基本であり、大多数の症例で良好な転帰が得られた。
pmid-39479419.summary_en: Systematic review of 249 fetus-in-fetu cases analyzing clinicopathological features and surgical management, noting that both mature and immature teratomas can occur with FIF and emphasizing complete resection.

pmid-39479066.summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で胸痛と嚥下困難を呈した19歳男性の症例報告で、正中胸骨切開により治療され完全摘出後の良好な予後を示しました。
pmid-39479066.summary_en: Case report of anterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma in 19-year-old male presenting with chest pain and dysphagia, successfully treated with median sternotomy with favorable prognosis.

pmid-39477316.summary_ja: セミノーマとコントロール精巣組織のケモカイン発現と腫瘍浸潤リンパ球の免疫組織化学的比較で、TILのケモカイン発現がセミノーマ再発の予後マーカーとなる可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-39477316.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study comparing chemokine expression and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes between 25 seminoma and 24 control testicular samples, suggesting chemokine expression in TILs may serve as prognostic marker.

pmid-39465013.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける好中球/リンパ球比(NLR)の診断的および予後的マーカーとしての評価システマティックレビュー。精巣がん患者でNLRが上昇し、予後不良と進行期を予測したが、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性亜型の鑑別はできなかった。
pmid-39465013.summary_en: Systematic review evaluating neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) as a diagnostic and prognostic marker in testicular cancer. NLR was elevated in testicular cancer patients compared to controls, predicted poor prognosis and advanced disease, but could not differentiate between seminoma and non-seminomatous subtypes.

pmid-39463534.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ寛解後6年経過した66歳男性の膵臓転移による閉塞性黄疸の症例。生検で転移セミノーマが確認され、BEP化学療法により完全寛解を達成。
pmid-39463534.summary_en: Case of 66-year-old male with prior testicular seminoma who developed obstructive jaundice from pancreatic metastatic seminoma six years after remission. Biopsy confirmed metastatic disease; patient achieved complete remission with cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy.

pmid-39462634.summary_ja: 胸部異常陰影で発見された肺結節が精巣セミノーマの転移であった稀な症例。肺に高い18F-FDG集積、精巣に淡い集積を認め、精巣セミノーマの単一肺転移と診断。
pmid-39462634.summary_en: Case of 57-year-old man with lung nodules discovered on imaging who was found to have testicular seminoma with solitary pulmonary metastasis. PET-CT showed high FDG uptake in lungs and faint uptake in left testis, an extremely rare presentation.

pmid-39461959.summary_ja: 精巣生殖細胞腫瘍の包括的ゲノムシーケンス解析。コピー数異常、構造変異、変異シグネチャを記載し、セミノーマと非セミノーマの異なる進化軌跡を確認。免疫回避機構としてのHLA喪失を解析。
pmid-39461959.summary_en: Comprehensive whole genome sequencing analysis of testicular GCTs from UK 100,000 Genomes Project. Characterizes genomic elements including copy number alterations, structural variations, mutational signatures, and HLA loss mechanisms, revealing divergent evolutionary trajectories between seminomas and non-seminomas.

pmid-39461379.summary_ja: 5症例の上皮様栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)の最大の系列。4症例は化学療法済みの精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往があり、初期診断から3-15年後に転移部位にETTを発症。β-hCGレベルは様々で、化学療法にもかかわらず転移性疾患で不良な転帰を示した。
pmid-39461379.summary_en: Largest series of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) in males, with five cases from prior testicular GCT treated with chemotherapy. Four patients developed ETT in metastatic sites 3-15 years after initial GCT diagnosis. ETT showed aggressive disease course despite varied β-hCG levels.

pmid-39461139.summary_ja: 37歳男性の後腹膜一次性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(卵黄嚢腫瘍およびセミノーマ)がSalmonella bovismorbificans膿瘍で複雑化。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は3,330 kIU/Lで上昇。適切な治療にもかかわらず感染継続時に基礎悪性腫瘍を考慮すべき症例。
pmid-39461139.summary_en: Case of 37-year-old man with primary retroperitoneal non-seminomatous GCT (yolk sac tumor and seminoma) complicated by Salmonella bovismorbificans abscess. Elevated AFP at 3,330 kIU/L. Case highlights importance of considering underlying malignancy when infections persist despite treatment.

pmid-39461133.summary_ja: 30歳男性の膵成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の稀な症例。石灰化を伴う8.8×7.2 cmの腫瘤。重要な構造への関与のためWhipple術を施行。膵奇形腫は文献に約52症例が記載されている。
pmid-39461133.summary_en: Rare case of 30-year-old male with pancreatic mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) measuring 8.8×7.2 cm with calcifications. Whipple procedure performed due to involvement with critical structures. Only approximately 52 cases of pancreatic teratomas documented in literature.

pmid-39458194.summary_ja: 胎児奇形腫の診断と管理に関するレビュー。超音波とMRIによる出生前診断、EXIT手術を含む管理戦略を論述。偶発所見から生命を脅かす重症例まで様々な病態を対象。
pmid-39458194.summary_en: Review of fetal teratomas covering diagnosis via prenatal ultrasound and MRI, and management strategies including EXIT procedures for complicated cases. Discusses varying severity from incidental findings to life-threatening conditions requiring multidisciplinary intervention.

pmid-39455407.summary_ja: 臨床病期I NSGCT患者774人(純粋奇形腫63人)のフォローアップ研究。純粋奇形腫群は他のNSGCTと比較して優れた再発無病生存率を示し、6年時点で85.2%対67.9%であったが、癌特異的生存率と全生存期間(全生存率)は同様で、精巣がんによる死亡はなかった。
pmid-39455407.summary_en: Study of 774 clinical stage I NSGCT patients (63 with pure teratoma) on surveillance. Pure teratoma group had superior relapse-free survival (85.2% vs 67.9% at 6 years) compared to other NSGCTs, but similar cancer-specific and overall survival with no deaths from testicular cancer.

pmid-39449371.summary_ja: P19胚細胞がん細胞におけるα-カテニン欠損が細胞分化と奇形腫形成に与える影響を研究。細胞間接着喪失は分化障害と正常な奇形腫形成の阻害をもたらした。
pmid-39449371.summary_en: Study of α-catenin knockout P19 embryonal carcinoma cells investigating effects on differentiation and teratoma formation. Loss of cell-cell contact impaired differentiation, prevented formation of normal embryoid bodies, and blocked teratoma development in vivo.

pmid-39446987.summary_ja: 悪性仙尾部奇形腫によるL3転移と馬尾症候群を呈した1歳男児の症例。術前化学療法後に遅延L3楔形切除を実施し、神経機能の回復を達成。
pmid-39446987.summary_en: Case report of 1-year-old boy with malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma and cauda equina syndrome from metastatic involvement of L3 with epidural compression. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by delayed en bloc L3 excision achieved neurological recovery.

pmid-39445228.summary_ja: 14歳の思春期女児が抗NMDA受容体脳炎で、初期は精神症状と双側卵巣奇形腫を呈した。双側嚢胞摘出術後に回復したが、1年後に左卵巣奇形腫の再発により卵管卵巣摘除術を要した。
pmid-39445228.summary_en: Case of 14-year-old female with anti-NMDAR encephalitis initially presenting with psychiatric symptoms and bilateral ovarian teratomas. After bilateral cystectomy, patient recovered but relapsed one year later with recurrent left ovarian teratoma requiring salpingo-oophorectomy.

pmid-39437503.summary_ja: 生後9ヶ月の女児における一次性成熟副腎奇形腫の症例報告。腹部膨満で来院し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で大きな右副腎上領域の不均質な腫瘤を認めた。外科的切除により成熟奇形腫が確認された。小児患者での報告は極めて稀である。
pmid-39437503.summary_en: Case report of 9-month-old female with primary mature adrenal teratoma presenting with abdominal distention. CT showed large right suprarenal heterogeneous mass. Surgical resection confirmed mature teratoma. Only few cases of primary adrenal teratoma in pediatric patients reported.

pmid-39435232.summary_ja: 左腎静脈から下大静脈への腫瘍栓を伴う混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢成分が優位）で、後腹膜および肺転移を有する38歳男性の症例。精巣摘除術後、BEP化学療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）3サイクルにより転移性疾患の完全奏効を達成した。
pmid-39435232.summary_en: Case of 38-year-old male with mixed testicular GCT (predominantly yolk sac components) and IVC tumor thrombus extending from left renal vein, with retroperitoneal and pulmonary metastases. Achieved complete remission with three cycles of BEP chemotherapy.

pmid-39435219.summary_ja: 44歳女性の原発性肺絨毛癌（稀な非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）で、初期には肺腺癌と誤診された症例。化学放射線療法失敗後、生検で確認され、シスプラチンとエトポシドを含む10サイクルの化学療法で完全な転移応答と著明な原発腫瘍縮小を達成した。
pmid-39435219.summary_en: Case of 44-year-old woman with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma (rare non-seminomatous GCT), initially misdiagnosed as adenocarcinoma. After failed chemoradiation, confirmed by biopsy and treated with ten cycles of chemotherapy achieving complete metastatic response and marked tumor reduction.

pmid-39435085.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連抗NMDA受容体脳炎を有する98人の女性患者を対象としたメタ解析およびシステマティックレビュー。発作、精神病、低換気、失語症、昏睡を含む神経精神症状の有病率を検討した。初発精神病での抗NMDAR抗体スクリーニングと卵巣奇形腫の検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-39435085.summary_en: Meta-analysis and systematic review of 98 female patients with anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma. Examined prevalence of neuropsychiatric symptoms including seizures, psychosis, hypoventilation, and coma. Emphasizes screening for anti-NMDAR antibodies and ovarian teratoma in first-episode psychosis.

pmid-39434070.summary_ja: 腎臓および肺転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛癌で、初期には異所性妊娠と誤診された27歳女性の症例報告。メトトレキサート治療が無効であった後、8サイクルの化学療法で完全寛解を達成し、その後1年以上の期間再発を認めていない状態が継続している。
pmid-39434070.summary_en: Case of 27-year-old woman with gestational trophoblastic disease (choriocarcinoma) presenting with renal and pulmonary metastases, initially suspected ectopic pregnancy. After failed methotrexate therapy, successfully treated with eight cycles of chemotherapy achieving recurrence-free status.

pmid-39425502.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫(小児胚細胞腫瘍)14例の研究。11例の長期生存者で3例の再発を認め、7例が成熟奇形腫、3例が未熟奇形腫、3例が悪性奇形腫であった。消化器系、泌尿器系、筋骨格系の重大な罹病率が認められ、多職種ケアが必要。
pmid-39425502.summary_en: Study of 14 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), a pediatric germ cell tumor. Results showed 11 long-term survivors with 3 recurrences; 7 had mature teratoma, 3 immature, 3 malignant. Significant morbidity involved gastrointestinal, genitourinary, and musculoskeletal systems requiring multidisciplinary care.

pmid-39421338.summary_ja: 広靱帯に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の極めて希少な症例報告。若い女性が腹痛で当院を受診し、B超音波検査で左付属器領域に異常な腫瘤が認められた。開腹術により広靱帯に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が存在し、病理検査で良性と診断され、卵巣と子宮は正常であった。
pmid-39421338.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma in the broad ligament, a rare extragonadal location. 24-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain; surgical exploration revealed benign mature teratoma in the broad ligament with normal ovaries and uterus.

pmid-39415133.summary_ja: 135例の小児および60例の成人精巣腫瘍の後方視的比較。小児症例は主に成熟奇形腫(82例)と卵黄嚢腫瘍(37例)で占められていたが、成人は主にセミノーマ(17例)を特徴とした。小児症例の大多数は良性であり、卵黄嚢腫瘍とセミノーマがそれぞれ最も一般的な悪性型だった。
pmid-39415133.summary_en: Retrospective comparison of 135 pediatric and 60 adult testicular tumors. Pediatric cases predominantly featured mature teratomas (82) and yolk sac tumors (37); adults had mainly seminomas (17). Most pediatric cases were benign; yolk sac tumor and seminoma were most common malignant types respectively.

pmid-39413983.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胎児性癌NT2/D1細胞におけるエストロゲン受容体(ER)シグナル伝達の研究。ER活性化によってERK1/2のリン酸化が増加した。SRCおよびERK1/2阻害剤によってエストロゲンまたはER作動薬によって誘導された増殖と浸潤が阻害され、ERが腫瘍形成ポテンシャルを増強することが示された。
pmid-39413983.summary_en: Study investigating estrogen receptor (ER) signaling in human testicular embryonic carcinoma NT2/D1 cells. ER activation increased ERK1/2 phosphorylation. SRC and ERK1/2 inhibitors blocked proliferation and invasion induced by estrogen or ER agonists, demonstrating ERs enhance tumorigenic potential.

pmid-39411122.summary_ja: 再発/難治性胚細胞腫瘍における自家造血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法のシステマティックレビューとメタ解析。IT94ランダム化試験(N=263)に基づいて、大量化学療法は全生存期間にほとんど効果を示さなかった(HR 0.98)。この治療法の有効性を支持または反論する十分なエビデンスは不足している。
pmid-39411122.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation in relapsed/refractory germ cell tumors. Based on IT94 randomized trial (N=263), high-dose therapy showed little to no effect on overall survival (HR 0.98). Insufficient evidence supports or refutes this treatment.

pmid-39411051.summary_ja: Struma ovarii19例の検討。中央値年齢41.7歳で、3例が悪性。良性例は腫瘍核出術で保存的治療、悪性例は片側付属器切除、全甲状腺切除、放射性ヨウ素アブレーション施行。全例で治療期間中死亡なし。
pmid-39411051.summary_en: Study of 19 patients with struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma with thyroid tissue. Median age 41.7 years; 3 cases (15.8%) were malignant. Benign cases treated conservatively with tumor enucleation; malignant cases underwent salpingo-oophorectomy, thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine ablation with excellent long-term outcomes.

pmid-39410982.summary_ja: 青年期患者のmediastinal germ cell tumorが胸骨全体への同時転移を呈した稀な症例。多剤化学療法、mediastinal massと胸骨の一塊切除、再建術を実施。専門的な集学的治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-39410982.summary_en: Case report of malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor in a teenager presenting with rare synchronous whole sternal metastasis. Treatment involved neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by en bloc excision of mediastinal mass with sternal resection and reconstruction at a specialized cancer center.

pmid-39406772.summary_ja: 卵巣germ cell tumors 34例（dysgerminoma 10例、卵黄囊腫瘍5例、未熟型奇形腫5例ほか）のPD-L1発現とTIL、予後の関連を検討。Dysgerminomaは卵黄囊腫瘍に比べてPD-L1高発現、TIL高値で予後良好、免疫療法の効果期待。
pmid-39406772.summary_en: Study of 34 ovarian germ cell tumors examining PD-L1 expression, immune infiltration, and prognosis. Dysgerminomas showed higher PD-L1 expression and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) compared to yolk sac tumors and immature teratomas, associating with better prognosis and potential benefit from immunotherapy.

pmid-39405752.summary_ja: 新生児の右心房の成熟奇形腫の症例報告。心エコーで心房中隔に付着した6×9 mmの腫瘤を認め、軽度の三尖弁逆流を伴っていた。外科的摘出に成功し、病理で奇形腫を確認。優れた回復と正常なフォローアップを得た。
pmid-39405752.summary_en: Case report of mature teratoma in right atrium of 20-hour-old newborn. Echocardiography showed 6×9 mm mass attached to interatrial septum with mild tricuspid regurgitation. Successful surgical removal; pathology confirmed teratoma. Child had excellent recovery with normal follow-up exams.

pmid-39403340.summary_ja: 725例のgestational trophoblastic neoplasm患者（epithelioid trophoblastic tumor 139例、placental site trophoblastic tumor 107例、gestational choriocarcinoma 479例）を対象とした機械学習による予後予測研究。Gradient Boostingモデルが最適で、腫瘍サイズ、診断年、年齢、人種が主要予後因子。
pmid-39403340.summary_en: Study using machine learning to predict survival in gestational trophoblastic neoplasms (GTN), analyzing 725 patients: 139 epithelioid trophoblastic tumors (ETT), 107 placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT), and 479 gestational choriocarcinomas. Gradient Boosting classifier best predicted outcomes; tumor size, year of diagnosis, age, and race were key prognostic factors.

pmid-39403079.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の既往を有する31歳女性のgestational choriocarcinoma症例。高度の頭痛、左片麻痺、言語障害で発症。β-hCGが200,000 mIU/mLに上昇。脳画像で右前頭頭頂部出血性静脈梗塞、肺転移を認めた。
pmid-39403079.summary_en: Case report of 31-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with neurological symptoms (severe headaches, weakness, speech difficulties) after molar pregnancy history. β-hCG elevated to 200,000 mIU/mL. Imaging showed hemorrhagic venous infarct and multiple lung metastases.

pmid-39399086.summary_ja: 28歳男性の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の下部頸椎・上部胸椎への転移による症候性脊髄圧迫症例。尿閉と進行性四肢筋力低下で発症し、減圧椎弓切除術で治療されたが、初回手術から1年後に再発し、その後の複数回の減量術にもかかわらず最終的に死亡した。
pmid-39399086.summary_en: Case report of 28-year-old male with testicular yolk sac tumor metastatic to lower cervical and upper thoracic vertebrae causing symptomatic cord compression. Presented with urinary retention and progressive weakness. Treated with decompressive laminectomies; disease recurred one year later requiring repeated debulking.

pmid-39398931.summary_ja: 局所進行性縦隔絨毛癌の38歳女性症例（上大静脈浸潤、β-hCG 298,220 mIU/mL）。初期BEP療法後、ARDS発症リスク軽減のためブレオマイシン非含有VIP療法に切り替え。合併症なく完全外科的切除を達成し、16ヶ月間無病生存中。
pmid-39398931.summary_en: Case report of 38-year-old woman with locally advanced primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma (6.5 cm mass invading superior vena cava), β-hCG 298,220 mIU/mL. After initial BEP therapy, switched to bleomycin-free VIP therapy to reduce ARDS risk. Complete surgical resection achieved without complications; disease-free at 16 months.

pmid-39396168.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後の転移(性)妊娠性絨毛癌の20歳女性患者。COVID-19中の化学療法自己中断により重篤な進行・腹腔内出血が生じ緊急手術。止血後EMA/CO療法続いてTP/TE療法で完全寛解を達成。
pmid-39396168.summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma after molar pregnancy. Self-discontinuation of chemotherapy during COVID-19 led to severe progression with intra-abdominal hemorrhage requiring emergency surgery. After hemostasis, EMA/CO followed by TP/TE regimen achieved complete remission.

pmid-39392037.summary_ja: Cisplatin耐性testicular germ cell tumorにおけるEMT関連因子SLUGの役割を検討。NTERA-2細胞株とマウスモデルでSLUGを含むEMT関連遺伝子が耐性モデルで上昇。SLUG低発現で無増悪生存期間が延長（46.4ヶ月対28.0ヶ月）。
pmid-39392037.summary_en: Study of cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors, investigating epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) regulator SLUG. Using NTERA-2 cell line and mouse model, EMT markers including SLUG were upregulated in cisplatin-resistant models. Lower SLUG expression associated with longer progression-free survival.

pmid-39387353.summary_ja: 46,XX核型を有する14.5歳の少女が両側性腺芽腫と左側ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）による男性化で発現した症例報告。両側卵管卵巣摘除術を施行。一次性性腺機能不全による男性化における悪性性腺腫瘍を考慮することの重要性を示唆している。
pmid-39387353.summary_en: Case report of 14.5-year-old girl with 46,XX karyotype presenting with virilization due to bilateral gonadoblastoma with left-sided dysgerminoma. Underwent bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Illustrates importance of considering malignant gonadal tumors in primary gonadal insufficiency with virilization.

pmid-39382358.summary_ja: 子宮外妊娠9ヶ月後に発生した腸管choriocarcinomaの初報告症例。24歳女性が腹痛、膨満、嘔吐で発症。手術で小腸閉塞・膿瘍を認め、病理診断でgestational choriocarcinoma確認。卵巣・子宮は正常。
pmid-39382358.summary_en: First reported case of intestinal choriocarcinoma following ectopic pregnancy, presenting 9 months after. 24-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain, distension, vomiting. Laparotomy revealed intestinal obstruction and abscess from choriocarcinoma with normal gynecologic organs. Pathology confirmed gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-39377011.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)は新生児における稀な胚細胞悪性腫瘍で、迅速な外科的切除が必要である。病理組織学的所見に関わらず、再発および潜在的合併症を監視するための長期フォローアップが必要であり、最適な転帰を確保し、早期介入を可能にすることを強調している。
pmid-39377011.summary_en: Sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) is a rare germ cell malignancy in newborns requiring prompt surgical resection. The paper emphasizes necessity of long-term follow-up for monitoring recurrence and potential complications, regardless of histopathological findings, to ensure optimal outcomes and enable early intervention.

pmid-39376553.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫を含む良性卵巣腫瘤の診断および管理上の課題を検討する症例集。画像検査、手術所見、および病理組織学的検査を統合した包括的診断アプローチを強調し、良性腫瘤と悪性腫瘤を正確に区別し、管理戦略を提供することの重要性を示唆している。
pmid-39376553.summary_en: Case series examining diagnostic and management challenges of benign ovarian masses, including mature teratoma. Paper emphasizes comprehensive diagnostic approach integrating imaging, surgical findings, and histopathology to accurately distinguish benign from malignant ovarian masses and inform management strategies.

pmid-39376438.summary_ja: 25歳女性の左口蓋扁桃における巨大エピグナサス(成熟奇形腫)の稀な症例。奇形腫は通常仙尾部領域で発生するが、この症例は異常な発現部位である。完全外科的切除で治療され、病理組織学的検査で確認された。6ヶ月のフォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39376438.summary_en: Rare case of giant epignathus (mature teratoma) in the left palatine tonsil of a 25-year-old female, an unusual presentation despite teratomas typically occurring in sacrococcygeal region. Complete surgical excision achieved with histopathology confirmation and 6-month follow-up showing no recurrence.

pmid-39375580.summary_ja: 症状発症時に明らかな卵巣奇形腫を認めなかった若い女性の抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例。症状発症から8ヶ月後に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。抗NMDA受容体脳炎関連卵巣奇形腫は症状を伴わない遅延的な発現の可能性があり、患者の長期フォローアップの重要性を強調している。
pmid-39375580.summary_en: Case of anti-NMDAR encephalitis in young woman initially without evident ovarian teratoma, later diagnosed with mature cystic teratoma eight months post-symptom onset. Demonstrates importance of long-term follow-up as anti-NMDAR encephalitis-associated teratomas may develop in delayed manner without symptoms.

pmid-39371651.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成で胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマとディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫))を発症した3例の後方視的臨床研究。胚細胞腫瘍は性腺異形成の最初の発現である可能性があることを強調し、原発性無月経を伴う女性型表現型患者における核型検査の重要性を示唆している。
