pmid-38967557.summary_en: Retrospective study comparing primary RPLND alone versus with adjuvant chemotherapy in pathologic stage II NSGCT. 109 patients (96 RPLND-only, 13 with adjuvant chemotherapy). 5-year RFS 72% vs 92%; DSS similar. Most patients don't require additional chemotherapy; RPLND-only approach may reduce treatment burden.

pmid-38966804.summary_ja: 低容量転移性セミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清の集団ベース研究(62例)。外科的合併症率は低く(5%)、24ヶ月無増悪生存率90%、全生存率100%。化学療法/放射線療法に対する代替治療選択肢となり、長期的な治療関連罹病率を減らす可能性がある。
pmid-38966804.summary_en: Population-based Swedish-Norwegian study of primary RPLND for low-volume metastatic seminoma (62 patients). Low surgical complication rate (5% Clavien-Dindo III). 24-month PFS 90%, OS 100%. RPLND offers alternative to chemotherapy/radiation for selected seminomas, potentially reducing long-term treatment morbidity.

pmid-38966772.summary_ja: 病期IIIBの進行精巣非セミノーマの症例報告。導入化学療法中のCOVID-19感染にもかかわらず化学療法で成功裏に治療され、最小限の治療延期で寛解を達成した。がん進行リスク管理と急性COVID-19重症度のバランスの重要性を示唆。
pmid-38966772.summary_en: Case report of stage IIIB advanced testicular non-seminoma successfully treated with chemotherapy despite COVID-19 infection during induction. Patient achieved remission with minimal treatment delay. Demonstrates importance of balancing cancer progression risk with acute COVID-19 severity in treatment decisions.

pmid-38966769.summary_ja: 17α-水酸化酵素欠損症を有する46,XY患者のセミノーマの稀な症例。この遺伝的背景における初めての生殖細胞腫瘍報告。予防的性腺摘出と多職種専門家の関与が重要である。
pmid-38966769.summary_en: Rare case of seminoma in 46,XY patient with 17α-hydroxylase deficiency presenting as 9-cm pelvic mass. Patient had undiagnosed XY karyotype and endocrine disorder until age 52. Third documented testicular tumor case in this genetic context. Highlights need for prophylactic gonadectomy in this disorder.

pmid-38966768.summary_ja: 絨毛癌症候群を伴う精巣腫瘍の症例。肺転移による呼吸不全に対してECMO管理と化学療法を組み合わせた治療を実施。ECMOは絨毛癌症候群による呼吸不全管理に有用である。
pmid-38966768.summary_en: Case report of testicular tumor with choriocarcinoma syndrome and multiple lung metastases causing respiratory failure. Reduced chemotherapy combined with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) successfully maintained oxygenation until chemotherapy reduced lung masses. Demonstrates ECMO utility in managing choriocarcinoma-related respiratory complications.

pmid-38966065.summary_ja: 16人の卵黄嚢腫瘍患者の後方視的分析（13卵巣、2仙骨尾骨、1腸間膜）。全症例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇。58.3％でCA125上昇。3つの超音波タイプを特定。超音波特性と腫瘍マーカーの組み合わせは診断を改善し受精能保存手術を導く。
pmid-38966065.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 16 yolk sac tumor (YST) patients (13 ovarian, 2 sacrococcygeal, 1 mesenteric). Elevated AFP observed in all cases; 58.3% had elevated CA125. Three ultrasound types identified. Combined ultrasound features with tumor markers improve diagnosis and guide fertility-preserving surgical decisions.

pmid-38965563.summary_ja: 32人の小児卵巣未熟奇形腫患者の後方視的レビュー。87.5％が病期I、手術単独で治療。5人の患者が腹膜神経膠腫症を有し広範な手術不要。5年全生存期間100％、無事象生存期間93.4％。限局性未熟奇形腫に対する手術単独戦略は適切。
pmid-38965563.summary_en: Retrospective review of 32 pediatric ovarian immature teratoma (IT) patients. 87.5% stage I, treated with surgery alone; 5 patients had gliomatosis peritonei without requiring extensive surgery. 5-year overall survival 100%, event-free survival 93.4%. Surgery-alone strategy appropriate for localized IT.

pmid-38963187.summary_ja: 100個の未熟奇形腫、125個の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍、6個の多胚腫の病理学的研究。よく形成された胚様体は稀であるが、14％の未熟奇形腫に胚様体残存がある。25％の悪性混合型腫瘍に残存を認め、卵黄嚢腫瘍および胎児性癌と関連。
pmid-38963187.summary_en: Pathologic study of embryoid bodies and related proliferations in 100 immature teratomas, 125 malignant mixed GCTs, and 6 polyembryomas. Well-formed embryoid bodies rare but remnants present in 14% of immature teratomas. Remnants found in 25% of malignant mixed tumors, often associated with yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-38961699.summary_ja: 双側転移性精巣腫瘍の3症例。発症間隔は平均19年と長く、対側精巣腫瘍検出には長期的経過観察が必要。精巣萎縮や未降下精巣の既往がある場合は対側精巣生検を考慮すべき。
pmid-38961699.summary_en: Three cases of bilateral metachronous testicular tumors: Case 1 - nonseminomatous GCT with metastases 24 years after germ cell neoplasia in situ; Case 2 - bilateral seminomas 19 years apart; Case 3 - bilateral seminomas 14 years apart. Long interval (mean 19 years) emphasizes need for lifelong surveillance.

pmid-38958901.summary_ja: 2023年SEOM精巣胚細胞腫瘍管理ガイドライン。鼠径精巣摘除術、IGCCCG予後分類、BEP化学療法レジメン、マーカー低下評価、残存腫瘍管理、救援治療をカバー。セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、性腺外後腹膜・縦隔腫瘍に適用。
pmid-38958901.summary_en: 2023 SEOM guidelines for testicular GCT management. Covers inguinal orchiectomy, IGCCCG prognostic classification, BEP chemotherapy regimens, marker decline assessment, residual mass management by tumor type, and salvage therapy. Applies to seminoma, non-seminoma, and extragonadal retroperitoneal/mediastinal tumors.

pmid-38957159.summary_ja: 両側同時性精巣がんで不一致の病理組織像を伴う症例報告（1853年以来57番目）。同時に発症する両側精巣腫瘍が異なる病理学的亜型を呈する非常に稀有な臨床像であり、異時性両側腫瘍の発現形式と比較して極めて稀である。
pmid-38957159.summary_en: Case report of bilateral synchronous testicular cancer with discordant histopathology (57th documented case since 1853). Demonstrates unusual presentation of simultaneous bilateral testicular tumors with different pathologic subtypes, emphasizing rarity compared to metachronous bilateral tumors.

pmid-38955375.summary_ja: 2,998人の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍）のNCDB分析。40歳以上の女性は予後不良で、併存疾患が多く両側腫瘍と高い段階を呈した。死亡リスク5.37倍増加。
pmid-38955375.summary_en: NCDB analysis of 2,998 women with malignant ovarian GCTs (immature teratoma, dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, mixed GCT). Women aged ≥40 had worse outcomes with higher comorbidities, bilateral tumors, and higher stage. Age ≥40 associated with 5.37-fold increased mortality risk.

pmid-38952741.summary_ja: 46歳男性の原発性肺絨毛膜癌の症例報告。咳嗽、呼吸困難、喀血で呈示。腫瘍塞栓症により術後28日で死亡。非常に稀で予後不良な悪性腫瘍であることを示唆している。
pmid-38952741.summary_en: Case report of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a 46-year-old male presenting with hemoptysis and dyspnea. Despite successful surgical resection, the patient died 28 days post-operatively from tumor emboli in the coronary artery, illustrating the aggressive nature and poor prognosis of this rare malignancy.

pmid-38947316.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に関連した傍腫瘍性視神経脊髄炎スペクトラム障害の48歳女性症例。段階的な視力低下で発症し、AQP4-IgG抗体陽性。免疫抑制療法と外科的切除、化学療法による治療により視力が回復し完全寛解を達成した。
pmid-38947316.summary_en: Case report and literature review of paraneoplastic neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) associated with ovarian dysgerminoma in a 48-year-old woman. Patient presented with visual loss, positive AQP4-IgG antibodies, and imaging-confirmed ovarian dysgerminoma. Complete remission achieved after chemotherapy and immunosuppressive therapy with vision recovery.

pmid-38944668.summary_ja: 正常妊娠後の肺転移性妊娠絨毛膜癌の症例報告。20歳イラン女性。β-hCG > 1,000,000で両側肺転移。多剤化学療法(EMACO)に良好に反応。予後は早期治療で良好。
pmid-38944668.summary_en: Case report of pulmonary metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma in a 20-year-old woman presenting with dyspnea and chest pain one day after uncomplicated term pregnancy. Markedly elevated β-hCG (>1,000,000) and bilateral pulmonary nodules confirmed diagnosis. Patient responded well to etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine chemotherapy.

pmid-38943678.summary_ja: 自然に退縮した精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるPD-L1発現の調査研究。完全に退縮した5腫瘍および部分的に退縮した6腫瘍を分析。完全退縮症例ではPD-L1がなく、セミノーマ含有部分退縮腫瘍のリンパ球では有意なPD-L1を示し、免疫介在性自然退縮を支持。
pmid-38943678.summary_en: Study investigating programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression in spontaneously regressed testicular germ cell tumors. Analyzed 5 completely regressed and 6 partially regressed tumors showing no PD-L1 in completely regressed cases but significant PD-L1 in lymphocytes of partially regressed seminoma-containing tumors, supporting immune-mediated spontaneous regression.

pmid-38938323.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に関連する続発性自己免疫溶血性貧血(AIHA)の症例報告および文献レビュー。22歳女性が進行性貧血および溶血マーカーで発症。腫瘍は赤血球に対するモノクローナルIgG-κ抗体を含有。プレドニゾロン療法で貧血の改善に反応。
pmid-38938323.summary_en: Case report and literature review of secondary autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) associated with mature ovarian cystic teratoma. 22-year-old woman presented with progressive anemia and hemolysis markers. Tumor contained monoclonal IgG-κ antibodies against red blood cells. Responded to prednisolone therapy with improved anemia.

pmid-38938322.summary_ja: 18歳女性の子宮頸部一次性ジスジェルミノーマの稀な症例報告。12ヶ月の膣出血。8×6×5 cm腫瘤。化学療法と放射線治療後に再発。水腎症と敗血症で死亡。極めて攻撃的経過。
pmid-38938322.summary_en: Rare case report of primary cervical dysgerminoma in an 18-year-old woman presenting with 12-month history of vaginal bleeding. MRI showed 8×6×5 cm cervicovaginal mass. Despite chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) and radiation, patient developed recurrence and died from hydronephrosis, anemia, and sepsis, illustrating aggressive clinical course.

pmid-38933061.summary_ja: 軽微な外傷後に頭皮腫脹で初発症状を呈した6歳女児における原発性心臓内胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。その後の臨床検査および画像検査により、原発性心臓腫瘍からの頭皮転移と診断された。心エコー検査により心臓内の腫瘍性病変が明確に記録されている。
pmid-38933061.summary_en: Case presentation of a 6-year-old girl with primary intracardiac germ cell tumor who presented with scalp swelling after minor trauma, later diagnosed as metastases from the primary cardiac tumor. Echocardiography images documented the cardiac lesion.

pmid-38929965.summary_ja: 肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍(S-YST)および上皮様栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)を含む化学療法耐性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍サブタイプの7名の患者の症例集積。治癒達成のための追加化学療法より初期の外科的切除が優れており、化学療法耐性胚細胞腫瘍の管理戦略を強調。
pmid-38929965.summary_en: Case series of seven patients with chemo-resistant non-seminomatous germ cell tumor subtypes including sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor (S-YST) and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT). Demonstrates early surgical resection as superior to additional chemotherapy for achieving cure, highlighting management strategies for chemotherapy-resistant germ cell tumors.

pmid-38928458.summary_ja: 18歳未満の64名の小児卵巣腫瘍におけるSALL4およびOCT3/4バイオマーカー発現の後方視的分析。SALL4は腺癌、ディスジャーミノーマ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、未熟奇形腫において有意に発現。両マーカーは高いグレード、病期、高いAFP/LDH値、短い無増悪生存期間に相関。
pmid-38928458.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of SALL4 and OCT3/4 biomarker expression in 64 pediatric ovarian tumors under age 18. Found SALL4 significantly expressed in adenocarcinoma, dysgerminoma, mixed germ cell tumors, and immature teratoma. Both markers correlated with higher grade, stage, elevated AFP/LDH, and shorter progression-free survival.

pmid-38928057.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した皮脂癌の初の詳細な遺伝子解析。TP53ナンセンス変異とPIK3R1欠失を同定。片親性二体性の証拠。術後8ヶ月で再発なし。
pmid-38928057.summary_en: First detailed genomic analysis of sebaceous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma (OMT) in a 36-year-old woman. Identified TP53 nonsense mutation (p.R306*) and PIK3R1 deletion with evidence of uniparental disomy. Stage IA disease with no recurrence 8 months post-surgery, illustrating malignant transformation mechanisms.

pmid-38927936.summary_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後のロボット支援一側性後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-rRPLND)後の性機能および生殖機能転帰の研究。適格患者22名のうち31.8%が逆行性射精(13.6%)、精子数減少症(4.5%)、勃起障害(13.6%)を含む男性学的障害を発症し、9.1%が自然妊娠に成功。
pmid-38927936.summary_en: Study of sexual and reproductive outcomes following post-chemotherapy robot-assisted unilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-rRPLND) for stage II non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of 22 eligible patients, 31.8% developed andrological disorders including retrograde ejaculation (13.6%), hypospermia (4.5%), and erectile dysfunction (13.6%), with 9.1% achieving natural conception.

pmid-38925744.summary_ja: 高容量基準センターにおける精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の集約化に関する検討。初期の管理ステップは他の施設で実行できるが、外科的および全身細胞障害性治療は中核センターで実行される必要がある。精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の地域中核化は優れた腫瘍学的転帰をもたらす。
pmid-38925744.summary_en: Review examining regionalization of testicular germ cell tumor care at high-volume reference centers. While initial management can be performed elsewhere, surgical and systemic therapy require specialized centers. Evidence shows regionalized care results in superior oncological outcomes for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-38925742.summary_ja: 精巣がん、特にセミノーマに対する現代的放射線療法のレビュー。セミノーマは放射線感受性で、病期I、IIA、IIB疾患の精巣摘除術後の補助放射線療法に良好に反応。線量漸減は二次悪性腫瘍リスクを含む急性および長期有害性を減らしながら再発を効果的に予防。
pmid-38925742.summary_en: Review of contemporary radiation therapy for testicular cancer, particularly seminoma. Seminomas are radiation-sensitive and respond well to adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy for stage I, IIA, and IIB disease. Dose de-escalation effectively prevents recurrence while reducing acute and long-term toxicities including secondary malignancy risk.

pmid-38925741.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍全体におけるマイクロRNA(miRNA)の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性のレビュー。高感度性と特異性を示し、特に化学療法後の奇形腫と生存可能な胚細胞腫瘍検出のための治療反応予測への使用を支持する新たなエビデンスがあるが、臨床応用にはさらなる研究が必要。
pmid-38925741.summary_en: Review of microRNA (miRNA) utility as tumor markers for testicular germ cell tumors across disease spectrum. miRNAs show high sensitivity and specificity for GCTs and emerging evidence supports their use for predicting treatment response, particularly for teratoma and viable GCT detection after chemotherapy, though clinical application requires further study.

pmid-38925740.summary_ja: 低病期セミノーマの現代的治療管理パラダイムの最新情報。高い耐久性のある治癒率を達成しながら治療負担を最小化。病期Iセミノーマの進化する経過観察戦略、および病期IIA/IIBセミノーマ患者に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の実行可能性を支持する新たなデータを検討。
pmid-38925740.summary_en: Update on contemporary management paradigm for low-stage seminoma achieving high cure rates while minimizing treatment burden. Reviews evolving surveillance strategies for stage I seminoma and emerging data supporting retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) as viable treatment option for selected stage IIA and IIB seminoma patients.

pmid-38922953.summary_ja: 発生学的起源と分子的特性によるI～III型分類を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍病態生物学の包括的レビュー。セミノーマ、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌の形態学的および免疫組織化学的診断アルゴリズムを論述。GCT発展における多能性因子(OCT3/4、SOX2、SOX17)の役割を強調。
pmid-38922953.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular germ cell tumor pathobiology covering type I-III classification by developmental origin and molecular features. Discusses seminoma, teratoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma with morphological and immunohistochemical diagnostic algorithms. Emphasizes role of pluripotency factors (OCT3/4, SOX2, SOX17) in GCT development and diagnosis.

pmid-38915994.summary_ja: 23歳男性、精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍とαフェトプロテイン上昇で診断。併存感染が診断され抗生物質で治療。感染治療後に腫瘍マーカーが低下。精巣摘除術で診断確認。併存感染が臨床的表現と腫瘍マーカーに影響を与える重要性を示唆。
pmid-38915994.summary_en: Case report of 23-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with testicular swelling, elevated AFP and LDH levels. Concurrent infection was diagnosed and treated with antibiotics, resulting in fever resolution and significant decrease in tumor marker levels. Mixed germ cell tumor diagnosis confirmed on orchidectomy.

pmid-38915051.summary_ja: 60歳閉経後女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から悪性転化したカルチノイド腫瘍。病理組織学的に低グレードとして分類。包括的手術後14ヶ月で再発なし。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からのカルチノイド転化は稀で、病理組織学的評価の重要性を強調。
pmid-38915051.summary_en: 60-year-old woman with malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma into carcinoid tumor with benign mucinous cystadenoma. After comprehensive staging surgery and hysterectomy, patient remained disease-free for 14 months without chemotherapy. Case highlights importance of careful histopathological evaluation in detecting rare carcinoid transformation in postmenopausal women with adnexal masses.

pmid-38912835.summary_ja: 小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者17名の後方視的研究。術前化学療法後のPET/CTで5例中1例の偽陰性。残存悪性成分と成熟奇形腫の識別困難。化学療法後の治療計画決定におけるPET/CTの限界を指摘。
pmid-38912835.summary_en: Retrospective study evaluating 18F-FDG PET/CT role in restaging malignant germ cell tumors in 17 pediatric patients after neoadjuvant chemotherapy. PET/CT showed one false negative case and limited discrimination between residual malignant component and mature teratoma. Findings suggest PET/CT limitations in post-chemotherapy assessment for treatment planning in pediatric GCT patients.

pmid-38907278.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫9例のゲノム異常をarray CGHで分析。EVX2、HOXD9-HOXD13などの遺伝子増幅が全例で認められ、軟骨造成・骨化の特性を説明する可能性がある。奇形腫形成の分子基盤と組織分化メカニズムの理解に貢献する。
pmid-38907278.summary_en: Array comparative genomic hybridization analysis of 9 ovarian mature cystic teratomas identified recurrent gene amplifications including EVX2, HOXD9-HOXD13, and Xq28-encoded genes. Amplifications may explain teratoma characteristics in chondrogenesis and osteogenesis, providing insights into teratoma molecular biology and tissue differentiation mechanisms.

pmid-38906271.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者216人を対象とした多施設後方視的研究。シスプラチン併用化学療法後、患者は6%の骨格筋喪失と脂肪量増加を示した。低骨格筋量は高い3度以上の化学療法関連有害事象と関連し、胚細胞腫瘍化学療法毒性管理への知見を提供。
pmid-38906271.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 216 men with testicular germ cell tumors. Following cisplatin-based chemotherapy, patients showed 6% skeletal muscle loss and increased adiposity. Decreased skeletal muscle mass was associated with higher grade 3+ chemotherapy-related adverse events, providing insights into GCT chemotherapy toxicity management.

pmid-38905377.summary_ja: 性腺悪性腫瘍リスク増加を伴う2つのまれな46,XY性分化異常症（XY純粋性腺異形成と完全アンドロゲン不応症）の症例。両側予防的性腺摘除術で性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を認めた。長期ホルモン補充療法が推奨される。
pmid-38905377.summary_en: Two rare cases of 46,XY disorders of sex development (XY pure gonadal dysgenesis and complete androgen insensitivity syndrome) with elevated gonadal malignancy risk. Bilateral prophylactic gonadectomy revealed gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. Long-term hormone replacement therapy recommended for secondary sexual characteristics and osteoporosis prevention.

pmid-38903767.summary_ja: 小児後腹膜腫瘍の腹腔鏡手術にインドシアニングリーン蛍光イメージングを応用した3症例。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を1例含む。蛍光イメージングにより血管構造の可視化が向上し、手術安全性が増強された。小児後腹膜GCT管理に有用な手技である。
pmid-38903767.summary_en: Three pediatric cases of laparoscopic retroperitoneal tumor resection using indocyanine green fluorescence imaging. One case was mature cystic teratoma. ICG fluorescence imaging improved vascular visualization and enhanced surgical safety. Technique demonstrated safe and effective outcomes for pediatric retroperitoneal tumor management.

pmid-38898921.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術2年後に前立腺セミノーマ転移を発症した34歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者。導入化学療法後、腫瘍マーカー正常化と画像反応を認め、ロボット支援根治的前立腺摘除術施行。9ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-38898921.summary_en: 34-year-old male with mixed germ cell tumor of testis presenting with prostatic seminoma metastasis two years after orchiectomy. After neoadjuvant chemotherapy with tumor marker normalization and imaging response, robot-assisted radical prostatectomy was performed. No recurrence observed at 9-month follow-up.

pmid-38893698.summary_ja: 卵巣ストルマオバリイは全卵巣奇形腫の2～5％に認められる稀な亜型。50％以上が甲状腺組織。妊娠中の診断・管理、悪性転化リスク（0.5～10％）、妊娠ホルモン（エストロゲン、プロゲステロン、hCG）による増殖促進の課題を検討している。
pmid-38893698.summary_en: Review of struma ovarii, a rare ovarian teratoma type composed of >50% thyroid tissue occurring in 2-5% of ovarian teratomas. Focuses on diagnostic challenges and management during pregnancy, considering malignant transformation risk (0.5-10%) and growth acceleration from pregnancy hormones including estrogen, progesterone, and hCG.

pmid-38893276.summary_ja: 2610人の小児の頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした登録ベースの研究。スウィーア症候群（OR 338.6）およびクラリーノ症候群（OR 34.2）との強い関連を確認。症候群性症例のほとんどが女児。胚細胞腫瘍発症のリスク層別化を提供。
pmid-38893276.summary_en: Registry-based study of 2610 children with extracranial germ cell tumors examining associations with genetic syndromes and congenital anomalies. Strong associations confirmed for Swyer (OR 338.6) and Currarino (OR 34.2) syndromes. Most syndromic cases involved girls. Study provides risk stratification for GCT development.

pmid-38892991.summary_ja: NSGCT患者における骨転移の20年後方視的分析(29同時性、11異時性)。ほとんどがIGCCCG不良リスク患者。骨転移はしばしば無症状で脊椎を関与し、病理で壊死/奇形腫/セミノーマを示した。異時性BMはより悪い転帰と関連(5年OS 36.4% vs 53.9%同時性)。
pmid-38892991.summary_en: Retrospective 20-year analysis of 40 NSGCT patients with bone metastases (29 synchronous, 11 metachronous). Most were IGCCCG poor-risk patients. Bone metastases frequently asymptomatic, involved spine (92.5%), revealed necrosis/mature teratoma/seminoma on pathology. Metachronous BM associated with worse outcomes (5-year OS 36.4% vs 53.9% synchronous).

pmid-38886867.summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫と子宮腺筋症を合併した症例報告。骨盤腫瘤の誤診リスク軽減のための文献考察。異なる骨盤病変の鑑別診断における画像診断と臨床評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-38886867.summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) complicated with uterine adenomyoma. Literature review addresses diagnostic considerations for pelvic masses to reduce misdiagnosis risk. Highlights importance of imaging and clinical assessment in managing pelvic teratomas.

pmid-38883380.summary_ja: 63例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍においてHOXA11プロモーターメチル化を調査した研究。メチル化はGCT組織で隣接組織より有意に頻繁であり、リンパ節転移およびTNM病期と相関した。メチルトランスフェラーゼ阻害薬によりHOXA11発現が増加し、異常メチル化がHOXA11を抑制して腫瘍進行を促進することを示唆する。
pmid-38883380.summary_en: Study investigating HOXA11 promoter methylation in 63 testicular germ cell tumors. Methylation significantly more frequent in GCT tissue than adjacent tissue and correlated with lymph node metastasis and TNM stage. Methyltransferase inhibitor increased HOXA11 expression, suggesting abnormal methylation suppresses HOXA11 and promotes tumor progression.

pmid-38881815.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘤症候群を有する巨大前縦隔腫瘍(>10 cm)についてのナラティブレビュー。成熟奇形腫およびliposarcomaが最も一般的な診断であり、悪性リンパ腫および悪性胚細胞腫瘍が頻繁にMMSを発症する。MMSの発症に基づくリスク分類と治療アルゴリズムを提案し、悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法および放射線療法の優先性を示す。
pmid-38881815.summary_en: Narrative review of giant anterior mediastinal tumors (>10 cm) and mediastinal mass syndrome. Discusses mature teratomas and liposarcomas as most common diagnoses; malignant lymphomas and malignant germ cell tumors frequently develop MMS. Proposes classification strategy based on imaging, treatment algorithms prioritizing chemotherapy/radiotherapy over surgery for malignant GCTs.

pmid-38881620.summary_ja: 52歳女性の肺動脈絨毛癌症例。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の既往があり、肺塞栓症に偽装して発症。β-hCG>100,000の上昇と血管内生検で診断。稀な頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の診断における血管内放射線学の重要性を示唆。
pmid-38881620.summary_en: Case report of isolated pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma in 52-year-old female with gestational trophoblastic disease history. Presented with dyspnea mimicking pulmonary embolism; diagnosis confirmed by elevated beta-hCG (>100,000) and endovascular biopsy. Illustrates diagnostic challenges and interventional radiology role in obtaining histological diagnosis of rare GCTs.

pmid-38872748.summary_ja: 気管および腕頭動脈圧迫による脳梗塞を起こした大きな嚢胞性縦隔奇形腫を有する51歳男性の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)/磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)画像所見およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)誘導下穿刺吸引による減圧を記述し、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を病理で確認した。
pmid-38872748.summary_en: Case report of 51-year-old male with large cystic mediastinal teratoma causing tracheal and brachiocephalic artery compression leading to stroke. Describes CT/MRI imaging findings and percutaneous CT-guided aspiration for decompression. Pathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-38872745.summary_ja: 若い女性に見られた最も一般的な卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍である卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の2症例を報告した。骨盤痛で発症し、特性的な線維血管中隔を有する大きな固形腫瘤を示すMRI画像所見を記述し、両症例で外科的切除および組織学的確認を実施した。
pmid-38872745.summary_en: Reports two cases of ovarian dysgerminoma, the most common ovarian malignant germ cell tumor, presenting with pelvic pain in young women. Describes MRI imaging features showing large solid masses with characteristic fibrovascular septa. Surgical resection and histological confirmation performed in both cases.

pmid-38871631.summary_ja: 病期I精巣がんにおけるセミノーマと非セミノーマの再発リスクに関する新しいリスク因子を検討し、更新されたリスク層別化が従来のパラメータと比較して再発をより良く予測し、補助化学療法と観察戦略間の選択を改善することを議論する。
pmid-38871631.summary_en: Reviews new risk factors for stage I testicular cancer relapse in seminoma and nonseminoma to guide adjuvant therapy decisions. Discusses how updated risk stratification better predicts recurrence compared to previous parameters and improves selection between adjuvant chemotherapy and surveillance strategies.

pmid-38869488.summary_ja: 白金化学療法で治療された小児胚細胞腫瘍生存者(n=100)におけるGOLDコホートで遠隔タブレットベース聴力評価の実現可能性を評価した。標準周波数で難聴が21%で観察され、自己報告と測定された難聴の間に強い一致が見られた。参加者の97%で遠隔評価を完全に成功した。
pmid-38869488.summary_en: Evaluates feasibility of remote tablet-based hearing assessment in pediatric germ cell tumor survivors (n=100) from GOLD cohort treated with platinum chemotherapy. Found 21% with hearing loss at standard frequencies; strong agreement between self-reported and measured hearing loss. Successfully completed remote assessments in 97% of participants.

pmid-38867687.summary_ja: 腹膜と大網に関連した卵巣奇形腫(8症例が未熟、3症例が成熟)を有する11症例の腹膜神経膠腫症を報告した。幹細胞分化指標SOX2とOCT4を検討し、GP焦点のすべてにおけるSOX2陽性およびOCT4陰性を示し、神経分化におけるSOX2の役割を示唆する。
pmid-38867687.summary_en: Reports 11 cases of gliomatosis peritonei, a rare condition with multiple mature glial implants in peritoneum/omentum associated with ovarian teratomas (8 immature, 3 mature). Examines SOX2 and OCT4 stem cell differentiation markers showing SOX2 positivity in all GP foci and negative OCT4, suggesting SOX2 role in neural differentiation.

pmid-38861385.summary_ja: セミノーマトランスクリプトームおよびエピジェネティック領域を正常男性生殖細胞発達に関連付け。セミノーマが前遊走/遊走原始生殖細胞に類似し、多能性および異なるMAPK/ERK信号を増強していることを発見。Pallister-Killian症候群のi(12p)モザイク多能性幹細胞由来PGCsを用いてセミノーマ形質転換機構をモデル化。
pmid-38861385.summary_en: Maps seminoma transcriptomes and epigenetic landscape to normal human male germline development. Finds seminoma resembles premigratory/migratory primordial germ cells with enhanced pluripotency and altered MAPK/ERK signaling. Uses pluripotent stem cell-derived PGCs from Pallister-Killian syndrome mosaic for chromosome 12p to model seminoma transformation mechanisms.

pmid-38858658.summary_ja: 乳頭状甲状腺癌を含む後腹膜奇形腫の41歳女性症例。画像所見と外科的切除、全甲状腺摘除術および放射性ヨウ素療法を実施。性腺外奇形腫の体細胞分化の診断課題と治療を強調。
pmid-38858658.summary_en: Case report of 41-year-old woman with retroperitoneal teratoma containing papillary thyroid carcinoma. Discusses imaging findings, surgical resection with negative margins, and subsequent total thyroidectomy with radioiodine therapy. Highlights diagnostic challenges and treatment considerations for rare extragonadal teratomas with somatic differentiation.

pmid-38856767.summary_ja: 体細胞型悪性性分化を伴う卵巣奇形腫（10例）と良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（193例）のMRI所見を比較。TSMはより大きく、固形成分に脂肪組織と環状強化がない。全例で動的MRIで高/中間リスク曲線を示す。感度100%、特異度97.4%。
pmid-38856767.summary_en: Compares MRI features of ovarian teratomas with somatic-type malignancy (10 cases) versus benign mature cystic teratomas (193 cases). TSMs larger with absence of fat tissue and ring-like enhancement in solid components; all show high/intermediate-risk time-intensity curves on dynamic MRI versus low-risk in MCTs. ROC analysis shows 100% sensitivity and 97.4% specificity.

pmid-38855718.summary_ja: 20歳女性の大網成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。画像検査とCA-125上昇に基づき腸間膜嚢胞が疑われたが、試験的開腹により正常卵巣と大網成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を確認。病理組織学的に診断。稀な性腺外起源を示す。
pmid-38855718.summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old woman with large omental mature cystic teratoma initially suspected to be mesenteric cyst based on imaging and elevated CA-125. Exploratory laparotomy revealed normal ovaries and large omental MCT. Successful excision with histopathological confirmation demonstrates rare extragonadal teratoma origin.

pmid-38852569.summary_ja: 産後5日に発症した新生児の仙尾部奇形腫（Type II）の症例報告。産前超音波診断、MRI評価、負の辺縁での広範切除、補助化学療法なしの良好な回復。辺縁の重要性と病理学的検査を強調。
pmid-38852569.summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma (Type II) in neonate presenting 5 days postpartum. Discusses prenatal ultrasound diagnosis, MRI assessment of extent, wide local excision with negative margins, and excellent postoperative recovery without adjuvant chemotherapy. Emphasizes importance of adequate margins and histological examination.

pmid-38851302.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫)由来の癌関連線維芽細胞の分子および遺伝子発現解析。セミノーマおよび胎児性癌は奇形腫より癌関連線維芽細胞をより活性化。IGFBP1、LGALS3BP、LYVE1、PTX3を介して増殖とシスプラチン感受性に影響。
pmid-38851302.summary_en: Molecular and epigenetic profiling of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAF) from testicular germ cell tumors (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma). Demonstrates CAF activation differs by tumor type; seminoma and EC activate CAF more than teratoma. CAF influence GCT proliferation, cisplatin sensitivity, and macrophage polarization via IGFBP1, LGALS3BP, LYVE1, PTX3.

pmid-38849277.summary_ja: 精巣がん管理に関する両学会ガイドラインを比較。低容量転移(性)血清腫瘍マーカー陰性第IIA/B期疾患および進行性/再発性疾患戦略における相違。全体的に高い一致率。
pmid-38849277.summary_en: Compares American Urological Association and European Association of Urology guidelines on testicular cancer management. Identifies high overall concordance with some differences in management of low-volume metastatic serum tumor marker-negative stage IIA/B disease and advanced/relapsed disease strategies.

pmid-38839493.summary_ja: SEER基盤の集団研究で0-40歳の男性胚細胞腫瘍の組織型変動を分析。幼少児では卵黄嚢腫瘍および奇形腫優位、思春期では混合型胚細胞腫瘍、成人ではセミノーマ優位。
pmid-38839493.summary_en: This SEER-based population study analyzes histological variations in male germ cell tumors across age groups (0-40 years), showing yolk sac tumors and teratomas predominate in young children, mixed GCT in adolescents, and seminoma in adults, with significant implications for cancer-specific survival.

pmid-38837659.summary_ja: 転移(性)胚細胞腫瘍を有する小児患者におけるgrowing teratoma syndromeを検討し、有病率(28%)、手術成績、および予後因子を分析。転移巣の完全外科的切除により多くの患者で寛解。
pmid-38837659.summary_en: This study examines growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in pediatric patients with metastatic germ cell tumors, analyzing prevalence (28%), surgical outcomes, and prognostic factors. Complete resection of metastatic sites achieved remission in most patients with GTS.

pmid-38835384.summary_ja: 同時性卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および卵黄嚢腫瘍）とトルコ鞍領域ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）を有する26歳女性。上昇した腫瘍マーカーと画像検査により多学科的管理を施行し化学療法および放射線療法により完全寛解。
pmid-38835384.summary_en: This case report describes a rare 26-year-old female with simultaneous ovarian mixed germ cell tumors (dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor) and sellar germinoma. Elevated tumor markers and imaging guided multidisciplinary management with chemotherapy and radiotherapy, achieving complete remission.

pmid-38834312.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織から構成される卵巣奇形腫である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が下垂体に転移してトルコ鞍領域腫瘤として呈示した症例。経蝶形骨手術、全甲状腺摘除術、および放射性ヨウ素アブレーション療法により5年間の継続的寛解を達成。
pmid-38834312.summary_en: This case describes metastatic malignant struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma composed of thyroid tissue) to the pituitary presenting as sellar mass. Successfully managed with trans-sphenoidal resection, total thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine ablation with sustained remission over 5 years.

pmid-38827934.summary_ja: 第IV期純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の23歳女性患者が妊孕性温存手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法により完全寛解を達成し、その後自然妊娠により健康児を出産した症例報告。
pmid-38827934.summary_en: This case report documents a 23-year-old woman with stage IV pure ovarian dysgerminoma (germ cell tumor) treated with fertility-sparing surgery and cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieving complete remission and spontaneous pregnancy with healthy infant birth.

pmid-38827013.summary_ja: 甲状腺発生の頸部縦隔奇形腫の症例。
pmid-38827013.summary_en: This case describes a rare cervico-mediastinal thyroid teratoma in a 37-year-old woman presenting with lateral cervical swelling. Surgical management revealed mixed-type teratoma originating from thyroid gland, highlighting diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmid-38826789.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマと無精子症を伴う16歳男性の症例。胸部CTと陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で診断、生検で病理組織学的に確認。腫瘍切除と術後化学療法で治療、フォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-38826789.summary_en: This case report presents a 16-year-old with primary mediastinal seminoma (germ cell tumor) with azoospermia. Histopathological diagnosis via biopsy guided tumor resection and postoperative chemotherapy with no recurrence.

pmid-38823222.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株におけるメトトレキサートの輸送機構の検討。
pmid-38823222.summary_en: This study investigates methotrexate transport mechanisms in human choriocarcinoma cell lines, identifying multiple transporters involved in MTX uptake and efflux. Findings have implications for predicting drug interactions and enhancing MTX sensitivity in choriocarcinoma treatment.

pmid-38821727.summary_ja: SEER登録簿データ(43,709例、ヒスパニック系23.3%)を用いた精巣がん予後研究。ヒスパニック系はNSGCTで悪い生存転帰を示したが、セミノーマでは見られず。体細胞変異は民族間で差がなく、ヒスパニック系の遺伝的祖先は不均質。
pmid-38821727.summary_en: This SEER-based study examines testicular cancer outcomes in Hispanic men compared to non-Hispanic Whites, finding worse cancer-specific survival for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT) in Hispanics despite presenting at younger ages.

pmid-38817519.summary_ja: 34歳男性の非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者における稀な十二指腸転移症例。18か月前のStage IA精巣腫瘍に対する根治的精巣摘除術後に十二指腸転移を発症。正常腫瘍マーカーにもかかわらず、CTおよび内視鏡生検で転移性胎児性癌が確認。
pmid-38817519.summary_en: This case reports metastatic embryonal carcinoma (non-seminomatous germ cell tumor) to duodenum in a 34-year-old male with prior stage IA testicular cancer. Despite previously normal tumor markers, imaging and endoscopic biopsy confirmed GCT metastasis.

pmid-38817478.summary_ja: 30歳男性のNSGCT患者におけるgrowing teratoma syndrome(GTS)の症例で、精巣摘除術と化学療法後に急性腹痛と肺転移を発症。正常腫瘍マーカーにもかかわらず後腹膜腫瘍が診断され、外科的切除で症状改善。
pmid-38817478.summary_en: This case describes growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in a 30-year-old male with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor presenting with acute abdomen and pulmonary metastasis despite normalized tumor markers. Surgical intervention achieved favorable outcomes.

pmid-38814255.summary_ja: 新生児および乳幼児における絨毛癌に関する後方視的二国間研究で8例を分析。中央値年齢6週間で、全腫瘍がびまん性。プラチナベース化学療法と遅延手術で4例が完全奏効し、転帰は不良だが治癒の可能性を示唆。
pmid-38814255.summary_en: This retrospective bi-national study analyzes eight cases of infantile choriocarcinoma (median age 6 weeks) with aggressive presentation. Four of eight patients achieved complete remission with platinum-based chemotherapy and delayed surgery on residual metastases.

pmid-38810324.summary_ja: 125例のStage 1精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における積極的監視への遵守に関する後方視的研究。遵守状況は最適(51%)、適切(11%)またはフォローアップ喪失(38%)に分類。文化的多様性、非喫煙、失業、パートナー存在が遵守予測因子。
pmid-38810324.summary_en: This retrospective study examines adherence to active surveillance in 125 stage 1 testicular germ cell tumor patients, categorizing outcomes as optimal (51%), adequate (11%), or loss-to-follow-up (38%). Predictors of adherence include cultural/linguistic diversity and non-smoking status.

pmid-38808385.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍中のSALL4-Aアイソフォーム発現に関する研究(124例)で、正常および良性組織と比較。セミノーマおよび胎児性癌における高いSALL4-A発現は腫瘍病期、再発および精巣上体浸潤の増加と関連し、予後指標としての有用性を示唆している。
pmid-38808385.summary_en: Study of SALL4-A isoform expression in testicular germ cell tumors (124 cases), comparing with normal and benign tissues. Higher SALL4-A expression in seminomas and embryonal carcinomas was associated with increased tumor stage, recurrence, and epididymal invasion, suggesting utility as prognostic indicator.

pmid-38807671.summary_ja: 子宮頸部小細胞神経内分泌癌と卵巣未熟奇形腫の同時性原発腫瘍の症例報告。臨床的特徴、組織病理学的および免疫表現型特性を記述。頸部と卵巣の同時性原発腫瘍に関する文献レビューも含む。
pmid-38807671.summary_en: Case report of synchronous primary malignancies: cervical small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma and ovarian immature teratoma in a woman. Describes clinical manifestations, histopathological and immunophenotypic features, with literature review of concurrent cervical and ovarian primary tumors.

pmid-38806400.summary_ja: 30歳代前半の男性におけるII型transverse testicular ectopiaと精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。診断的および治療的課題を強調し、臨床的提示、画像所見および病理学的特徴を記述し、13例の類似症例を文献からレビューした。
pmid-38806400.summary_en: Case report of type II transverse testicular ectopia (TTE) with testicular mixed germ cell tumor in a man in his early 30s. Highlights diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, presents clinical presentation, imaging findings, and pathological features, with review of 13 similar literature cases.

pmid-38803367.summary_ja: 肺がん疑いで入院した縦隔原発絨毛癌の剖検例。診断困難性を示し、肺と縦隔にかかる腫瘍診断時にβ-hCG測定と稀な絨毛癌を考慮することの重要性を強調。
pmid-38803367.summary_en: Autopsy case of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma in 65-year-old man initially suspected of lung cancer. Emphasizes diagnostic difficulty and importance of evaluating serum β-hCG levels when encountering poorly differentiated carcinoma in mediastinal and pulmonary regions.

pmid-38796656.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるCD44発現研究。セミノーマで腫瘍細胞および間質細胞のCD44発現増加が腫瘍サイズ、転移、血管侵襲、疾患ステージと関連。攻撃的表現型形成に寄与することを示唆。
pmid-38796656.summary_en: Study of CD44 expression in testicular germ cell tumors (71 tissue specimens) in seminomas and non-seminomatous tumors. Found increased CD44 expression in tumor and stromal cells associated with larger tumor size, metastasis, vascular invasion, and advanced stage in seminomas, indicating role in aggressive phenotype.

pmid-38788608.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおけるSMI由来血管指数(VI)の研究(腫瘍患者31例を含む62例)。VIは正常精巣と腫瘍の間で統計的に有意に異なり、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、リンパ腫の区別を支援できることが示された。
pmid-38788608.summary_en: Study of Superb Microvascular Imaging (SMI)-derived Vascular Index (VI) in testicular cancer (62 patients including 31 with tumors). VI significantly differed between normal testis and tumors, helping distinguish seminomas, non-seminomas, and lymphomas. Proposed as quantitative imaging parameter for tumor differentiation.

pmid-38786342.summary_ja: 14,832検体を対象にしたEpCAM発現の大規模組織マイクロアレイ研究。精巣セミノーマではEpCAMが他の上皮マーカーと比べ高発現を示した。上皮バイオマーカーとしての有用性と診断的意義を支持。
pmid-38786342.summary_en: Large tissue microarray study of EpCAM expression in 14,832 tumor samples across 120 tumor categories. Germ cell tumors included with EpCAM positivity ≥90%. EpCAM particularly elevated in testicular seminomas compared to other epithelial markers (pan-cytokeratin, TROP2), supporting its diagnostic utility for epithelial tumors.

pmid-38782099.summary_ja: 18例の精子球細胞腫瘍のマイクロRNA-371-373を定量的リアルタイムポリメラーゼ連鎖反応で解析。侵攻的精子球細胞腫瘍は非侵攻的症例より有意に高値。胎児期マイクロRNAが侵攻的表型に関与し、血清マイクロRNA検査の可能性が示唆される。
pmid-38782099.summary_en: Analysis of microRNA-371-373 in spermatocytic tumors (18 cases) by quantitative RT-PCR. Found microRNA levels significantly higher in aggressive spermatocytic tumors compared to non-aggressive cases. Results suggest embryonic microRNAs contribute to aggressive phenotype and support need for close follow-up and future serum testing.

pmid-38778412.summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌14症例と文献89症例のレビュー研究。化学療法に感受性があり、良好な寛解率と低い再発率。転移の有無にかかわらず治療後の妊娠成績が良好。患者への心理的支援が重要である。
pmid-38778412.summary_en: Retrospective study of 14 patients with intraplacental choriocarcinoma and review of 89 literature cases. Found IC sensitive to chemotherapy with good remission rates and low recurrence. Discusses fertility outcomes showing patients achieving successful pregnancies post-treatment, while emphasizing psychological support importance.

pmid-38774314.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞に対する経膣自然口腔内視鏡手術505例の後方視的研究。奇形腫が56.8%を占めた。手術転換の危険因子として重度骨盤癒着、両側嚢胞、子宮内膜症性嚢胞を同定。低い合併症率を示した。
pmid-38774314.summary_en: Retrospective study of 505 patients undergoing transvaginal natural orifice endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) for ovarian cysts. Teratomas comprised 56.8% of cases. Identified risk factors for surgical conversion including severe pelvic adhesions, bilateral cysts, and endometriotic cysts. Demonstrated low complication and conversion rates.

pmid-38768296.summary_ja: 再発原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍32例を対象とした大量化学療法と末梢血造血幹細胞移植の研究。中央年齢30歳、2年無増悪生存率31%、全生存率35%。9例(28%)が長期無病生存を達成。
pmid-38768296.summary_en: Study of high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell transplantation as salvage therapy in 32 relapsed primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients. Median age 30 years. Two-year progression-free survival 31%, overall survival 35%. Nine patients (28%) achieved long-term disease-free survival including platinum-refractory cases.

pmid-38766798.summary_ja: 120名の妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者を対象とした後方視的研究(2019～2022年)。不完全流産34例、完全流産82例、侵入奇胎3例、絨毛癌1例が診断された。患者への情報提供と適切な管理、妊娠回避期間の設定が重要である。
pmid-38766798.summary_en: Retrospective study of 120 gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) patients between 2019-2022. Analyzed clinical presentations, demographics, and pathological diagnoses. Found incomplete abortion (34), complete abortion (82), invasive moles (3), and choriocarcinoma (1). Discusses management timing and patient counseling regarding pregnancy avoidance periods.

pmid-38763421.summary_ja: 化学療法後胚細胞型卵黄嚢腫瘍34例のベータカテニン発現研究。29%で核ベータカテニン検出、CTNNB1変異を50%で同定。全例でi(12p)陽性。Wnt経路活性化が進行に関与することを示唆。
pmid-38763421.summary_en: Study of beta-catenin expression in postchemotherapy postpubertal-type yolk sac tumors with enteroblastic phenotype (34 cases). Found nuclear beta-catenin in 29% of cases; DNA sequencing identified CTNNB1 variants in 50%. FISH positive for i(12p) in all analyzed cases, suggesting Wnt pathway activation in tumor progression.

pmid-38759398.summary_ja: 気道閉塞を伴う前縦隔成熟奇形腫の周術期麻酔管理の症例報告。仰臥位で呼吸困難が増悪。体外循環で肺を安全にデフレート、腫瘍切除を促進し血行動態的・呼吸的リスクを軽減。
pmid-38759398.summary_en: Case report of anesthetic management of 18-year-old woman with large anterior mediastinal mature teratoma causing severe airway obstruction. Patient presented with progressive dyspnea in supine position. Femoro-femoral cardiopulmonary bypass used during resection to safely deflate lungs and facilitate tumor dissection with reduced hemodynamic and respiratory complications.

pmid-38756265.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍患者の化学療法後に絨毛癌症候群を発症した症例。β-hCG高値、精巣腫瘍、肺転移。化学療法開始後に急速な呼吸機能低下でARDSで死亡。
pmid-38756265.summary_en: Case report of 37-year-old male with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (elevated β-hCG, testicular mass, pulmonary metastases) who developed choriocarcinoma syndrome after chemotherapy initiation. Experienced rapid respiratory decline resulting in ARDS and death. Highlights importance of early detection and awareness of this rare but serious complication.

pmid-38755694.summary_ja: 女性新生児の大きな先天性頸部未熟奇形腫(10cm×10cm)症例。出生時に気道閉塞による呼吸窮迫を呈し、気管挿管と機械換気が必要だった。出生後17日に外科的切除を施行し、良好な転帰が得られた。
pmid-38755694.summary_en: Case report of female Persian neonate with large congenital cervical immature teratoma (10 cm × 10 cm) causing airway obstruction. Presented with respiratory distress at birth requiring intubation and mechanical ventilation. Surgical resection on postnatal day 17 resulted in good recovery, demonstrating importance of airway stabilization before definitive surgery.

pmid-38752660.summary_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫が心膜液貯留と胎児水腫で発症した症例報告。妊娠31週での心膜穿刺により静脈圧迫が緩解し、水腫が消失した。妊娠継続が可能になり、出生後の外科的腫瘍摘出が実施された。
pmid-38752660.summary_en: Case report of fetal pericardial teratoma presenting with pericardial effusion and hydrops fetalis. Pericardiocentesis performed at 31 weeks gestational age relieved venous compression, resolved hydrops, and allowed pregnancy continuation to term for definitive postnatal surgical management of the tumor.

pmid-38750408.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫と確認された5症例のMRI所見を分析。腫瘍サイズ増大と散在性脂肪成分が主要な診断指標。包括的なMRI評価の診断と管理における重要性を強調。
pmid-38750408.summary_en: Case series study of five patients with adnexal masses histopathologically confirmed as immature teratomas. Analyzed magnetic resonance imaging findings on pelvic MRI. Key diagnostic indicators included larger tumor size and scattered fatty components. Underscores importance of comprehensive MRI evaluation in diagnosis and management.

pmid-38744098.summary_ja: 283名の胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした多施設研究。再発・治療抵抗性症例に対して、初回救援治療としての大量化学療法は後続治療より優れた成績を示した。2年全生存率は74%対53%であり、治癒の可能性が示唆される。
pmid-38744098.summary_en: This multicenter analysis evaluates high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation for relapsed or refractory germ cell cancer, comparing first versus subsequent salvage treatment. Among 283 patients, first-line high-dose therapy showed superior outcomes with 74% two-year overall survival versus 53%, demonstrating curative potential despite challenging disease.

pmid-38741801.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫が磁気共鳴画像法で悪性腫瘍に酷似し、卵巣付属器報告データシステムスコア5と判定された症例。ガドリニウム造影後の高い信号強度が良性奇形腫に見られることを示し、卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断における落とし穴を強調している。
pmid-38741801.summary_en: Case report of solid-appearing struma ovarii (monodermal teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue) that mimicked malignancy on MRI O-RADS scoring. Demonstrates the diagnostic challenge and importance of including benign teratomas in differential diagnosis of ovarian masses with high signal enhancement.

pmid-38741622.summary_ja: 北西インドの三次癌センターにおける145例の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的3年後方視的研究。成熟奇形腫が最も多く、21-30歳女性で最高発症。良性症例85.5%;固形腫瘍と10cm以上の腫瘍は悪性傾向が高い。
pmid-38741622.summary_en: Comprehensive 3-year retrospective study of 145 ovarian germ cell tumors at a tertiary hospital in North-Western India. Mature teratomas were most prevalent, with highest incidence in 21-30-year-old women. Benign cases comprised 85.5%; solid tumors and masses >10cm showed higher malignancy propensity.

pmid-38741621.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（dermoid cyst）から悪性黒色腫への変化を示した56歳女性の症例。破裂した奇形腫から黒色腫への悪性転化は極めて稀な合併症である。
pmid-38741621.summary_en: Case report of rare malignant transformation of mature ovarian cystic teratoma to melanoma in a 56-year-old woman presenting with ruptured dermoid cyst. Histopathology showed melanin-positive cells positive for Melan-A and HMB-45, confirming melanoma arising from teratoma.

pmid-38739485.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌の症例報告で、血清β-hCG上昇を伴っていた。FDG PET/CTで原発巣と転移巣の異なるuptakeパターンを示し、稀な肺原発絨毛癌の画像所見を提示している。
pmid-38739485.summary_en: Case report of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with intrapulmonary metastases in a postmenopausal woman with elevated serum β-hCG. FDG PET/CT showed intense uptake in primary tumor and variable uptake in metastases, demonstrating imaging characteristics of this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-38737998.summary_ja: 288人の成熟卵巣奇形腫と9人の未熟奇形腫の女性を対象とした15年後方視的研究。成熟奇形腫は卵巣甲状腺腫との正の相関を示しました;子宮内膜様癌、嚢胞腺腫、他の婦人科病変を含む良性および悪性の共存が記録されました。
pmid-38737998.summary_en: 15-year retrospective study of 288 women with mature ovarian teratomas and 9 with immature teratomas. Mature teratomas showed positive correlation with struma ovarii; benign and malignant coexistence was documented including endometrioid cancer, cystadenomas, and other gynecological lesions.

pmid-38737718.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に随伴するNMDA受容体脳炎の32歳女性症例。精神症状から始まり精神病と癲癇に進行。腫瘍関連神経症候群としての奇形腫の重要性を示す。
pmid-38737718.summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis secondary to mature ovarian cystic teratoma in 32-year-old woman presenting with altered mental status progressing to psychosis and epilepsy. Documents diagnostic pathway including CSF findings, imaging of teratoma, and immunological confirmation.

pmid-38736792.summary_ja: 胎盤絨毛膜疾患（完全奇胎、部分奇胎、侵襲性奇胎、絨毛膜癌）が肺塞栓症を伴った3症例の報告。結核として誤認された画像所見も記述されている。
pmid-38736792.summary_en: Three case reports of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) including hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma presenting with pulmonary embolism and mimicking tuberculosis on imaging. Documents rare but serious thrombotic complications of GTN.

pmid-38736004.summary_ja: 新生児の高血管性巨大仙尾部奇形腫に対する術前塞栓術の症例報告。マイクロコイルなどを用いた塞栓により術中出血量を最小化する技術を示した。
pmid-38736004.summary_en: Case report of preoperative endovascular embolization of highly vascular giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in neonate prior to surgical resection. Demonstrates technique for minimizing intraoperative blood loss from large vascular teratomas using microcoils and embolic agents.

pmid-38733954.summary_ja: 87例の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍(OYST)患者の後方視的研究で、全エクソムシーケンシングにより遷延・再発疾患の予後因子と分子的特性を分析。不良転帰と関連するがんドライバー遺伝子と経路を同定し、免疫チェックポイント療法の可能性を示唆しました。
pmid-38733954.summary_en: Retrospective study of 87 ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST) patients analyzing prognostic factors and molecular characteristics of persistent/recurrent disease via whole-exome sequencing. Identified cancer driver genes and pathways associated with poor outcomes, suggesting immune checkpoint therapy potential.

pmid-38731178.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫157例の系統的レビュー。開放的胎児手術、経皮的介入、無治療の予後を比較。生存率は56%、46%、71%で、出産時妊娠週数が予後予測因子であった。
pmid-38731178.summary_en: Systematic review of 157 fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma cases comparing outcomes between open fetal surgery, percutaneous intervention, and no intervention. Survival rates were 56%, 46%, and 71% respectively; gestational age at delivery was key predictor of outcome.

pmid-38729824.summary_ja: 180人のGCT患者を対象とした前向き診断研究で、血清マイクロRNA-371a-3p(M371)を化学療法後残存腫瘤における生存癌の同定のためのバイオマーカーとして評価。感度69%、特異度99%;奇形腫と体性型悪性腫瘍ではマイクロRNA(miRNA)は検出不可。
pmid-38729824.summary_en: Prospective diagnostic study of 180 GCT patients evaluating serum microRNA-371a-3p (M371) as biomarker to identify viable cancer in postchemotherapy residual masses. Sensitivity 69% and specificity 99%; M371 undetectable in teratoma and somatic-type malignancy.

pmid-38728792.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍454例患者(195セミノーマ、259非セミノーマ)の後方視的研究で、腫瘍軸承精巣における精子形成の状態と転移性疾患との関連を分析。障害された精子形成と胎児性癌>50%が進行期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を予測しました。
pmid-38728792.summary_en: Retrospective study of 454 testicular GCT patients (195 seminomatous, 259 nonseminomatous) analyzing spermatogenesis status in tumor-bearing testis and association with metastatic disease. Impaired spermatogenesis and embryonal carcinoma >50% predicted advanced NSGCT stage.

pmid-38725891.summary_ja: インド三次医療施設(2003-2022年)で化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた73例のNSGCT患者の後方視的研究。診断時に75%の病期IIIの疾患にもかかわらず、2年再発無病生存率93%と全生存期間(全生存率)90%を達成しました。
pmid-38725891.summary_en: Retrospective study of 73 NSGCT patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection at Indian tertiary center (2003-2022). Achieved 2-year recurrence-free survival 93% and overall survival 90% despite 75% Stage III disease at diagnosis.

pmid-38725152.summary_ja: 42例の小児性腺胚細胞腫瘍標本のマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現解析により、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫の個別のマイクロRNA(miRNA)プロファイルを同定。6つのマイクロRNA(miRNA)(miR-302a-3p、miR-302b-3p、miR-371a-5pなど)が悪性腫瘍で有意な過剰発現を示しました。
pmid-38725152.summary_en: Comprehensive miRNA expression analysis of 42 pediatric gonadal GCT samples identifying distinct miRNA profiles for dysgerminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and immature teratomas. Six miRNAs (miR-302a-3p, miR-302b-3p, miR-371a-5p, etc.) showed significant overexpression in malignant tumors.

pmid-38722785.summary_ja: 小児腹部悪性腫瘍の病期分類と再病期分類に関する実践的画像ガイド。胚細胞腫瘍を含む一般的な病態を対象。神経芽腫、Wilms腫瘍、肝芽腫、リンパ腫、胚細胞腫瘍、横紋筋肉腫の特徴的な画像パターン、予後指標、治療反応評価をレビューしました。
pmid-38722785.summary_en: Practical imaging guide for staging and restaging common pediatric abdominal malignancies including germ cell tumors. Reviews distinctive imaging patterns, prognostic indicators, and response assessment for neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor, hepatoblastoma, lymphoma, GCT, and rhabdomyosarcoma.

pmid-38722483.summary_ja: 39歳女性の膵尾部の18cm成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)が腹腔鏡下遠位膵切除術により正常に切除された症例報告。大きな奇形腫に対する手術技術を示し、悪性腫瘍を示唆するMRI所見にもかかわらず良性病理を確認しました。
pmid-38722483.summary_en: Case report of 18-cm mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of pancreatic tail in 39-year-old woman successfully resected via laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy. Demonstrates surgical technique for large teratomas and confirms benign pathology despite MRI findings suggesting malignancy.

pmid-38721636.summary_ja: 良性卵巣甲状腺腫170人中15人の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫患者の後方視的症例集積。乳頭状甲状腺癌(47%)と濾胞性甲状腺癌(27%)が最も一般的であり、全例が術後に診断されました。可変的な手術範囲と一貫性を欠く内分泌フォローアップが記録されました。
pmid-38721636.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 15 malignant struma ovarii patients among 170 with benign struma ovarii. Papillary thyroid carcinoma (47%) and follicular thyroid carcinoma (27%) most common; all diagnosed post-operatively. Variable surgical extent and inconsistent endocrine follow-up documented.

pmid-38720563.summary_ja: 21歳の現役軍人が病期IIIB精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を診断され、左下肢腫脹を呈した下大静脈と腸骨静脈の広範な腫瘍栓で発症。血管内血栓摘出術と病理診断確認後、標準的な化学療法で治療継続。
pmid-38720563.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old active duty soldier with Stage IIIB nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor presenting with extensive inferior vena cava and iliac vein tumor thrombus. Underwent endovascular thrombectomy with pathologic confirmation of malignant cells; continued standard chemotherapy successfully.

pmid-38717551.summary_ja: 真菌由来代謝産物アルテルソラノールAのヒト栄養膜細胞（絨毛がん細胞株JEG-3及び正常栄養膜）への細胞毒性効果を調査。絨毛がん細胞は正常栄養膜より感受性が高く、ミトコンドリア媒介アポトーシスとMAPKシグナル経路阻害を示す。栄養膜悪性腫瘍への治療応用の可能性を示唆。
pmid-38717551.summary_en: Investigates cytotoxic effects of fungal metabolite altersolanol A on human placental trophoblasts including choriocarcinoma cell line JEG-3. Choriocarcinoma cells more sensitive than normal trophoblasts. Demonstrates mitochondrial-mediated apoptosis, MAPK pathway inhibition, and suppression of migration/invasion. Suggests potential reproductive toxicity and therapeutic applications against trophoblastic malignancies.

pmid-38716034.summary_ja: 37歳男性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例報告。左側肺葉への進展を伴い、CT/MRI画像検査により包虫嚢胞との鑑別が確立された。生命を脅かす合併症予防のため外科的切除を実施。多面的画像診断による嚢胞性縦隔病変の鑑別に関する有用性を強調。
pmid-38716034.summary_en: Case report of mediastinal mature cystic teratoma with intrapulmonary extension in 37-year-old male presenting with left chest pain. CT and MRI confirmed teratoma diagnosis rather than hydatid cyst. Surgical removal performed to prevent life-threatening complications. Demonstrates advantages of multimodal imaging in differentiating teratomas from other cystic mediastinal lesions.

pmid-38712621.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における胚仔型神経外胚葉/腺複合体34例を検討し免疫表型を特徴付け。免疫組織化学パネル（シナプトフィジン、GFAP、ビリン、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)）で両要素を区別。胚仔型神経外胚葉腫瘍への誤診を防ぎ、臨床管理を改善。
pmid-38712621.summary_en: Comprehensive pathological study of 34 testicular germ cell tumors with embryonic-type neuroectodermal/glandular complexes. Distinguishes embryonic neuroectodermal from primitive yolk sac tumor-like glandular elements using immunohistochemistry. Synaptophysin, GFAP, villin, and AFP comprise optimal panel to prevent misdiagnosis of embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumor and guide appropriate clinical management.

pmid-38710175.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症の臨床分析。438人の患者を分析し、全体で0.7%で確認、極めて高いβ-hCGレベルの患者では60%。全患者が進行性転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍。シスプラチン併用化学療法と甲状腺機能抑制薬治療により正常化。
pmid-38710175.summary_en: Clinical analysis of paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Study of 438 patients identified hyperthyroidism in 0.7% overall, but 60% in those with extremely elevated beta-hCG levels. All affected patients had advanced, metastasized non-seminomatous GCTs. Thyroid function rapidly normalized with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and thyrostatic treatment, emphasizing need for TSH/fT3 monitoring in poor-prognosis GCTs.

pmid-38709671.summary_ja: 27例の転移性胚細胞腫瘍が体腔液および脳脊髄液に関与。原発部位：精巣（10）、卵巣（7）、縦隔（4）、後腹膜（3）。組織型は混合胚細胞腫瘍、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌。89%が他の転移部位を有する、48%死亡率、中央生存期間4ヶ月。
pmid-38709671.summary_en: Case series of 27 metastatic germ cell tumors in serous cavity effusions and cerebrospinal fluid. Primary sites: testis (10), ovary (7), mediastinum (4), retroperitoneum (3), pineal (2), sacrococcyx (1). Histologies included mixed GCTs with seminoma, immature teratomas, yolk sac tumors, and embryonal carcinomas. Subtyping performed using cytomorphology and immunohistochemistry; 89% had additional metastatic sites, 48% mortality with 4-month median survival.

pmid-38707071.summary_ja: 26歳患者における原発性縦隔ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例報告。セミノーマの女性相当体で、稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を代表。前上縦隔腫瘤が縦隔の重要構造を覆っている。
pmid-38707071.summary_en: Case report of primary mediastinal dysgerminoma in 26-year-old patient. Dysgerminoma is the female equivalent of seminoma and represents a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Large anterosuperior mediastinal mass encasing vital mediastinal structures. Typical presentation of mediastinal seminomatous GCTs with slow growth pattern, often discovered incidentally. Discusses management of this rare extragonadal GCT location.

pmid-38704586.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が粘液性嚢胞腺癌と共存する卵巣腫瘍の症例。33歳女性における診断の課題で、衝突腫瘍か悪性転化の鑑別が必要。免疫組織化学分析（CK7-/CK20+）から良性奇形腫の腺癌化を示唆。
pmid-38704586.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma coexisting with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma in ovary of 33-year-old woman. Diagnostic challenge distinguishing collision tumor from malignant transformation of benign teratoma. Immunohistochemical analysis (CK7-/CK20+) suggested adenocarcinomatous transformation. Emphasizes importance of thorough sampling, histopathological examination, and immunohistochemistry in diagnosing uncommon ovarian tumors.

pmid-38701311.summary_ja: 28歳未婚女性の非妊娠関連卵巣絨毛がん(NGCO)と両側成熟奇形腫の極めて稀な症例報告。hCG上昇により初期診断は異所性妊娠。IFIGO I期疾患で温存手術とBEP化学療法で治療。月経回復し36ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。若い女性の異常膣出血では NGCO考慮の重要性を強調。
pmid-38701311.summary_en: Case report of nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma (NGCO) with bilateral mature teratomas in 28-year-old unmarried woman with regular menstruation. Initially misdiagnosed as ectopic pregnancy due to elevated hCG. IFIGO stage IA disease treated with fertility-preserving surgery and BEP chemotherapy. Demonstrates importance of considering NGCO in young women with abnormal bleeding and adnexal masses, with 36-month disease-free follow-up.

pmid-38701185.summary_ja: 病期IIA/Bセミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清のシステマティックレビュー・メタ解析。7研究、331人の男性を分析。2年無再発生存率は81%で再発率17.69%。合併症率9.16%、逆行性射精7.01%。従来の化学療法・放射線療法の毒性を考慮すると、実行可能な代替治療選択肢。
pmid-38701185.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for stage IIA/B seminomas. Analysis of 7 studies comprising 331 male patients. 2-year recurrence-free survival rate was 81% with 17.69% recurrence rate. Complication rate 9.16%, retrograde ejaculation 7.01%. Demonstrates RPLND as viable alternative to chemotherapy/radiation with favorable long-term outcomes, particularly relevant given toxicities of conventional treatments in young males.

pmid-38697270.summary_ja: 77例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の臨床病理学的研究。分子特徴と染色体異常を分析：12p等腕染色体（26%）、21番染色体獲得（37%）。主部位：前縦隔、中枢神経系、後腹膜、仙骨尾骨、頚部。8%に体細胞型悪性腫瘍。縦隔セミノーマは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍より良好な生存率。
pmid-38697270.summary_en: Large clinicopathologic study of 77 extragonadal germ cell tumors (EGCTs) analyzing molecular features and chromosomal abnormalities including 12p isochromosome (26%) and chromosome 21 gain (37%). Primary sites: anterior mediastinum, CNS, retroperitoneum, sacrococcygeal, neck. Somatic-type malignancies identified in 8%. Mediastinal seminomas had better survival than non-seminomatous EGCTs, with outcomes varying by anatomic site.

pmid-38696929.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の両側腎転移が自発的腎出血で発症した症例。胞状奇胎の既往を有する22歳の女性が急性側腹部痛で来院。初期診断は腎細胞癌でしたが、病理組織学的検査で絨毛癌が確認された。多剤併用化学療法により1年後にβ-hCGが検出不可能に。
pmid-38696929.summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma with bilateral renal metastasis presenting with spontaneous renal hemorrhage. 22-year-old female with history of molar pregnancy (confirmed by biopsy) presented with acute flank pain. Initially suspected renal cell carcinoma but pathology confirmed choriocarcinoma. Multi-agent chemotherapy achieved undetectable beta-hCG after 1 year. Emphasizes importance of considering choriocarcinoma in young women with recent pregnancy loss.

pmid-38695022.summary_ja: 高齢患者（≥50歳）における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原因特異的死亡率を予測する競合リスク・ノモグラム。2004～2015年に診断された2,751人の高齢患者のSEER分析。3年、5年、10年の原因特異的死亡発生率はそれぞれ4.4%、5.0%、6.1%。ノモグラムは良好な識別能（C-index>0.8）を示し、AJCC病期分類よりも臨床的意義が高い。
pmid-38695022.summary_en: Competing risk nomogram predicting cause-specific mortality in older testicular germ cell tumor patients (≥50 years). SEER database analysis of 2,751 older TGCT patients diagnosed 2004-2015. 3-, 5-, and 10-year cause-specific death incidences were 4.4%, 5.0%, 6.1%. Predictors included age, marital status, income, histology, tumor size, stage, and surgery. Nomogram showed good discrimination (C-index >0.8) with superior clinical significance compared to AJCC staging.

pmid-38693651.summary_ja: デノボ転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者150人の後方視的研究：<40、40-49、≥50歳の年齢グループ。年齢グループ間で生存転帰に有意差がなく、高齢患者でも標準化学療法遵守率が同等。50歳以上で発熱好中球減少症が有意に高い。適切な有害事象管理があれば高齢患者も同等の転帰を達成可能。
pmid-38693651.summary_en: Retrospective study of 150 patients with de novo metastatic germ cell tumors stratified by age: <40, 40-49, and ≥50 years. No significant survival differences between age groups despite elderly patients tending to receive less-intense chemotherapy. Febrile neutropenia significantly higher in patients ≥50 years. Standard first-line chemotherapy adherence rates comparable across ages, suggesting elderly patients can achieve equivalent outcomes with appropriate adverse event management.

pmid-38693576.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるNANOG調節マイクロRNA(miRNA)を同定する研究で、MIR9-2-5pは腫瘍抑制因子として機能。ゲイン機能実験は胎児性癌およびセミノーマ細胞における増殖、侵襲、および幹性低下を示す。NANOG負フィードバック調節を通じた治療可能性を示唆。
pmid-38693576.summary_en: Study identifies NANOG-regulated microRNAs in testicular GCTs, focusing on MIR9-2-5p as a tumor suppressor. Gain-of-function experiments show MIR9-2-5p reduces proliferation, invasion, and stemness in embryonal carcinoma and seminoma cells, suggesting therapeutic potential through NANOG feedback regulation.

pmid-38692356.summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けた127人患者の後方視的研究。標準BEP治療は最適な転帰を示した; 残存病理は生きている疾患（20.5%）、奇形腫（52.7%）、および壊死（26.8%）を含んだ。高容量センターでのケアの重要性と受け入れ可能な合併症率を強調。
pmid-38692356.summary_en: Retrospective study of 127 patients undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND for testicular and extragonadal GCTs. Standard BEP regimen showed optimal outcomes; residual pathology included viable disease (20.5%), teratoma (52.7%), and necrosis (26.8%). Emphasizes importance of high-volume center care with acceptable complication rates.

pmid-38686073.summary_ja: 停留精巣を有する水無脳症長期生存者における精巣がんの最初の報告症例。混合型胚細胞腫瘍が外科的切除された。重度の脳性麻痺を有する成人のがん管理の決定における課題と臨床倫理相談の価値を強調。
pmid-38686073.summary_en: First reported case of testicular cancer in a long-term hydranencephaly survivor with cryptorchidism. Mixed-type GCT was surgically resected. Highlights challenges in cancer management decisions for adults with severe cerebral palsy and the potential value of clinical ethics consultation.

pmid-38682848.summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌の稀な2症例報告。偶発的発見から臨床的疾患まで多様な臨床像を呈示。母体および新生児転移なく、保存的管理でβ-hCG低下。詳細な胎盤検査の重要性を強調。
pmid-38682848.summary_en: Case series of two rare intraplacental choriocarcinoma cases with varied presentations, ranging from incidental lesion to clinical disease. No maternal or neonatal metastasis found; conservative management with declining serum β-hCG levels. Emphasizes importance of detailed placental examination.

pmid-38681028.summary_ja: 脳内出血で発症した転移性絨毛癌の若年女性3症例報告。臨床像の多様性が診断を複雑化。特に限られた医療資源下ではβ-hCG測定と高い臨床的疑いが妊娠性栄養膜疾患診断に必須。
pmid-38681028.summary_en: Case series of three young females with metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting with intracerebral hemorrhage. Varied clinical presentations complicated diagnosis. Emphasizes importance of high clinical suspicion and serum β-hCG testing in resource-limited settings for identifying gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-38678494.summary_ja: 52歳成人における無症状成熟心膜内奇形腫の稀な症例。ほとんどの心膜内奇形腫は乳幼児に発生; 成人症例は全体の1%未満。完全外科的切除後5年でフォローアップで再発なし。悪性転化と心臓合併症の予防における外科的切除の重要性を強調。
pmid-38678494.summary_en: Rare case of asymptomatic mature intrapericardial teratoma in 52-year-old adult. Most intrapericardial teratomas occur in infancy; adult cases represent <1% of cases. Complete resection performed without recurrence at 5-year follow-up. Highlights importance of excision to prevent malignant transformation and cardiac complications.

pmid-38677742.summary_ja: CT画像と臨床変数を用いた機械学習モデルで化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節廓清標本の奇形腫対壊死を予測。ResNet50は診断精度80%、感度67.3%、特異度90.5%を達成。治療方針決定に有用。
pmid-38677742.summary_en: Machine learning model using CT imaging and clinical variables to predict residual teratoma versus necrosis in post-chemotherapy RPLND specimens. ResNet50 achieved 80% diagnostic accuracy (sensitivity 67.3%, specificity 90.5%, AUC 0.84). Helps identify patients requiring surgery versus observation.

pmid-38674232.summary_ja: テスト性がんの治療と性機能障害に関する総説。手術、化学療法、放射線療法、後腹膜廓清による勃起障害、射精障害、不妊、ホルモン変化を記述。若年患者の生活の質向上の重要性を強調。
pmid-38674232.summary_en: Narrative review of testicular cancer treatments and sexual outcomes. Addresses erectile dysfunction, ejaculatory disorders, fertility issues, and hormonal changes associated with surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and RPLND. Emphasizes need for balanced approach between oncological control and quality of life in young male patients.

pmid-38672528.summary_ja: 腹膜偽粘液腫の卵巣原因の文献レビュー。粘液性嚢胞腺腫、卵巣癌、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を含む7つの主要な状況が同定された。疾患の疫学、画像検査、症状および治療について記述。診断遅延のリスクと管理の必要性を強調している。
pmid-38672528.summary_en: Literature review of ovarian causes of pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP). Seven main scenarios identified including mucinous cystadenoma, ovarian cancer, and malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma. Addresses epidemiology, imaging, symptoms, and treatment of rare mucus-secreting malignancy.

pmid-38670445.summary_ja: 1,054例の卵巣奇形腫の後方視的研究。平均年齢38歳、平均嚢腫サイズ6.26 cm。捻転率5.6%、悪性転化1.1%、両側性10.7%。腹腔鏡アプローチが70%以上で使用され、低い合併症率と関連していたが、嚢腫漏出リスク増加。嚢腫漏出は腹膜炎を稀に引き起こした。
pmid-38670445.summary_en: Retrospective study of 1,054 ovarian teratoma cases. Mean age 38 years, average cyst size 6.26 cm. Torsion rate 5.6%, malignant transformation 1.1%, bilateral involvement 10.7%. Laparoscopic approach used in >70%, associated with lower complications but increased spillage risk. Cyst spillage rarely caused peritonitis.

pmid-38669424.summary_ja: 成人Altman III型仙骨尾骨奇形腫の腹腔鏡下経腹会陰式切除の症例。31歳女性、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。腟超音波、CT、MRIによる診断有用性と腹腔鏡手術の安全性を示唆。
pmid-38669424.summary_en: Case report of adult Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma treated with laparoscopic transabdominal-sacrococcygeal resection. 31-year-old woman with mature cystic teratoma. Demonstrates diagnostic utility of imaging (ultrasound, CT, MRI) and laparoscopic surgical approach safety for adult SCT management.

pmid-38666932.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞（栄養膜モデル）におけるグリコプロテインホルモンα-サブユニット遺伝子発現制御の研究。cAMP、カルシウム、p38シグナルによる刺激誘導的活性化を検討。複数のシグナル経路の収束点として機能。
pmid-38666932.summary_en: Study of glycoprotein hormone α-subunit gene expression in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells (trophoblast model). Examines stimulus-induced activation via cAMP, Ca2+, and p38 signaling pathways. Tandem cAMP response element acts as convergence point for multiple signaling. Relevant to understanding choriocarcinoma biology.

pmid-38665348.summary_ja: 多羊水を伴う出生前超音波診断された口腔奇形腫（未熟）。50×36×42mm、口腔全体に充満し下咽頭圧迫。33週での早産。気管挿管失敗で新生児死亡。病理学的に口腔未熟奇形腫を確認。
pmid-38665348.summary_en: Prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of fetal oral teratoma (immature) presenting with polyhydramnios. 50×36×42 mm solid mass filling entire oral cavity with hypopharyngeal compression. Preterm delivery at 33 weeks due to increased amniotic fluid. Neonatal death after failed intubation. Pathology confirmed oral immature teratoma.

pmid-38661513.summary_ja: テスト性非セミノーマ性細胞腫瘍（胚細胞癌95%、卵黄嚢腫瘍5%）の11年後の晩期再発症例。非典型的な対側後腹膜再発。細胞診で28個中12個のリンパ節に胚細胞癌。SALL4、CD30陽性。
pmid-38661513.summary_en: Case report of 41-year-old with late relapse of testicular NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor) after 11 years of remission. Atypical contralateral retroperitoneal recurrence. Fine needle aspiration showed embryonal carcinoma in 12/28 lymph nodes. Immunostaining positive for SALL4 and CD30.

pmid-38658465.summary_ja: テスト性がん長期生存者625例の生活の質評価（中央追跡26.2年）。放射線療法と化学療法はRPLND比較で生活の質が低下。非セミノーマ生存者はセミノーマより生活の質が良好（性的関心除く）。治療選択は長期転帰に重要。
pmid-38658465.summary_en: Long-term quality of life assessment in testicular cancer survivors (n=625, median follow-up 26.2 years). RT and CT showed greater QoL impairment compared to RPLND. NSGCT survivors reported lower QoL impairment than seminoma survivors, except for sexual concerns. Treatment type significantly impacts long-term outcomes.

pmid-38649788.summary_ja: テスト性性細胞腫瘍と上皮内性細胞新生物の免疫細胞組成の研究。正常精巣のマクロファージからTGCTのT細胞、B細胞、樹状細胞への変化。Treg、Tfhはセミノーマで最も豊富。免疫療法の標的候補を示唆。
pmid-38649788.summary_en: Study of immune cell composition in testicular GCTs and GCNIS using immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry, and scRNA-seq. Profound shift from macrophages in normal testes to T cells, B cells, and dendritic cells in TGCT. Treg and Tfh cells most abundant in seminomas. Novel findings suggest role in TGCT pathobiology and immunotherapy targets.

pmid-38647426.summary_ja: 3ヶ月男児の反復性上部消化管出血症例報告。胃奇形腫は小児奇形腫全体の1%未満という極めて稀な腫瘍で、術前診断が困難である。
pmid-38647426.summary_en: A 3-month-old boy with recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding was found to have a gastric teratoma. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of this extremely rare pediatric tumor, representing less than 1% of all pediatric teratomas and typically presenting as a palpable abdominal mass.

pmid-38645982.summary_ja: 46XXモザイク型ターナー症候群患者の左卵巣に発生した大きな卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例。Y染色体物質を有さないTS患者における胚細胞腫瘍の発生を強調し、GCT発症の理解を拡大する。
pmid-38645982.summary_en: A 23-year-old with mosaic 46XX Turner syndrome presented with a large left ovarian yolk sac tumor. This rare case highlights the occurrence of germ cell tumors in TS patients without Y chromosome material, expanding understanding of GCT pathogenesis.

pmid-38645951.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの腹部転移症例。術後のサーベイランスの重要性と、進行期精巣がんの管理における化学療法の役割を示した症例報告である。
pmid-38645951.summary_en: A 45-year-old with prior testicular seminoma presented with abdominal metastasis. This case emphasizes the importance of post-orchiectomy surveillance and demonstrates how advanced seminoma can present with large conglomerate masses requiring combination chemotherapy.

pmid-38630148.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者における精子凍結保存の利用率についての研究。年齢や教育水準が利用決定に影響を与え、術後の生殖機能維持と妊孕性に関する重要な知見が得られた。
pmid-38630148.summary_en: Study examining sperm cryopreservation utilization in 279 testicular cancer survivors over 5.7 years. Younger age and higher education were associated with cryopreservation use; minimal unmet desires for biological children reported post-treatment.

pmid-38629199.summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるmiR-371a-3pの診断精度を検討した前向き研究。感度98.3%、特異度95%で従来のマーカーを上回る診断精度を示し、腫瘍の臨床病期や大きさと相関した。
pmid-38629199.summary_en: Prospective study evaluated miR-371a-3p as a diagnostic biomarker for testicular GCTs in Turkish population. Marker demonstrated 98.3% sensitivity and 95% specificity (AUC=0.997), outperforming traditional markers AFP and bHCG.

pmid-38627058.summary_ja: 若い女性の未熟卵巣奇形腫に対する化学療法後に、腹膜神経膠腫症とgrowing teratoma syndromeが同時発症した症例報告。早期外科的介入と妊孕性温存が極めて重要であり、双方の同時発症は文献では稀である。
pmid-38627058.summary_en: Case report of concurrent gliomatosis peritonei and growing teratoma syndrome in a young woman with immature ovarian teratoma post-chemotherapy. Early surgical intervention and fertility preservation were crucial; dual occurrence is scarcely reported in literature.

pmid-38622623.summary_ja: 胸膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。化学療法と拡大胸膜切除術、高温胸腔内化学療法の組み合わせ治療で完全切除を達成した稀な臨床例である。
pmid-38622623.summary_en: Case series describing surgical management of rare primary pleural neoplasms including a yolk sac tumor. The yolk sac tumor case involved neoadjuvant chemotherapy, extended pleurectomy, and hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy with complete resection and no recurrence.

pmid-38619599.summary_ja: 精巣・精巣傍腫瘍と遺伝性症候群の関連性に関する総説。セミノーマを含む複数の腫瘍型と家族性症候群の確立した関連性と新知見について述べられている。
pmid-38619599.summary_en: Comprehensive review of syndromic associations with testicular and paratesticular neoplasms including GCTs. Covers established associations (Carney complex, Peutz-Jeghers, VHL) and discusses emerging potential links with seminomas and other testicular tumors.

pmid-38617068.summary_ja: 乳頭がんに変性した卵巣ストルマ（特殊化した卵巣奇形腫）の症例。甲状腺成分から悪性腫瘍への変性と、その管理について述べられている。
pmid-38617068.summary_en: Case report of struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma primarily composed of thyroid tissue, with malignant transformation to papillary thyroid carcinoma in a 64-year-old woman. Discusses evaluation and management of this rare malignant-potential condition.

pmid-38616838.summary_ja: 肝臓浸潤を伴う小児傍精巣外GCTの症例報告。神経芽腫と肝芽腫との鑑別診断が課題であり、細胞診と免疫組織化学で確定診断された。
pmid-38616838.summary_en: Case report of a suprarenal extragonadal germ cell tumor with hepatic infiltration in a pediatric patient. Differential diagnosis included neuroblastoma and hepatoblastoma; diagnosis confirmed by fine-needle aspiration cytology and immunohistochemistry.

pmid-38614119.summary_ja: 初期診断から数年後に悪性転化を示した良性卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化は極めて稀（<5%）。37歳女性は14年後、26歳女性は6年後に診断。複数転移病巣を有する患者は放射性ヨウ素療法で治療。長期監視の重要性を強調。
pmid-38614119.summary_en: Two cases of benign struma ovarii that underwent malignant transformation to highly differentiated follicular carcinoma years after initial diagnosis. Emphasizes rarity of malignant transformation (<5%) and importance of long-term surveillance and radioactive iodine therapy.

pmid-38611057.summary_ja: GCTにおけるマイクロRNAバイオマーカー（特にmiR-371a-3p）の診断・管理上の役割についての総説。従来のマーカーより診断精度が優れており、治療強度調整と再発検出に有用である。
pmid-38611057.summary_en: Review of circulating microRNAs, particularly miR-371a-3p, as blood-based biomarkers for germ cell tumor diagnosis and management. microRNAs demonstrate superior diagnostic accuracy compared to AFP, bHCG, and LDH, with potential for treatment guidance.

pmid-38608099.summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるKLRB1遺伝子発現と免疫浸潤の関連性についての総説。免疫細胞の浸潤と相関し、新しい予測因子および治療標的となる可能性が指摘されている。
pmid-38608099.summary_en: Comprehensive review of KLRB1 gene expression in testicular germ cell tumors using TCGA and GTEx datasets. KLRB1 is upregulated in malignant tissues and correlates with immune infiltration and inflammatory response, suggesting potential as biomarker and therapeutic target.

pmid-38597023.summary_ja: 職業的有機溶剤曝露と精巣GCTリスクの関連性を検討した症例対照研究。トリクロロエチレンと精巣GCTの関連が確認され、職業曝露がGCT発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-38597023.summary_en: French case-control study of 454 testicular GCT cases and 670 controls examining occupational solvent exposure. Results showed consistent associations between trichloroethylene, ketone esters, and petroleum solvents with TGCT, suggesting occupational factors in GCT pathogenesis.

pmid-38596159.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の破裂による化学腹膜炎は婦人科悪性腫瘍を模倣する。早期手術介入で合併症防止可能。婦人科腫瘍医の関与が推奨される。
pmid-38596159.summary_en: Rupture of mature cystic ovarian teratoma can cause chronic chemical peritonitis mimicking gynecologic malignancy. Case discusses diagnostic challenges, morbidity from delayed intervention, and importance of gynecologic oncology involvement in management of complex benign ovarian pathology.

pmid-38591215.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。血清AFPおよびCA-125上昇を認め、PET/CTで著明なFDG取り込みを示した。化学療法後に完全な代謝反応を達成。
pmid-38591215.summary_en: Case report of ovarian yolk sac tumor (OYST) in 19-year-old woman with elevated serum AFP and CA-125. PET/CT imaging showed intense FDG uptake in solid component. Patient achieved complete metabolic response after chemotherapy, demonstrating utility of PET/CT in diagnosis and treatment monitoring of OYST.

pmid-38590416.summary_ja: 低リスクGTN患者310例のメトトレキサート療法検討。後流産絨毛癌と高い前治療hCG濃度が抵抗性の独立危険因子。意思決定木モデルで予測精度向上。
pmid-38590416.summary_en: Study of 310 low-risk GTN patients receiving methotrexate chemotherapy. Postmolar choriocarcinoma and elevated pretreatment hCG were independent risk factors for MTX resistance (35.5% resistant). Decision tree model developed to predict MTX resistance risk and guide clinical treatment decisions.

pmid-38581310.summary_ja: 肺転移なく心臓（左房）に転移した絨毛癌の稀な症例。β-hCG上昇、心エコーで診断。左房腫瘍切除後、EP・EMACO化学療法で良好結果。
pmid-38581310.summary_en: Rare case of choriocarcinoma with metastasis to left atrium and pulmonary vein without lung involvement. Patient presented with cough and hemoptysis. Elevated β-hCG and cardiac imaging aided diagnosis. Surgical resection followed by chemotherapy (EP and EMACO regimens) achieved satisfactory outcomes.

pmid-38576805.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の家族歴（母親、叔母、祖母）を有する16歳女児が、3年前の両側成熟奇形腫に対する卵巣囊胞切除術後に1級未熟卵巣奇形腫を発症。腹腔鏡下両側輸卵管卵巣摘出術および病期分類手術が実施された。家族性卵巣奇形腫患者の長期管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-38576805.summary_en: Case report of 16-year-old girl with family history of ovarian teratomas (mother, aunt, grandmother) who developed grade-1 immature teratoma 3 years after bilateral mature teratoma resection. Underwent repeat bilateral oophorectomy with staging. Highlights importance of management guidance for familial ovarian teratomas.

pmid-38573206.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍管理における現在の課題のレビュー。不良リスク疾患治療、脳転移患者の多学科的管理、プラチナ耐性疾患への対応が必要。腫瘍マーカー(αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG))に加えて最小残存疾患と奇形腫検出のための新規バイオマーカー開発が重要。
pmid-38573206.summary_en: Review of current challenges in germ cell tumor (GCT) management including poor-risk disease treatment, brain metastases management, platinum-refractory disease, and novel biomarkers for minimal residual disease and teratoma detection. Emphasizes multidisciplinary approach at tertiary care centers.

pmid-38572155.summary_ja: 41歳男性の妊娠性以外の絨毛癌で肺、脳、骨、後腹膜リンパ節転移が認められた。β-hCGの著しい上昇と女性化乳房が見られ、陽電子放射断層撮影/コンピュータ断層撮影で確認。攻撃的な化学療法とペムブロリズマブで治療されたが全生存期間は診断後5か月。
pmid-38572155.summary_en: Rare case of non-gestational choriocarcinoma in 41-year-old man with lung, brain, bone, and lymph node metastases. Elevated β-hCG and gynecomastia noted. Treated with aggressive chemotherapy and pembrolizumab, but prognosis remained poor with overall survival of 5 months. Emphasizes need for systematic evaluation in men with elevated hCG.

pmid-38566825.summary_ja: 141例の小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の9年間の後方視的研究。悪性胚細胞腫瘍群の5年全生存率は81%、無イベント生存率は73%。奇形腫群は90%の全生存率と85%の無イベント生存率を達成。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値、血清AFP動態、切除状態が有意な予後因子。
pmid-38566825.summary_en: Retrospective study of 141 children with extracranial GCTs over 9 years. Malignant GCT group showed 5-year overall survival 81% and event-free survival 73%. Teratoma group achieved 90% OS and 85% EFS. AFP level, serum AFP kinetics, and resection status identified as significant prognostic factors.

pmid-38566646.summary_ja: 生後1日の新生児口腔硬口蓋の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。呼吸困難で発症。CT検査と外科的切除で確定診断。新生児口腔腫瘤管理の重要性を示す。
pmid-38566646.summary_en: Case of 1-day-old male neonate with mature cystic teratoma of right hard palate causing respiratory distress. CT confirmed intraoral cystic lesion with cleft palate. Surgical excision performed with histopathological confirmation. Highlights diagnostic and management challenges in neonatal oral cavity masses.

pmid-38565457.summary_ja: 副鼻腔奇形腫肉腫27例の後方視的分析。導入化学療法後、70.4%で部分奏効を達成し、77.8%の患者で外科的切除が実現可能となった。シスプラチン-エトポシドが主要レジメン（74.1%）として使用され、無増悪生存期間中央値は19か月、全生存期間中央値は23か月であった。
pmid-38565457.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 27 sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS) patients receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy with cisplatin-etoposide. Achieved 70.4% partial response, enabling resection in 77.8% of patients. Median progression-free survival 19 months, overall survival 23 months. NACT shown to be effective for downstaging locally advanced disease.

pmid-38564927.summary_ja: 精巣転移性非精上皮腫性GCT 6792例の検討。一次腫瘍の奇形腫成分は良好予後群で5年生存率を低下させる。奇形腫患者は術後化学療法をより高率に要する。
pmid-38564927.summary_en: Study of 6792 metastatic testicular NSGCT patients comparing survival outcomes with teratoma (TER) versus without teratoma (NTER) in primary tumor. In good prognosis group, teratoma presence negatively impacted 5-year PFS (87.8% vs 92.0%) and OS (94.5% vs 96.5%). Teratoma patients required more frequent post-chemotherapy surgery.

pmid-38559663.summary_ja: 段階的な右下腹部/骨盤痛で提示した40歳女性における卵管の大規模完全卵管内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影と超音波検査で液体、肉眼的脂肪、および石灰化を含む拡張右卵管を認識し、術前診断を可能にした。患者は卵管切除術を受け、病理学的に確認。卵管成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は極めて稀で、英語文献で100例未満。
pmid-38559663.summary_en: Case report of large mature cystic teratoma of fallopian tube in 40-year-old woman presenting with pelvic pain. CT and ultrasound showed dilated tube with fat and calcifications, enabling preoperative diagnosis. Salpingectomy performed with pathological confirmation. Extremely rare entity with fewer than 100 cases reported worldwide.

pmid-38558963.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫からの扁平上皮癌の悪性転化症例。転移を伴う。手術、化学療法、PARP阻害薬、免疫療法による多機関治療を実施。奇形腫悪性転化の管理を提示。
pmid-38558963.summary_en: Case report of metastatic squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Rare occurrence of malignant transformation without consensus on optimal treatment. Describes multimodality approach including surgery, chemotherapy, maintenance PARP inhibitor, and immunotherapy for metastatic disease.

pmid-38555680.summary_ja: 151人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における化学療法誘発末梢神経障害(CIPN)と生活の質(QOL)の関連を調査した前向き研究。中央フォローアップ10年。高CIPNスコアを報告した生存者は有意に低いグローバルヘルスステータス、身体的・感情的・認知的・社会的機能の低下、疲労・痛み・呼吸困難などの症状負担の増加と経済的問題を示し、CIPNがQOL低下の強い予測因子。
pmid-38555680.summary_en: Prospective study of 151 testicular GCT survivors (median 10-year follow-up) investigating chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) impact on quality of life using EORTC questionnaires. High CIPN scores strongly correlated with impaired global health status, physical/emotional functioning, and symptom burden.

pmid-38555208.summary_ja: 70人の混合型卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者の後方視的コホート。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も一般的な成分(80%)、その後ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）(50%)、未熟奇形腫(40%)。5年無再発生存期間77.9%、疾患特異的生存期間87.9%。FIGO病期III-IVと遅延腫瘍マーカー正常化が予後因子として識別。
pmid-38555208.summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 70 mixed malignant ovarian germ cell tumor (mMOGCT) patients. Yolk sac tumor most common component (80%), followed by dysgerminoma (50%), immature teratoma (40%). 5-year RFS 77.9%, DSS 87.9%. FIGO stage III-IV and delayed tumor marker normalization identified as prognostic factors with risk stratification model.

pmid-38553733.summary_ja: 原発子宮腫瘍がない妊娠性絨毛性疾患関連絨毛癌の単発腎転移の稀な症例報告。41歳女性が血尿と重度の側腹部痛で提示。画像検査で左腎下極に活動性出血を伴う病変を認識。部分腎摘除術後、エトポシド・メトトレキサート・アクチノマイシンD・シクロホスファミド・ビンクリスチン(EMA-CO)化学療法で治療。β-hCGレベルは5 mIU/mLに低下し、6ヶ月間の経過観察で正常範囲を維持。
pmid-38553733.summary_en: Case report of post-molar choriocarcinoma with solitary renal metastasis in absence of primary uterine tumor. Patient presented with hematuria and flank pain. Treated with standard chemotherapy (EMA-CO), achieving complete response with normalized hCG levels.

pmid-38553575.summary_ja: 妊娠関連疾患における標的化ナノ医薬品のレビュー。絨毛癌を含む妊娠性栄養膜疾患を対象にナノキャリアシステムの応用を検討。
pmid-38553575.summary_en: Review of actively targeted nanomedicines for pregnancy-related diseases including preeclampsia, preterm birth, fetal growth restriction, and choriocarcinoma. Discusses nanocarrier systems, active targeting ligands, and clinical applications in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-38552061.summary_ja: 子宮頸部成熟奇形種の稀有症例。複数の胚葉由来組織を含む。手術により治癒、再発なし。
pmid-38552061.summary_en: Rare case report of mature solid teratoma of uterine cervix in 40-year-old. Histology revealed respiratory epithelium, intestinal epithelium, adipose tissue, and mature glial components. Surgical resection (tumorectomy) achieved cure without recurrence.

pmid-38546253.summary_ja: 腹部膨満で発症した小児胃奇形種2例。放射線画像検査と組織病理で診断。外科切除で治癒可能。
