pmid-38546253.summary_en: Two cases of gastric teratomas in pediatric patients presenting with abdominal distension. Diagnosis confirmed by radiological imaging and histopathological analysis. Surgical excision is curative for these rare tumors.

pmid-38544795.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形種の管理に関するMaGICコンセンサスレビュー。小児と成人の治療方針の相違、AFP高値症例の管理を検討。
pmid-38544795.summary_en: MaGIC consortium consensus review on management of ovarian immature teratoma in pediatric and adult patients. Addresses diagnostic challenges, elevated AFP, and treatment variations between pediatric (surgery-only) and adult (adjuvant chemotherapy) approaches.

pmid-38541782.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマを含む複数の悪性腫瘍におけるPRAME発現を検討。ヒストン3アセチル化とDNAメチル化が免疫療法標的の制御に関与。
pmid-38541782.summary_en: Study of PRAME expression in three malignancy types including testicular seminoma. Examined epigenetic mechanisms including histone H3 acetylation and DNA methylation status in regulating immunotherapy targets for cancer.

pmid-38541186.summary_ja: 腹膜癌腫症に類似した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形種破裂症例。軽度外傷後の腹痛で発症。手術により治癒。
pmid-38541186.summary_en: Case report of ruptured mature cystic ovarian teratoma mimicking peritoneal carcinomatosis. Presented with abdominal pain following minor trauma. CT and MRI showed peritoneal dissemination of teratoma contents; surgical management achieved favorable outcome.

pmid-38537882.summary_ja: hCG過剰分泌による卵巣奇形種発生機序を検討。単為発生を介した腫瘍形成、卵胞発育障害とERK1/2シグナルの抑制。
pmid-38537882.summary_en: Transgenic mouse study investigating hCG's role in ovarian teratoma development. Chronic hCG hypersecretion induced parthenogenetic oocyte activation and teratoma formation with 100% penetrance. Identifies mechanism linking gonadotropin dysfunction to teratoma pathogenesis.

pmid-38531266.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ453人の全国人口ベースコホート研究。中央フォローアップ6.3年で139人(30.6%)が再発。精巣精巣部肉芽組織への腫瘍侵襲、腫瘍サイズ、リンパ管侵襲、および胎児性癌が再発の独立した予測因子。これらの因子を用いた新しいモデルは、現在の臨床慣行より正確な危険度層別化を提供。
pmid-38531266.summary_en: Population-based cohort study of 453 clinical stage I testicular non-seminoma patients identifying independent prognostic factors for relapse. Tumor invasion, size, lymphovascular invasion, and embryonal carcinoma were significant predictors. Model provides improved risk stratification.

pmid-38525515.summary_ja: 分子時代における精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進化に関する包括的レビュー。ゲノムイベントによる発症経路、GCNIS前駆病変、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性分化の機構、シスプラチン耐性、有望なマイクロRNAバイオマーカーについて論述。
pmid-38525515.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular germ cell tumor evolution in molecular era. Discusses pathogenesis driven by genomic events, GCNIS precursor lesion, mechanisms of seminoma and non-seminomatous differentiation, cisplatin resistance, and promising miRNA biomarkers.

pmid-38525427.summary_ja: 妊娠中期に診断された転移性絨毛癌の症例。EMA-CO化学療法で治療、26週で健康児を出産。その後の疾患制御に成功。
pmid-38525427.summary_en: Case report of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosed in second trimester of viable pregnancy. Successfully treated with EMA-CO and TC chemotherapy during pregnancy, achieving healthy live delivery at 26 weeks gestation with subsequent disease control.

pmid-38525405.summary_ja: 小児・若年成人患者における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の3症例報告。患者はいずれも著しく上昇したAFPレベルを示し、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン(BEP)化学療法で治療。治療反応のモニタリングとフォローアップにおいてAFP測定が重要。若年患者で高いAFPレベルと急速増大する卵巣腫瘤が見られた場合は卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断を念頭に置くべき。
pmid-38525405.summary_en: Three case reports of ovarian yolk sac tumors in pediatric and young adult patients with elevated AFP levels. Discusses treatment with BEP chemotherapy and monitoring response. Addresses fertility preservation considerations in these highly treatable malignancies.

pmid-38524661.summary_ja: Y染色体を有するターナー症候群でジスジャーミノーマが予防的去勢時に発見。悪性化リスクと妊孕性保存のバランスを検討。
pmid-38524661.summary_en: Case report of dysgerminoma with gonadoblastoma revealed on prophylactic bilateral gonadectomy in 12-year-old with mosaic Turner syndrome with Y chromosome material. Discusses challenges in timing prophylactic surgery, balancing malignancy risk with fertility preservation.

pmid-38524218.summary_ja: 化学療法後無精子症患者の精子採取に関する研究。セミノーマと非セミノーマを含む。シクロホスファミド用量と精子採取率の関連。
pmid-38524218.summary_en: Retrospective study of sperm retrieval by microdissection TESE in azoospermic cancer survivors post-chemotherapy, including seminoma and non-seminomatous GCT patients. Minimal cyclophosphamide equivalent dose significantly associated with improved sperm retrieval rates.

pmid-38523926.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形種による疑似Meigs症候群。好酸球性胸水を伴う非典型的炎症応答を呈した稀有症例。
pmid-38523926.summary_en: Case report of pseudo-Meigs' syndrome with eosinophilic pleural effusion secondary to mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Rare presentation with atypical inflammatory response; typical pseudo-Meigs syndrome shows mononuclear predominance rather than eosinophilia.

pmid-38523295.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌への悪性転化は稀(約2%)だが、術前診断は困難である。43歳女性が腹痛で提示。完全な外科的切除と化学療法で治療。悪性転化の可能性を考慮して、腹痛を伴う高齢者や腫瘍マーカー上昇者で評価すべき。
pmid-38523295.summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma malignant transformation arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma in 43-year-old woman. Emphasizes rarity of malignant transformation (approximately 2%) and diagnostic challenges, requiring comprehensive staging and adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-38521742.summary_ja: 小児卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍118人(中央年齢12歳)における手術タイミング(一次、遅延、二次検査)が手術罹患率と転帰に与える影響を比較。一次手術は高い手術罹患率と関連し、遅延手術は同様の転帰で合併症を最小化。二次検査手術は有意な合併症をもたらした。追跡調査中央値5.2年で、5年無イベント生存期間86%、全生存期間89%。
pmid-38521742.summary_en: Study comparing surgical timing in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors in children (118 patients, median age 12 years). Primary surgery associated with higher morbidity; delayed surgery minimizes complications with similar outcomes. Five-year event-free survival 86%, overall survival 89%.

pmid-38520671.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者21人(年齢31-47歳)を対象とした質的研究。伝統的男性規範が治療後の自己認識に与える影響を探索。男性は感情統制と身体的強さを重視する一方、能力低下により男性性の脅威を経験。男性性の柔軟な適応を促すことで、精巣がん患者の対処と心理的転帰の改善を推奨。
pmid-38520671.summary_en: Qualitative study of 21 men (ages 31-47) who survived testicular cancer (TC), exploring how traditional masculine norms affect post-treatment self-perception. Men valued emotional control and physical strength, but experienced threats to masculine identity from reduced competencies. The study recommends encouraging flexible adaptation of masculinity to improve coping and psychological outcomes in TC survivors.

pmid-38516493.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を呈した25歳女性で、行動変化、けいれん、カタトニアで発症。初期画像検査陰性だが血清・脳脊髄液は抗NMDA受容体抗体陽性。免疫療法に良好反応したが、2年後の監視で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が発見。
pmid-38516493.summary_en: Case report of 25-year-old female with anti-NMDAR encephalitis presenting with behavioral changes, seizures, and catatonia. Initial imaging was negative, but serum and CSF tested positive for anti-NMDAR antibodies. Patient responded well to immunotherapy (steroids, IVIg, rituximab). Ovarian mature cystic teratoma was discovered two years later during surveillance, highlighting importance of continued imaging screening.

pmid-38515195.summary_ja: 小児・思春期患者212名の付属器腫瘤と腹痛に関する研究。成熟奇形腫（29.4%）と単純嚢胞（25.6%）が最も一般的。腫瘤サイズ>5cm、急性発症痛が茎捻転のリスク因子。卵巣温存手術が推奨される。
pmid-38515195.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 212 pediatric and adolescent patients with adnexal masses and abdominal pain. Mature teratoma (29.4%) and simple cysts (25.6%) were most common pathologic findings. Multivariate analysis identified mass size >5 cm, acute onset pain, and persistent/recurrent pain as risk factors for adnexal torsion. Early laparoscopy with ovary-preserving surgery is recommended for better outcomes.

pmid-38514050.summary_ja: 思春期患者85名の精巣および精巣傍悪性腫瘍を分析。腫瘍サイズ0.8-18cm（平均4.4cm）。11.8%が≥10cm。11-13歳グループでは100%が大腫瘍。思春期患者は診断遅延に脆弱であり、早期スクリーニングの必要性を強調。
pmid-38514050.summary_en: Analysis of 85 malignant testicular and paratesticular tumors in adolescents (ages 11-20). Tumor size ranged 0.8-18 cm (mean 4.4 cm). Notably, 11.8% were ≥10 cm, with 100% of the youngest group (11-13 years) having large tumors. This suggests adolescents, particularly 11-13 year-olds, are vulnerable to delayed diagnosis, highlighting need for increased awareness and early screening.

pmid-38511034.summary_ja: 腸間膜に発生した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例。22歳男性が腸間膜嚢胞として初期診断されたが、病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学（SALL-4、グリピカン-3、PLAP、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性）で確認。正確な病理診断の重要性と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の発生起源について論述。
pmid-38511034.summary_en: Case report of rare extragonadal yolk sac tumor (YST) in the mesentery of a 22-year-old male, initially presenting as a mesenteric cyst. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry (positive for SALL-4, glypican-3, PLAP, AFP) confirmed diagnosis. The case emphasizes the importance of accurate histopathology in distinguishing mesenteric YST from benign cysts and recognition of extragonadal GCT pathogenesis.

pmid-38511017.summary_ja: 精巣混合胚細胞腫瘍が肺転移として初発した症例。CT誘導下FNACで角質物質と軟骨粘液質間質が検出された。奇形腫成分の識別が診断的課題。肺偶発所見のある患者での転移性胚細胞腫瘍検討の重要性を強調。
pmid-38511017.summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor (MGCT) with lung metastasis as initial presentation in a young male without prior testicular symptoms. CT-guided FNAC revealed keratinous debris and chondromyxoid stroma consistent with teratoma components. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of identifying teratoma elements in FNA specimens and importance of considering metastatic MGCT in patients with unexpected lung findings.

pmid-38511013.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の右副腎に発生した一次性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の稀な症例報告。腫瘤18×13×10cmで壊死物質と固体領域を含む。組織学的検査で多組織系統への分化を確認。成熟奇形腫は良好予後を示し、外科的切除とフォローアップが標準治療。
pmid-38511013.summary_en: Rare case report of primary mature cystic teratoma in right adrenal gland of postmenopausal female presenting with abdominal pain. Large mass (18×13×10 cm) showed cystic contents with necrotic material and solid gelatinous areas. Histology confirmed teratoma with differentiation along multiple tissue lineages. Surgical resection remains standard treatment with good prognosis for mature teratomas.

pmid-38507271.summary_ja: 精巣がん（TC）は男性悪性腫瘍の1%であるが、若年男性で最も一般的な悪性腫瘍。胚細胞腫瘍が95%、性索間質腫瘍が5%を占める。シスプラチン併用化学療法の導入により5年生存率は95%を超えて改善。本レビューは多因子的病因、出生前後の原因、新規診断バイオマーカー、治療戦略について述べる。
pmid-38507271.summary_en: Review of testicular cancer (TC), comprising 95% germ cell tumors and 5% sex cord-stromal tumors. Despite being only 1% of male neoplasms, TC is the most common malignancy in young males with rising global prevalence. Discussion includes multifactorial etiology, prenatal and postnatal causes, novel diagnostic biomarkers, and therapeutic approaches, highlighting improved 5-year survival exceeding 95% with cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-38499669.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来の血管新生間葉系病変39例（低悪性度19例、高悪性度16例）を検討。P53過剰発現（核陽性>80%）は全体13%、高悪性度腫瘍で25%の頻度で認められ、疾患進行と肉腫への形質転換に関連。定期的な臨床フォローアップが必要。
pmid-38499669.summary_en: Study of 39 vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions (VMLs) of germ cell tumor origin, including teratoma with vasculogenic stroma (TVS), low-grade and high-grade vasculogenic mesenchymal tumors (VMTs). P53 overexpression (>80% cells) was observed in 13% of cases, with higher frequency in high-grade tumors (25%). P53 overexpression associated with disease progression and potential sarcoma transformation, suggesting it warrants routine surveillance.

pmid-38496757.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の末梢血単核球のDNA損傷が予後予測因子となる研究。化学療法前後で同等の予後価値。コメットアッセイでDNA損傷評価。無増悪生存率と全生存期間と相関。治療戦略への応用推奨。
pmid-38496757.summary_en: Study demonstrating that DNA damage levels in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) serve as independent prognostic markers in germ cell tumor (GCT) patients both before and after first cycle of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. DNA damage assessed by alkaline and styrene oxide-modified comet assay correlated with progression-free and overall survival. Clinical use is recommended to stratify poor-prognosis patients for tailored therapeutic interventions.

pmid-38495851.summary_ja: 40歳男性の精巣における稀な奇形腫様Wilms腫瘍（腎芽腫）の症例。奇形腫（60%）と腎芽腫（40%）の混合腫瘍。後腹膜リンパ節転移。成人精巣奇形腫様腎芽腫の稀性と包括的診断の必要性を強調。
pmid-38495851.summary_en: Case report of rare testicular teratoid Wilms tumor (nephroblastoma) in 40-year-old male with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Initial orchiectomy showed 60% teratoma with 40% nephroblastoma and extensive necrosis. Re-review of pathology after metastasis detection revealed the nephroblastoma component. Case illustrates rarity of adult testicular teratoid Wilms tumors and emphasizes need for comprehensive diagnostic approaches and further research into extrarenal teratoid Wilms tumor pathophysiology.

pmid-38494295.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に伴う傍腫瘍性神経症候群に関するハンドブック章。神経特異的自己抗体（抗NMDAR、抗LG1など）と様々な神経症候群表型を討議。臨床的・放射線学的特徴と治療を概説。早期診断がGCT発見と神経合併症予防に重要。
pmid-38494295.summary_en: Handbook chapter on paraneoplastic neurologic syndromes (PNSs) associated with germ cell tumors (GCTs), covering pathophysiology and epidemiology. Discusses neural-specific autoantibodies (anti-NMDAR, anti-LG1, and others) and various PNS phenotypes. Reviews clinical and radiologic accompaniments, treatment, and prognosis. Early PNS diagnosis is vital for uncovering underlying GCTs and preventing permanent neurologic complications.

pmid-38494274.summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性脳炎と悪性腫瘍関連神経障害に関するハンドブック章。若年女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎と卵巣奇形腫の関連、および他の抗体関連脳炎症候群を論述。歴史的辺縁系脳炎概念から新規神経膜蛋白抗体を伴う広い表現型への転換を示す。
pmid-38494274.summary_en: Handbook chapter on paraneoplastic encephalitis and malignancy-associated neurologic disorders. Discusses well-characterized association of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis with ovarian teratoma in young women, along with other antibody-associated encephalitis syndromes. Reviews shift from historical limbic encephalitis concept to broader phenotypes involving novel neuronal membrane protein antibodies. Covers pathogenic mechanisms and importance of malignancy screening in seronegative cases.

pmid-38490094.summary_ja: 妊娠滋養膜疾患における ST6Gal1 が integrin β1 のシアリル化を介して細胞増殖と幹性を促進することを示唆。miR-199a-5p による制御と FAK シグナル経路の関与を解明。
pmid-38490094.summary_en: Research demonstrating ST6Gal1 sialyltransferase promotes proliferation and stemness in gestational trophoblastic disease through α2,6-sialylation of integrin β1, with miR-199a-5p regulating ST6Gal1 expression and integrin β1/FAK pathway involvement.

pmid-38490077.summary_ja: 腎がん、尿路上皮がん、精巣がんに対する天然物の効果についてのシステマティックレビュー。抗増殖作用、アポトーシス誘導機構、既存化学療法および免疫療法の効果増強の可能性、並びにPI3K/AKT、NF-κB、STAT、MAPKパスウェイの調節による作用機序を示す。
pmid-38490077.summary_en: Systematic review examining natural products' effects on renal cancer, urothelial carcinoma, and testicular cancer, highlighting anti-proliferative, pro-apoptotic mechanisms and potential to enhance existing chemotherapy and immunotherapy through modulation of PI3K/AKT, NF-κB, STAT, and MAPK pathways.

pmid-38489712.summary_ja: 分娩後遅延性出血で発症する絨毛がん 4 症例。β-hCG 監視と標準化学療法で 3 例が完全奏効。妊娠遺残物との鑑別の重要性を強調。
pmid-38489712.summary_en: Four case reports of postpartum choriocarcinoma presenting as delayed hemorrhage with respiratory and neurological symptoms, emphasizing importance of β-hCG monitoring, standardized chemotherapy protocols (EMA-CO with modifications), and awareness of this rare malignancy mimicking gestational remnants.

pmid-38487612.summary_ja: 妊娠中の良性付属器腫瘤に対する腹腔鏡嚢胞摘除術126症例の分析。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が76.2%で最多病理診断であった。開腹術への移行例なく、正期産率は97.4%と高く、卵巣機能を温存しながら付属器捻転などの合併症リスクを軽減する有効性が示された。
pmid-38487612.summary_en: Analysis of 126 laparoscopic cystectomies for benign adnexal masses during pregnancy, primarily mature cystic teratomas (76.2%), demonstrating safety, high full-term delivery rates (97.4%), and ovarian function preservation while reducing torsion risk.

pmid-38485549.summary_ja: 難治性精巣がん患者における plerixafor 先制的投与で、94% で CD34+ 細胞採取成功、中央値 1 回のアフェレーシスで達成。幹細胞動員効率の著明な向上。
pmid-38485549.summary_en: Study of upfront plerixafor use in relapsed/refractory germ cell tumor patients demonstrating 94% successful CD34+ cell collection in median one apheresis day, improving mobilization efficiency and facilitating autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

pmid-38481908.summary_ja: 21歳女性の急速進行性未熟奇形腫で脾転移と腹膜神経膠腫症を認めた症例報告。生殖機能温存的減量手術と化学療法後、二次手術で最終的に成熟奇形腫と関連GPであることが判明。
pmid-38481908.summary_en: Case report of rapidly progressive immature teratoma with splenic metastasis and gliomatosis peritonei in 21-year-old female treated with fertility-sparing debulking surgery and chemotherapy, followed by secondary surgery revealing mature teratoma and associated peritoneal nodules.

pmid-38481902.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマ患者における化学療法中の好中球減少性腸炎と Streptococcus gallolyticus 菌血症の症例。本菌とこの合併症の新規関連を報告。
pmid-38481902.summary_en: Case report of neutropenic enterocolitis with Streptococcus gallolyticus bacteremia in metastatic seminoma patient during chemotherapy, successfully treated with broad-spectrum antibiotics and filgrastim, representing unique association with this organism.

pmid-38480589.summary_ja: 小児眼窩非眼球外軟部腫瘍に関する多モダリティ画像レビュー。奇形腫を含む複数の腫瘍型の画像的特徴を解説し診断に貢献。
pmid-38480589.summary_en: Multimodality imaging review of pediatric neoplastic extraocular soft-tissue orbital lesions including teratomas, emphasizing key imaging features for differential diagnosis among vascular neoplasms, optic nerve lesions, and other soft-tissue masses.

pmid-38476634.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と転移性絨毛癌（脳・肺転移）を伴う甲状腺ストームを呈した女性の症例報告。集中治療支援、EMA-CO化学療法、子宮摘出術、追加化学療法を含む多職種アプローチで成功裏に管理。
pmid-38476634.summary_en: Case of metastatic gestational trophoblastic choriocarcinoma with brain and lung metastases presenting with thyroid storm, successfully managed with multidisciplinary approach including intensive care support, EMA-CO chemotherapy, hysterectomy, and additional cycles.

pmid-38476276.summary_ja: 炭素被覆 MoSe2 ナノ粒子による絨毛がん光熱治療研究。高い光熱変換効率（50.97%）と良好な生体適合性。ROS 産生と DNA 複製抑制によるアポトーシス誘導を確認。
pmid-38476276.summary_en: Study of carbon-coated molybdenum diselenide nanoparticles for photothermal therapy in choriocarcinoma, demonstrating high photothermal conversion efficiency (50.97%), biocompatibility with normal cells, significant ROS induction, and transcriptomic evidence of apoptosis induction.

pmid-38476210.summary_ja: 自然破裂と出血を起こした縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫）を認めた20歳男性の症例報告。血管豊富な腫瘍の管理の困難性を強調。
pmid-38476210.summary_en: Case report of mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor with spontaneous rupture and life-threatening hemorrhage containing four pathological types (embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma), highlighting challenges of managing highly vascular tumors.

pmid-38474332.summary_ja: CDK 阻害剤 dinaciclib が非セミノーマ精巣がんモデルで CDK5 を標的としてシスプラチン感受性を回復。細胞株および動物モデルで効果を実証。
pmid-38474332.summary_en: Preclinical study demonstrating CDK inhibitor dinaciclib enhances cisplatin response in nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor models by targeting CDK5 upregulation, improving cell viability reduction and in vivo efficacy in zebrafish xenograft model.

pmid-38468475.summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的比較レビュー。共通の病因および腫瘍生物学的特徴を有する一方で、顕著な予後格差（5年全生存期間98.2% vs 85.2%）を認識。精巣がんから適応した特定の治療戦略を採用することにより、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の成果改善を提案。
pmid-38468475.summary_en: Comprehensive review comparing testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors, highlighting common etiologic and biological features but significant prognostic disparity (98.2% vs 85.2% 5-year survival), proposing treatment strategies adapted from testicular cancer to improve ovarian GCT outcomes.

pmid-38468427.summary_ja: 胸腺癌から卵巣成熟奇形腫への腫瘍間転移を認めた25歳女性の症例報告。病理学的確認により正確な腫瘍分類と病期分類が可能となり、この稀な現象の認識の重要性を示した。
pmid-38468427.summary_en: Case report of tumor-to-tumor metastasis from thymic carcinoma to ovarian mature teratoma in 25-year-old woman, demonstrating importance of pathological confirmation for accurate tumor staging and recognition of this rare phenomenon.

pmid-38463691.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ症例報告の訂正。空陰嚢と腹部腫瘤を伴う発症パターンの重要性。
pmid-38463691.summary_en: Erratum to case report of testicular seminoma presenting as intra-abdominal mass with empty scrotum, correcting prior publication and highlighting diagnostic considerations in germ cell tumor presentation.

pmid-38462832.summary_ja: 46歳男性の転移性胚胎癌（腹部リンパ節）がリンパ腫と類似した臨床像・画像所見を呈したが、腫瘍マーカーと生検で確定診断された症例報告。診断には臨床所見、画像、腫瘍マーカーおよび病理組織診が必要とされた。
pmid-38462832.summary_en: Case report of 46-year-old male with metastatic embryonal carcinoma of abdominal lymph nodes mimicking lymphoma clinically and radiologically. Diagnosis required correlation of clinical presentation, tumor markers, imaging findings, and pathological biopsy confirmation.

pmid-38462578.summary_ja: 小児腹部胚細胞腫瘍の非定型的な画像・臨床症状の包括的レビュー。多焦点原発腫瘍、卵巣捻転、破裂類皮嚢腫、燃え尽きた原発腫瘍、growing teratoma syndrome、腹膜神経膠腫症、内分泌症状、傍腫瘍症候群などを含む。
pmid-38462578.summary_en: Comprehensive review of atypical imaging and clinical manifestations of pediatric abdominal germ cell tumors, including multifocal primaries, torsion, ruptured dermoids, burned-out primary, growing teratoma syndrome, gliomatosis peritonei, endocrine manifestations, and paraneoplastic syndromes.

pmid-38460443.summary_ja: CT放射線学的特徴と機械学習を組み合わせた多施設共同研究により、精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別診断モデルを開発。統合モデルは高精度（AUC 0.918-0.839）を示し、臨床的治療方針決定に有用。
pmid-38460443.summary_en: Multicenter study developing clinical-radiomics machine learning model to differentiate testicular seminomas from nonseminomas on CT. Combined model achieved high accuracy (AUC 0.918-0.839) across training, validation, and test cohorts, providing noninvasive diagnostic tool.

pmid-38460244.summary_ja: 大全臓器逆位を伴う32歳女性の悪性混合型卵巣GCT初報告例。腹腔鏡下全子宮摘出、両側卵巣摘出、後腹膜リンパ節廓清術が施行された。
pmid-38460244.summary_en: First worldwide case report of malignant ovarian mixed germ cell tumor in patient with situs inversus totalis (mirror-image organ transposition). Patient underwent successful laparoscopic total abdominal hysterectomy, salpingo-oophorectomy, and bilateral retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.

pmid-38459862.summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟奇形腫に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の27歳男性の症例報告。精神症状と神経学的悪化で発症。腫瘍切除術と血液交換療法・ステロイド療法により回復し、人工呼吸器から離脱した。
pmid-38459862.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old male with anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor encephalitis associated with anterior mediastinal mature teratoma. Tumor resection combined with plasmapheresis and steroid therapy led to recovery with successful mechanical ventilation weaning.

pmid-38458023.summary_ja: 直腸腺癌が化学療法後に絨毛癌へ組織学的に転化した稀な非妊娠性絨毛癌症例。β-hCG上昇と病理組織学的転化を認め、再生検と遺伝子検査の重要性を示す。
pmid-38458023.summary_en: Rare case report of non-pregnant choriocarcinoma transformed from primary rectal adenocarcinoma. Post-chemotherapy histologic transformation showed elevated β-hCG and choriocarcinoma component without adenocarcinoma. Demonstrates importance of repeat biopsies and genetic testing in unusual disease progression.

pmid-38455983.summary_ja: 52歳無症状男性で偶発的に発見された左副腎成熟奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍の大きさが大きいため腹腔鏡下副腎摘出術を施行。病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫が確認され、術後経過は良好で再発を認めなかった。
pmid-38455983.summary_en: Case report of 52-year-old asymptomatic male with incidental left adrenal mature teratoma discovered on CT imaging. Laparoscopic adrenalectomy performed due to large tumor size; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with excellent post-operative recovery.

pmid-38455810.summary_ja: 42歳女性の左卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）の症例報告。過去5ヶ月間に漸進的に増大する腹部腫瘤と直近5日間の左下腹痛を主訴に来院。試験的開腹手術を施行し、全腹式子宮摘出術および両側卵管卵巣切除術を実施。病理組織学検査により成熟奇形腫を確認し、1年間3ヶ月間隔でフォローアップ。
pmid-38455810.summary_en: Case report of 42-year-old female with left ovarian dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) presenting with progressive abdominal mass and lower abdominal pain. Exploratory laparotomy with total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy performed; histology confirmed mature teratoma.

pmid-38454224.summary_ja: 1～16歳の小児腹腔内嚢腫36例の単一3次医療機関後方視的症例集積。診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、リンパ管腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫、重複嚢腫など。嚢腫の種類と位置に応じた外科的管理が必要。
pmid-38454224.summary_en: Retrospective single-center case series of 36 pediatric intraabdominal cysts (ages 1-16 years). Diagnoses included mature cystic teratoma, lymphangioma, mucinous cystadenoma, duplication cyst, and others. Surgical management varied by cyst type and location; timely diagnosis and resection emphasized.

pmid-38449876.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内低悪性度グリオーマの初の記録例。45歳女性、けいれんと意識変容で腹腔鏡下卵巣摘除；病理で稀な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を確認。
pmid-38449876.summary_en: First documented case of anti-NMDAR encephalitis patient with low-grade glioma within mature cystic teratoma (MCT). 45-year-old woman with seizures and altered consciousness underwent laparoscopic ovarian resection; pathology revealed rare malignant transformation of MCT showing astrocytic proliferation with cellular atypia.

pmid-38448741.summary_ja: SOHLH1遺伝子新規ホモ接合ミスセンス変異を有する卵巣ジスゲネシスとジスゲルミノーマ症例。両側ジスゲルミノーマを発症；定期的な画像検査による腫瘍監視が推奨される。
pmid-38448741.summary_en: Case report of two sisters and paternal great-aunt with ovarian dysgenesis and bilateral dysgerminoma. Whole-exome sequencing identified novel homozygous SOHLH1 missense variant (c.275C>T). Histopathology showed dysgerminoma and ovarian fibrosis with follicle absence, supporting tumor surveillance in affected women.

pmid-38444815.summary_ja: 32歳男性の肝臓原発卵黄嚢腫瘍症例。周囲リンパ節転移による胆管閉塞で黄疸を呈現。初期生検は腺癌を疑ったが、免疫染色で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確診され、BEP化学療法開始。
pmid-38444815.summary_en: Case report of 32-year-old male with primary yolk sac tumor (YST) of the liver presenting with painless jaundice from periductal lymph node metastases causing bile duct obstruction. Initial biopsy suggested adenocarcinoma; diagnosis of primary YST confirmed with appropriate immunostaining, enabling BEP chemotherapy.

pmid-38443937.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(MSO)の2症例の臨床経過と治療。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に分化した甲状腺癌で診断された稀な胚細胞腫瘍。症例1：乳頭状甲状腺癌の濾胞型変異体を伴い、腹膜細胞診は悪性；症例2：乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。両症例とも腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣切除術、全甲状腺切除術、放射性ヨウ素療法が施行された。
pmid-38443937.summary_en: Two cases of malignant struma ovarii (MSO)—rare germ cell tumor showing differentiated thyroid cancer within mature cystic teratoma. Case 1: follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma with peritoneal involvement; Case 2: papillary thyroid cancer within teratoma. Both underwent surgery, thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine therapy.

pmid-38441175.summary_ja: 精巣がん31検体の実験的研究。細胞老化は腫瘍サイズと正相関（Pearson r=0.40, p=0.027）、術前LDH値と負相関（r=-0.53, p=0.002）を示した。
pmid-38441175.summary_en: Experimental study investigating correlation between cellular senescence and testicular cancer characteristics (size, stage, tumor markers). Analyzed 31 testicular cancer specimens; senescence rate correlated positively with tumor size (Pearson r=0.40, p=0.027) and negatively with preoperative LDH level (r=-0.53, p=0.002).

pmid-38438174.summary_ja: 骨盤がんの生殖能温存における子宮転位術のレビュー。18症例で直腸がん50%、子宮頸がん33%、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例を含む。3例で自然妊娠成功。
pmid-38438174.summary_en: Literature review of uterine transposition for fertility preservation in pelvic cancers. Eighteen published cases reviewed; indications included rectal cancers (50%), cervical squamous cell carcinomas (33%), and one sacral yolk sac tumor (GCT). Mean operative time ~150 min; three spontaneous pregnancies achieved with successful gestations.

pmid-38434469.summary_ja: 妊娠後8年経過した閉経後女性における転移性絨毛癌の稀な症例報告。脳、脾臓、肺、腎臓への転移を認め、脳放射線療法、脾動脈塞栓術、EMA/CO化学療法により完全寛解を達成した。
pmid-38434469.summary_en: Case report of a postmenopausal woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma of presumed gestational origin 8 years after last pregnancy, presenting with brain, spleen, lung, and kidney metastases. Treatment included whole-brain radiotherapy, splenic artery embolization, and EMA/CO chemotherapy achieving complete remission.

pmid-38434467.summary_ja: 卵巣ダーモイド嚢胞の捻転後に生じた化学性腹膜炎の稀な合併症の症例報告。複数回のドレナージ、抗生物質、抗炎症療法、および再開腹術を含む治療管理について述べている。
pmid-38434467.summary_en: Case report of chemical peritonitis and prolonged fever following laparoscopic surgery for ovarian dermoid cyst with torsion. Management included repeated drainage, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory therapy, and re-laparotomy for this rare postoperative complication.

pmid-38430900.summary_ja: 妊娠17週で急性卵巣茎捻転で診断された稀な卵巣ストルマルカルチノイドの症例報告。腹腔鏡下嚢胞切除術を施行；病理診断で確認。この胚細胞腫瘍亜型は稀性にもかかわらず優れた予後を示す。
pmid-38430900.summary_en: Case report of rare ovarian strumal carcinoid diagnosed at 17 weeks gestation presenting with acute ovarian torsion. Laparoscopic cystectomy was performed; pathology confirmed strumal carcinoid. Despite rarity, excellent prognosis is typical for this germ cell tumor subtype.

pmid-38430323.summary_ja: 精巣がん管理における後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の進化する役割の総説。患者選択、神経温存技術、現代的画像診断、および改善された腫瘍学的転帰を強調している。
pmid-38430323.summary_en: Comprehensive review of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in testicular cancer management, highlighting its dual role in staging and therapy. Emphasizes patient selection, nerve-sparing techniques, modern imaging approaches, and improved oncological outcomes.

pmid-38428910.summary_ja: 生存妊娠中に超音波で診断された無症状の妊娠性絨毛癌の稀な症例。超音波による早期診断と治療監視により、タイムリーな治療介入と新生児の安全な退院が達成された。
pmid-38428910.summary_en: Rare case of asymptomatic gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosed by ultrasonography during viable pregnancy. Early diagnosis and treatment monitoring via ultrasound enabled timely therapeutic intervention and successful newborn discharge.

pmid-38427603.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形種の易罹患性に関連するBMP15の稀な生殖細胞変異を同定。成熟BMP15分泌の減少とH-Ras/MAPK経路の異常活性化がOIT発症に関与することを示した。
pmid-38427603.summary_en: Study identifying a rare BMP15 germline missense mutation associated with hereditary ovarian immature teratomas (OITs). Findings showed reduced mature BMP15 secretion and abnormal H-Ras/MAPK pathway activation in OIT development, providing insights into genetic susceptibility.

pmid-38426154.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの後腹膜転移に対するヨウ素125シード組織内放射線療法とカルボプラチン併用の治療成績報告。従来の放射線療法・化学療法と比較して長期毒性を低減した治療法を示した。
pmid-38426154.summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal metastatic seminoma treated with iodine-125 seed brachytherapy combined with carboplatin. Novel approach demonstrated tumor control with reduced long-term toxicity compared to standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy over 3-year follow-up.

pmid-38425866.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形種の腹腔鏡除去術後に生じた難治性乳糜腹水に対するリンパ静脈吻合術の症例報告。術中腸間膜リンパ管造影を用いた新規ハイブリッドリンパ静脈吻合術により、再発なく乳糜腹水を完全に解決した。
pmid-38425866.summary_en: Case report of lymphovenous anastomosis surgery for refractory chylous ascites following laparoscopic adnexectomy for ovarian teratoma. Hybrid lymphovenous anastomosis with intraoperative mesenteric lymphangiography guidance successfully resolved ascites without recurrence.

pmid-38425251.summary_ja: 薬剤耐性妊娠絨毛性疾患に対するPD-1/PD-L1免疫チェックポイント阻害剤と化学療法併用の4症例。3/4例が完全奏効または部分奏効を達成し、軽度の免疫関連有害事象のみで有効性を示唆した。
pmid-38425251.summary_en: Four case reports of immune checkpoint inhibitor (PD-1/PD-L1) therapy combined with chemotherapy for recurrent drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Three of four patients achieved complete or partial response with mild immune-related adverse events.

pmid-38421563.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者145例の危険度適応化治療後の長期合併症を検討。10年累積発生率は男性ホルモン低下症5.3%、高血圧8.6%、脂質異常症25.1%で、治療群間に有意差なし。
pmid-38421563.summary_en: Retrospective study of 145 stage I seminoma patients treated with risk-adapted strategy (surveillance, single-dose or two-dose carboplatin). Cumulative 10-year incidences were 5.3% for hypogonadism, 8.6% for hypertension, and 25.1% for dyslipidemia.

pmid-38421457.summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛癌の症例を遺伝子解析とメチル化解析で検討。145個の癌関連遺伝子に変異なくMDM2増幅を観察。異常メチル化パターンから、発がんの機序はエピジェネティック機序が関与する可能性を示唆した。
pmid-38421457.summary_en: Single case of intraplacental choriocarcinoma with feto-maternal hemorrhage analyzed by cancer gene panel and methylation analysis. No mutations detected in 145 cancer-related genes; MDM2 amplification observed. Aberrant methylation patterns suggested epigenetic mechanisms in carcinogenesis.

pmid-38420071.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍がオプソクロヌス失調症パネオプラスティック症候群で呈示した稀な症例報告。神経学者と腫瘍医による多学際的管理が診断と治療に不可欠であった。
pmid-38420071.summary_en: Case report of mediastinal yolk sac germ cell tumor presenting with opsoclonus-ataxia paraneoplastic syndrome, an unusual neurological association. Multidisciplinary management involving neurologists and oncologists was essential for diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-38418277.summary_ja: 57例の小児仙骨尾骨部奇形種におけるAFP測定値の再発予測精度を検討した全国的研究。AFP値の変化は再発の予測因子ではなかったが、55μg/L以上は悪性再発を予測する可能性を示した。
pmid-38418277.summary_en: Nationwide Dutch study of 57 pediatric sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients examining AFP's diagnostic accuracy for recurrence surveillance. AFP dynamics were not predictive of recurrence; however, serum AFP >55 μg/L predicted malignant recurrence with 100% specificity.

pmid-38415548.summary_ja: 18-25歳男子大学生350例を対象とした精巣がんの保健信念モデルに基づく教育介入研究。介入後、知識、知覚便益、自己効力感、精巣自己検診実践に有意な改善が認められた。
pmid-38415548.summary_en: Quasi-experimental study of 350 male university students (ages 18-25) implementing a Health Belief Model-based educational intervention on testicular cancer. Post-intervention improvements observed in knowledge, perceived benefits, self-efficacy, and testicular self-examination performance.

pmid-38414722.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形種に起因する抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。当初はCOVID後症候群と誤診されたが、骨盤CT検査で奇形種を同定し、形質交換療法と腫瘍切除で改善。パネオプラスティック神経症候群における奇形種スクリーニングの重要性を強調した。
pmid-38414722.summary_en: Case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis caused by ovarian teratoma, initially misdiagnosed as post-COVID syndrome. Pelvic CT identified the teratoma; patient improved with plasmapheresis and teratoma resection, emphasizing teratoma screening in paraneoplastic neurological syndromes.

pmid-38410854.summary_ja: 20歳女性における腹部腫瘤として提示したグレードII未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例報告。若い女性に罹患することが多い稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍亜型である未熟卵巣奇形腫の臨床表現、画像診断所見、および管理上の課題について詳しくレビューしました。
pmid-38410854.summary_en: Case report of grade II immature ovarian teratoma in a 20-year-old woman presenting with abdominal mass. Reviews clinical presentation, imaging features, and management challenges of immature teratomas, a rare malignant germ cell tumor subtype in young women.

pmid-38409834.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の悪性化におけるTwist-1の役割を検討した研究。Twist-1抑制は上皮間葉転換とPI3K/AKT経路を抑制し、絨毛癌細胞の増殖、浸潤、転移を阻害した。
pmid-38409834.summary_en: Study investigating Twist-1's role in hydatidiform mole (HM) malignancy. Twist-1 silencing inhibited choriocarcinoma cell proliferation, migration, and invasion through suppressing epithelial-mesenchymal transition and PI3K/AKT pathway signaling.

pmid-38403108.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者における根治的精巣摘出術と同時実施の顕微鏡下精巣精子採取（m-OncoTESE）の外科技術を詳細に説明。精液が無精子症の患者から生殖能温存のため精子を採取・凍結保存した。
pmid-38403108.summary_en: Video presentation and technique guide for microscopic oncotesticular sperm extraction (m-OncoTESE) performed simultaneously with radical orchiectomy in testicular cancer patients. Successfully extracted and cryopreserved motile sperm for fertility preservation in an azoospermic seminoma patient.

pmid-38398766.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者280例における多発性と臨床病理学的特性の関連性検討。多発性は15.7%に認められ、より小さい一次腫瘍と関連していたが、進行期疾患の予後因子ではなかった。
pmid-38398766.summary_en: Study of 280 testicular cancer patients examining multifocality (distinct tumor foci >1mm). Multifocality occurred in 15.7%, associated with smaller primary tumors but not a significant prognostic factor for advanced disease.

pmid-38398175.summary_ja: 臨床病期IIセミノーマに対する陽子ペンシルビーム走査、光子線VMAT、3D放射線療法の二次がん発症リスクを比較検討。PBSはリスク臓器への平均線量を60%削減し、他の方法より優れた用量削減と低い二次がん発症リスク予測を示し、晩期副作用を軽減する可能性がある。
pmid-38398175.summary_en: Compared secondary cancer risk from proton PBS, photon VMAT, and 3D radiotherapy for stage II seminoma. PBS achieved 60% dose reduction to organs-at-risk and lower secondary cancer risk.

pmid-38398106.summary_ja: 精巣GCT治療後の思春期・若年成人13例の性的問題に関する定性研究。子供を望むこと、性的再発見、不安など7つのテーマが抽出され、性に関する支援方策の構築が推奨された。
pmid-38398106.summary_en: Qualitative study of 13 adolescents/young adults with testicular GCT examining sexuality-related late effects. Seven themes identified: desire for children, sexual rediscovery, performance anxiety, physical acceptance, masculinity loss, relationship burden, communication about sexuality.

pmid-38396829.summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるマイクロRNAバイオマーカーのレビュー。miR-371a-3pは未分化GCTで発現されるが奇形腫では発現されない。miR-371とmiR-375の組み合わせは腫瘍の鑑別に有用。
pmid-38396829.summary_en: Review of microRNA biomarkers in testicular GCTs, focusing on challenges distinguishing teratomas. miR-371a-3p expressed in undifferentiated GCTs but not teratomas; combined miR-371/miR-375 panels differentiate viable tumors, teratomas, necrosis/fibrosis.

pmid-38396644.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(異所性甲状腺を伴う卵巣奇形腫)、口蓋裂、甲状腺癌を伴う家族を対象とした研究。FOXE1およびAXIN1の生殖系列変異、ならびに腫瘍における体細胞BRAF/HRAS変異を同定した。FOXE1変異は遺伝子発現に影響を与え、MAPK経路活性化とともに悪性転化に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-38396644.summary_en: Study of families with malignant struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma with ectopic thyroid), cleft palate, thyroid cancer. Identified germline FOXE1 and AXIN1 variants; somatic BRAF/HRAS mutations in tumors. FOXE1 variants affect expression and contribute to malignant transformation.

pmid-38396072.summary_ja: 129系統マウスの胚細胞腫瘍感受性から始まり、胎児性癌細胞をテラトカルシノーマの幹細胞として同定し、初期胚の多能性細胞との関係を認識し、マウスおよびヒト由来の胚性幹細胞の導出へと至るまでの、癌遺伝学から再生医学への学問的発展の過程を辿った歴史的レビュー。
pmid-38396072.summary_en: Historical review tracing development from strain 129 mice susceptibility to germ cell tumors through embryonal carcinoma cells as teratocarcinoma stem cells, their relationship to embryonic pluripotent cells, to embryonic stem cell derivation and regenerative medicine.

pmid-38394502.summary_ja: 精巣がんと無精子症の若い男性2例。最初の採取に失敗したが、その後の補正的微小採取で精子採取に成功。がん治療中の生殖機能温存の機会を示唆。
pmid-38394502.summary_en: Case reports of two men with testicular cancer and azoospermia. Failed onco-microdissection TESE initially; remedial mTESE successfully recovered sperm in both. Demonstrates opportunities for fertility preservation in GCT despite treatment complications.

pmid-38394499.summary_ja: 再発・治療抵抗性GCT患者44例に対する大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植の治療成績。化学療法後の最良奏効が生存の独立した予測因子であった。
pmid-38394499.summary_en: Retrospective study of 44 relapsed/refractory GCT patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation. Median PFS 7 months, OS 14.9 months. Best response to HDCT was strongest predictor of survival.

pmid-38393356.summary_ja: 135例患者（卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内扁平上皮癌12例、良性MCT 123例）の後方視的MRI研究。壁在結節所見は感度83.3%、特異度97.6%で扁平上皮癌診断に有用。
pmid-38393356.summary_en: Retrospective MRI study of 135 patients (12 with squamous cell carcinoma in ovarian mature cystic teratoma, 123 benign). Mural nodule findings showed 83.3% sensitivity, 97.6% specificity for SCC-MCT diagnosis.

pmid-38391385.summary_ja: 消退精巣腫瘍（治療なしで自発的に完全または部分的に退行する精巣胚細胞腫瘍）の症例報告。精巣胚細胞腫瘍全体の約5%に発生。2016年WHO分類に含まれる。適切な管理のため臨床医の認識の重要性を強調。
pmid-38391385.summary_en: Case report of burnt-out testicular tumor, spontaneous complete or partial regression of testicular GCT without treatment. Occurs in ~5% of testicular GCTs. Included in 2016 WHO classification. Emphasizes clinician awareness for proper management.

pmid-38389620.summary_ja: 70例の陰嚢腫瘤の横断面病理組織学的研究。非腫瘍性病変80%で精巣萎縮が最も一般的。腫瘍性病変20%でセミノーマが最頻（7例）。定期的な病理組織学的検査の重要性を強調。
pmid-38389620.summary_en: Cross-sectional histopathological study of 70 scrotal masses. 80% non-neoplastic lesions; testicular atrophy most common. 20% neoplastic; seminoma most frequent (7 cases). Emphasizes importance of routine histopathology.

pmid-38389451.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術前精液凍結保存を受けた64例の精巣がん患者における精液パラメータを検討した後方視的研究。病期II/III患者は病期I患者と比較して前向き運動性および奇形精子症が低い。全ての精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者への精液凍結保存を推奨、特に転移性疾患で重要。
pmid-38389451.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of semen parameters in 64 testicular cancer patients undergoing pre-orchiectomy cryopreservation. Stage II/III showed worse progressive motility and teratozoospermia than stage I. Recommends cryopreservation for all GCT patients.

pmid-38389218.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織を主とする卵巣奇形腫（卵巣甲状腺腫）が広範な腹膜播種転移を呈した55歳女性の症例。初回摘出手術4年後の再発。腹部骨盤腔の複数結節が画像検査で確認され、病理組織学的検査で甲状腺様濾胞上皮を認定。全甲状腺摘除術および放射性ヨウ素療法で治療。
pmid-38389218.summary_en: Case report of struma ovarii (ovarian teratoma with thyroid tissue) with extensive peritoneal implants metastasis. 55-year-old with 4-year history of initial resection. Multiple abdominopelvic nodules confirmed as thyroid tissue. Treated with total thyroidectomy and 131I therapy.

pmid-38386793.summary_ja: 病期IIAセミノーマ患者（24歳）に対するロボット支援二側後腹膜リンパ節郭清による治療の症例報告。手術時間4時間13分、出血量400ml、神経温存手術を施行。24時間以内に退院し、射精機能が保持。解剖病理学的結果に基づきEP 2サイクルの補助療法を追加。
pmid-38386793.summary_en: Case report of 24-year-old with stage IIA seminoma treated with robot-assisted bilateral RPLND. Surgery 4h13min, 400ml blood loss, nerve-sparing; patient discharged 24 hours with preserved ejaculation.

pmid-38385979.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞がん細胞においてマイクロRNA-320aがLRWD1（精子マーカー）を調節する機構を検討した研究。miR-320aはAGO2/FXR1依存経路を通じてLRWD1を正に調節し、細胞増殖を促進するとともに遊走・侵襲能を抑制し、酸化ストレス応答に影響する。
pmid-38385979.summary_en: Study of miR-320a regulation of LRWD1 (sperm-specific marker) in testicular embryonic carcinoma cells. miR-320a positively regulated LRWD1 through AGO2/FXR1-dependent pathway, affecting cell proliferation, migration/invasion, and oxidative stress response.

pmid-38381210.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の病理組織学的特性とリンパ節浸潤および化学療法耐性との相関を検討した研究。EYST/EYSグループで高リンパ節浸潤に関連。救援化学療法VIP反応率41%。NSGCTの管理プロトコル用の病理組織学的ノモグラムを提案。
pmid-38381210.summary_en: Study examining non-seminomatous GCT histopathological properties correlation with lymph node involvement and chemoresistance. EYST/EYS groups associated with high lymph node involvement. Salvage VIP response 41%. Proposed histopathological nomogram for NSGCT management.

pmid-38380227.summary_ja: 精巣純セミノーマのサブタイプ識別のための深層学習ツール開発。ROC-AUC 0.896を達成。従来は識別不可能な形態学的相違を検出。
pmid-38380227.summary_en: Deep learning tool development for identifying two distinct pure seminoma subtypes from histopathological slides using TCGA samples. Achieved ROC-AUC 0.896. Discovered morphological differences between subtypes imperceptible to human eye.

pmid-38380211.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的レビュー。分類（ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍）、超音波検査およびMRIなどの画像検査と腫瘍マーカー（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCG）を用いた診断、FIGO病期分類、および手術、化学療法、標的療法、免疫療法を含む治療法をカバー。予後因子と管理上の課題に対応。
pmid-38380211.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian germ cell tumors covering classification (dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, mixed GCT), diagnosis using imaging and tumor markers (AFP, hCG), FIGO staging, and treatment modalities including surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapies, and immunotherapy. Addresses prognosis factors and management challenges.

pmid-38377960.summary_ja: 精巣後思春期型奇形腫を伴う後腹膜肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例報告。ポリソミー12、MYC増幅、ARAF増幅、ATR変異を含む分子所見を記載。診断上の困難性と正確な分類のための免疫組織化学と分子研究の重要性を強調。
pmid-38377960.summary_en: Case report of rare sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor in retroperitoneum occurring with testicular postpubertal teratoma. Describes molecular findings including polysomy 12, MYC amplification, ARAF amplification, and ATR mutation. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges and importance of immunohistochemistry and molecular studies for accurate classification.

pmid-38377946.summary_ja: SEER研究による13,515例の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者における人種/民族別がん特異的死亡率検討（2004-2019）。非白人で全病期にわたり死亡率が上昇。ヒスパニック系では全病期で上昇、アフリカ系米国人では病期IおよびIIIで上昇、アジア系は病期IIIのみで上昇。個別患者管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-38377946.summary_en: Population-based SEER study examining cancer-specific mortality in 13,515 non-seminoma testicular cancer patients by race/ethnicity (2004-2019). Non-Caucasians showed higher mortality across stages. Hispanics had higher hazard ratios at all stages; African-Americans at stages I and III; Asians only at stage III. Emphasizes importance of individualized patient management.

pmid-38373783.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器病理学における肉眼標本検査に関するレビュー。精巣摘除術標本における焦点非セミノーマ性成分の同定が患者管理に重要であることを強調。精巣胚細胞腫瘍および他の泌尿器科標本における臨床的に重要な所見を検出するための適切なサンプリング方法について述べる。
pmid-38373783.summary_en: Review of macroscopic specimen examination in genitourinary pathology. Emphasizes critical importance of identifying focal non-seminomatous components in orchidectomy specimens for patient management. Discusses adequate sampling protocols for testicular germ cell tumors and other urological specimens to detect clinically important findings.

pmid-38372776.summary_ja: 5日齢男児に見られた脈動性の巨大仙尾部奇形腫症例。多様な硬さ、耳様付属器、毛髪、骨、壊死組織を伴う。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で不均一に増強される腫瘤が確認。全摘出術施行後、病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判定。術後経過良好でフォローアップ中。
pmid-38372776.summary_en: Case report of large sacrococcygeal teratoma in 5-day-old male presenting as pulsatile mass with variegated consistency, ear-like appendage, hair, bone, and necrotic tissue. MRI confirmed heterogeneously enhancing mass. Gross total excision performed with histopathology showing mature cystic teratoma. Uncomplicated postoperative course with good follow-up.

pmid-38371620.summary_ja: 妊孕性温存手術を受けた74例の病期I卵巣未熟奇形腫患者の後方視的研究。中央値188ヶ月のフォローアップでサーベイランス(88%)と補助化学療法(12%)を比較。再発率に有意差なし(13.9% vs 11.1%)。5年無病生存率87-90%、全生存率100%。サーベイランスアプローチの実現可能性を支持。
pmid-38371620.summary_en: Retrospective study of 74 stage I ovarian immature teratoma patients treated with fertility-sparing surgery. Compared surveillance (88%) versus adjuvant chemotherapy (12%) with median 188-month follow-up. No significant difference in recurrence rates between groups (13.9% vs 11.1%). 5-year DFS 87-90%, OS 100% in both cohorts. Supports feasibility of surveillance approach.

pmid-38369705.summary_ja: 妊娠・周産期間の個体間がん伝播に関するレビュー。母体がん細胞の胎児への伝播、ヒト絨毛膜癌の胎児伝播、一卵性双生児間の伝播の3つの病因を論述。小児体内でのがん細胞生存・定着の免疫学的機序と機序ベース免疫療法を考察。
pmid-38369705.summary_en: Review of cross-individual cancer transmission during gestation and perinatal periods. Discusses three etiologies: maternofetal transmission of maternal cancer, gestational choriocarcinoma transmission to fetus, and transfer between monozygotic twins. Summarizes immunological mechanisms enabling cancer cell survival in child and discusses mechanism-based immunotherapy approaches.

pmid-38369557.summary_ja: 1,672名の転移性非セミノーマ精巣がん患者(2010-2018年)におけるIGCCCG予後グループのSEER人口ベース検証研究。改善された5年全生存期間(全生存率)率を確認:94%(良好予後)、87%(中間予後)、65%(不良予後)。IGCCCG更新コンソーシアムの生存改善が優秀なセンターを超えて広い機関に適用されることを検証。
pmid-38369557.summary_en: Population-based SEER validation study of IGCCCG prognosis groups in 1,672 metastatic non-seminoma testicular cancer patients (2010-2018). Confirmed improved 5-year OS rates: 94% (good prognosis), 87% (intermediate), 65% (poor). Validated that IGCCCG Update Consortium survival improvements apply beyond centers of excellence to broader institutions.

pmid-38362619.summary_ja: 非定型精子細胞腫瘍の分子解析。異なる2つの進展経路が明らかに：RAS/MAPK経路変異またはTP53変異/12p領域増加を伴う倍数性シフト。可塑性概念が全GCT型に適用され、内在的異質性と進展中の重大な形質転換能を示唆。
pmid-38362619.summary_en: Analysis of atypical spermatocytic tumors (type III GCT) revealing molecular heterogeneity with two distinct progression pathways: RAS/MAPK pathway mutations or ploidy shifts with TP53 mutations and/or chromosome 12p gain. Demonstrates plasticity concept applies to all GCT types, illustrating inherent heterogeneity and capability for significant transformation during progression.

pmid-38361551.summary_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠28週で非常に大きな奇形腫が診断され、出生前の侵襲的処置と早産分娩のリスク・ベネフィットについて学際的専門家によるコンサルテーションが実施された。計画的な早産帝王切開により乳児を出生させた後、直後に心肺バイパス下での外科的切除を施行し、良好な転帰を得た。
pmid-38361551.summary_en: Case report of very large fetal pericardial teratoma diagnosed at 28 weeks gestation. Multidisciplinary consultation led to planned preterm cesarean delivery for immediate postnatal surgical management. Infant underwent cardiopulmonary bypass and surgical resection with successful outcome.

pmid-38360519.summary_ja: 355名の病期IIセミノーマ患者における一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を実施した8つの研究のシステマティックレビューおよびメタ解析。全体的再発率14%(領内4%)、4%≥病期III合併症。順行性射精が98%のケースで保存。臨床病期IIセミノーマに対する一次RLPNDは安全で有効な治療選択肢、優れた治癒率。
pmid-38360519.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies with 355 stage II seminoma patients undergoing primary RPLND. Overall recurrence rate 14% (infield 4%) with 4% ≥grade III complications. Antegrade ejaculation preserved in 98% of cases. Concluded primary RPLND is safe and effective treatment option for CS II seminomatous GCT with excellent cure rates.

pmid-38359725.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍130患者（成人90例、小児40例）を含む87試験のメタ分析。年齢別全生存率差なし（23vs25ヶ月）。3・5年全生存率は成人34.4%・22.9%、小児41.5%・41.5%。腹側位置、化学療法、手術と良好な転帰の関連。早期診断と治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-38359725.summary_en: Meta-analysis of 87 studies including 130 mediastinal yolk sac tumor patients (90 adults, 40 pediatrics). No significant age-related OS difference (23 vs 25 months). 3- and 5-year OS 34.4% and 22.9% (adults) vs 41.5% and 41.5% (pediatrics). Anterior tumor location, chemotherapy receipt, and surgery associated with better outcomes. Emphasizes importance of early diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-38359698.summary_ja: 化学療法後の胸部転移を有する非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者37名の後方視的研究。化学療法と根治的手術を組み合わせた多面的治療で10年全生存期間(全生存率)94.3%を達成。一次腫瘍型として奇形腫(40.5%)および胎児性癌(40.5%)が優位、転移で奇形腫が主流(70.3%)。
pmid-38359698.summary_en: Retrospective study of 37 non-seminomatous testicular cancer patients with intrathoracic metastasis after chemotherapy. Multimodality treatment combining chemotherapy with radical surgery achieved 10-year OS of 94.3% with no surgical mortality. Teratoma (40.5%) and embryonal carcinoma (40.5%) were prevalent primary histologies; 70.3% teratoma in metastases.

pmid-38358219.summary_ja: 58歳閉経後女性における乳房侵襲的微乳頭癌および偶然発見された良性ブレンナー腫瘍を伴う両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。稀な同時性発症として非ヘレディタリー同時性腫瘍として文書化。正確な診断における免疫組織化学の重要性を強調。
pmid-38358219.summary_en: Case report of 58-year-old postmenopausal woman with invasive micropapillary carcinoma of breast and incidentally discovered bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas with benign Brenner tumor. Unusual synchronous presentation documented as non-hereditary synchronous tumors. Emphasizes importance of immunohistochemistry in accurate diagnosis.

pmid-38357086.summary_ja: テッカ・ルテイン嚢胞を伴う完全子宮胎盤奇胎の少女症例。異常出血、上昇したhCG、過度嘔吐、子癇前症で呈示。テッカ・ルテイン嚢胞は子宮胎盤奇胎に関連する良性ホルモン応答性嚢胞。保存的管理と妊娠後の自然消退を論述。
pmid-38357086.summary_en: Case report of complete hydatidiform mole complicated by theca lutein cysts in teenager. Presented with abnormal bleeding, elevated hCG, hyperemesis, and pregnancy-induced hypertension. Theca lutein cysts are benign, hormonally responsive cysts associated with molar pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic disease. Discusses conservative management and spontaneous resolution after pregnancy.

pmid-38355204.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を有する若い女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。脳脊髄液IgG抗体検査によりNMDARのGluNR1およびGluNR2サブユニットに対する陽性を確認。奇形腫の外科的切除と複数の免疫調整療法で治療。
pmid-38355204.summary_en: Case report of anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis in young woman with ovarian teratoma. Diagnosis confirmed by cerebrospinal fluid IgG antibodies against GluNR1 and GluNR2 subunits of NMDAR. Treated with surgical resection of teratoma and multiple immunomodulatory therapies for management of paraneoplastic encephalitis.

pmid-38350264.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌患者80名が化学療法なしで腫瘍除去後のhCG正常化を達成した多施設国際後方視的研究。中央値50ヶ月のフォローアップ中に再発なし。FIGO/WHOリスクスコア≤6が93.7%のケースに該当。基準センターの厳選された患者における補助化学療法なしの期待的管理が安全なアプローチである可能性が示唆。
pmid-38350264.summary_en: Multicenter international retrospective study of 80 gestational choriocarcinoma patients achieving hCG normalization after tumor removal without chemotherapy. Zero recurrence during median 50-month follow-up. FIGO/WHO risk score ≤6 in 93.7% of cases. Suggests expectant management without adjuvant chemotherapy may be safe approach for highly selected gestational choriocarcinoma patients in reference centers.

pmid-38349599.summary_ja: 治療されていない停留精巣を有する思春期後患者23名(2010-2019年)の後方視的研究。1名(4%)がセミノーマを有していた。停留精巣における正常な精子形成は観察されず、19名が精細管の欠損、3名が成熟停止を示した。片側停留精巣を有する思春期後男性における精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスク低下を目的とした精巣摘除術を支持。
pmid-38349599.summary_en: Retrospective study of 23 post-pubertal patients with untreated cryptorchidism undergoing orchiectomy (2010-2019). One patient (4%) had seminoma. No normal spermatogenesis observed in any undescended testis; 19 patients lacked seminiferous tubules, 3 showed maturation arrest. Results support orchiectomy in post-pubertal males with unilateral cryptorchidism to reduce GCT risk.

pmid-38348386.summary_ja: 停留精巣手術既往と重度乏精子症を有する38歳男性の左精巣における2つの異なる腫瘍(頭側セミノーマ、尾側に胚細胞新生物)の症例報告。精巣摘除術後、腫瘍マーカーとホルモンレベルは正常化し、精液パラメータが改善。片側精巣における2つの腫瘍タイプの報告は初例。
pmid-38348386.summary_en: Case report of 38-year-old male with two distinct tumors in left testis: cranial seminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic cells and caudal mass showing germ cell neoplasia in situ. Patient had severe oligozoospermia with cryptorchidism surgery history. Underwent orchiectomy with tumor marker normalization and improved semen parameters postoperatively. First reported case of two tumor types in unilateral testis.

pmid-38347538.summary_ja: 40歳の46,XX性分化疾患患者の前立腺における卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫成分を有する混合型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例。全ゲノムシーケンシングにより高い体細胞変異負荷と46,XX（SRY+）核型が確認された。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇、ゴナドトロピン上昇、テストステロン低値を呈示。
pmid-38347538.summary_en: Rare case of mixed germ cell tumor (with yolk sac tumor and teratoma components) in the prostate of a 40-year-old with 46,XX disorder of sexual development. Whole-genome sequencing revealed high somatic mutational load and confirmed karyotype as 46,XX (SRY+). Patient presented with elevated AFP, elevated gonadotropins, and low testosterone levels. Case advances understanding of genetic and phenotypic profiles.

pmid-38344694.summary_ja: ステージIIIc非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の初回化学療法から4日以内に化学療法誘発性β-hCG上昇により傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症が生じた21歳男性の初の報告症例。
pmid-38344694.summary_en: First documented case of paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism triggered by chemotherapy-induced surge in β-hCG in a 21-year-old with stage IIIc non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Thyrotoxicosis developed within 4 days of initial chemotherapy. This first peer-reviewed report expands understanding of hCG-mediated endocrine complications in GCT patients during cancer treatment.

pmid-38341381.summary_ja: 卵巣由来腹膜偽粘液腫患者に対する減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法のフランス後方視的研究。15例中60%が卵巣奇形腫内またはその由来の粘液性新生物。卵巣奇形腫由来の腹膜偽粘液腫は5年・10年で100%の無病生存率。
pmid-38341381.summary_en: Retrospective French study of cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for ovarian pseudomyxoma peritonei (OPMP). Among 15 patients, 60% involved mucinous neoplasms arising within or from ovarian teratomas. OPMP of teratomatous origin showed superior disease-free survival (100% at 5 and 10 years).

pmid-38341184.summary_ja: 出生前診断された新生児先天性口腔奇形腫症例。妊娠30週の胎児MRI所見により多職種チーム管理を決定し、予定帝王切開後に速やかに腫瘍摘出術を実施。気道開存を確保し良好な予後を得た。
pmid-38341184.summary_en: Case report of prenatally diagnosed congenital oral teratoma in a neonate. Fetal MRI at 30 weeks guided multidisciplinary management, leading to planned cesarean delivery at 38 weeks. Immediate postnatal surgery ensured airway patency and successful tumor resection with no postoperative complications at three-month follow-up.

pmid-38337762.summary_ja: 未熟仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビュー。成熟型と比較して急速な増殖、高い再発リスク、高い死亡率を特徴とし、出生前診断と適切な治療管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-38337762.summary_en: Case report and extensive literature review of immature sacrococcygeal teratoma. This histological form exhibits rapid growth, higher recurrence risk, and increased mortality compared to mature types. Paper emphasizes importance of prenatal diagnosis and optimal therapeutic management for improving prognosis in immature teratoma cases.

pmid-38337479.summary_ja: 家族性Swyer症候群患者における性腺芽腫症例報告。家族性症例での悪性腫瘍リスクが散発例より高い（66.6% vs 15-45%）ことを示唆。予防的性腺摘出術と長期ホルモン補充療法が推奨される。
pmid-38337479.summary_en: Case report of gonadoblastoma in two siblings with familial Swyer syndrome (46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis). Literature review suggests familial cases have significantly higher gonadal tumor risk (66.6%) compared to sporadic cases (15-45%). Preventive gonadectomy and long-term hormonal replacement therapy are recommended management.

pmid-38332632.summary_ja: 49歳女性の腎門に発生した稀な混合型胚細胞腫瘍（カルチノイドを伴う奇形腫）。組織学的に単純嚢胞内の奇形腫様組織から発生するカルチノイドを確認。この部位での性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の稀有性を強調。
pmid-38332632.summary_en: Rare case report of mixed germ cell tumor (carcinoid with teratoma) arising from renal hilum in 49-year-old woman. Histological examination revealed carcinoid tumor arising from teratomatous tissue within simple cyst. Tumor appeared independent of kidney parenchyma, highlighting rarity of extragonadal GCTs at this site.

pmid-38331649.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫の外科治療後に発生した後頭環椎回旋脱臼症例。4歳女児が頸部手術後に軸椎亜脱臼を発症。段階的治療により症状改善。小児頭頸部外科における稀有な術後合併症。
pmid-38331649.summary_en: Case report of atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation (AARS) as complication following neck surgery in 4-year-old girl with cervical teratoma. Patient received one month of conservative management with serial treatment, resulting in symptom improvement and resolution of neck tilt. Raises awareness of rare postoperative complication.

pmid-38330895.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者45例の監視コンピュータ断層撮影における撮影プロトコル比較。分割ボーラス単一相プロトコルは放射線量を21.5%削減しながら診断許容性を維持。精巣がんフォローアップにおける放射線安全性を改善。
pmid-38330895.summary_en: Retrospective comparison of CT imaging protocols (split-bolus single-phase vs. single-bolus split-phase) in 45 testicular cancer patients undergoing surveillance imaging. Split-bolus protocol achieved 21.5% radiation dose reduction while maintaining diagnostic acceptability. Demonstrates improved radiation safety in testicular cancer follow-up.

pmid-38322677.summary_ja: 結腸腺癌が卵巣成熟奇形腫に転移した腫瘍間転移症例。41歳女性患者に大腸がんの多臓器転移と左卵巣奇形腫を認定。手術で奇形腫内の転移腺癌を確認。大腸がん患者における奇形腫切除の重要性を示唆。
pmid-38322677.summary_en: Case of tumor-to-tumor metastasis from sigmoid colon adenocarcinoma to mature ovarian teratoma in 41-year-old woman. Patient presented with metastatic colorectal cancer involving liver, lungs, bone, and ovarian teratoma. Exploratory surgery revealed metastatic adenocarcinoma in mature ovarian teratoma. Highlights importance of teratoma resection to prevent secondary metastasis.

pmid-38321801.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患を示唆する胎盤前置として初期管理された3回の帝王切開既往を有する42歳ナイジェリア人女性。帝王切開子宮全摘術で病理組織学的に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断。
pmid-38321801.summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in 42-year-old Nigerian woman with three prior cesarean sections, initially managed conservatively for suspected placenta previa. Cesarean hysterectomy revealed PSTT on histopathology. Case highlights diagnostic challenges of gestational trophoblastic disease mimicking placental abnormalities.

pmid-38321336.summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（異時性24例、同時性16例）40例の多施設後方視的分析。両側疾患は若い年齢で発症し、より進行した疾患を呈し、β-hCG上昇とリンパ節転移がより頻繁。同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍は異時性例より疾患特異的死亡率が18%高かった。
pmid-38321336.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective analysis of 40 patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors (24 metachronous, 16 synchronous) compared to unilateral cases. Bilateral disease presented at younger age with more advanced disease, elevated β-hCG levels, and higher nodal involvement. Synchronous bilateral GCT showed 18% higher disease-specific mortality.

pmid-38317250.summary_ja: 18歳未満のがん患者9例における卵巣刺激と卵母細胞凍結保存の症例集積。うち2例は胚細胞腫瘍患者（ディスジャーミノーマ1例、胚細胞腫瘍1例）で、化学療法前の思春期胚細胞腫瘍患者における生殖能温存の実行可能性を示した。
pmid-38317250.summary_en: Case series of controlled ovarian stimulation with oocyte cryopreservation in 9 adolescent cancer patients (<18 years) prior to cancer treatment. Two patients had germ cell tumors (one dysgerminoma, one GCT). Study demonstrates feasibility of fertility preservation in adolescents with GCT before chemotherapy and provides outcome data on oocyte recovery and cryopreservation.

pmid-38316790.summary_ja: 異数性胚盤葉幹細胞由来の奇形腫は、追加変異なしに高いステムネスと不全なプロテアソーム活性を示し転移能を有する。プロテアソーム活性化剤とER応力阻害薬が転移抑制に有効。
pmid-38316790.summary_en: Teratomas derived from aneuploid murine embryonic stem cells demonstrate metastatic capacity through high stemness populations with deficient proteasome activity and ER stress, independent of additional genetic mutations. Proteasome activators and ER stress inhibitors effectively suppress aneuploid teratoma metastasis.

pmid-38314227.summary_ja: 65歳男性の肺原発絨毛癌でβ-hCG産生があり、両側乳房女性化を呈した稀な症例。両側肺病変と脳転移を認め、化学免疫療法で部分奏効を得た。
pmid-38314227.summary_en: Rare case of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with β-hCG secretion in a 65-year-old male presenting with bilateral gynecomastia. Bilateral pulmonary lesions and brain metastasis identified; treated with carboplatin-etoposide-pembrolizumab achieving partial response.

pmid-38308982.summary_ja: 結核高流行地域で初期に結核と誤診された小児の縦隔奇形腫2症例。開胸手術により成熟奇形腫が確認され、良好な長期転帰が得られ再発はなかった。
pmid-38308982.summary_en: Case series of two children with mediastinal teratoma initially misdiagnosed as tuberculosis in a TB-endemic setting. Both underwent thoracotomy; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with satisfactory long-term outcomes and no recurrence.

pmid-38306872.summary_ja: 20歳女性の後腹膜成熟奇形腫例。腹痛で発症、画像診断とCA19.9高値で診断。完全切除で治癒、再発なし。
pmid-38306872.summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old female with primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma presenting with abdominal pain. Imaging and elevated CA19.9 were diagnostic; complete surgical resection was curative with excellent postoperative outcome.

pmid-38305430.summary_ja: 臨床病期II精巣がん管理における最近の進歩。選択的セミノーマ患者への一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清と補助化学療法の減量。新規バイオマーカーマイクロRNA-371a-3pによるリスク層別化。
pmid-38305430.summary_en: Review of clinical stage II testicular cancer management advances, including retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for seminoma and adjuvant chemotherapy de-escalation. Discusses novel biomarkers like microRNA-371a-3p for risk stratification and personalized approaches.

pmid-38304749.summary_ja: 小児の両側精巣腫瘍（左卵黄嚢腫、右成熟奇形腫）同時性例。左精巣摘除と右精巣温存手術。後腹膜再発に化学療法実施。
pmid-38304749.summary_en: Pediatric case of synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histologies: left yolk sac tumor and right mature teratoma. Left orchiectomy with right testis-sparing surgery performed; retroperitoneal recurrence treated successfully with chemotherapy.

pmid-38301309.summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜疾患の分子プロファイリング。高PD-L1陽性率を確認。治療標的としてWee1、PARP、MEK阻害薬を特定。
pmid-38301309.summary_en: Molecular profiling of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia including choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumors (ETT), and placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT). Identifies high PD-L1 positivity and potential therapeutic targets including Wee1, PARP, and MEK inhibitors.

pmid-38301040.summary_ja: バイオインフォマティクス解析でMAELが精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含む複数のがんで高発現。ccRCCではMAEL発現が予後と関連。低MAEL発現は免疫療法の治療効果利益を示唆。患者選別の有用性。
pmid-38301040.summary_en: Bioinformatic analysis of MAEL expression across human cancers including testicular germ cell tumors. MAEL expression correlates with treatment response and prognosis in various malignancies.

pmid-38300402.summary_ja: 泌尿器悪性腫瘍の総説。精巣セミノーマのリンパ節郭清に関するSEMS試験を含む。
pmid-38300402.summary_en: Review of paradigm-shifting studies in urologic oncology including SEMS trial on retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular seminoma with limited nodal metastases.

pmid-38296531.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞株を用いた研究。バルプロ酸がHIF-1α経由でCGB発現を上昇させ、glucose摂取を抑制。妊娠性栄養膜疾患関連。
pmid-38296531.summary_en: Study using BeWo choriocarcinoma cells investigating valproic acid effects on placental function. VPA elevated chorionic gonadotropin β (CGB) expression and suppressed glucose uptake through HIF-1α-mediated mechanisms relevant to gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-38296184.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるgrowing teratoma syndromの分子およびエピジェネティック特性評価。循環バイオマーカーの特定、成長率による分層、化学療法後に持続する潜在的な非セミノーマ性成分の示唆。
pmid-38296184.summary_en: Molecular and epigenetic characterization of growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in germ cell tumors. Identifies circulating biomarkers, stratifies GTS by growth rate, and suggests occult non-seminomatous components may persist after chemotherapy in teratomas.

pmid-38293778.summary_ja: CS IIA marker陰性NSGCT患者の監視療法研究。RPLND病理：70%生存癌、26%良性リンパ節、6%奇形腫。
pmid-38293778.summary_en: Prospective study of clinical stage IIA marker-negative NSGCTs managed with surveillance and CT imaging. RPLND histopathology showed 70% viable cancer, 26% benign nodes, and 6% teratoma, identifying patients with occult disease.

pmid-38292806.summary_ja: 腹部腫瘤の奇形腫対胎児内胎児の鑑別診断。画像診断で胎児内胎児と確認。腫瘍マーカー正常。
pmid-38292806.summary_en: Pediatric case of abdominal mass initially suspected to be teratoma or fetus-in-fetu. Imaging confirmed fetus-in-fetu diagnosis; normal serum tumor markers. Illustrates diagnostic differentiation between these entities.

pmid-38292777.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫からの粘液性腺癌例。多房性嚢胞性腫瘍で異常なFDG-PET集積。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化を議論。
pmid-38292777.summary_en: Case report of mucinous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma showing atypical cytokeratin expression profile. Imaging demonstrates multilocular cystic mass with abnormal FDG-PET uptake. Discusses malignant transformation risk in mature teratomas.

pmid-38285100.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者64例を対象とした後方視的研究で、MLH1およびREV-7の免疫組織化学的発現を予測的マーカーとして検討。REV-7陽性は化学療法耐性と不良予後と強く関連していた。
pmid-38285100.summary_en: Retrospective study of 64 testicular germ cell tumor patients examining immunohistochemical expression of MLH1 and REV-7 as predictive markers. REV-7 positivity strongly associated with chemoresistance and poor prognosis.

pmid-38282269.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫が扁平上皮癌に悪性化した症例。66歳閉経後女性。免疫組織化学によりCK5/6およびP63陽性を確認。高齢および腫瘍の大きさが危険因子。ステージIA患者の予後は良好で化学療法不要。
pmid-38282269.summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratoma in a 66-year-old woman. Discusses risk factors including advanced age and large tumor size, histopathology findings, and favorable prognosis in stage IA disease without requiring chemotherapy.

pmid-38281986.summary_ja: 70歳女性の縦隔に発見された大型腫瘤が70年以上無症状で経過。右後側方開胸術により完全切除。組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認。血清hCGおよびAFP値は正常。予後は良好。
pmid-38281986.summary_en: Case report of a 70-year-old woman with a voluminous mediastinal mass found incidentally on chest X-ray, remaining asymptomatic for over 70 years. Surgical resection via posterolateral thoracotomy confirmed histologically as mature cystic teratoma with excellent prognosis.

pmid-38281826.summary_ja: 17歳以下女児の卵巣腫瘍の包括的レビュー。疫学、危険因子、臨床症状、診断、鑑別診断、治療選択肢を網羅。妊孕性温存手術と小児・思春期患者への心理的影響に注目。
pmid-38281826.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian tumors in females under 17 years, covering epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentations, diagnosis, differential diagnosis, and treatment options. Emphasizes fertility-sparing surgery and psychological impacts on children and adolescents.

pmid-38281479.summary_ja: 絨毛膜疾患の稀な亜型3つ（ETT、PSTT、APSN）の診断的特徴、臨床特性、標準治療、妊孕性温存療法を網羅。中間トロホブラストから発生する稀な腫瘍の新しい知見を提供。
pmid-38281479.summary_en: Comprehensive review of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), and atypical placental site nodule (APSN). Covers diagnostic features, clinical characteristics, standard treatment, and fertility-sparing management strategies.

pmid-38279983.summary_ja: 睾丸がん自己検診に関する一般男性と医師の知識・認識を調査。医師の8.9%しかスクリーニング検査を実施せず、男性の77.5%は自己検診方法を認識しておらず、知識ギャップが明白。
pmid-38279983.summary_en: Survey assessing knowledge and perceptions of testicular self-examination for cancer detection among general practitioners and males aged 15-45. Found significant gaps: only 8.9% of GPs perform screening, and 77.5% of males don't know how to perform self-examination.

pmid-38278693.summary_ja: 病期II精巣がんに対する開腹的対ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の傾向スコアマッチング分析。ロボット支援アプローチは短い入院期間と低い出血量を示しながら、腫瘍学的有効性を維持していた。神経温存を含む標準的管理アルゴリズムへの組み入れが推奨される。
pmid-38278693.summary_en: Propensity-matched analysis comparing open versus robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage II testicular cancer. Robotic approach showed shorter hospital stay and lower blood loss without compromising oncologic efficacy.

pmid-38265529.summary_ja: 日本の病院ベースがん登録における1,767人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)の分析。病期II-III患者は低容量施設での5年生存率が著明に低く、治療集約化により転帰が改善することを示す。
pmid-38265529.summary_en: Hospital-based cancer registry analysis of 1,767 testicular GCT patients in Japan (seminoma and non-seminoma). Shows stage II-III patients at low-volume institutions had significantly worse 5-year survival, indicating treatment centralization improves outcomes.

pmid-38259260.summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫（fetiform type）の症例。腸など完全に形成された構造を含む。組織学的に成熟型であり悪性所見なし。術後14ヶ月で良好に経過。AFP値3.5 μg/L。
pmid-38259260.summary_en: Case report of a 5-day-old neonate with type II sacrococcygeal fetiform teratoma (homunculus). Surgical excision revealed fully formed bowel, bones, and well-defined structures. Histopathology confirmed mature features without malignancy.

pmid-38250128.summary_ja: 小児期から診断された20歳女性患者の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。緩徐成長する骨盤外腫瘤として、圧迫症状で発症。外科的切除により成熟奇形腫が確認された。悪性転化の危険性は1-2%である。
pmid-38250128.summary_en: Case report of a 20-year-old female with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed since childhood, presenting as a slowly growing extraperitoneal mass causing compression. Surgical resection confirmed mature teratoma; 1-2% malignant transformation risk noted.

pmid-38244349.summary_ja: オランダ(1989-2019)で診断された12,528人の精巣がん(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)の分析。青年・若年成人における発生率は著明に増加。放射線療法使用は78%から5%に低下。積極的監視を受けた患者が大半で、20年生存率は90%を超える。
pmid-38244349.summary_en: Analysis of 12,528 testicular cancers (seminoma and non-seminoma) diagnosed in Netherlands (1989-2019) among adolescents and young adults. Incidence increased significantly; radiotherapy declined from 78% to 5%; most received active surveillance with >90% 20-year survival.

pmid-38236556.summary_ja: 39歳男性の転移性精巣セミノーマから生じた頭蓋底軟骨肉腫(体細胞型悪性腫瘍)の症例報告。上横隔膜リンパ節腫大を伴う。胚細胞腫瘍の稀だが重大な合併症で、分子特性が異なり予後不良である。
pmid-38236556.summary_en: Case report of skull base chondrosarcoma arising as somatic-type malignancy from metastatic testicular seminoma in a 39-year-old man with supradiaphragmatic lymphadenopathy. Demonstrates rare but serious complication of GCT with divergent molecular features and poor prognosis.

pmid-38229735.summary_ja: 84歳男性における片側精巣に発生した同時性Leydig細胞腫瘍（性索間質腫瘍）と精子細胞腫瘍（胚細胞腫瘍）の初報告症例。異なる起源を有する両腫瘍が同一精巣で同時に発生することは極めて稀であり、臨床的に重要な症例である。
pmid-38229735.summary_en: First reported case of synchronous Leydig cell tumor (sex cord-stromal tumor) and spermatocytic tumor (germ cell tumor) in a single testis of an 84-year-old male. These tumors rarely coexist due to their different origins.

pmid-38225551.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者においてシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けている際の1年間の監視下身体活動プログラムが癌関連疲労に及ぼす影響を評価する第III相試験プロトコル。腸内微生物叢とその代謝産物の潜在的仲介効果を調査する。
pmid-38225551.summary_en: Phase-III trial protocol evaluating one-year supervised physical activity program's impact on cancer-related fatigue in metastatic testicular germ cell tumor patients receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy, investigating gut microbiota as potential mediator.

pmid-38223403.summary_ja: 精巣純粋絨毛膜癌は生殖細胞腫瘍の中で最も稀で高い悪性度を有し、早期血行性転移を特徴とする。65歳患者の化学療法への部分奏効例を報告し、免疫療法の可能性について検討している。
pmid-38223403.summary_en: Rare case of pure testicular choriocarcinoma in 65-year-old with partial chemotherapy response. Reviews characteristics and therapeutic principles; discusses emerging targeted and immune-based therapies showing potential for maintenance therapy in advanced GCTs.

pmid-38222311.summary_ja: 眼球欠損、四肢奇形を伴う12週齢胎児の前額部成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。病理学的診断により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認され、胎児眼球欠損と四肢奇形症候群と診断された。
pmid-38222311.summary_en: Case report of 12-week fetus with anophthalmia, left upper limb absence, and infratemporal teratoma measuring 4mm. Pathological investigation confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Diagnosed with fetal microphthalmia with limb anomalies.

pmid-38218332.summary_ja: 16,412件の医療記録を49年間調査した結果、300の過誤腫、2つの異所性腫瘍、1つの奇形腫類似病変が口腔領域から確認された。オドントーマが最も一般的で、異所性腫瘍と奇形腫類似病変は稀である。
pmid-38218332.summary_en: 49-year cross-sectional study of 16,412 records found 300 hamartomas (1.83%), 2 choristomas (0.01%), and 1 teratoid lesion (0.01%) in oral cavity. Odontoma most frequent hamartoma. Low occurrence of choristomatous and teratoid lesions.

pmid-38216273.summary_ja: 短い反復配列遺伝子型検査により3例の妊娠関連絨毛膜癌の起源を同定した研究。症例1では10年前の臨床的に診断されなかった完全胞状奇胎が根拠と判明。起源の特定はFIGOスコアシステム決定に重要。
pmid-38216273.summary_en: Short tandem repeat genotyping identified origins of gestational choriocarcinoma in three cases. Case 1: choriocarcinoma originated from previously undiagnosed complete hydatidiform mole 10 years prior. Cases 2-3 confirmed clinically presumed origins.

pmid-38215755.summary_ja: HLA遺伝子欠損と免疫回避因子発現により改変された多能性幹細胞は、T細胞、NK細胞、補体によるバリアを回避できる。これらの改変細胞は免疫能マウスにおいて永続性奇形腫を形成し、細胞治療研究に有用である。
pmid-38215755.summary_en: Genetic ablation of HLA and immune evasion factor expression in pluripotent stem cells led to persistent teratoma formation in wild-type mice despite immune barriers. Demonstrates T cell, NK cell, and complement evasion necessary for preventing immunological rejection.

pmid-38212900.summary_ja: 絨毛膜癌JEG-3細胞におけるLGALS16遺伝子発現はcAMP依存的にp38 MAPKおよびEPAC経路を介して制御される。LGALS16は栄養膜分化と合胞体栄養膜マーカー発現に必要であり、胎盤細胞生物学に重要。
pmid-38212900.summary_en: LGALS16 gene expression in choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells is regulated by cAMP-dependent signaling through p38 MAPK and EPAC pathways. LGALS16 required for trophoblast differentiation and syncytiotrophoblast marker expression.

pmid-38205041.summary_ja: 24歳男性に認められた前立腺原発性胎児性癌の初報告症例。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の極めてまれな形態。患者はシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けたが、外科的切除を拒否したため、疾患再発および短期間での死亡に至った。タイムリーな外科的切除の重要性が示唆される。
pmid-38205041.summary_en: First reported case of primary embryonal carcinoma of prostate in 24-year-old male. Represents extragonadal germ cell tumor. Patient received cisplatin-based chemotherapy but refused surgical treatment, resulting in disease relapse and death.

pmid-38199869.summary_ja: デンマークでの化学療法後後腹膜限定切除術を受けた219人の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者の後方視的集団ベース研究（1990-2015年）。主要罹患率は低く（5%）、10年再発率は5.9%、10年全生存期間は96%。
pmid-38199869.summary_en: Retrospective population-based study of 219 nonseminoma testicular cancer patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lumpectomy in Denmark (1990-2015). Low major morbidity (5%), 10-year recurrence rate 5.9%, 10-year overall survival 96%.

pmid-38173625.summary_ja: 炭素コーティングセレン二水化物粒子と近赤外線レーザーの組み合わせは絨毛膜癌細胞の増殖を阻害し、活性酸素産生を通じてアポトーシスを誘導する。低侵襲的光熱療法の新規治療選択肢として有望である。
pmid-38173625.summary_en: Carbon-coated selenium nanoparticles combined with near-infrared laser inhibit choriocarcinoma cell proliferation, induce apoptosis through ROS production. Shows potential for minimally invasive photothermal therapy as alternative to conventional chemotherapy.

pmid-38172961.summary_ja: 13歳患者の卵巣非妊娠性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)で肺への遠隔転移と軽微な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫成分を伴う症例。遠隔転移を伴う初めての症例であり、非妊娠性PSTTが胚細胞由来の別個の腫瘍として認識されるべきことを支持する。
pmid-38172961.summary_en: Case of 13-year-old with non-gestational ovarian placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) with lung metastasis and minor mature cystic teratoma component. First case with distant metastasis; supports recognition of non-gestational PSTT as distinct germ cell-derived neoplasm.

pmid-38171036.summary_ja: セミノーマ33例およびディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）31例における免疫組織化学研究。高いCD45RO浸潤；変動するPD-1/PD-L1発現は抗腫瘍反応有効性と免疫療法の可能性に影響。
pmid-38171036.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of CD45RO memory T cell marker and PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitory molecules in 33 seminoma and 31 dysgerminoma patients. High CD45RO infiltration; variable PD-1/PD-L1 expression impacts anti-tumor response effectiveness and immunotherapy potential.

pmid-38169660.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のMRI見かけ拡散係数ヒストグラムパラメータを用いた良性と悪性の鑑別研究。最大ADCが最も良好な鑑別能を示し、悪性腫瘍の診断における有用な画像バイオマーカーである。
pmid-38169660.summary_en: Retrospective study of apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) histogram parameters for MRI-based differentiation of 45 testicular tumors (7 benign, 39 malignant including seminoma). Maximum ADC performed best in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions.

pmid-38166849.summary_ja: 高レベルβ-hCGを伴う妊娠関連絨毛膜癌の心腔内転移症例。右房、三尖弁、右室に転移巣が位置した。多くの化学療法サイクル後も限定的な奏効で、心腔内腫瘤切除後も急速に再発し、姑息的治療に至った。
pmid-38166849.summary_en: Case of gestational choriocarcinoma with intracardiac metastasis in right atrium, tricuspid valve, and right ventricle (high β-hCG 199,060 mIU/mL). Limited response to eight chemotherapy cycles; intracardiac masses resected but rapidly recurred.

pmid-38165518.summary_ja: 28歳男性の両側精巣前思春期型奇形腫の症例報告。3層由来の成熟組織からなる大型の固液性腫瘤。FISH検査でi(12p)欠失がなく、長期経過にもかかわらず転移なしで良性と確認。
pmid-38165518.summary_en: Case report of bilateral testicular prepubertal-type teratomas in a 28-year-old man. Large solid-cystic masses comprised mature tissues from all three germ layers. FISH confirmed absence of i(12p), establishing benign prepubertal-type teratoma diagnosis despite lifelong tumor burden.

pmid-38161647.summary_ja: 体部型悪性転化を伴う極めて巨大な縦隔未熟奇形腫の一塊切除症例。未熟奇形腫の悪性転化は化学療法感受性に乏しく、完全外科的切除がより良い生存をもたらす可能性がある。
pmid-38161647.summary_en: Case report of en bloc resection of a giant mediastinal immature teratoma with somatic-type malignant transformation. Demonstrates importance of complete surgical resection given poor chemotherapy sensitivity in immature teratomas with malignant somatic components.

pmid-38158258.summary_ja: 乳幼児仙尾部奇形腫355例の多施設研究。再発は11.8%、機能障害後遺症23.4%（肛門直腸、尿路、下肢運動機能障害）。リスク因子は未熟組織学、不完全切除、手術合併症。
pmid-38158258.summary_en: Multi-institutional study of 355 infantile sacrococcygeal teratomas. Recurrence occurred in 11.8%, with 23.4% experiencing functional sequelae (anorectal, urinary, motor dysfunction). Risk factors included immature histology, incomplete resection, and surgical complications.

pmid-38146022.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化と良性例のMRI所見比較。悪性転化は固形成分が大きく脂肪成分が低く、有茎性結節、不規則な辺縁、腹膜播種を認めた。
pmid-38146022.summary_en: MRI study comparing imaging features of malignant transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratomas versus benign cases. Malignant transformation showed larger solid components, lower fat occupancy, sessile solid nodules, irregular margins, and peritoneal dissemination.

pmid-38141134.summary_ja: 肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍のGATA3およびFOXA2発現の免疫組織化学研究。FOXA2欠失とGATA3焦点発現が認められ、成熟表現型維持遺伝子の下制御が肉腫様化に関与することを示唆。
pmid-38141134.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of GATA3 and FOXA2 expression in sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor postpubertal-type from testicular germ cell tumors. Sarcomatoid YSTpt showed absence of FOXA2 and focal GATA3, suggesting downregulation underlying sarcomatoid transformation.

pmid-38135144.summary_ja: 女性生殖器官の内分泌腫瘍のレビュー。ステロイド産生腫瘍、神経内分泌新生物、ならびに卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および奇形腫に生じる甲状腺濾胞細胞増殖を含む。遺伝的易罹患症候群と転移性悪性腫瘍との鑑別を述べた。
pmid-38135144.summary_en: Review of endocrine tumors in female reproductive tract. Includes steroidogenic tumors, neuroendocrine neoplasms, and thyroid follicular proliferations arising in ovarian germ cell tumors and teratomas. Discusses genetic predisposition syndromes and distinction from metastatic disease.

pmid-38123189.summary_ja: 妊娠性と非妊娠性絨毛癌の包括的なレビュー。非妊娠性絨毛癌は胚細胞由来または体細胞悪性腫瘍に関連。疫学、病因、臨床呈示、管理の相違を検討し、正確な診断と予後のための鑑別を強調。
pmid-38123189.summary_en: Comprehensive review distinguishing gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma. Non-gestational choriocarcinoma can be germ cell-derived or associated with somatic malignancy. Discusses epidemiology, pathogenesis, clinical presentation, and management differences for accurate diagnosis and prognosis.

pmid-38099663.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫手術における経膣NOTES対経臍LESS術の前向きランダム化試験。経膣NOTESは手術時間が短く、術後疼痛が少なく、穿孔率が低かった。
pmid-38099663.summary_en: Randomized controlled trial comparing transvaginal NOTES versus transumbilical LESS for ovarian mature cystic teratoma cystectomy in 81 women. Transvaginal NOTES achieved shorter operative time (68 vs 85 minutes), lower postoperative pain, and lower intraoperative rupture rate.

pmid-38097681.summary_ja: 極度に上昇したhCG(>1000 U/L)を示す精原細胞腫患者7人の分子および病理学的特性化。高hCGにもかかわらず純粋精原細胞腫と診断、絨毛膜絨毛下層が認められた。
pmid-38097681.summary_en: Molecular and histopathological characterization of seven seminoma patients with extraordinarily elevated serum hCG levels (>1000 U/L). Despite high hCG, tumors were diagnosed as pure seminoma with syncytiotrophoblast subpopulations by immunohistochemistry and gene expression analysis.

pmid-38092129.summary_ja: 精巣胚胎がん細胞のエストロゲン受容体効果のプロテオミクス解析。17β-エストラジオール処理により遊走、浸潤、アンカリッジ非依存的増殖が増加。
pmid-38092129.summary_en: Proteomic analysis of estrogen receptor effects on human testicular embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells. Treatment with 17β-estradiol and ERβ-selective agonist increased migration, invasion, and anchorage-independent growth, identifying potential therapeutic targets for non-seminomatous management.

pmid-38085711.summary_ja: 2施設研究：非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清中に補助臓器切除を受けた242例。切除臓器の22%のみが実行可能な腫瘍を含有し、39%は奇形腫、39%は壊死のみであった。補助手術の腫瘍学的利益は限定的。
pmid-38085711.summary_en: Two-center study of 242 patients undergoing adjunctive organ resection during postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Only 22% of resected organs contained viable tumor; 39% had teratoma and 39% had only necrosis.

pmid-38074424.summary_ja: 急性腎盂腎炎の精査中に偶然発見された精巣精原細胞腫の症例報告。精巣がんの非典型的な発症と包括的臨床検査の重要性を示唆。
pmid-38074424.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma discovered incidentally during evaluation for acute pyelonephritis in a young man. Demonstrates unusual clinical presentation of testicular cancer and importance of thorough physical examination.

pmid-38072736.summary_ja: 435例の精巣がん患者を対象とした機関内研究で、停留精巣治療の有無による腫瘍病理を比較した。停留精巣治療経験のある患者では良性病理がより一般的（15.2% vs 4.7%）であり、混合型胚細胞腫瘍はより低率（18.2% vs 37.3%）であった。
pmid-38072736.summary_en: Institutional study of 435 testicular cancer patients comparing tumor pathology in those with versus without prior cryptorchidism treatment. Benign pathology was significantly more common in previously treated patients (15.2% vs 4.7%); mixed GCT less common (18.2% vs 37.3%).

pmid-38070256.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除を受けた36例小児の研究：27例成熟奇形腫、8例未熟奇形腫、1例悪性胚細胞腫瘍。病理組織学的亜型別の監視戦略と再発率を検討し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)監視慣行の変動を評価した。
pmid-38070256.summary_en: Retrospective study of 36 children undergoing sacrococcygeal teratoma resection: 27 mature, 8 immature, and 1 malignant GCT. Examines surveillance strategies, recurrence rates, and varying AFP monitoring practices across histopathologic subtypes.

pmid-38069497.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の精子ミトコンドリア機能障害を検討。ATP産生、酸化的リン酸化、酸化ストレスが精巣がん関連の精子異常の基礎となるメカニズムであることを探索した。胚細胞腫瘍患者における精子品質低下の可能性を検討。
