pmid-38069497.summary_en: Review examining mitochondrial dysfunction in sperm of testicular cancer patients. Explores ATP production, oxidative phosphorylation, and oxidative stress as mechanisms underlying cancer-associated sperm abnormalities in GCT patients.

pmid-38052712.summary_ja: 55例の精巣がん生存者の前向きコホート研究。シスプラチン併用化学療法後のテロメア長変化と心血管危険因子（代謝症候群、男性ホルモン低下）を治療後5年間のフォローアップで検討した。
pmid-38052712.summary_en: Prospective cohort of 55 testicular cancer survivors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Examines telomere length changes and cardiovascular risk factors including metabolic syndrome and hypogonadism over 5-year follow-up.

pmid-38040333.summary_ja: hCG産生腫瘍55例のモレキュラージェノタイピング有用性を検討。81.2%が妊娠関連（絨毛疾患）。分子検査は診断・治療決定・生存予測を導いた。
pmid-38040333.summary_en: Retrospective study from French Reference Center analyzing molecular genotyping of 55 hCG-producing tumors: 81.2% gestational origin, 12.7% non-gestational. Molecular testing guided diagnosis, treatment decisions, and predicted overall survival in GTD.

pmid-38038079.summary_ja: 48歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(主にセミノーマ)で後腹膜リンパ節転移を有する症例。持続ミュラー管症候群とtransverse testicular ectopiaに関連し、化学療法および手術で治療された。成人のPMDSとTTEは通常、術中に発見され、ectopic精巣の悪性腫瘍に関連している。
pmid-38038079.summary_en: Case report of a 48-year-old with mixed germ cell tumor (predominantly seminoma) of testis with retroperitoneal nodal metastases. Associated with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome and transverse testicular ectopia, treated with chemotherapy and surgery.

pmid-38019392.summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌の初の原位置マウスモデル開発。JEG-3細胞を妊娠中マウス胎盤に注射。腫瘍進行と肝脾肺への転移を観察し臨床像を再現。
pmid-38019392.summary_en: First orthotopic animal model of gestational choriocarcinoma using JEG-3 luciferase cells injected into gravid mouse placenta. Studies tumor development and rapid metastasis to liver, spleen, lung, and peritoneum mimicking clinical disease progression.

pmid-38010229.summary_ja: 再発転移性GCT患者43例へのHDC-ASCT実施の回顧的研究。単回および二重移植の治療成績を検討。無病生存率と全生存率を評価。
pmid-38010229.summary_en: Retrospective review of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation for 43 relapsed metastatic GCT patients in Alberta. Examines disease-free and overall survival outcomes comparing second/third-line therapy and single vs. tandem transplants.

pmid-38009817.summary_ja: 828人の日本人男性における精巣微小石灰化と関連する因子を調査した後方視的コホート研究。胚細胞腫瘍の既往が有意に関連(16.7% vs 1.3%)し、血清クレアチニン値の上昇(1.04 vs 0.91 mg/dL)も関連していた。
pmid-38009817.summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 828 Japanese men examining testicular microlithiasis and associated factors. History of germ cell tumor was significantly associated (16.7% vs 1.3% controls), along with elevated serum creatinine levels.

pmid-37993989.summary_ja: 絨毛癌46例の内膜形態を検討。分泌期・非分泌期パターンと臨床病理学的特性を分析。化学療法の影響とhCG受容体発現を評価。
pmid-37993989.summary_en: Histopathologic study of endometrial morphology in 46 choriocarcinoma specimens. Describes diverse secretory and proliferative changes, analyzes relationship to treatment and hCG effects, distinguishing choriocarcinoma from hydatidiform mole endometrium.

pmid-37991604.summary_ja: 28の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例におけるSerpinB9発現の免疫組織学的研究。非セミノーマにおけるSerpinB9アップレギュレーション、CD8陽性腫瘍浸潤細胞との逆相関を示し、精巣腫瘍における免疫逃避メカニズムを示唆している。
pmid-37991604.summary_en: Immunohistologic study of SerpinB9 expression in 28 testicular GCT cases. Demonstrates SerpinB9 upregulation in non-seminomas with inverse correlation to CD8-positive tumor-infiltrating cells, suggesting immune escape mechanism in testicular tumors.

pmid-37981168.summary_ja: 診断遅延が腫瘍サイズ、病期、および腫瘍マーカーに及ぼす影響を検討した71名の精巣がん患者(セミノーマ39名、非セミノーマ32名)の後方視的研究。遅延は病理学的サイズ増加、αフェトプロテイン/LDH上昇、およびN病期上昇と正の相関を示した。
pmid-37981168.summary_en: Retrospective study of 71 testicular cancer patients (39 seminoma, 32 non-seminoma) examining effect of diagnostic delay on tumor size, stage, and markers. Delay positively correlated with increased pathological size, elevated AFP/LDH, and higher N stage.

pmid-37980196.summary_ja: 小児16例の肝臓転移切除を検討、GCT6例を含む。成熟奇形腫のみが検出された例も認めた。転移GCTの治療成績と安全性を評価。
pmid-37980196.summary_en: Observational study of 16 pediatric patients undergoing hepatic metastasectomy, including 6 with germ cell tumors. Some GCT metastases revealed only mature teratoma, guiding adjuvant therapy. Examines safety and utility of hepatectomy for metastatic pediatric malignancies.

pmid-37977155.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜上皮腫瘍スペクトラムの子宮内病変についてのレビュー。診断特性、分子生物学的ツール、予後因子を論述。子宮内絨毛膜癌は無症状から広範転移まで多様な臨床像を示す。
pmid-37977155.summary_en: Reviews intraplacental gestational choriocarcinoma and chorangiocarcinoma, rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasms affecting mothers and fetuses. Discusses diagnostic features, molecular tools, and prognostic factors. IPCs range from asymptomatic to widely metastatic with potential for metastasis even with microscopic disease.

pmid-37967143.summary_ja: 258名の病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者において中央値18ヶ月フォローアップされた再発検出のための血清マイクロRNA-371a-3pを評価。M371テストは100%感度および96.3%特異度を達成し、従来診断法を著しく上回る。しかし、術後M371レベルは将来の再発を予測しなかった。
pmid-37967143.summary_en: Evaluates serum microRNA-371a-3p for detecting relapses in 258 stage I testicular GCT patients followed for median 18 months. M371 test achieved 100% sensitivity and 96.3% specificity, significantly outperforming conventional diagnostics. However, postoperative M371 levels did not predict future relapse.

pmid-37966940.summary_ja: シスプラチン化学療法後の精巣がん生存者358名における長期健康害を調査。神経障害性疼痛、糖尿病、肥満、疲労が生活の質に有意な悪影響を与えることを明らかにした。
pmid-37966940.summary_en: Examines long-term health impacts in 358 testicular cancer survivors receiving cisplatin (median 10.7 years post-treatment). Identifies chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain, diabetes, obesity, and fatigue as significant factors reducing global mental and physical health outcomes.

pmid-37964485.summary_ja: 低リスクGTN 115名の20年間レジストリ研究。メトトレキサート単剤療法で77%が完全奏効。WHO危険度スコア5-6と高いhCGは治療抵抗性と関連。再発率4.3%。
pmid-37964485.summary_en: 20-year registry study of 115 low-risk GTN patients with 100% survival. 77% achieved complete response to methotrexate monotherapy. WHO risk scores 5-6 and elevated pretreatment hCG associated with higher treatment resistance. Relapse rate 4.3% with successful salvage therapy.

pmid-37956765.summary_ja: 思春期周辺における稀な転移性精巣混合型非精上皮胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。通常と異なる低年齢での広範転移を示す。
pmid-37956765.summary_en: Case report of rare peripubertal mixed nonseminomatous testicular GCT with widespread metastases at presentation, classified as poor-risk disease. Highlights unusual presentation in younger patients compared to typical postpubertal presentation.

pmid-37951820.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者1016例の患者個別データ分析における新しいリスク層別化の提案。腫瘍サイズ、精巣網浸潤、リンパ管侵襲に基づく3段階リスク群で、5年累積再発確率は低リスク8%、中間リスク20%、高リスク44%を報告。
pmid-37951820.summary_en: Individual patient data analysis of 1016 stage I seminoma patients identifying prognostic factors. Proposes new risk stratification based on tumor size, rete testis invasion, and lymphovascular invasion with 5-year relapse probabilities: low-risk 8%, intermediate 20%, high-risk 44%.

pmid-37947355.summary_ja: 思春期・若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍管理に関する総説。治療成績の50年間での劇的改善（25%から80%）と化学療法耐性疾患への対応を論述。
pmid-37947355.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular GCT management in adolescents and young adults. Discusses treatment advances improving cure rates from 25% in 1970s to nearly 80%. Addresses toxicity, relapsed disease, and platinum-refractory disease management.

pmid-37946365.summary_ja: 思春期前精巣の成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な混合型の18ヶ月男児症例。AFP上昇。思春期前での成熟奇形腫との組み合わせは報告例が極めて少ない。
pmid-37946365.summary_en: Case of 18-month-old with prepubertal testicular mixed teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Elevated serum AFP (2200 ng/ml). Rare combination of mature teratoma with yolk sac tumor in prepubertal testis with only one prior published case.

pmid-37944943.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫と後腹膜リンパ節転移に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の日本初報告。小侵襲手術の安全性と有効性を示す。
pmid-37944943.summary_en: First reported robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-RPLND) in Japan for 32-year-old with testicular teratoma and para-aortic lymph node metastases. Demonstrates R-RPLND as safe and effective minimally invasive alternative to open RPLND.

pmid-37932157.summary_ja: マーカー陰性ステージIIA/Bの精巣胚細胞腫瘍24名でマイクロRNA-371a-3pによるリンパ節転移予測を検証。感度90.9%、陽性適中率100%。不必要な治療回避に有用。
pmid-37932157.summary_en: Evaluates miR-371a-3p predictive accuracy in 24 marker-negative stage IIA/B TGCT patients for identifying lymph node metastases. miR371 showed 90.9% sensitivity and 100% positive predictive value, useful for avoiding unnecessary treatment and associated toxicity.

pmid-37921603.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍30名の導入化学療法に関する研究。内胚葉腺腫瘍と顆粒層膜細胞腫が大多数。42ヶ月で67%が無病生存。18名で生殖温存手術施行。
pmid-37921603.summary_en: Retrospective study of 30 malignant ovarian GCT patients receiving neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Majority had endodermal sinus tumor or dysgerminoma. 67% disease-free survivors at median 42-month follow-up with successful fertility-sparing surgery in 18 patients.

pmid-37916954.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の液体生検バイオマーカーとしてのマイクロRNAのレビュー。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではmiR-371a-3pが臨床応用の最終段階に。
pmid-37916954.summary_en: Reviews microRNAs as liquid biopsy biomarkers for genitourinary malignancies. Testicular GCTs have specific target miR-371a-3p with high sensitivity and specificity, approaching clinical implementation. Other GU cancers remain in earlier biomarker development stages.

pmid-37915108.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍80名の化学療法267サイクル分析。高年齢、腎機能低下、第1サイクルが発熱性好中球減少症の独立予測因子として同定。
pmid-37915108.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 80 advanced GCT patients (267 chemotherapy cycles). Identified older age (≥36 years), renal dysfunction (CCr <70), and first chemotherapy cycle as independent predictive factors for febrile neutropenia (15% incidence).

pmid-37898912.summary_ja: 小児頭外胚細胞腫瘍20名でマイクロRNA9種を検討。miR367、371、372、373、302dの臨床的有用性を確認。miR375-3pは悪性GCTと奇形腫で発現なし。
pmid-37898912.summary_en: Study of 20 pediatric extracranial GCT cases examining 9 microRNAs (clusters 302/367, 371-373, 375). miR 367, 371, 372, 373, 302d showed high clinical utility for malignant GCT diagnosis and monitoring. miR 375-3p not expressed in malignant GCT or teratomas.

pmid-37891379.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞のシスプラチン高感受性の分子メカニズムを検証。p53誘導、プロアポトーティックタンパク上昇、ミトコンドリア・Fas/FasL経路の二重活性化を確認。
pmid-37891379.summary_en: Investigates cisplatin-induced apoptotic pathways in testicular GCT cells versus cisplatin-resistant bladder cancer cells. Shows p53 induction, elevated pro-apoptotic Bax/Noxa, and dual mitochondrial and Fas/FasL-mediated apoptotic activation explaining unique cisplatin sensitivity of testicular GCT.

pmid-37882676.summary_ja: 化学療法耐性GTN患者4名に対するイピリムマブとニボルマブ併用試験。奏効率75%。6ヶ月無増悪生存率75%。毒性は忍容範囲内。
pmid-37882676.summary_en: Phase II trial of dual checkpoint blockade (ipilimumab plus nivolumab) in 4 patients with chemotherapy-refractory GTN. Overall response rate 75% (1 CR, 2 PRs) in gestational choriocarcinoma and malignant GTN. 6-month PFS 75% with manageable toxicity profile.

pmid-37881832.summary_ja: KLHL11抗体関連腫瘍随伴神経症候群の症例報告。精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連する新規バイオマーカー。小脳・脳幹病変と早期治療の重要性を論述。
pmid-37881832.summary_en: Case report of KLHL11 antibody-associated paraneoplastic encephalomyelitis. KLHL11 recently identified as biomarker for paraneoplastic neurological syndromes in GCT patients, particularly seminoma. Reviews cerebellar and brainstem involvement with emphasis on early diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-37872125.summary_ja: 南アフリカの小児成熟奇形腫60名と未熟奇形腫40名の転帰研究（1990-2015）。5年生存率85.4%、ステージに大きく依存。完全切除率高し。標準化ガイドラインの必要性提唱。
pmid-37872125.summary_en: Retrospective study of 60 mature and 40 immature extracranial teratoma cases in South African children (1990-2015). 5-year overall survival 85.4%, highly stage-dependent (Stage I 96.9%, Stage III 38.9%). High complete resection rates. Highlights need for standardized treatment guidelines.

pmid-37867292.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者12例の一次化学療法におけるエトポシド-アプレピタント相互作用の薬物動態研究。臨床的に関連性のある相互作用なく、両薬剤とも安全に併用でき、AUCおよび最大血漿濃度に影響なし。
pmid-37867292.summary_en: Pharmacokinetic study evaluating etoposide-aprepitant interaction in 12 testicular cancer patients receiving first-line chemotherapy. No clinically relevant interaction was found; AUC and Cmax values were similar with and without aprepitant, confirming safe co-administration of both drugs.

pmid-37857140.summary_ja: 病期I精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者5,743例の大規模後方視的研究。監視および化学療法率は時間とともに増加、RPLND使用は低下。RPLND群は化学療法群と比較してがん特異的死亡率が有意に低い。
pmid-37857140.summary_en: Large retrospective study of 5,743 stage I testicular mixed germ cell tumor patients comparing surveillance versus active treatment (chemotherapy/RPLND). Surveillance and chemotherapy rates increased over time while RPLND use declined. RPLND showed significantly lower cancer-specific mortality than chemotherapy in active treatment cohorts.

pmid-37853749.summary_ja: 56例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者（男性60%、女性40%）の臨床病理学的分析。一般的な部位：縦隔（45%）、仙骨尾骨部（18%）、後腹膜（14%）。組織型は成熟奇形腫（34%）、混合型胚細胞腫瘍（27%）、セミノーマ/ジャーミノーマ（12%）を含む。白金製剤併用化学療法は有意に予後を改善した。
pmid-37853749.summary_en: Clinical-pathological analysis of 56 extragonadal germ cell tumor cases (60% male, 40% female). Common sites: mediastinum (45%), sacrococcyx (18%), retroperitoneum (14%). Histologies included mature teratoma (34%), mixed germ cell tumor (27%), seminoma/germinoma (12%), yolk sac tumor (11%). Platinum-based chemotherapy significantly improved outcomes.

pmid-37839891.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の腹腔内播種後、26年後にダグラス窩に再発した症例。腹腔内溢出物の完全な除去の重要性を強調し、再発予防の手術技法を提唱。
pmid-37839891.summary_en: Case report of benign mature teratoma recurrence in pouch of Douglas 26 years after bilateral ovarian cystectomy. Recurrent lesion was firmly adherent to peritoneal tissues despite normal ovaries. Emphasizes importance of intraoperative irrigation to remove spilled tumor contents and prevent extragonadal recurrence.

pmid-37827125.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜疾患の国家・国際的管理における連携のレビュー。専門センター設置と組織的管理体制が良好な予後に直結。国際的協力が治療プロトコル最適化と生存率向上に不可欠。
pmid-37827125.summary_en: Review of national and international collaboration in gestational trophoblastic disease management. Established expert GTD centers and organized national systems achieve superior disease outcomes. Emphasizes importance of international collaboration for optimizing management protocols and improving survival rates across income levels.

pmid-37820296.summary_ja: 思春期および若年成人における胚細胞腫瘍（精巣および卵巣）は最も一般的な悪性腫瘍。シスプラチン併用化学療法で優れた転帰を達成するが、晩期有害事象軽減のため新治療法開発が急務。悪性胚細胞腫瘍国際コンソーシアムが16か国115名以上専門家参加、分子的リスク層別化と精密腫瘍学試験を展開中。
pmid-37820296.summary_en: Comprehensive review of adolescent and young adult germ cell tumors (testicular and ovarian), the most common malignancies in this age group. Discusses innovations including collaborative clinical trials across pediatric/gynecologic/genitourinary specialties, molecular risk stratification, and precision oncology. The Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium coordinates efforts across 16 countries and 115+ experts.

pmid-37819776.summary_ja: セミノーマ stage IIA の治療戦略（RPLND、化学療法、放射線療法）の費用対効果分析。RPLND が最も費用対効果的。放射線療法と化学療法は高コストと慢性毒性による利益喪失が大きい。
pmid-37819776.summary_en: Cost-effectiveness analysis comparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), radiotherapy, and chemotherapy for stage IIA seminoma. RPLND was most cost-effective at lifetime horizon ($58,469/patient, 40.61 QALYs) versus radiotherapy ($98,783, 40.70 QALYs) and chemotherapy ($104,096, 39.15 QALYs). RPLND advantage driven by lower toxicity-related costs.

pmid-37798961.summary_ja: 新生児眼窩奇形腫に対する眼窩摘出術の長期管理症例。眼窩尖端での骨硬化症と副鼻腔の過度な気化を4年にわたり観察。発育過程での複雑な骨変化を示唆。
pmid-37798961.summary_en: Case report of neonatal orbital teratoma management via lid and conjunctiva-sparing orbital exenteration with temporalis muscle rotation and dermis-fat graft. Sequential postoperative imaging over 4 years showed progressive hyperostosis in orbital apex and over-pneumatization of paranasal sinuses, demonstrating complex developmental bony changes.

pmid-37793425.summary_ja: アイルランドの仙骨尾骨奇形腫29例の研究。成熟奇形腫76%、未熟奇形腫7%、悪性腫瘍17%。Type IV が28% と Altman 分類より頻度が高く、再評価の必要性を提案。
pmid-37793425.summary_en: Retrospective study of 29 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients in Ireland (2004-2020), predominantly female (79%). Histology: 22 mature (76%), 2 immature (7%), 5 malignant (17%). Type IV (completely presacral) lesions present in 28% versus 10% in Altman's original series, suggesting Type IV prevalence may be underestimated.

pmid-37792634.summary_ja: 精巣精子細胞腫瘍27例のゲノム解析。2つのサブグループ（diploid RAS/RAF変異型と核分裂相変化型）を同定。悪性転帰は TP53 変異と 12p 領域のゲイン関連で、肉腫様転化と関連。
pmid-37792634.summary_en: Genomic analysis of 27 spermatocytic tumor samples identifying molecular features predicting aggressive behavior. Found two genomic subgroups: diploid with RAS/RAF hotspot mutations and ploidy-shifted without recurrent mutations. Aggressive behavior associated with TP53 mutations and 12p gains; sarcomatoid transformation linked to TP53 mutations.

pmid-37737565.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者70人（中央値22.5歳）の妊孕性温存手術後方視的研究（フォローアップ92ヶ月）。未熟奇形腫が最多（32.9%）、両側侵襲稀（1.4%）。5年無病生存/全生存期間(全生存率)：未熟奇形腫91.1%/95.7%、ディスジャーミノーマ94.1%/100%、卵黄嚢82.4%/88.2%。妊娠試行者34人中23人（67.6%）が妊娠成功。
pmid-37737565.summary_en: Retrospective study of 70 fertility-sparing surgery patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, median age 22.5 years (92-month follow-up). Immature teratoma most common (32.9%), bilateral involvement rare (1.4%). 5-year DFS/OS rates: immature teratoma (91.1%/95.7%), dysgerminoma (94.1%/100%), yolk sac (82.4%/88.2%). 67.6% (23/34) attempting conception achieved pregnancy.

pmid-37725930.summary_ja: 胎児心嚢内奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠31週で腫瘍著明増大、胎児腹水・心嚢液貯留。母体ベタメタゾン投与で改善し、妊娠33週で帝王切開・胎児心臓手術施行。良好な転帰。
pmid-37725930.summary_en: Case report of fetal intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed prenatally in second trimester. At 31 weeks, tumor enlargement with fetal ascites and pericardial effusion prompted delivery planning. Maternal low-dose betamethasone therapy reduced fetal ascites and extended gestation to 33 weeks. Neonate underwent ex utero intrapartum treatment and cardiac surgery with good outcome.

pmid-37717783.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ stage II に対する放射線療法73例の検討。de novo CS-II 38例、再発 CS-II 35例。5年無再発生存率は再発例92%、de novo 例73%。全再発が照射野外で、疾患特異的生存率100%。
pmid-37717783.summary_en: Retrospective review of 73 testicular seminoma patients (CS-II stage) treated with modern radiation therapy (2001-2022). De novo CS-II: 38 patients; relapsed CS-II: 35 patients. 5-year RFS: 92% relapsed versus 73% de novo. All recurrences out-of-field; no in-field failures. Disease-specific survival 100%. Two secondary malignancies noted.

pmid-37707243.summary_ja: 2023年修正版AUAガイドラインで早期精巣がんの診断および治療をまとめた。1980年1月から2023年3月の文献を体系的にレビュー。画像検査、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ管理、臨床病期Iサーベイランス、サバイバーシップをカバー。強度評価（A/B/C）で臨床意思決定をガイド。
pmid-37707243.summary_en: Updated AUA guideline for early-stage testicular cancer diagnosis and treatment (2023 amendment). Systematic literature review (January 1980-March 2023) with evidence-based recommendations. Covers imaging, seminoma and non-seminoma management, stage I surveillance strategies, and survivorship. Strength ratings (A/B/C) guide clinical decision-making.

pmid-37706405.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣嚢胞に対する緊急腹腔鏡下手術48例。成熟奇形腫が最多病理診断。平均手術時間45分、全例成功で胎児母体合併症なし。全例37週以上で妊娠継続。
pmid-37706405.summary_en: Retrospective study of 48 urgent laparoscopic surgeries for ovarian cysts during pregnancy (first/second trimesters). Ovarian torsion most common indication; mature teratoma most frequently identified pathology. Mean operative time 45 minutes with successful completion in all cases, no fetal-maternal complications. All pregnancies continued beyond 37 weeks.

pmid-37696647.summary_ja: III～IV病期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍および混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者40人の後方視的研究。術前化学療法+間隔減量（n=19）対初期減量手術（n=21）。3年DFS/OSに差なし。術前群は出血少ない（328対1286 mL）、輸血量少ない（1044対3067 mL）、周術期合併症少ない。
pmid-37696647.summary_en: Retrospective study of 40 stage III-IV ovarian yolk sac and mixed germ cell tumor patients comparing neoadjuvant chemotherapy + interval debulking (n=19) versus primary debulking surgery (n=21). No difference in 3-year DFS/OS. Neoadjuvant group had less blood loss (328 vs. 1286 mL), lower transfusion needs (1044 vs. 3067 mL), and fewer perioperative complications.

pmid-37683134.summary_ja: デンマーク臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者924人の研究。精巣網侵襲、リンパ管侵襲、上昇β-hCG、LDHが独立的再発予測因子。5年再発リスクはリスク因子なしで6%、全因子合併時で62%。予後モデルは臨床意思決定を改善する可能性。
pmid-37683134.summary_en: Study of 924 Danish patients with clinical stage I seminoma identifies prognostic factors for relapse including rete testis invasion, lymphovascular invasion, and elevated β-hCG and LDH. A prognostic model showed 5-year relapse risk ranging from 6% to 62% based on risk factor combinations, potentially improving clinical decision-making for risk-adapted treatment strategies.

pmid-37673783.summary_ja: 軽度ライディヒ細胞不全を有する精巣がん生存者69人のランダム化研究。低INSL3およびhCG刺激テストステロン患者はテストステロン補充療法後に脂肪量が減少。これらのバイオマーカーはテストステロン置換の恩恵患者を特定するのに役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-37673783.summary_en: Randomized study of 69 testicular cancer survivors with mild Leydig cell insufficiency found that patients with low INSL3 and hCG-stimulated testosterone showed decreased fat mass after testosterone replacement therapy. These biomarkers may help identify which survivors benefit from testosterone substitution therapy.

pmid-37672753.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが後腹膜に転移した患者45人の後方視的症例集積研究。初期後腹膜リンパ節郭清で患者の96%に生存可能な胚細胞腫瘍を認めた。2年無再発生存率は81%（サーベイランス群）。後腹膜再発なく、低容量転移に対する手術の安全性と効果を実証。
pmid-37672753.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 45 patients with testicular seminoma metastatic to retroperitoneum treated with primary nerve-sparing RPLND. Viable seminoma found in 96% of patients; 2-year recurrence-free survival was 81% with surveillance, with no retroperitoneal recurrences, demonstrating safety and efficacy of surgery for low-volume metastases.

pmid-37632231.summary_ja: 精巣GCT細胞由来のmiRNA含有細胞外小胞が腫瘍微小環境に与える影響を検討。miR-371~373とmiR-302/367クラスターが過剰発現。線維芽細胞や内皮細胞への取り込みでコラーゲン収縮と血管新生を促進。
pmid-37632231.summary_en: Study examining microRNA-containing extracellular vesicles released by testicular GCT cells and their effects on tumor microenvironment cells. TGCT cells overexpressed miR-371~373 and miR-302/367 clusters, released in EVs internalized by stromal cells, promoting collagen contraction and angiogenesis, suggesting GCT-stromal cell communication facilitates tumor progression.

pmid-37603038.summary_ja: 654例の男性における妊娠中の母体喫煙暴露(コチニン測定)と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を調査した入れ子型症例対照研究。母体タバコ暴露と子孫におけるリスク間に有意な関連は認められなかった。
pmid-37603038.summary_en: Nested case-control study of 654 males examining maternal smoking exposure (measured by cotinine) during pregnancy and testicular GCC risk. Found no significant association between maternal tobacco exposure and GCC in offspring, though different patterns observed for seminomas vs. nonseminomas. Includes biomarkers from maternal serum and amniotic fluid.

pmid-37599628.summary_ja: 出生前診断された腫瘍51例。仙尾部奇形腫9例を含む。多学際的管理により予後良好。26.1%が新生児集中治療要。中央値60ヶ月追跡で大多数が無病生存。
pmid-37599628.summary_en: 10-year retrospective study of 51 fetuses with prenatally diagnosed tumors including 9 sacrococcygeal teratomas and other masses. Multidisciplinary prenatal management with 26.1% requiring intensive postnatal care. Median 60-month follow-up showed most children alive and disease-free despite 12 with sequelae.

pmid-37539533.summary_ja: 63歳男性の左腹痛で後腹膜腸原性嚢胞および肝胃間膜脂肪織奇形腫を検出。腸原性嚢胞のみ外科的切除施行。奇形腫は主要血管枝近傍に位置するため非切除とした。病理組織学的検査で粘液腺上皮および線毛円柱上皮を確認。
pmid-37539533.summary_en: Case report of 63-year-old male with left abdominal pain found to have retroperitoneal enterogenous cyst and hepatogastric space teratoma. Surgical resection performed for enterogenous cyst. Teratoma not resected due to proximity to major vessels. Histopathology confirmed mucinous and ciliated epithelium consistent with enterogenous cyst.

pmid-37485958.summary_ja: 絨毛膜性疾患（絨毛膜癌、胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍）のSEER解析。年齢40歳以上とFIGO III/IVが独立予後因子。多学際的管理と心理社会的支援が重要。
pmid-37485958.summary_en: Study of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) including choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor using SEER database (1975-2016) and single institution data. Cox regression identified age ≥40 years and FIGO stage III/IV as independent prognostic factors. Multidisciplinary care recommended.

pmid-37468341.summary_ja: 非セミノーマGCT患者45例のPC-RPLNDで放射線医学的特性から病理所見を予測。53%が奇形腫。第一次統計値が有意に相関し、低値が陽性病理と関連。化学療法後の残存病変予測に有用。
pmid-37468341.summary_en: Study of 45 patients with nonseminomatous GCT undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND evaluating radiomic features to predict persistent disease. 53% had teratoma and 4% had viable GCT on pathology. First-order statistics showed significant correlations; lower radiomic signal associated with positive pathology.

pmid-37438222.summary_ja: マーカー陰性臨床病期IIA/Bセミノーマ患者30人を対象とした神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清試験。中央値フォローアップ22ヶ月で、80%がセミノーマ、低い罹患率(13%のClavien-Dindo grade 3a)、10%が再発で全身化学療法により救援。放射線/化学療法への有効な代替法を示す。
pmid-37438222.summary_en: Prospective trial of 30 marker-negative clinical stage IIA/B seminoma patients treated with primary nerve-sparing RPLND. Median follow-up 22 months; 80% had seminoma on histology. Three patients (10%) developed outfield relapse and were salvaged with chemotherapy. Low morbidity (13% Clavien-Dindo grade 3a) provides feasible alternative to radiation or chemotherapy.

pmid-37395935.summary_ja: 精巣GCTサバイバー55例と対照100例のQOL比較。情動・社会・全体スコア低下。悪心、疼痛、呼吸困難、食欲喪失増加。GCT既往の総体的QOL低下を示唆。
pmid-37395935.summary_en: Case-control study of 55 testicular GCT survivors (>2 years disease-free) vs. 100 controls using EORTC QLQ-C30. Survivors had significantly lower emotional, social, and global QOL scores. Greater reported nausea, pain, dyspnea, appetite loss, and financial toxicity. Overall GCT history had detrimental impact on long-term QOL.

pmid-37354024.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者の化学療法前後の精子DNA メチル化追跡。化学療法後6ヶ月で74個の異なるメチル化領域、24ヶ月後17個が持続。胚発生に重要な遺伝子関連領域の異常で、子孫への影響懸念。
pmid-37354024.summary_en: Longitudinal DNA methylation study of cryopreserved sperm from testicular GCT patient before and up to 24 months after BEP chemotherapy. Among 74 DMRs altered at 6 months, 17 remained altered at 24 months. DMRs associated with genes important for embryonic development, raising concerns about potential epigenetic effects on offspring.

pmid-37292006.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍121個の後方視的病理組織学的分析(108件のGCT、89%)。純粋セミノーマが最も一般的(52%)で、35%が混合型GCTであった。リンパ管/血管浸潤(40%)、精巣網浸潤(26%)、門部軟部組織浸潤(8%)が認められ、3cm以上で有意に増加。
pmid-37292006.summary_en: Retrospective histopathological analysis of 121 testicular tumors (108 GCTs, 89%). Pure seminoma was most common (52% of GCTs); 35% were mixed GCTs. Lymphovascular invasion (40%), rete testis invasion (26%), and hilar soft tissue invasion (8%) were common. LVI and rete testis invasion increased significantly with tumor size ≥3 cm.

pmid-37287245.summary_ja: 卵巣複雑嚢胞性腫瘤と大網肥厚、CA125上昇の患者。卵巣質量のFNACは判定困難。大網生検で結晶物質と異物巨細胞反応。卵巣腫瘤は甲状腺組織のみの奇形腫。
pmid-37287245.summary_en: Case report of middle-aged woman with complex ovarian mass, omental thickening, and elevated CA125. Fine needle aspiration from ovarian mass was inconclusive. Omental biopsy showed calcium oxalate crystals with foreign body giant cell reaction. Ovarian mass resection revealed struma ovarii (teratoma with thyroid tissue), with crystals likely from FNA procedure.

pmid-37255420.summary_ja: 胎盤部位結節（PSN）2例の診断基準についての検討。従来基準はAPSN診断に大きさと組織学的特徴を重視するが、細胞増殖マーカーなしでの区別の妥当性を疑問視。
pmid-37255420.summary_en: Case report and discussion of two incidentally identified placental site nodules >10 mm with corded/nested arrangement potentially categorized as atypical PSNs per current criteria. Questions whether size and histologic features alone adequately distinguish APSNs from typical PSNs without increased cellular proliferation markers.

pmid-37246069.summary_ja: 高リスク精巣胚細胞腫瘍男性293人対対照3157人の全エクソムシーケンシングでNIN、QRSL1の機能喪失バリアント特定。有糸分裂/細胞周期、共訳タンパク質標的化、性決定の3経路との関連を示し、多遺伝子遺伝性と治療可能なターゲットを示唆。
pmid-37246069.summary_en: Exome sequencing of 293 high-risk TGCT men (familial or bilateral) vs. 3157 controls identified genes with loss-of-function variants (NIN, QRSL1). Pathway analysis showed associations with mitosis/cell cycle, co-translational protein targeting, and sex differentiation. Results suggest polygenic heritability and identify potentially druggable targets.

pmid-37170541.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣GCT（ジスゲルミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍）のp16過剰発現。Ki67増殖指数と相関。CDK経路の機能不全が悪性卵巣GCT腫瘍発生に関与示唆。
pmid-37170541.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of p16 expression in malignant ovarian GCTs (5 dysgerminomas, 8 immature teratomas, 9 yolk sac tumors) vs. mature teratomas and normal ovary. p16 overexpressed in all malignant GCTs (p<0.001). Cytoplasmic p16 correlated with Ki67 proliferation index, suggesting CDK pathway dysfunction in tumorigenesis.

pmid-37147893.summary_ja: オーストリアの二次学校生徒337人(平均年齢17.3歳)を対象にした男性生殖系統の解剖と精巣がんに関する知識調査。81%が年齢ピークを正しく特定し、54.9%が自己検査の目的を理解した。平均スコア10.4/15で、学校タイプによるバリエーション。精巣がんリスク認識と検診の知識欠陥を浮き彫りにした。
pmid-37147893.summary_en: Survey of 337 Austrian secondary school students (age 17.3 years) on knowledge of male reproductive anatomy and testicular cancer. 81% correctly identified age peak; 54.9% understood purpose of testicular self-examination. Mean score 10.4/15 with variation by school type. Findings highlight knowledge deficits regarding testicular cancer risk and screening.

pmid-37074092.summary_ja: Swyer症候群（46,XY完全性腺形成不全）はGCTのリスク因子。本報告は12歳女性患者における転移性精細胞腫の稀な症例を呈示。この文脈における精細胞腫は46,XY性腺形成不全患者における性腺監視の必要性を強調。
pmid-37074092.summary_en: Swyer syndrome (46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis) confers high risk for germ cell tumor development. This case reports a 12-year-old phenotypic female who developed advanced metastatic seminoma, a rare presentation highlighting the necessity of gonadal monitoring and awareness of GCT risk in this population.

pmid-37046379.summary_ja: 18歳女性の卵巣腫瘤と転移病変。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の高悪性度神経外胚層腫瘍で、分子的特徴は小児性膠芽腫様だがGCT化学療法に著効。正確な分類と治療選択の重要性を示唆。
pmid-37046379.summary_en: An 18-year-old with metastatic ovarian mass showed high-grade neuroectodermal tumor arising within mature cystic teratoma. Molecular analysis resembled pediatric glioma, but the patient achieved excellent response to germ cell tumor chemotherapy, demonstrating importance of accurate classification for optimal therapy selection.

pmid-37015215.summary_ja: 停留精巣と先天性低ゴナドトロピン性性腺機能低下症の関連における精巣がんリスクについてのレビュー。孤立した停留精巣では2～8倍のリスク増加が認められるが、低ゴナドトロピン血症合併では3症例のみの報告で、ゴナドトロピン欠乏がリスク保護因子である可能性を示唆する。
pmid-37015215.summary_en: This review examines testicular cancer risk in undescended testes associated with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism. Contrary to isolated cryptorchidism (2-8 fold increased risk), gonadotropin deficiency may provide protection. Only 3 published cases suggest orchidopexy may be deferred in this specific population.

pmid-36861716.summary_ja: 43歳男性が脊椎傍領域に発生した原始的精細胞腫（極めて稀な部位）を呈示。精巣起源を除外後、extragonadal精細胞腫と診断。化学療法5サイクルで完全寛解を達成し再発なし。
pmid-36861716.summary_en: A 43-year-old male presented with primitive extragonadal seminoma in the paravertebral dorsal region, an exceptionally rare anatomical site. After exclusion of testicular origin, diagnosis of extragonadal seminoma was confirmed. Five cycles of chemotherapy achieved complete remission with no evidence of recurrence.

pmid-36823769.summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌13例の後方視的分析。平均年齢36歳、69%は満期妊娠後。50%で化学療法耐性が発生。このGTD亜型は予後不良と早期転移傾向が特徴で、他のGTNと異なる。
pmid-36823769.summary_en: This bicentric retrospective study analyzed 13 patients with gestational choriocarcinoma (GCC). Median age 36 years; 69% had term pregnancy as antecedent. Chemoresistance occurred in 50%; overall complete response was 69%. GCC exhibits poor prognosis and early metastatic tendency compared to other gestational trophoblastic neoplasias.

pmid-36412989.summary_ja: 19歳男性が下血と高度貧血（Hb 5.8 g/dL）で入院。上部消化管内視鏡で十二指腸潰瘍病変を認識。免疫組織化学はGCTマーカー（CD30、glypican 3、AFP）発現を示唆し、GCTメタスターシスによる消化管出血を確認。
pmid-36412989.summary_en: A 19-year-old male presented with melena and severe anemia (hemoglobin 5.8 g/dL). Endoscopy revealed an ulcerated lesion in the duodenum. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated expression of GCT markers (CD30, glypican 3, alpha-fetoprotein), consistent with metastatic germ cell tumor causing gastrointestinal bleeding.

pmid-36355799.summary_ja: 30週の妊娠中の女性に生じた転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍による自発的気胸の症例報告。ビデオ補助胸腔鏡手術と化学的癒着を実施した。帝王切開後、メトトレキサート化学療法により完全奏効を得た。気胸と流産の既往を有する患者では転移性GTNを考慮すべきことを示す。
pmid-36355799.summary_en: A 25-year-old pregnant woman at 30 weeks presented with spontaneous pneumothorax caused by metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN). Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery with chemical pleurodesis was performed. Histopathology confirmed gestational trophoblastic metastasis with choriocarcinoma features. After cesarean section and methotrexate chemotherapy, complete remission was achieved.

pmid-36200158.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された先天異常の周産期管理に関するエビデンスに基づく総説。胎児仙尾部奇形腫はハイリスク症例として認識。GCT関連腫瘍を含む異常の最適な新生児予後のため、周産期治療施設での管理が強調。
pmid-36200158.summary_en: This evidence-based review addresses perinatal management of prenatally detected congenital anomalies. Sacrococcygeal teratoma with fetal compromise is identified as requiring preterm delivery consideration. Delivery at tertiary centers with surgical capabilities is emphasized for optimizing outcomes in high-risk GCT-related malformations like sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-40406391.summary_ja: 妊娠22週で診断された巨大エピグナスス（口咽頭奇形腫）。MRIで頭蓋内浸潤なし。37+6週でex-utero術式分娩。病理診断は成熟奇形腫を確認。完全切除後、良好な転帰を達成。
pmid-40406391.summary_en: This case describes prenatal diagnosis of giant epignathus (congenital oropharyngeal teratoma) at 22 weeks gestation. MRI confirmed absence of intracranial extension or CNS involvement. Ex-utero intrapartum treatment at 37+6 weeks was performed. Pathology confirmed mature teratoma; complete resection achieved excellent postnatal outcome.

pmid-40041260.summary_ja: 妊娠中の仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）症例で、出生前画像診断でTerminal myelocystoceleとの鑑別困難。妊娠中絶後、病理学的に成熟嚢胞性SCTを確認。出生前診断確認の重要性を示唆。
pmid-40041260.summary_en: This case presents a pregnant woman with fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) where prenatal imaging differentiation from terminal myelocystocele was difficult. After pregnancy termination, histological examination confirmed mature cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma, highlighting importance of histopathologic verification for accurate prenatal diagnosis and prognosis determination.

pmid-39399296.summary_ja: 本システマティックレビューは思春期後停留精巣の管理を悪性腫瘍リスクの観点から検討した。42人の患者において、セミノーマ、奇形腫、及び上皮内癌が最も一般的な悪性腫瘍であった。本レビューは対側精巣の状態、UDT部位、テストステロン値、患者年齢、及び妊孕性温存への関心を考慮した個別化管理を推奨している。
pmid-39399296.summary_en: This systematic review examined post-pubertal undescended testis management focusing on malignancy risk. Among 42 patients, malignancies found included seminoma, teratoma, and carcinoma in situ. The review recommends individualized management considering contralateral testis condition, UDT location, testosterone levels, patient age, and fertility preservation preferences.

pmid-39034120.summary_ja: 32歳男性が性交時の急性陰嚢痛で発症。超音波とMRIで異質性腫瘤を検出。病理診断で混合型GCT（精細胞腫60%、奇形腫20%、胎児癌20%）。1年フォローアップで再発なし。急性陰嚢症での悪性腫瘍の重要性を示唆。
pmid-39034120.summary_en: A 32-year-old male presented with acute scrotal pain during intercourse. Testicular ultrasound and MRI revealed a heterogeneous mass. Pathology confirmed mixed germ cell tumor: seminoma (60%), teratoma (20%), and embryonal carcinoma (20%). One-year follow-up showed no recurrence, highlighting importance of considering malignancy in acute scrotum differential diagnosis.

pmid-38974059.summary_ja: ナイジェリア大学病院の精巣病理検体430例の後方視的研究。精巣萎縮と捻転が大多数だが、16例の悪性腫瘍中6例がセミノーマ。アフリカ人口におけるGCT疫学データを提供。
pmid-38974059.summary_en: This retrospective clinicopathologic study analyzed 430 testicular specimens from a Nigerian tertiary center. While testicular atrophy (76.3%) and torsion (9.8%) dominated, malignancies comprised 3.7% with 6 seminomas (37.5%). The report provides GCT epidemiologic data in an African population, contributing to understanding geographic variations in testicular GCT incidence.

pmid-38807623.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（dermoid cyst）の悪性転化に関する症例報告と文献総説。腺癌と扁平上皮癌の2症例を呈示。稀だが大型腫瘍と中年女性で多く、腫瘍マーカーと術中診断が治療決定に重要。
pmid-38807623.summary_en: This case report and literature review examines malignant transformation in mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts). Two cases are presented: adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. Although rare, malignant transformation occurs more frequently in larger tumors and middle-aged women. Accurate intraoperative diagnosis and tumor marker assessment guide treatment decisions.

pmid-38516509.summary_ja: 妊娠初期の仙尾部奇形腫（Type 2）が12mmから急速増大し、21週で49×37×36mm。男児は38週で帝王切開分娩。生後7日で腫瘍摘出：成熟奇形腫Grade 0で190×160×100 mm、1100g。急速増大にもかかわらず良好な転帰達成。
pmid-38516509.summary_en: This case reports a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma (Type 2) prenatally diagnosed at first trimester (12 mm), progressively enlarging to 49×37×36 mm by 21+6 weeks. The male fetus was delivered by planned cesarean section at 38 weeks. Tumor resection at age 7 days revealed mature teratoma (Grade 0) measuring 190×160×100 mm (1100 g) with excellent outcome.

pmid-38504737.summary_ja: 55歳閉経後女性の大型卵巣dermoidが悪性転化と腸瘻形成で腸閉塞。複数の腸瘻が認められ、子宮全摘、両側卵管卵巣摘出、腸切除施行。悪性奇形腫の破裂と腸瘻形成は極めて稀な合併症。
pmid-38504737.summary_en: A 55-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with large ovarian dermoid complicated by malignant transformation and ileo-dermoid fistula causing intestinal obstruction. Imaging revealed multiple fistulous communications with ileal loops. Management included total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and bowel resection. Rupture and fistulization of malignant teratoma represents an extremely rare complication.

pmid-38298441.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫手術1年後に卵黄嚢腫瘍を発症した24歳女性の症例。術後定期的なサーベイランスにより早期検出が可能であった。手術、化学療法、および生殖能温存により良好な予後が得られた。
pmid-38298441.summary_en: 24-year-old woman with yolk sac tumor developing one year after mature ovarian teratoma surgery. Demonstrates malignant transformation/recurrence following mature teratoma resection. Early detection through routine surveillance, surgical treatment, chemotherapy, and fertility preservation resulted in favorable prognosis.

pmid-38293700.summary_ja: CTテクスチャ解析と機械学習を用いた精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断。精巣腫瘍の良悪性鑑別（AUC 0.946）およびセミノーマ同定（AUC 0.928）に有用。泌尿器科医の診断判断と治療方針決定を支援。
pmid-38293700.summary_en: Machine learning-based CT texture analysis to differentiate benign from malignant testicular masses and identify seminoma in germ cell tumors. Logistics regression model achieved highest AUC (0.946 for benign/malignant, 0.982 for lymphoma, 0.928 for seminoma identification). Non-invasive diagnostic tool supporting clinical decision-making.

pmid-38292387.summary_ja: 18～45歳のTGCT患者454例を対象としたフランス症例対照研究で、親の職業と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討。父親のサービス業や運輸機械職、母親の中等教育職がリスク増加と関連。セミノーマと非セミノーマで関連職業に差異が認められた。
pmid-38292387.summary_en: French case-control study of 454 TGCT cases examining association between parental occupations at birth and adult testicular GCT risk. Paternal jobs as service workers, transport operators, and farmers associated with increased risk; maternal secondary education jobs linked to TGCT risk. Histological differences noted between seminoma and non-seminoma.

pmid-38289807.summary_ja: 出生前30週に診断された巨大仙尾部奇形腫。新生児第3日目の手術切除を実施。手術部位感染にもかかわらず、良好な転帰が得られた。早期診断と迅速な治療管理が予後改善に重要。
pmid-38289807.summary_en: Giant sacrococcygeal teratoma detected at 30 weeks gestation in fetus. Neonatal surgical excision on day 3 of life. Despite surgical site infection, favorable outcome with normal vital signs, bowel, bladder, and lower extremity function. Early diagnosis and prompt management critical for optimal outcomes.

pmid-38289795.summary_ja: 妊娠20週に診断された左付属器未分化奇形腫（stage 1A, grade 2）の26歳女性。妊娠30週時に転移病変が進行。36週で帝王切開と腹腔鏡検査で高悪性度転移性奇形腫を確認。妊娠中の化学療法により良好な予後。
pmid-38289795.summary_en: 26-year-old pregnant woman with immature teratoma stage 1A, grade 2 diagnosed at 20 weeks gestation. Despite counseling, metastasis developed by 30 weeks. Exploratory laparotomy and cesarean section at 36 weeks revealed grade 3 immature teratoma in metastatic mass. Fertility-sparing surgery with chemotherapy during pregnancy achieved good prognosis.

pmid-38283145.summary_ja: Turner症候群患者のリンパ節転移を伴う卵巣ジスジャーミノーマ（stage IIIc）。KIT遺伝子変異（exon 13）と腫瘍微小環境の詳細な解析。化学療法中に多発性脳梗塞を併発。
pmid-38283145.summary_en: 33-year-old woman with Turner syndrome carrying 46,X, del(Xp22.33-11.23) and del(2)(q11.1-11.2) presenting with dysgerminoma stage IIIc with lymphatic metastases. KIT gene mutation identified in exon 13. Robust CD4+ T lymphocyte and PD-1 expression in tumor microenvironment despite poor clinical outcome.

pmid-38281483.summary_ja: Y染色体物質がないターナー症候群の女性患者に転移性ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を認めた。全エクソムおよびRNA解析により、KIT遺伝子の病原性ゲイン・オブ・ファンクション変異とMTOR遺伝子の変異が明らかになった。これまで異形成腺の悪性転化にはY染色体が必須と考えられていたが、本症例はこの理解に疑問を呈する。
pmid-38281483.summary_en: Turner syndrome female with metastatic dysgerminoma without Y-chromosomal material. Whole exome and RNA sequencing revealed pathogenic gain-of-function KIT mutation and MTOR missense mutation. Questioned current understanding that Y-chromosomal material is essential for malignant transformation in dysgenetic gonad. Patient died 7 months post-diagnosis.

pmid-38275829.summary_ja: 左鎖骨下動脈、上大静脈、右肺門を関与する大きな縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍。化学療法への生化学的反応にもかかわらず、画像検査で増大。心臓および胸部外科を含む多学際的外科チームが上大静脈再構築を伴う完全切除を達成。病理検査は関連する横紋筋肉腫を示した。
pmid-38275829.summary_en: Large mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor involving left subclavian artery, superior vena cava, and right lung hilum. Despite biochemical response to chemotherapy, tumor enlarged on imaging. Multidisciplinary surgical team including cardiac and thoracic surgery achieved complete resection with SVC reconstruction. Pathology revealed associated rhabdomyosarcoma.

pmid-38268646.summary_ja: Holt-Oram症候群と仙尾部奇形腫の稀な合併症例（新生児男児）。本論文が初めてのHOS伴随仙尾部奇形腫の報告。仙尾部奇形腫患者には多発先天異常の評価が必須。
pmid-38268646.summary_en: Rare case of Holt-Oram syndrome associated with sacrococcygeal teratoma in male neonate. HOS characterized by upper-limb defects and congenital heart malformation; SCT most common neonatal tumor. First reported case of HOS with SCT. Thorough clinical, laboratory, and radiological evaluation emphasized for SCT patients.

pmid-38259393.summary_ja: サウジアラビアにおける完全胞状奇胎の30年間の臨床像と発生率の変化を検討。発生率は2.1/1000出産から0.9/1000出産に低下。経腟超音波検査の普及により第1三半期での診断が可能となり、古典的臨床症状が減少。
pmid-38259393.summary_en: 30-year retrospective analysis of complete molar pregnancy (CM) trends in Saudi population (121 CM cases: 87 from 2007-2022, 34 from 1992-2006). Incidence declined from 2.1 to 0.9 per 1,000 deliveries. Early transvaginal ultrasound diagnosis shifted presentation from classical second-trimester to first-trimester findings with reduced classic symptoms.

pmid-38239822.summary_ja: 20代後半の以前は健康な男性で、左腕の一次性未分化腫瘍が性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と高悪性度肉腫の両方の特性を有していた。エトポシドおよびシスプラチン化学療法に劇的な反応。フォローアップ不良により肢の切断が必要となった。プラチナベース治療に反応した腫瘍の最初の報告例。
pmid-38239822.summary_en: Previously healthy man in late 20s with primary undifferentiated tumor of left arm showing immunohistological features of both extragonadal germ cell tumor and high-grade sarcoma. Dramatic response to etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy. Poor follow-up led to massive progression requiring limb amputation. First reported tumor with these features responding to platinum-based therapy.

pmid-38234964.summary_ja: 14ヶ月女児の子宮壁一次性卵黄嚢腫瘍。思春期前女児の稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍。手術およびpBEP化学療法により治療。46ヶ月のフォローアップ後、超音波検査と腫瘍マーカー評価を含む。患者は無病で良好な転帰。
pmid-38234964.summary_en: 14-month-old female infant with primary yolk sac tumor of uterine wall. Rare malignant germ cell tumor in prepubertal girls. Treated with surgery and bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin (pBEP) chemotherapy. After 46 months follow-up including ultrasound and tumor markers, patient remains disease-free with favorable outcome.

pmid-38234428.summary_ja: 停留精巣における胚細胞の病因に関する総説。出生前から胚細胞数の減少が明らかで、生後1年以内に急速な低下が見られ、ゴノサイトのクリアランス遅延が起こる。性分化障害や特定の症候群でGCNISが発症する可能性がある。精巣がんの95%以上は胚細胞腫瘍である。
pmid-38234428.summary_en: Review of germ cell pathogenesis in cryptorchid testis regarding infertility and testicular malignancy. Impaired germ cell numbers evident prenatally; rapid decline within first year of life with delayed gonocyte clearance. Germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) may develop in disorders of sexual development and specific syndromes. Over 95% of testicular cancers are germ cell tumors.

pmid-38230600.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した扁平上皮癌（stage IIIA）の50歳女性。最適な初期手術と化学療法が予後改善に重要。不十分な治療により急速に進行し、診断後8ヶ月で死亡。
pmid-38230600.summary_en: 50-year-old postmenopausal woman with stage IIIA squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma. Large pelvic mass with rapid progression after incomplete primary surgery. Secondary debulking and single chemotherapy cycle due to poor performance status. Progressive disease within 4 months; death 8 months post-diagnosis. Demonstrates poor prognosis of advanced-stage malignant transformation.

pmid-38226073.summary_ja: 直腸肛門狭窄を伴うCurrarino症候群7症例の治療。仙骨前腫瘤は成熟奇形腫（6症例）、髄膜瘤（3症例）、脂肪腫（1症例）。奇形腫の切除と狭窄に対する多様な手術術式を実施。臨床転帰改善に治療フローチャート確立が重要。
pmid-38226073.summary_en: Currarino syndrome complicated with anorectal stenosis: 7 cases treated 1998-2021. Presacral masses included mature teratomas (6 cases), meningoceles (3), and lipoma (1). Surgical resection performed for teratomas; duraplasty for meningoceles. Multiple surgical approaches used for stenosis. Pathology showed disorganized smooth muscle and increased collagen.

pmid-38201471.summary_ja: 生後3ヶ月以内に行われた839例の胎児および新生児磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)検査の後方視的レビュー。出生前に76個、生後27個の腫瘍を診断。奇形腫が最も一般的（主に仙尾骨領域）で、次いで心臓横紋筋腫および脳室周囲巨細胞星状細胞腫が続く。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は特性評価と診断に重要で、妊娠および新生児管理を指導する。
pmid-38201471.summary_en: Retrospective MRI review of 839 fetal and postnatal studies performed in first 3 months of life. 76 tumors diagnosed prenatally, 27 postnatally. Teratomas most common (mainly sacrococcygeal), followed by cardiac rhabdomyomas and subependymal giant cell astrocytomas. MRI crucial for characterization and diagnosis guiding pregnancy and neonatal management.

pmid-38201285.summary_ja: SMARCA4変異を有する副鼻腔テラトカルシノサルコーマから派生した最初のインビトロ細胞株(TCS627)。上皮性、間葉性、神経内分泌性および胚細胞成分を有する稀な腫瘍。全エクソンシーケンシングにより99個の体細胞変異を確認。CDK4/6阻害薬パルボシクリブに対する強い反応だが、EZH1/2阻害薬に対する反応は最小限。前臨床治療試験に有用なモデル。
pmid-38201285.summary_en: First in vitro cell line (TCS627) derived from SMARCA4-mutated sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma. Rare tumor with epithelial, mesenchymal, neuroendocrine, and germ cell elements. Whole-exome sequencing revealed 99 somatic mutations. Strong response to CDK4/6 inhibitor palbociclib but minimal response to EZH1/2 inhibitor. Valuable model for preclinical therapeutic testing.

pmid-38190477.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の分子画像診断に関するレビュー章。奇形腫/胚細胞腫瘍、胸腺腫瘍、リンパ腫、および神経原性腫瘍を含む。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は腫瘍の正確な位置、範囲、および血管浸潤を示す。全身陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)または磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の組み合わせは、代謝情報、病期分類、治療計画、および治療後モニタリングを提供する。
pmid-38190477.summary_en: Review chapter on molecular imaging of mediastinal tumors including teratoma/germ cell tumors, thymic tumors, lymphomas, and neurogenic tumors. Cross-sectional imaging (CT, MRI) shows precise tumor location, extent, and vascular involvement. Whole-body PET with CT or MRI provides metabolic information, staging, therapy planning, and post-treatment monitoring.

pmid-38188738.summary_ja: 撤回論文。LRSAM1 E3ユビキチンリガーゼによる絨毛癌の進行と転移、p53/p21シグナルを研究。撤回されたが、絨毛性疾患の腫瘍生物学と分子機序研究に関連。
pmid-38188738.summary_en: Retracted article (DOI: 10.1155/2022/1926605) on choriocarcinoma progression and metastasis via LRSAM1 E3 ubiquitin ligase and p53/p21 signaling. Although retracted from publication record, subject matter remains relevant to gestational trophoblastic disease oncology and molecular mechanistic research.

pmid-38179400.summary_ja: 12歳女児の成熟卵巣奇形種に神経膠腫症が伴った稀な症例。腹水、胸水、CA-125上昇を示した。温存手術により良好な転機を得た。
pmid-38179400.summary_en: Mature ovarian teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei in a 12-year-old girl presenting with ascites, pleural effusion, and elevated CA-125. Gliomatosis peritonei (peritoneal glial nodules) is a rare manifestation of mature ovarian teratomas. Fertility-sparing surgery including salpingo-oophorectomy and peritoneal deposit resection was successful.

pmid-38178954.summary_ja: ジョルダンのがんセンターで治療された241人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（セミノーマ108人、非セミノーマ133人）の後方視的レビュー（2010-2020年）。5年全生存期間は病期Iで98%、病期IIで94%、病期IIIで87%と報告。専門の泌尿生殖器病理医による再審査時の病理不一致率は19.3%で、適切な分類と管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-38178954.summary_en: Retrospective review of 241 testicular germ cell tumor patients (108 seminomas, 133 non-seminomas) from Jordan cancer center (2010-2020). Reported 5-year overall survival rates of 98% (stage I), 94% (stage II), and 87% (stage III). Highlighted 19.3% pathology discrepancy when slides reviewed by expert genitourinary pathologists.

pmid-38173627.summary_ja: 仙尾骨領域に発生した性腺外混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、奇形腫成分に成熟胸腺組織を伴う稀な症例。このような組織学的関連性を呈する症例は初めての報告であり、異所性胚細胞腫瘍における異常な発育所見を代表する重要な臨床的意義を有する症例である。
pmid-38173627.summary_en: Rare extragonadal mixed germ cell tumor of the sacrococcygeal region containing mature thymic tissue within the teratomatous component. First reported case of this specific histopathological association, representing an unusual developmental finding in an ectopic germ cell neoplasm.

pmid-38170094.summary_ja: 35歳不妊男性の同時性両側精巣腫瘍で、各精巣に異なる組織所見を示した稀な症例。両側同時精巣がんは2-3%に過ぎず、組織型の不一致は極めて稀。
pmid-38170094.summary_en: Rare case of 35-year-old infertile male with synchronous bilateral testicular tumors with discordant histopathologies. Bilateral testicular cancer is uncommon (2-3% of cases), with synchronous discordant histology being exceptionally rare, presenting unique diagnostic and management challenges.

pmid-38169855.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者で反復する発作と意識変容を認めた。腫瘍切除と免疫療法への反応は限定的だったが、術後に開始した血漿交換に良好な反応を示し、最適な外科的範囲と追加療法の時期決定の重要性が示唆された。
pmid-38169855.summary_en: Case of ovarian teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis with recurrent seizures and consciousness disturbance. Patient showed limited response to tumor resection and immunotherapy but responded favorably to plasma exchange initiated postoperatively, illustrating importance of optimal surgical extent and timing of additional therapies.

pmid-38155377.summary_ja: 完全および部分奇胎のマイクロRNAプロファイリング研究。10種の差異発現miRNAを同定。妊娠関連栄養膜疾患の診断バイオマーカーと治療標的として有望。
pmid-38155377.summary_en: MicroRNA profiling study of complete and partial hydatidiform moles using next-generation sequencing. Identified 10 differentially expressed miRNAs between moles and control placental tissue, including 5 novel microRNAs. Results suggest potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets for gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-38144531.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの接着分子（β-カテニン、E-カドヘリン、ガレクチン-3）の免疫組織化学的検討。セミノーマではβ-カテニンとE-カドヘリン発現が著明に低下。
pmid-38144531.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of adhesion molecules (β-catenin, E-cadherin, galectin-3) in testicular seminoma compared to normal tissue. Found marked decreased expression of β-catenin and E-cadherin in seminomas, with altered galectin-3 localization, suggesting roles in seminoma carcinogenesis.

pmid-38143997.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞奇形種に角膜、結膜、水晶体などの眼組織が含まれた稀な症例。従来報告では網膜構造が主で、このような眼組織併存は特に珍しい。
pmid-38143997.summary_en: Rare case of mature cystic ovarian teratoma containing ectopic ocular structures including corneal epithelium with goblet cells, conjunctival epithelium, and lenticular tissue. Extremely rare finding of ocular tissue elements, with previous reports limited to retinal structures.

pmid-38138213.summary_ja: 妊娠38週の35歳妊婦の抗NMDA受容体脳炎。けいれん発作、精神症状、幻覚で来院。腰椎穿刺と脳画像で診断。妊娠38週で帝王切開施行。6ヶ月フォローアップで母体の良好な回復と新生児の良好な適応を観察。
pmid-38138213.summary_en: Case of anti-NMDAR encephalitis in 35-week pregnant woman presenting with seizures, psychiatric symptoms, and hallucinations. Diagnosed by lumbar puncture and brain imaging. Patient underwent cesarean section at 38 weeks with excellent maternal recovery and good neonatal adaptation at 6-month follow-up.

pmid-38125762.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍を有する思春期患者34例の多施設10年後方視的研究。性腺外腫瘍18例（縦隔11例、卵巣5例）と頭蓋内腫瘍16例。組織学は未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合悪性腫瘍、胎児性癌、セミノーマ。性腺外腫瘍の生存率62.9%対頭蓋内100%。
pmid-38125762.summary_en: Multicenter 10-year retrospective study of 34 adolescents with malignant germ cell tumors: 18 extragonadal (11 mediastinal, 5 ovarian) and 16 intracranial. Histology included immature teratomas, yolk sac tumors, mixed malignant tumors, embryonal carcinoma, and seminoma. Extragonadal tumors had lower survival (62.9%) versus intracranial (100%).

pmid-38125622.summary_ja: 下腹部痛と膨満感を呈した14歳女児の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍。腫瘍マーカー上昇で診断確認。妊孕性温存手術と補助ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン化学療法で治療。卵黄嚢腫瘍は稀だが悪性の胚細胞腫瘍。
pmid-38125622.summary_en: 14-year-old girl with ovarian yolk sac tumor presenting with abdominal pain and distention. Elevated tumor markers confirmed diagnosis. Treated with fertility-sparing surgery and adjuvant bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin chemotherapy. Yolk sac tumors are rare but highly malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-38123589.summary_ja: セミノーマの単一細胞マルチオミックスと空間トランスクリプトミクス解析。セミノーマと始原胚細胞の共通遺伝子発現プログラムを同定。腫瘍微小環境の15種類免疫細胞サブタイプを特徴付け。腫瘍浸潤と遊走促進のTFAP2Cを同定。
pmid-38123589.summary_en: Single-cell multi-omics and spatial transcriptomics analysis of seminoma. Identified gene expression programs shared between seminoma and primordial germ cells. Characterized 15 immune cell subtypes in tumor microenvironment. Identified TFAP2C in promoting tumor invasion and migration.

pmid-38116038.summary_ja: 膵臓ユルクサック腫瘍によるACTH依存性クッシング症候群の成人初報告例。ACTH前駆体の測定でエクトピックACTH症候群と診断。
pmid-38116038.summary_en: First adult case of pancreatic yolk sac tumor causing ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome through ACTH precursor secretion. 27-year-old woman with Cushingoid features and hyperpigmentation. Demonstrates importance of ACTH precursor measurement in ectopic ACTH syndrome diagnosis and distinguishing ectopic from pituitary source.

pmid-38115773.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎は多様な神経精神症状を呈し、ループス症と多発性硬化症に類似する。脳脊髄液分析と画像検査の重要性を強調。卵巣奇形腫および他の潜在性悪性腫瘍のスクリーニングが重要であり、腫瘍摘除により脳炎が寛解する可能性がある。
pmid-38115773.summary_en: Review of anti-NMDAR encephalitis emphasizing diverse neuropsychiatric presentations mimicking lupus and multiple sclerosis. Discusses importance of CSF analysis and imaging. Emphasizes critical need to screen for ovarian teratoma and other occult malignancies, as tumor removal can resolve the encephalitis.

pmid-38115376.summary_ja: 一次性肝ユルクサック腫瘍患者に肝移植を実施。術前TACE、術後化学療法とTRK阻害剤の併用で腫瘍マーカーが正常化し、34ヶ月良好な転機。
pmid-38115376.summary_en: 31-year-old woman with primary hepatic yolk sac tumor with omental metastasis managed with transarterial chemoembolization, orthotopic liver transplantation, and adjuvant chemotherapy with TRK inhibitor larotrectinib. Multimodal therapy normalized elevated AFP (31,132 ng/mL) with sustained remission at 34-month follow-up.

pmid-38111418.summary_ja: 9歳女児の卵巣未分化奇形種（グレード3）で大きな腹部腫瘤として発症。手術と化学療法で治療。小児未分化奇形種の早期診断と多業種治療の重要性を示す。
pmid-38111418.summary_en: 9-year-old girl with grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma presenting as massive abdominal mass. Treated with exploratory laparotomy, debulking surgery, and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Demonstrates importance of early diagnosis and multimodal treatment of immature teratomas in pediatric patients.

pmid-38106706.summary_ja: 双角子宮での絨毛癌による子宮穿孔の稀な症例。5ヶ月無月経で急性腹痛で発症。総子宮切除で治療。妊娠関連栄養膜疾患の早期診断の重要性。
pmid-38106706.summary_en: 22-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma in bicornuate uterus presenting with spontaneous uterine perforation and five months amenorrhea. Imaging showed perforation with tumor. Total abdominal hysterectomy revealed choriocarcinoma with uterine rupture, emphasizing need for timely diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-38106326.summary_ja: 小児奇形種における未分化/成熟の術前鑑別ノモグラムの開発と検証。519例の分析でAUC 0.92、感度80%、特異度90%を達成。
pmid-38106326.summary_en: Development and validation of nomogram for preoperative prediction of immature vs. mature teratomas in children based on clinical and CT features. Analysis of 519 patients identified AFP, age, tumor composition, calcification, and fat as independent risk factors. Nomogram achieved AUC 0.92 with 80% sensitivity and 90% specificity.

pmid-38098935.summary_ja: カリアーニノ症候群における仙骨前腫瘍再発の初報告例。生後1年での初回治療後、成人で再発が判明。Kraske手術で治療し、その後の経過は安定。
pmid-38098935.summary_en: First reported case of recurrent presacral tumor in Currarino syndrome. 52-year-old woman initially treated for Currarino syndrome-associated presacral mass at age 1. Presented with recurrence on imaging requiring Kraske procedure (posterior approach resection). Residual tumor remained stable at annual surveillance.

pmid-38097381.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍に悪性転化し縦隔転移した稀な症例。根治的精巣摘除術、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、およびVAC/IE化学療法で治療された。悪性転化したGCTの重要な臨床例。
pmid-38097381.summary_en: Testicular teratoma is a germ cell tumor that can undergo malignant transformation. This rare case reports transformation of a testicular teratoma into a primitive neuroectodermal tumor with mediastinal metastasis, treated with radical orchiectomy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and VAC/IE chemotherapy.

pmid-34219574.summary_ja: 異なる組織型の両側精巣GCT同時発症の稀な症例。右精巣混合型、左精巣胚細胞癌。精巣温存手術と化学療法で治療。18ヶ月追跡調査で再発なし。
pmid-34219574.summary_en: Rare case of 20-year-old with synchronous bilateral testicular GCTs: right testis with mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma and embryonal carcinoma) and left with embryonal carcinoma. Treated with testis-sparing surgery on left followed by chemotherapy; recurrence-free at 18-month follow-up.

pmid-34730441.summary_ja: 5ヶ月女児の左卵巣成熟奇形腫症例。非胆汁性嘔吐で発症。卵巣温存手術を施行。小児急性腹症の鑑別における卵巣疾患の重要性。
pmid-34730441.summary_en: Case of 5-month-old female with left ovarian grade 1 mature teratoma presenting with fever, abdominal distension, and nonbilious vomiting. Treated with ovary-sparing surgery. Highlights importance of including ovarian pathology in differential diagnosis of infant acute abdomen.

pmid-35188860.summary_ja: 5歳男児の腎原発YST症例。ウィルムス腫瘍と誤診。AFP検査と病理鑑別の重要性を強調。組織学的・画像学的にウィルムス腫瘍と区別困難。
pmid-35188860.summary_en: Case report of primary renal yolk sac tumor in 5-year-old initially misdiagnosed as Wilms tumor. Emphasizes importance of serum tumor markers (AFP) and expert pathological review, as renal YST may be indistinguishable from nephroblastoma clinically and radiologically.

pmid-35258404.summary_ja: 小児眼窩原発YST症例。眼球突出と菌状腫瘤として進行。化学療法に良好反応。小児眼窩病変の鑑別診断における重要性を強調。
pmid-35258404.summary_en: Case of primary yolk sac tumor of orbit in young child with aggressive presentation as fungating mass and proptosis. Responds well to systemic chemotherapy. Emphasizes importance of recognizing this rare entity in pediatric orbital pathology.

pmid-35377080.summary_ja: 典型的でない部位（特に大腿）に発生する悪性未分化奇形腫の総説。分類、治療戦略、予後を検討。頭蓋外GCT管理について記載。
pmid-35377080.summary_en: Review of immature teratomas in extragonadal locations, particularly thigh. Discusses pathological classification, atypical presentation sites, treatment strategies, and prognosis for malignant teratomas outside common midline locations.

pmid-35394041.summary_ja: 妊娠初期流産200例調査。21%にGTD検出。部分胞状奇胎42.9%、完全胞状奇胎40.5%、絨毛癌16.5%。組織学的評価の重要性を強調。
pmid-35394041.summary_en: Cross-sectional study of 200 women with first trimester pregnancy loss in Tanzania. Gestational trophoblastic disease identified in 21%: partial hydatidiform mole (42.9%), complete hydatidiform mole (40.5%), choriocarcinoma (16.5%). Highlights routine histopathological evaluation importance.

pmid-35512212.summary_ja: 9歳女児の卵巣悪性混合型GCT。多胎体パターン、非妊娠性絨毛癌、血管形成性間葉系腫瘍成分を伴う。化学療法で完全奏効。28ヶ月フォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-35512212.summary_en: Case of 9-year-old girl with ovarian malignant mixed GCT featuring polyembryoma pattern with numerous embryonal bodies, nongestational choriocarcinoma, and vasculogenic mesenchymal components. Successfully treated with adjuvant chemotherapy; recurrence-free at 28-month follow-up.

pmid-35639370.summary_ja: 子宮頸部YST症例。腸芽葉性分化、腺型優位パターン。HPV関連腺癌由来。体細胞がん由来のYSTの異なる臨床像を示す。
pmid-35639370.summary_en: Case of cervical yolk sac tumor with enteroblastic differentiation and glandular-predominant pattern in 44-year-old woman. HPV-associated adenocarcinoma origin confirmed. Illustrates YST arising from somatic carcinoma.

pmid-35639393.summary_ja: 閉経後女性における卵巣・結腸漿膜YST症例。PTEN、PIK3CA、FGFR2、FBXW7の共通変異同定。YST、子宮内膜様癌、子宮内膜症が共通前駆細胞由来であることを示唆。
pmid-35639393.summary_en: Case of postmenopausal woman with yolk sac tumor in ovary and colon serosa showing molecular evidence of shared mutations in PTEN, PIK3CA, FGFR2, FBXW7. Supports somatic origin theory with shared precursor origin of YST, endometrioid carcinoma, and endometriosis.

pmid-35700382.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外GCTのマイクロRNA発現研究。miR-371-373、miR-302/367、miR-375発現が悪性GCTサブタイプ、未分化奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍識別に有用。診断価値を確立。
pmid-35700382.summary_en: Study of microRNA expression in pediatric extracranial germ cell tumors including malignant subtypes, immature teratomas, and yolk sac tumors. Established diagnostic value of miR-371-373, miR-302/367, and miR-375 for GCT classification.

pmid-35702046.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術と化学療法の後に精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔再発を生じた、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と奇形腫を合併したまれな症例。英語文献で報告された男性例としては8例目である。形態学的特徴と鑑別診断について考察している。
pmid-35702046.summary_en: Rare case of placental site trophoblastic tumor with teratoma in mediastinal recurrence of testicular mixed germ cell tumor post-orchiectomy and chemotherapy. Eighth documented male case. Discusses morphologic features and differential diagnoses.

pmid-35746844.summary_ja: 口腔・咽頭部の新生児巨大奇形腫と口蓋裂の症例報告。気道閉塞と呼吸窮迫を呈し、緊急手術で対応。新生児奇形腫には即時気道管理と摘出が重要。
pmid-35746844.summary_en: Case report of neonatal giant teratoma in oral cavity and oropharynx with cleft palate causing airway obstruction and respiratory distress. Demonstrates successful emergency surgical management via orotracheal intubation and immediate tumor resection.

pmid-35749581.summary_ja: 10-29歳の卵巣熟嚢胞性奇形腫患者372例における手術方法別の再発パターン研究。嚢胞摘出法vs卵巣摘出法で5年再発率11.2% vs 20.3%。腫瘍サイズと両側性が再発予測因子。
pmid-35749581.summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 372 young women (ages 10-29) with ovarian mature cystic teratoma comparing cystectomy vs oophorectomy outcomes. 5-year cumulative recurrence rates 11.2% vs 20.3%; large tumor size and bilaterality predicted recurrence after cystectomy.

pmid-35840444.summary_ja: GCNIS、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的な最新情報。免疫組織化学による診断と、12p増幅に基づく層別化を含むAJCC分類の変更点を解説している。
pmid-35840444.summary_en: Comprehensive update on testicular germ cell tumors including GCNIS precursor, seminomas, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and teratoma. Reviews immunohistochemical diagnosis and AJCC classification changes including 12p amplification-based stratification.

pmid-35915559.summary_ja: 病期II胚細胞腫瘍の患者66例に、初回治療として開腹または腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を実施した前向き研究である。化学療法や放射線療法の代替として位置づけられている。中央値29か月の追跡で77.4%が無再発であった。腹腔鏡下アプローチは、入院期間の短縮および合併症の低減と関連していた。
pmid-35915559.summary_en: Prospective study of 66 stage II GCT patients undergoing primary open or laparoscopic RPLND as alternative to chemotherapy/radiation. Overall 77.4% recurrence-free rate at median 29-month follow-up; laparoscopic approach associated with shorter hospital stay and lower complications.

pmid-35930290.summary_ja: 男性生殖器系癌のマイクロRNAバイオマーカーの総説。精巣生殖細胞腫瘍ではmiRNA-371a-3pが臨床応用に向けて進んでおり、診断、リスク層別化、治療モニタリングで期待されている。
pmid-35930290.summary_en: Comprehensive review of microRNA (miRNA) biomarkers in male reproductive tract cancers including testicular GCTs. Highlights that miRNA-371a-3p for testicular GCTs is universally accepted and moving toward clinical implementation for diagnosis and treatment monitoring.

pmid-36031470.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ生殖細胞腫瘍の化学療法後RPLND 151例の大規模前向き研究。腹腔鏡法は手術時間中央値208分、合併症率6%、追跡期間中央値22ヶ月での無再発生存率77.4%で安全かつ有効である。
pmid-36031470.summary_en: Large prospective series of 151 post-chemotherapy laparoscopic RPLND for nonseminomatous GCTs with residual masses. Median operative time 208 minutes, 6% complication rate, 77.4% recurrence-free survival at median 22-month follow-up, demonstrating safety and efficacy.

pmid-36037258.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマの転移に対する初回腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を、仰臥位および側臥位の両アプローチで実施できることを示した症例集積である。2例において、手術時間は150〜210分、退院は48時間後であった。開腹手術と比べて手術時間の短縮と罹患率の低減が示されている。
pmid-36037258.summary_en: Case series demonstrating feasibility of primary laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for pure seminoma metastasis using supine and lateral approaches. Shows shorter operative time and reduced morbidity compared to open surgery.

pmid-36044302.summary_ja: 若年女性にみられた卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告と文献レビュー。異常に顕著な胚様体(ポリエンブリオーマ様の像)を呈し、組織形態学、免疫組織化学、FISH解析で評価している。
pmid-36044302.summary_en: Case report and literature review of ovarian malignant mixed germ cell tumor with unusual prominent embryoid bodies (polyembryoma pattern) in a young woman. Includes histomorphologic, immunohistochemical, and FISH analyses.

pmid-36059277.summary_ja: 2008～2016年のドイツと米国における性腺胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ、非セミノーマ、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍)の発生率を男女間で比較した疫学研究。男性優位、女性でより早い年齢ピーク、Y染色体に関連する病因の違いについて考察している。
pmid-36059277.summary_en: Epidemiological comparison of gonadal germ cell tumor incidence (seminoma, nonseminoma, teratoma, yolk sac tumor) between males and females in Germany and US (2008-2016). Shows male predominance, earlier female age peak, and discusses gender-specific pathogenesis related to Y-chromosome.

pmid-36088223.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的な総説であり、良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫とその悪性の変異型を含めて扱っている。臨床病理学的特徴、免疫組織化学的診断、上皮性腫瘍および性索腫瘍との鑑別診断について論じている。
pmid-36088223.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian germ cell tumors encompassing benign mature cystic teratomas and malignant variants. Discusses clinicopathologic features, immunohistochemical diagnosis, and differential diagnosis with epithelial and sex cord-stromal tumors.

pmid-36103044.summary_ja: 71例の精巣がん患者を対象とし、家族歴や精巣異形成症候群などの疫学的危険因子と、腫瘍ステージおよび進行との関連を検討した研究である。危険因子を有する患者では無増悪生存期間が有意に短く、家族歴と精巣異形成症候群は進行の独立した予後不良因子であった。
pmid-36103044.summary_en: Study of 71 testicular cancer patients examining epidemiological risk factors including family history and testicular dysgenesis syndrome. These factors correlated with advanced stage and worse progression-free survival, with family history and dysgenesis syndrome identified as independent adverse prognostic factors.

pmid-36106577.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に対するボリノスタット（ヒストン脱アセチラーゼ阻害剤）の治療効果を検証。細胞株・マウス移植モデルでIC50～1μM、フェロプトーシス関連遺伝子を抑制。難治性絨毛癌患者への治療選択肢になる可能性を示唆。
pmid-36106577.summary_en: Drug screening study identifying vorinostat (histone deacetylase inhibitor) as therapeutic candidate for choriocarcinoma using cell lines and tumor-bearing mouse models. Vorinostat inhibited cell growth at IC50~1μM and suppressed ferroptosis-related genes (GPX4, NRF2) both in vitro and in vivo. Suggests vorinostat could be effective for treatment-resistant choriocarcinoma patients.

pmid-36112277.summary_ja: 45歳男性の両側性感音難聴、めまい、進行性運動失調を呈した抗KLHL11傍腫瘍症候群の症例報告である。画像検査の再評価で縦隔の小さな腫瘤が同定され、精巣外セミノーマと診断された。この症候群とセミノーマとの強い関連を示し、未診断の胚細胞腫瘍の綿密な検索の必要性を強調している。
pmid-36112277.summary_en: Case report of 45-year-old man with anti-KLHL11 paraneoplastic rhombencephalitis presenting with bilateral sensorineural hearing loss, vertigo, and ataxia. Thorough imaging search identified small mediastinal extragonadal seminoma. Demonstrates strong association between anti-KLHL11 syndrome and seminoma, emphasizing need for careful search for undiagnosed extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-36114758.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫16例（平均嚢胞径7.2cm）の低侵襲手術報告。完全密閉型保護装置を使用。75%に術中破裂あるも漏出なし。手術時間平均1.3時間、出血量12.5ml。全例良性。腹膜炎関連症状なし。平均在院2.4日。新規装置の安全性示唆。
pmid-36114758.summary_en: Case series of 16 ovarian teratoma patients (mean cyst diameter 7.2cm) treated with laparoscopic cystectomy using a totally enclosed protective device. 75% had intraoperative rupture without spillage. Mean operative time 1.3 hours, blood loss 12.5ml. All pathology benign. No peritonitis-related complications. Mean hospital stay 2.4 days. Novel device proved safe and feasible.

pmid-36127201.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫1116例（女性854例77%）の長期機能転帰を37研究から分析。膀胱機能異常はAltman進行期度上昇で増加（Type I：18%→IV：60%）。腸機能障害19%、便秘26%。未分化・悪性腫瘍と再手術が予後悪化に関連。多職種管理の重要性強調。
pmid-36127201.summary_en: Systematic review of 37 studies (1116 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients: 854 female, 77%) analyzing long-term functional outcomes. Abnormal bladder function increased with higher Altman stage (Type I: 18% → Type IV: 60%). Bowel dysfunction in 19%, constipation in 26%. Immature/malignant tumors and reoperations associated with poor functional outcomes. Emphasizes multidisciplinary management importance.

pmid-36128783.summary_ja: 精子細胞腫瘍（精巣GCTの1%）の肉腫様変異例。初回診断は混合型と誤認。肺転移は横紋筋肉腫様所見。肉腫様分化の認識が適切な治療と予後評価に重要。GCT病理診断の困難性を示唆。
pmid-36128783.summary_en: Case report of sarcomatoid spermatocytic tumor, a rare germ cell tumor type (1% of testicular GCTs). Patient initially misdiagnosed as mixed GCT, presented with rhabdomyosarcomatous lung metastases. Illustrates diagnostic challenge of sarcomatoid differentiation in spermatocytic tumors and importance of recognizing this variant for appropriate management and prognosis assessment.

pmid-36136298.summary_ja: 前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン併用化学療法後の切除標本91例を検討し、胸腺上皮の多様な変化を記述した。嚢胞変化、過形成、化生などの所見は残存奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍に類似しうる。治療に伴う胸腺変化を認識し、良性胸腺上皮との連続性を確認することで誤診を避けることができると結論づけている。
pmid-36136298.summary_en: Pathology study of 91 anterior mediastinal GCT resections post-cisplatin chemotherapy. Describes spectrum of thymic epithelial alterations (cystic changes, hyperplasia, metaplasia) that can mimic residual teratoma or yolk sac tumor. Recognition of therapy-induced thymic changes critical to avoid misdiagnosis. Continuity with benign thymic epithelium aids differentiation.

pmid-36151048.summary_ja: 1981〜2018年に治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者138例の転帰を解析した。5年無増悪生存率は良好予後群、中間予後群、予後不良群でそれぞれ91%、83%、64%であった。予後不良群の5年全生存率は、初期(1981〜99年)の70%から後期(2000〜18年)には85%へ改善した。著者らは、これが有意な治療の進歩を示すと報告している。
pmid-36151048.summary_en: Outcomes analysis of 138 non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT) patients treated 1981-2018. Good/intermediate/poor prognosis groups showed 5-year progression-free survival of 91%/83%/64% and overall survival of 97%/89%/82%. Poor-prognosis group 5-year overall survival improved from 70% (1981-99) to 85% (2000-18), demonstrating significant therapeutic advances.

pmid-36168917.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)患者18例、GCNIS単独の患者5例、対照25例の精漿を小RNAシーケンシングで解析した。TGCTおよびGCNIS患者では6種の細菌・ウイルス種が対照より有意に高値であった一方、Streptomyces phage VWBは低値であった。精漿マイクロバイオームがTGCTの発症に関与する可能性を示した初めての報告である。
pmid-36168917.summary_en: Study of seminal plasma microbiome in 18 testicular GCT (TGCT) patients, 5 GCNIS-only patients, and 25 controls using small RNA sequencing. Six bacterial/viral species were significantly elevated in TGCT/GCNIS patients (Acaryochloris marina, Halovirus HGTV-1, Thermaerobacter marianensis, and others). One species (Streptomyces phage VWB) was reduced. First report suggesting microbiome involvement in TGCT pathogenesis.

pmid-36173552.summary_ja: 脂肪含有付属器腫瘤188例（良性163、悪性25）のMRI解析。未分化奇形腫を含む。悪性腫瘍と良性腫瘤間に腫瘍サイズと脂肪分布パターンに有意差。未分化奇形腫の85.7%が散在脂肪パターン。新規スコアリング有用性を示唆。
pmid-36173552.summary_en: Retrospective MRI study of 188 fat-containing adnexal masses (163 benign, 25 malignant) including immature teratomas. Size measurements and fat distribution patterns differed significantly between malignant and benign lesions. Immature teratomas (85.7%) displayed scattered fat pattern. Incorporating solid tissue volume and fat distribution improved O-RADS MRI scoring for predicting malignancy.

pmid-36183854.summary_ja: 心内腔卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例報告。2.5歳女児。心雑音で発見。心臓MRIで横紋筋腫が疑われたが、組織診断で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確認。血清AFP値上昇が診断を支持。心内腫瘍の鑑別診断に重要。
pmid-36183854.summary_en: Case report of a yolk sac tumor in the right ventricle of a 2.5-year-old girl presenting with cardiac murmur. Imaging suggested rhabdomyoma, but histopathology confirmed yolk sac tumor. Elevated alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) levels supported diagnosis. No evidence of primary tumor elsewhere. Highlights yolk sac tumor as important differential diagnosis for intracardiac masses.

pmid-36191558.summary_ja: 神経芽腫47例と頭蓋外GCT 31例、計78例の小児がん患者を対象に、シスプラチンやカルボプラチンによる聴器毒性を検討した研究である。難聴は13.8〜65.5%の患者に認められ、高周波域で最も顕著であった(16kHzで75.9%)。4つの聴器毒性グレーディングスケールを比較し、特に小児で感度と特異度の改善が必要であることが示された。
pmid-36191558.summary_en: Study of ototoxicity in 78 pediatric cancer patients (47 neuroblastoma, 31 extracranial GCT) treated with ototoxic agents (cisplatin/carboplatin). Hearing loss occurred in 13.8-65.5% of patients, most prominent at high frequencies (75.9% at 16kHz). Comparison of four ototoxicity grading scales showed need for improved sensitivity and specificity, particularly in pediatric populations.

pmid-36209999.summary_ja: 小児・思春期患者691例の卵巣腫瘍中27例に迅速診断実施。悪性度判定の感度44.4%、特異度94.4%。見逃し例に未分化奇形腫を含む。37%の症例で手術判断に影響を与えず。迅速診断の標準化に課題あり。
pmid-36209999.summary_en: Prospective study of frozen section (FS) accuracy for 691 pediatric/adolescent ovarian masses (27 underwent FS; 33.3% malignant). FS sensitivity for malignancy was 44.4% with specificity 94.4%. Missed diagnoses included immature teratoma (1 case), mucinous tumors (3), and serous borderline tumor. FS failed to guide intervention in 37% of cases, raising concerns about utility.

pmid-36218240.summary_ja: 妊娠37-38週女児新生児（体重3290g）の臍帯成熟奇形腫症例。腫瘍は臍帯腹部付着部から10cm離れた位置に8cm大。他の先天異常なし。臍帯奇形腫は臨床的に独立した経過をとる可能性を示唆。
pmid-36218240.summary_en: Case report of a mature teratoma in the umbilical cord of a 37-38 week female newborn weighing 3290g. The 8cm teratoma was located 10cm from the abdominal insertion site. Comprehensive work-up revealed no other congenital abnormalities. Illustrates that mature teratomas can occur in umbilical cord and may have minimal clinical sequelae.

pmid-36218319.summary_ja: カナダ・ノバスコシア州のがん登録に記録された胚細胞腫瘍229例の正確性を、カルテと照合して検証した研究である。病理診断の不一致は7.0%、病期の不一致は17.3%であった。組織型の誤分類と病期の過小評価が主な誤りであった。GCTの病理と病期分類に関する登録担当者への教育の改善が必要であることが示された。
pmid-36218319.summary_en: Registry accuracy study of 229 germ cell tumor (GCT) patients (57.6% seminoma, 34.5% non-seminoma, 7.9% other). Pathology discrepancies occurred in 7.0% and staging discrepancies in 17.3%. Common errors included histological subtype misclassification and understaging. Study highlights critical need for improved training on GCT-specific pathology and staging interpretation.

pmid-36222180.summary_ja: セミノーマ細胞株TCam-2のシスプラチン応答を動的に解析した研究である。高濃度では細胞外経路のアポトーシスが誘導され、低濃度ではG2M期停止と老化様表現型が見られた。老化にはp53、p21、p16の発現上昇が関与していた。シスプラチンに対するセミノーマの感受性の機序に示唆を与えるとされている。
pmid-36222180.summary_en: Study of seminoma (TCam-2 cell line) response to cisplatin using comprehensive dynamic monitoring. High cisplatin concentrations induced extrinsic apoptosis with upregulated Fas/FasL-caspase-8/-3 genes. Lower concentrations caused G2M arrest with senescence phenotype, SA-β-gal positivity, and upregulated p53/p21/p16 genes. Provides mechanistic insights into seminoma cisplatin sensitivity.

pmid-36226665.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫低侵襲手術で倒刺付き縫合糸と従来糸を比較（各40例）。倒刺付き縫合は手術時間（54対68分）と縫合時間（12対20分）が有意に短く、卵巣機能障害は両群同等。
pmid-36226665.summary_en: Comparison of barbed suture versus conventional suture in laparoscopic cystectomy for ovarian mature cystic teratoma (40 patients per group). Barbed suture group had significantly shorter operating time (54 vs 68 minutes) and suturing time (12 vs 20 minutes) without increasing ovarian damage. Anti-Müllerian hormone levels declined equally in both groups postoperatively.

pmid-36229941.summary_ja: 英国での仙尾部奇形腫165例の長期転帰調査。術後36%が膀胱・腸機能障害を発症。再発は7%で中央値13ヶ月に発生。外科腫瘍学、小児泌尿器科、小児大腸科の多職種による統合的管理がQOL向上に必須。
pmid-36229941.summary_en: Long-term outcomes study of 165 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients across 14 UK pediatric surgical oncology centers. 36% developed bladder or bowel dysfunction after surgery. Tumors recurred in 7% at median age 13 months. Multidisciplinary care involving surgical oncology, pediatric urology, and colorectal specialists recommended for optimal functional outcomes.

pmid-36244473.summary_ja: 産前診断された精巣内奇形腫で精巣温存手術が初めて実施された症例報告。従来の6例すべてが精巣全摘術を受けていたが、本報告は精巣組織保存手術の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-36244473.summary_en: First reported case of prenatally diagnosed intrascrotal testicular teratoma treated with testis-sparing surgery. Previous 6 cases of prenatally detected testicular teratomas all underwent orchiectomy; this report introduces tissue-preserving surgical approach.

pmid-36250319.summary_ja: 胎児期に診断された心膜内奇形腫の2症例報告。第1例は胎児死亡、第2例は出生直後の手術により良好な転帰を得た。産前診断と適切な対応の重要性を強調している。
pmid-36250319.summary_en: Case report of two prenatal presentations of intrapericardial teratoma causing hemodynamic complications in fetus. First case resulted in fetal demise; second managed with postnatal surgery with favorable outcome, emphasizing importance of prenatal monitoring.

pmid-36254623.summary_ja: RPLNDにおける生存セミノーマの検出に対するmiR-371a-3pの有用性を評価した。15例(良性6例、セミノーマ9例)を解析した。化学療法未治療例では感度78%、特異度100%を示し、従来の腫瘍マーカーを上回った。
pmid-36254623.summary_en: Study evaluating miR-371a-3p utility for detecting viable seminoma at RPLND. 15 patients evaluated (6 benign, 9 seminoma). miR-371a-3p showed 78% sensitivity and 100% specificity in chemotherapy-naive patients, outperforming conventional tumor markers.

pmid-36255654.summary_ja: 複数がん種におけるCOMP(軟骨オリゴメリックマトリックスタンパク)バイオマーカー価値を検証した研究。精巣胚細胞腫瘍は診断価値(AUC=0.823)が認められ、免疫回避と腫瘍微小環境との相関が示された。
pmid-36255654.summary_en: Pan-cancer study evaluating cartilage oligomeric matrix protein (COMP) as biomarker. Among 16 cancers tested, testicular GCTs showed diagnostic value (AUC=0.823); COMP correlated with immune evasion and tumor microenvironment.

pmid-36288207.summary_ja: シアノトキシンであるマイクロシスチン-LRに曝露したマウス精原細胞において、PI3K/AKT/mTOR経路の活性化を検討した実験研究。この経路が、セミノーマの発生に関連する悪性転化を媒介することが示唆された。
pmid-36288207.summary_en: Experimental study investigating PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway activation in mouse spermatogonia exposed to cyanotoxin microcystin-LR. Results suggest this pathway mediates malignant transformation related to seminoma development.

pmid-36305517.summary_ja: 高年女性の卵巣混合上皮性-胚細胞腫瘍(絨毛癌と粘液腺癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍と内膜様腺癌)の分子解析。両成分で同一の変異が認められ、真の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく体細胞性上皮由来の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-36305517.summary_en: Molecular analysis of two ovarian mixed epithelial-germ cell tumors (choriocarcinoma with mucinous component, yolk sac tumor with endometrioid component) in older women. Identical mutations in both components suggest somatic epithelial origin rather than true GCT.

pmid-36314449.summary_ja: 卵巣粘液癌に卵黄嚢腫瘍様成分を伴う3症例の報告。卵黄嚢腫瘍様成分は全体の5%未満であったが、予後は通常の粘液癌より有意に不良であり、強い予後指標であることが示唆された。
pmid-36314449.summary_en: Report of three ovarian mucinous carcinomas with yolk sac tumor-like components. YST component comprised <5% of tumor. Prognosis significantly worse than conventional mucinous carcinomas, suggesting YST-like component is strong prognostic indicator.

pmid-36328575.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連する抗NMDAR抗体陰性脳炎2例の治療報告。抗体は陰性であったが、腫瘍摘出と免疫療法により神経症状が改善し、卵巣奇形腫との密接な関連が示唆された。
pmid-36328575.summary_en: Two cases of anti-NMDAR-negative encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma, successfully treated with tumor resection and immunotherapy. Despite negative anti-NMDAR antibodies, close association between neurological disease and ovarian teratoma demonstrated.

pmid-36345463.summary_ja: 停留精巣の合併症を論じた症例報告と文献的考察である。未下降精巣に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍が捻転・破裂し、傍腫瘍症候群であるNMDA受容体脳炎とgrowing teratoma syndromeを呈した症例が示された。停留精巣の胚細胞腫瘍では、悪性化以外にも捻転や破裂などの稀な合併症が起こりうることが指摘されている。
pmid-36345463.summary_en: Case report and literature review of cryptorchidism complications. Describes rare complications of cryptorchid testicular GCT including torsion, rupture, and paraneoplastic syndrome (NMDA encephalitis) associated with mixed GCT of undescended testis with growing teratoma syndrome.

pmid-36368863.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と性索間質腫瘍のMR画像診断に関する総説。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(脂肪成分)と他のGCT新生物の画像特性について述べ、良性と悪性の鑑別に有用な所見を解説している。
pmid-36368863.summary_en: Review of MR imaging features of ovarian germ cell and sex cord stromal tumors. Discusses characteristics of mature cystic teratomas (fat on MR) and other GCT neoplasms with imaging features useful for distinguishing benign from potentially malignant lesions.

pmid-36372627.summary_ja: 臨床病期IIA/Bの精巣セミノーマに対する原発性RPLNDのPRIMETEST第II相試験。33例が登録され、追跡期間中央値32か月で30%に再発が認められ、主要評価項目(30%未満)は達成されなかった。高度に選択された患者には有益である可能性が示唆されたが、選択基準の検証が必要である。
pmid-36372627.summary_en: PRIMETEST phase 2 trial of primary RPLND in seminomatous TGCT (clinical stage IIA/B). 33 patients accrued; 30% experienced recurrence at 32-month median follow-up, not meeting the <30% primary endpoint. Results suggest potential benefit for highly selected patients but require validated selection criteria.

pmid-36373757.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と経過観察におけるマイクロRNA(特にmiR-371a-3p)バイオマーカーの臨床応用に関する総説。従来のマーカー(AFP、hCG)の限界とマイクロRNAの有用性について論じている。
pmid-36373757.summary_en: Review of microRNA biomarkers, particularly miR-371a-3p, for testicular GCT diagnosis and surveillance. Discusses limitations of current markers (AFP, hCG) and the promise of miRNA in discriminating TGCT presence with improved sensitivity and specificity.

pmid-36379869.summary_ja: 12件の研究(835例)を対象としたシステマティックレビューで、臨床病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する原発性RPLNDの転帰を評価した。78%の患者で病理学的病期IIが確認された。再発率は補助化学療法なしで12～40%、補助化学療法ありで0～4%であった。
pmid-36379869.summary_en: Systematic review of 12 studies (835 men) evaluating outcomes of primary RPLND for clinical stage II nonseminomatous GCT. Pathological stage II confirmed in 78% of patients. Recurrence rates were 12-40% without adjuvant chemotherapy versus 0-4% with chemotherapy.

pmid-36399723.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTN)の化学療法オプションに関する系統的総説。胞状奇胎、流産、異所性妊娠後の治療を含む。多剤併用化学療法、手術、免疫療法について論じており、特に早期診断と専門センター治療での高い寛解率を強調している。
