pmid-37391990.summary_en: Rare case of synchronous tumors: immature teratoma of ovary and carcinoid tumor of appendix in a 30-year-old female. Patient presented with abdominal heaviness and anorexia; imaging and pathology confirmed both diagnoses. Case highlights diagnostic and therapeutic complexity of simultaneous neoplasms and importance of considering this possibility.

pmid-37392170.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のIGCCCG危険度分類における腫瘍マーカー測定時期による誤分類研究。523例中20%が誤分類され治療過剰または過少のリスク。高位結紮術後のマーカー測定の重要性強調。
pmid-37392170.summary_en: Multicenter study examining misclassification errors in IGCCCG risk stratification of metastatic non-seminomatous GCT. Of 523 patients with sufficient marker data, 20% were misclassified using pre-orchiectomy markers; 72 over-treated, 34 under-treated. Emphasizes critical importance of accurate pre-chemotherapy tumor marker (AFP, HCG, LDH) assessment after orchiectomy.

pmid-37395743.summary_ja: 31歳女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌（高細胞型）の稀な症例。これまでstruma ovarii内の乳頭状癌は3例のみ報告。60ヵ月の良好経過を示した。
pmid-37395743.summary_en: Unique case of tall cell variant papillary thyroid carcinoma arising within mature cystic teratoma of ovary in 31-year-old female. Only three prior cases of papillary thyroid carcinoma in struma ovarii reported in literature. Cystectomy performed with 60-month uneventful follow-up. Highlights rarity of thyroid malignancy in ovarian teratomas.

pmid-37396795.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫と抗NMDAR抗体に関連するOPOMAS症候群の症例報告。抗体と奇形腫の関連性が複雑だが、ステロイド、血漿交換、奇形腫摘出による治療が有効。
pmid-37396795.summary_en: Two cases of opsoclonus-myoclonus-ataxia syndrome (OMAS) with psychosis associated with ovarian teratoma and/or anti-NMDAR antibodies. First patient had anti-NMDAR antibodies without teratoma; second had teratoma without antibodies. Treatment with steroids, plasma exchange, and surgical teratoma resection achieved favorable outcomes, highlighting immune-mediated mechanisms.

pmid-37398766.summary_ja: 陰嚢外精巣を有する33歳男性に発生したセミノーマの症例報告。腹腔内腫瘤が画像で検出され病理で胚細胞腫瘍と確認。陰嚢外精巣の胚細胞腫瘍リスク増加を示唆。
pmid-37398766.summary_en: Case report of seminoma developing in cryptorchid testis in a 33-year-old male with undescended left testis presenting with abdominal swelling and pain. Imaging and histopathology confirmed testicular germ cell tumor despite intra-abdominal location. Emphasizes dramatically elevated GCT risk in cryptorchidism and importance of clinical recognition.

pmid-37405035.summary_ja: 精巣がんの初回治療から18年後に、体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う奇形腫の後腹膜リンパ節転移が生じた1例の報告。46歳男性で傍大動脈領域に15mmの腫瘤を認め、腹腔鏡下に切除された。病理学的には体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う奇形腫であり、原発巣は卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断されていた。長期的な監視の必要性が示された。
pmid-37405035.summary_en: Case of late relapse with teratoma containing somatic-type malignancy in retroperitoneal lymph node 18 years after initial testicular cancer treatment. A 46-year-old male with 15 mm para-aortic mass underwent successful laparoscopic resection; pathology showed somatic-type malignancy despite original primary being yolk sac tumor, illustrating need for long-term surveillance.

pmid-37406535.summary_ja: 16歳男性の縦隔に生じ、右心房と右心室に浸潤した混合型胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、成熟奇形腫)の症例報告。右室流出路の閉塞により心原性ショックを来し、緊急の外科的切除と病理組織学的診断が必要であった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は全胚細胞腫瘍の3〜4%を占めるとされる。
pmid-37406535.summary_en: Rare case of mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma, yolk sac tumor, mature teratoma) infiltrating the heart in a 16-year-old male. Extragonadal GCTs comprise 3-4% of all GCTs. Presented with cardiogenic shock from right ventricular outflow tract obstruction, requiring emergency surgical resection and histopathological diagnosis.

pmid-37408671.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する陽子線療法の成績。3年無病生存率90.9%、全生存率100%を達成。陽子線療法は光子療法と比べて臓器線量低下と二次悪性腫瘍リスク低下を示した。
pmid-37408671.summary_en: Study of proton radiation therapy outcomes for stage I-IIB testicular seminoma in 24 patients achieving 90.9% disease-free and 100% overall survival at 3 years. Proton therapy demonstrated significantly lower organ doses to kidneys, stomach, colon, liver, bladder, and reduced secondary malignancy risks compared to photon-based approaches while maintaining excellent cancer control with minimal toxicity.

pmid-37409830.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣がんの精巣摘除術後のフォローアップに関する国際的な診療ガイドラインを比較したシステマティックレビュー。泌尿器科および腫瘍学の学会のガイドラインを検討し、フォローアップの計画や頻度に大きなばらつきがあることを示した。再発リスクのパターンに基づき、標準化されたフォローアップ計画のための統一的な推奨を提案している。
pmid-37409830.summary_en: Systematic review of international clinical practice guidelines for follow-up surveillance after orchidectomy in stage 1 testicular cancer. Compares recommendations from urological and oncology societies, identifying considerable variability in follow-up schedules and intensity based on recurrence risk patterns. Proposes unified evidence-based surveillance protocols for standardized follow-up.

pmid-37410968.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の最適管理に関する総説。化学療法抵抗性の奇形腫を含む残存腫瘤の外科的切除が標準で、組織型により術後管理が異なる。
pmid-37410968.summary_en: Oncology Grand Rounds review of optimal management of metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, emphasizing chemotherapy-resistant teratoma requiring surgical resection. Standard care involves resecting all resectable residual masses after chemotherapy; if only teratoma/necrosis found, surveillance follows. Viable cancer with positive margins warrants adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-37416106.summary_ja: 妊娠14週の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に対する経膣内視鏡手術の初症例。21歳の5.9cm奇形腫を妊娠中に合併症なく切除でき、妊娠中の低侵襲治療の安全性を示した。
pmid-37416106.summary_en: First case of vaginally-assisted natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) for ovarian cystic teratoma in a pregnant woman at 14 weeks gestation. A 21-year-old with 5.9 cm ovarian teratoma underwent successful cystectomy without complications. Demonstrates safety and feasibility of minimally invasive approach for ovarian teratoma management during pregnancy.

pmid-37416320.summary_ja: 嚢胞内脂肪がない成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。歯と石灰化などの特徴があるも脂肪がないため診断困難で、捻転が発症。診断上の困難性を示唆。
pmid-37416320.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma lacking visible intratumoral fat, presenting diagnostic imaging challenges. Despite characteristic features (teeth, calcification), absence of fat complicated diagnosis. Tumor underwent torsion, demonstrating important complication potential and diagnostic implications of unusual imaging presentations in benign mature teratomas.

pmid-37416752.summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍（未熟奇形腫と胚細胞新生物を伴う非セミノーマ）が副腎腫瘍と誤診された症例。30歳男性の15cm後腹膜腫瘤は未熟奇形腫で、腹腔鏡下副腎摘出と病理診断で確認。
pmid-37416752.summary_en: Case of extragonadal germ cell tumor (non-seminoma with immature teratoma and germ cell neoplasm in situ) initially misdiagnosed as left adrenal tumor in a 30-year-old male. Fifteen-cm retroperitoneal mass with calcification showed well-defined boundaries from adrenal gland. Laparoscopic adrenalectomy with histopathological confirmation of germ cell origin.

pmid-37425586.summary_ja: 胚細胞癌に対するBEP化学療法中に心筋梗塞を発症した32歳男性の症例。化学療法の心毒性が問題で、他の危険因子がない中での重要な有害事象を示唆。
pmid-37425586.summary_en: Case report of myocardial infarction in a 32-year-old male receiving bleomycin-etoposide-cisplatin (PEB) chemotherapy for embryonal carcinoma. Cardiac event attributed to chemotherapy cardiotoxicity in absence of conventional risk factors. Highlights critical adverse effect of cancer treatment regimen in germ cell tumor patients requiring monitoring.

pmid-37427129.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む卵巣腫瘍を超音波画像からディープラーニングモデルで分類する研究。ResNext50は7組織型を95.2%精度で分類し、高度漿液性癌では感度90%・特異度99.2%を達成。コンピュータ支援診断の有用性を実証した。
pmid-37427129.summary_en: Deep convolutional neural networks effectively classify ovarian tumors from ultrasound images including mature cystic teratoma and high-grade serous carcinoma among seven histologic categories. ResNext50 model achieved 95.2% overall accuracy with 90% sensitivity and 99.2% specificity for high-grade serous carcinoma. Results demonstrate promising computer-aided diagnostic capability.

pmid-37427132.summary_ja: シスプラチン化学療法25年後の後腹膜奇形腫の悪性転化による転移性肝癌の症例報告。遺伝子解析でシスプラチン耐性に関連する可能性のある遺伝子変異を同定した。
pmid-37427132.summary_en: Case report of possible malignant transformation of teratoma to metastatic liver cancer following cisplatin-based chemotherapy 25 years earlier. Genetic analysis using Tempus gene testing identified variants of unknown significance potentially related to cisplatin resistance.

pmid-37427644.summary_ja: 若年女性にみられた症状を伴う原発性後腹膜成熟奇形腫の症例報告。後腹膜奇形腫は通常、乳児期または成人初期に発症し、多くは傍腎領域に発生する。その起源は、正常な部位へ移動できなかった胚細胞とされる。
pmid-37427644.summary_en: Case report of symptomatic primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma in a young woman. Retroperitoneal teratomas typically present in infancy or early adulthood, usually develop in the pararenal area, and originate from germ cells that failed to migrate.

pmid-37433861.summary_ja: 韓国国民健康保険データベースを用いた生殖腺奇形腫とてんかんリスク関連性を調査した後向きコホート研究。卵巣奇形腫は特に悪性転化で高いてんかんリスクと関連していた。
pmid-37433861.summary_en: Nationwide population-based cohort study using Korean National Health Insurance database investigating epilepsy risk in gonadal teratoma. Ovarian teratoma associated with increased epilepsy risk, especially with malignant transformation; testicular teratoma showed no significant association.

pmid-37448530.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が扁平上皮癌および紡錘形細胞肉腫に悪性転化した36歳女性の症例。包括的な病期診断と化学療法を受け、追跡調査で再発なし。
pmid-37448530.summary_en: Case report of 36-year-old woman with malignant transformation of mature ovarian teratoma to squamous cell carcinoma and spindle cell sarcoma. Underwent comprehensive staging surgery and chemotherapy with no recurrence at follow-up.

pmid-37449938.summary_ja: 小児および若年成人の細胞外生殖細胞腫瘍に関するCOG 2023研究方針。危険度層別化、最小残存病変検出、分子的理解、生物学的標的治療開発が重要な課題として述べられている。
pmid-37449938.summary_en: COG 2023 research blueprint on extracranial GCTs in children, adolescents, and young adults. Addresses unmet needs including patient stratification, minimal residual disease detection, molecular understanding, biology-driven therapy development, and late effects assessment.

pmid-37450654.summary_ja: 白金製剤による化学療法を受けた精巣がん患者を対象に、高強度インターバルトレーニング参加者の血栓塞栓イベント発生率を調べた後方視的コホート研究。HIIT実施中およびその後の血栓塞栓イベント発生率は低かった。
pmid-37450654.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study examining incidence of thromboembolic events in testicular cancer patients undergoing platinum-based chemotherapy who participated in high-intensity interval training. Low thromboembolic event rate observed during and after HIIT participation.

pmid-37452481.summary_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍（生殖細胞腫瘍を含む）の細胞学と組織学の相関に関する研究。混合GCT、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍が若年から中年男性に認められた。
pmid-37452481.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of testicular malignancies on fine-needle aspiration cytology. GCTs were common in young and middle-aged men, including mixed GCTs, seminomas, and yolk sac tumors with cytohistological correlation available in selected cases.

pmid-37453124.summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例。十二指腸転移による上部消化管出血で発症した。緊急手術を受けたが、広範な転移性疾患と全身状態不良のため、診断から3か月後に死亡した。
pmid-37453124.summary_en: Rare case of 24-year-old man with testicular mixed GCT presenting with upper gastrointestinal bleeding from duodenal metastasis. Despite emergency surgery, patient succumbed three months after diagnosis due to extensive metastatic disease and poor clinical status.

pmid-37458713.summary_ja: 米空軍の男性兵士を対象とした、PFASへの曝露と精巣胚細胞腫瘍との関連を調べたネステッド症例対照研究。2回目の血清検体で高いPFOS濃度を示した者は、他のPFASで調整後も精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高かった。
pmid-37458713.summary_en: Nested case-control study investigating association between PFAS exposure and testicular GCTs in US Air Force servicemen. Elevated PFOS concentrations in second serum sample positively associated with testicular GCT risk after adjustment for other PFAS.

pmid-37460279.summary_ja: 27歳男性で、下大静脈に浸潤した後腹膜原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法を施行した症例である。腫瘍マーカー陽性に対する手術として後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、病理では壊死組織のみが認められた。免疫組織化学では壊死組織にhCG陽性が確認され、術後に血清hCG値は正常化した。
pmid-37460279.summary_en: 27-year-old male with extragonadal GCT involving inferior vena cava treated with chemotherapy. Marker-positive surgery performed; pathology showed only necrotic tissue, but immunohistochemistry revealed hCG-positive staining, achieving serum hCG normalization.

pmid-37468325.summary_ja: 完全および部分胞状奇胎の分子診断法についての総説。形態学的診断が標準であるものの、経験豊富な病理医であっても誤分類率は依然として高い。遺伝子解析は奇胎と非奇胎性流産を確実に区別し、奇胎の型を決定する。これにより、不必要または欠落したβ-hCGフォローアップを防ぎ、絨毛癌への進行リスクを低減する。
pmid-37468325.summary_en: Review of molecular diagnostic methods for complete and partial hydatidiform moles. While morphological diagnosis is standard, misclassification rates remain high even among experienced pathologists. Genetic analysis reliably distinguishes molar from non-molar abortions, defines mole type, prevents unnecessary or missed β-hCG follow-up, reducing choriocarcinoma progression risk.

pmid-37470618.summary_ja: 水胞性奇胎切除10年後の腎臓転移性絨毛膜がん症例。原発性子宮腫瘍なし。腎摘出標本で組織学的確認。初回化学療法で完全奏効。若い女性の原因不明腎腫瘍の鑑別診断で絨毛膜がんを考慮すべき。
pmid-37470618.summary_en: Rare case report of metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma to kidney, diagnosed 10 years after hydatidiform mole resection. No primary uterine tumor identified on imaging. Histopathological confirmation via nephrectomy specimen. First-line chemotherapy achieved complete response. Case emphasizes considering gestational choriocarcinoma in differential diagnosis of young females with unexplained renal pathology.

pmid-37477777.summary_ja: サウジアラビア小児精巣悪性腫瘍10年疫学調査。115例、中央年齢14歳。卵黄嚢腫瘍28.2%、胚細胞がん27.4%、混合胚細胞腫瘍23.1%。腫瘍進行度が生存率に有意に関連。全死亡率5.2%、全例stage 3非セミノーマ。
pmid-37477777.summary_en: Ten-year epidemiological review of malignant testicular tumors in Saudi pediatric population (2008-2017). 115 patients; median age 14 years. Yolk sac tumor most frequent (28.2%), followed by embryonal carcinoma (27.4%) and mixed GCT (23.1%). Tumor stage significantly associated with survival. Overall mortality 5.2%; all deaths occurred in stage 3 non-seminomatous disease.

pmid-37485120.summary_ja: 血清AFP上昇を伴う精巣セミノーマの稀な症例。通常セミノーマはAFPを産生しない。根治的除睾術と化学療法（ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン）施行。pT1bNxM0、stage IS。セミノーマとAFP上昇の稀な組み合わせ。
pmid-37485120.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma with unusually elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP). Seminomas typically produce no AFP; only non-seminomatous tumors express AFP. Patient received radical orchiectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Stage IS disease with pT1bNxM0 classification. Illustrates rare presentation combining seminoma with AFP elevation.

pmid-37490059.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する腹膜後リンパ節郭清295例の大規模研究。Clavien-Dindo grade III-IV合併症9.8%、追加手術20%。AFP上昇が重大合併症の独立予測因子（OR 3.3）。複雑な腫瘍患者は専門施設での治療から利益。
pmid-37490059.summary_en: Large retrospective study analyzing 295 RPLNDs for GCT (1992-2020). Postoperative complications grade III-IV in 9.8%; additional surgery needed in 20%. Preoperative AFP elevation independently predicted major complications (OR 3.3). Study emphasizes RPLND as demanding procedure; complex tumor history patients benefit from high-volume specialized centers.

pmid-37492037.summary_ja: 異なる組織型の両側性同時精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍が共存。念密な臨床評価、包括的診断検査、個別化治療計画の重要性を強調。各腫瘍特性に応じた併合治療が必要。
pmid-37492037.summary_en: Rare case report of bilateral synchronous testicular GCTs with different histology—one seminoma and one non-seminomatous. Emphasizes importance of meticulous clinical evaluation, comprehensive diagnostic imaging and histopathology, and individualized treatment planning. Treatment requires combination approaches tailored to each tumor's characteristics and patient health status.

pmid-37492385.summary_ja: 精巣画像診断のラジオミクス応用の系統的レビュー。6研究を評価。ラジオミクス品質スコア平均31.48%。初期段階で方法論的制限あり。有望な知見もあるが、精巣画像ラジオミクスは発展途上。
pmid-37492385.summary_en: Systematic review evaluating radiomics application in testicular imaging including GCT. Six studies reviewed using Radiomics Quality Score and QUADAS-2. Mean quality score 31.48%, indicating early developmental stage with methodological limitations. Despite promising findings, radiomic research in testicular imaging remains nascent.

pmid-37497464.summary_ja: 30歳で原発性無月経を呈した46,XY完全性腺異形成（Swyer症候群）の症例報告。異形成性性腺は、ディスジャーミノーマや性腺芽腫を含む悪性転化のリスクがある。臨床的疑い、適切な検査、早期診断、そして悪性腫瘍予防のための予防的性腺摘出術の重要性を強調している。
pmid-37497464.summary_en: Case report of late-presenting Swyer syndrome (46-XY complete gonadal dysgenesis) in 30-year-old with primary amenorrhea. Dysgenetic gonads carry risk of malignant transformation including dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma. Emphasizes importance of clinical suspicion, appropriate investigation, early diagnosis, and prophylactic gonadectomy for malignancy prevention.

pmid-37499300.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫のNMDAR脳炎における外科切除の臨床効果と切除タイミングの系統的レビュー。切除群で再発率低下（相対リスク0.30）だが、エビデンス確実性は低い。早期切除の利益を示唆するが、確実な推奨には不十分。
pmid-37499300.summary_en: Systematic review assessing clinical effect of ovarian teratoma resection in NMDAR-antibody encephalitis patients and comparing early versus late resection timing. Relapse rate lower with resection (RR 0.30) versus non-resection, though evidence certainty very low. Evidence suggests early resection benefit but insufficient data for definitive recommendations.

pmid-37500013.summary_ja: 肝転移を伴う絨毛性疾患26例の分析。5年全生存率60.7%。初回化学療法での完全寛解達成時100% vs 非達成時20%。肝転移6個以上が独立予後因子。単発転移例で死亡なし。
pmid-37500013.summary_en: Analysis of 26 GTN patients with liver metastases from French Trophoblastic Diseases Center. Five-year overall survival 60.7%; survival 100% for complete remission after first-line chemotherapy versus 20% without. Independent prognostic factor: ≥6 liver metastases (16.7% vs 82.4% survival). Single liver metastasis had excellent prognosis.

pmid-37504318.summary_ja: 再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する救援化学療法の診療実態を調査した。大量化学療法が最も一般的な戦略(70%)で、TIP(64%)およびVIP(25%)が標準レジメンであった。65%でブリッジングCDCTが使用されており、地域による有意な差異と診療の標準化の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-37504318.summary_en: Canadian national survey characterizing salvage chemotherapy practices for relapsed testicular GCT. Among 30 respondents from 18 cancer centers, high-dose chemotherapy most common strategy (70% availability). TIP (64%) and VIP (25%) standard regimens. Bridging CDCT used in 65%. Highlights significant regional variation and need for care standardization.

pmid-37507528.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後ロボット支援RPLND。66例の多施設研究。出血量中央値50mL、低合併症率。血管損傷4例、開腹転換3例。中央値16ヶ月で再発2例。専門施設での安全性と実行可能性を示唆。
pmid-37507528.summary_en: Retrospective multicenter analysis of post-chemotherapy robot-assisted RPLND in 66 metastatic GCT patients. Median blood loss 50 mL with low morbidity (ileus 10.6%, lymphorrea 7.6%). Four vascular injuries occurred; three conversions to open surgery. Two relapses at 16-month median follow-up outside surgical template. Procedure feasible in expert centers with low morbidity.

pmid-37508506.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のバイオマーカー分析。POU5F1、KIT、SOX17の発現パターンを評価。新規バイオマーカーDPPA3、CALCA、TDGF1を提案。MGMT確認、RASSF1、PRSS21を健全精巣組織マーカーとして同定。多学際的アプローチの重要性を強調。
pmid-37508506.summary_en: Comparative immunohistochemical biomarker analysis of testicular GCTs using Human Protein Atlas data. Identified discrepancies in core diagnostic genes POU5F1, KIT, SOX17. Proposed novel TGCT biomarkers: DPPA3, CALCA, TDGF1. Confirmed MGMT and identified RASSF1, PRSS21 as markers of healthy testicular tissue. Highlights multidisciplinary approach importance.

pmid-37508611.summary_ja: 小児における卵巣腫瘤の包括的レビュー。胚細胞腫瘍が卵巣新生物の大部分を占め、成熟奇形腫が最も一般的、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が最も頻繁な悪性腫瘍である。超音波検査、MRI、CTの画像所見と腫瘍マーカー(AFP、hCG、LDH、インヒビン)について論じ、専門センターにおける機能保存的で低侵襲な管理を推奨している。
pmid-37508611.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian masses in pediatric patients. Germ cell tumors constitute majority of ovarian neoplasms in children; mature teratoma most common, dysgerminoma most frequent malignancy. Discusses clinical presentation, imaging findings on ultrasound/MRI/CT, tumor markers (AFP, hCG, LDH, inhibin), and emphasizes importance of malignancy evaluation. Recommends function-preserving, minimally invasive management in specialized centers.

pmid-37509313.summary_ja: 43名のGCT患者を対象にしたPET/CT影響評価研究。51%で病期分類が変更され、化学療法計画の変更と侵襲的検査の減少が報告された。
pmid-37509313.summary_en: Prospective registry study of 43 male GCT patients evaluating [18F]FDG-PET/CT impact on staging and management. Staging changed in 51% (16% upstaging, 23% downstaging). PET/CT reduced planned invasive procedures in 19% and additional diagnostics in 58% of patients.

pmid-37509533.summary_ja: 非セミノーマGCT由来の胚性癌細胞株NT2D1のERK/MAPK経路研究。ERK阻害は増殖を抑制し、代償的AKT活性化が観察。標的治療開発に関連。
pmid-37509533.summary_en: Study of ERK/MAPK signaling in NT2D1 embryonal carcinoma cells (non-seminomatous TGCT-derived line). ERK inhibition suppressed basal and HGF-induced proliferation. Compensatory AKT pathway activation and partial EMT phenotype observed, relevant for targeted therapy development.

pmid-37512038.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者における生殖能温存の重要性を強調した第三次医療機関の経験報告。精子採取されたonco-mTESEは、9人の患者中3人で精子回収に成功し、細胞質内精子注入により1人の生児出産と1人の流産を得た。腫瘍学的治療の有効性を保証しながら生殖能温存を実現している。
pmid-37512038.summary_en: Tertiary center experience with onco-mTESE (testicular sperm extraction at orchiectomy) in 9 testicular cancer patients with oligozoospermia/azoospermia. Sperm retrieved in 3 patients; ICSI resulted in 1 live birth and 1 miscarriage. Emphasizes fertility preservation importance in GCT.

pmid-37512061.summary_ja: 精巣GCTに対する臓器温存手術についての総合レビュー。低再発率、80～90%の内分泌機能温存、約50%の妊娠達成が報告された。
pmid-37512061.summary_en: Literature review of organ-sparing surgery for testicular germ cell tumors as alternative to radical orchiectomy. Reports low recurrence rates, adequate oncologic control, endocrine function preservation in 80-90%, and paternity achievement in ~50% of patients. Discusses candidate selection criteria.

pmid-37512119.summary_ja: 男性不妊と精巣がんの関係についての文献レビュー。不妊男性における胚細胞瘤(GCNIS)発生率が高く、精巣がん発症リスクが増加している。精巣形成不全症候群、停留精巣の既往、陰嚢超音波検査、精液パラメータ、およびマイクロRNAバイオマーカーの役割について論じている。
pmid-37512119.summary_en: Literature review of bilateral relationship between male infertility and testicular cancer. Discusses testicular dysgenesis syndrome, GCNIS incidence in infertile men, cryptorchidism risk, ultrasound screening value, and potential miRNA biomarkers for TC/GCNIS diagnosis.

pmid-37515809.summary_ja: 精巣TGCT患者16名と対照9名の精子小RNA比較研究。11の差異発現sncRNAがTGCTを識別し、診断バイオマーカーの可能性が示唆された。
pmid-37515809.summary_en: Pilot study comparing sperm small non-coding RNA signatures in 16 men with testicular GCT versus 9 controls. After considering sperm physiological parameters, 11 differentially expressed sncRNAs distinguished TGCT patients, suggesting potential diagnostic biomarker.

pmid-37517249.summary_ja: 先天性口蓋奇形腫（エピグナティス）による満期女児の重度気道閉塞症例。極めて稀な疾患（出生10万～20万に1例）。画像検査で鼻咽頭腫瘤を確認、外科的切除と腫瘤の部分的減量手術により気道確保に成功。病理組織学的検査により成熟奇形腫と診断。
pmid-37517249.summary_en: Case of congenital palatal teratoma (epignathus) in full-term female infant causing severe airway obstruction at birth. Rare occurrence (1:35,000-200,000 births). Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma. Successful surgical resection achieved airway clearance.

pmid-37519783.summary_ja: 一次性肺絨毛癌の症例報告。絨毛癌は予後不良で、診断の困難さと治療上の課題について述べられている。
pmid-37519783.summary_en: Case report of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, a rare malignant germ cell neoplasm with high invasiveness. While most choriocarcinomas are pregnancy-related with lung metastases, this case represents primary pulmonary presentation with poor prognosis without early diagnosis.

pmid-37520391.summary_ja: 骨盤MRIで評価された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫2症例。卵巣奇形腫の95%、GCTの69%を占め、多様な画像所見を示す。
pmid-37520391.summary_en: Case report of two patients with ovarian mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) evaluated by pelvic MRI with pathologic confirmation. Mature teratomas comprise 95% of ovarian teratomas and 69% of ovarian germ cell tumors with heterogeneous imaging presentations.

pmid-37522577.summary_ja: EORTC QLQ-TC26質問票を用いて、日本の精巣がん生存者567名の性機能を評価した研究。化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、特に射精機能の低下と関連していた。神経温存手術は、非温存手術と比べて機能をよりよく維持した。
pmid-37522577.summary_en: Study of 567 Japanese testicular cancer survivors evaluating sexual function using EORTC QLQ-TC26 questionnaire. Post-chemotherapy RPLND associated with reduced sexual function, especially ejaculation. Nerve-sparing technique preserved function better than non-nerve-sparing.

pmid-37523789.summary_ja: APE1が胚性幹細胞の増殖と奇形腫形成に果たす役割を研究。APE1低下はGDNF/GFRα1軸を介して細胞増殖と腫瘍体積を減少させた。
pmid-37523789.summary_en: Experimental study investigating APE1's role in embryonic stem cell proliferation and teratoma formation. APE1 knockdown reduced cell proliferation, pluripotency, and teratoma volume in xenografted mice via GDNF/GFRα1 axis regulation.

pmid-37524020.summary_ja: 16歳男児の縦隔セミノーマの症例報告。小児では極めて稀で、化学療法と手術による複合治療で長期生存を期待。
pmid-37524020.summary_en: 16-year-old boy with biopsy-proven mediastinal seminoma presenting with productive cough and dyspnea. Extremely rare in pediatrics (3-7% of pediatric GCTs). Treated with multimodal approach: chemotherapy followed by surgical resection.

pmid-37527936.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマを有する15歳男児が抗Hu抗体脳炎で発症。免疫療法と腫瘍切除により発作消失を達成。GCT関連神経障害の重要な報告。
pmid-37527936.summary_en: 15-year-old boy with mediastinal seminoma and anti-Hu encephalitis presenting with epilepsia partialis continua. Diagnosis confirmed by serum anti-Hu antibodies and neuroimaging. Treated with immunotherapy and mediastinal lesion resection, achieving seizure freedom.

pmid-37530363.summary_ja: 11カ月女児の眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍。AFPが著明に上昇し、MRIで視神経圧排所見を確認。BEP化学療法で良好な臨床放射線学的反応が得られた。
pmid-37530363.summary_en: Case of pure orbital yolk sac tumor in 11-month-old infant presenting with proptosis and lid edema. Marked AFP elevation (76,900 ng/mL). MRI showed retroocular mass displacing optic nerve. BEP chemotherapy initiated with good clinical and radiological response.

pmid-37530808.summary_ja: 53,309人の精巣がん患者を対象としたSEERデータベース分析で続発悪性腫瘍のリスク因子を同定。高齢、化学療法、放射線療法が続発悪性腫瘍発症と有意に関連。C指数0.776と0.824の予測ノモグラムを開発した。
pmid-37530808.summary_en: Analysis of 53,309 testicular cancer patients from SEER database to identify risk factors for secondary malignant neoplasms. Higher age, chemotherapy, and radiation significantly associated with SMN development. Predictive nomograms developed with C-indices 0.776 and 0.824.

pmid-37534583.summary_ja: 骨形成不全症を有する小児の陰茎に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍。前例では報告されていない組み合わせの症例で、卵黄嚢腫瘍の異所性発生部位を拡大する。
pmid-37534583.summary_en: Case report of primary penile yolk sac tumor in child with achondroplasia. Fourth previous report of penile YST; first report associated with achondroplasia. YST can occur in prepubertal penile location, expanding known extragonadal GCT sites.

pmid-37539411.summary_ja: トリソミー21を有する12カ月女児の副腎成熟奇形腫内にウィルムス腫瘍成分が存在する症例。完全切除後12カ月で再発なし。
pmid-37539411.summary_en: First known case of adrenal mature teratoma containing Wilms tumor component in 12-month-old girl with Trisomy 21. Discusses tumor origin theories and successful gross total resection with no recurrence at 12-month follow-up.

pmid-37542883.summary_ja: 精巣のITGCN（前癌病変）の症例報告。放射線療法または経過観察の治療選択肢が検討されており、生殖能温存の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-37542883.summary_en: A 37-year-old man with testicular intratubular germinal cell neoplasia (ITGCN), formerly called carcinoma in situ, presenting with infertility. The case discusses ITGCN detection, management options including active surveillance and radiotherapy, and the importance of fertility preservation.

pmid-37543446.summary_ja: 14人のセミノーマ患者に対するPC-RPLND。全889手術の1.6%。一次化学療法後の残存疾患が適応。手術単独で無病状態は3人のみで、8人は救援化学療法が必要。腎摘出や大動脈グラフト等の重篤な合併症多数。
pmid-37543446.summary_en: Study of 14 seminoma patients undergoing PC-RPLND for residual disease after first-line chemotherapy (out of 889 total non-seminoma surgeries). Only 3 disease-free with surgery alone; 8 required salvage chemotherapy. Surgical complications included nephrectomy and caval resection.

pmid-37543714.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの免疫浸潤と免疫細胞亜型に関する研究。6個の免疫関連DEGsに基づくリスク署名を開発。WNT/TGF-β経路と関連する2つの免疫パターンを同定、予後に関連。
pmid-37543714.summary_en: Study identifying immune infiltrates and immune cell subtypes in testicular GCTs (TGCT). Developed risk signature based on 6 immune-related DEGs; identified two immune patterns with different survival outcomes; discussed WNT/TGF-β signaling pathways.

pmid-37546103.summary_ja: 29歳アジア系男性の副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫(SNTCS)症例。生検時に誤診され、腫瘍減量手術と再切除施行後も局所再発を来した。放射線療法施行中に肺肝転移を発症し、姑息的治療に移行。
pmid-37546103.summary_en: Case of 29-year-old male with sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS), highly aggressive malignant neoplasm. Initially misdiagnosed on biopsy; underwent surgical debulking and re-resection with adjuvant radiotherapy, but developed metastasis.

pmid-37558516.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマGCT第III期患者2,092例の条件付き生存に関する研究。36ヶ月無病生存後の5年全生存率は有意に改善。予後不良群で最大の改善が認められた。
pmid-37558516.summary_en: Study of stage III non-seminoma testis cancer patients (n=2,092) analyzing conditional survival after disease-free interval. 36-month disease-free interval improved 5-year overall survival estimates significantly; poor prognosis patients showed greatest improvement.

pmid-37559378.summary_ja: 30歳男性がコクシジオイデス菌症と誤診されたが、実際は転移性胚細胞癌であった。胚細胞腫瘍が感染症に類似する臨床像を呈する場合の診断上の課題を示す症例。患者は緩和ケアを選択した。
pmid-37559378.summary_en: Case of 30-year-old man initially misdiagnosed with disseminated coccidioidomycosis but confirmed as metastatic germ cell carcinoma. Demonstrates diagnostic challenges when GCT presentations mimic infectious diseases; patient opted for palliative care.

pmid-37564606.summary_ja: 15歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍(13×12×8cm)で右上縦隔に位置。BEP化学療法6サイクル後も腫瘍サイズは不変。右肺、心膜、横隔膜の部分的切除を含む拡大外科的切除を施行。
pmid-37564606.summary_en: Case of 15-year-old with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor (13×12×8cm) in right upper mediastinum. After 6 BEP chemotherapy cycles with minimal response, extended surgical resection with pericardial and lung resection performed successfully.

pmid-37565058.summary_ja: 先天性頭頸部奇形腫の小児患者137例の外科的転帰に関するレビュー。58%が緊急気道確保を要し、再発率6%。再発例の大半が頭蓋内進展を認めた。
pmid-37565058.summary_en: Scoping review of surgical outcomes in 137 pediatric patients with congenital head and neck teratomas. Median gestational age 37 weeks; 58% required emergent airway management. Recurrence rate 6% with most recurrent cases showing intracranial extension.

pmid-37565860.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した扁平上皮癌の56歳女性の症例。初期治療で完全寛解を達成したが10ヶ月後に再発。細胞減量手術と化学放射線療法で再度完全寛解を達成。
pmid-37565860.summary_en: Case of 56-year-old with ovarian squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma. Initial laparoscopic treatment achieved complete response; recurred 10 months later and treated with cytoreductive surgery and concurrent chemoradiation.

pmid-37565881.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の既往を持つ24歳女性の反復性絨毛癌の症例。化学療法中にハンセン病併発し、複数の化学療法に耐性を示したが、感染制御を図りながら治療完了。
pmid-37565881.summary_en: Case of 24-year-old with recurrent choriocarcinoma after previous hydatidiform mole, complicated by leprosy infection during chemotherapy. Despite drug resistance, leprosy was controlled while cancer treatment completed.

pmid-37566672.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫が異所性妊娠に似た画像所見を呈した妊娠中の21歳女性の症例報告。腹腔鏡で診断され、病理組織学的に確認された。MCT画像診断の課題を強調。
pmid-37566672.summary_en: Case report of 21-year-old pregnant woman with ovarian mature cystic teratoma mimicking heterotopic pregnancy on ultrasound. Laparoscopic diagnosis confirmed pathologically; emphasizes diagnostic challenges of MCT imaging.

pmid-37568585.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍診断のためのソノエラストグラフィのシステマティックレビューとメタ解析研究。11論文から悪性腫瘍と良性の鑑別における併合感度86%を報告。技術的課題と深い学習モデルを用いた将来の研究方向を提案。
pmid-37568585.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of sonoelastography for testicular tumor diagnosis. Pooled sensitivity 86% for distinguishing malignancy from benignity. Discusses technical challenges and future directions with deep learning approaches.

pmid-37568759.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの新規血清バイオマーカーmiR371に関するレビュー。感度約90%、特異度>90%で、従来のマーカー（AFP、hCG、LDH）より優れており、診断・治療効果判定・フォローアップに有用。
pmid-37568759.summary_en: Review of microRNA-371a-3p as novel serum biomarker for testicular GCTs. Sensitivity ~90%, specificity >90%, outperforming conventional markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) in diagnosis, therapy monitoring, and follow-up strategies.

pmid-37569569.summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるエピジェネティクスとncRNAs（マイクロRNA、lncRNA）の役割に関するレビュー。遺伝子制御、腫瘍進行、および予後・標的治療に関する情報を提供している。
pmid-37569569.summary_en: Comprehensive review of epigenetic factors and non-coding RNAs (microRNAs, lncRNAs) in testicular germ cell tumors. Discusses their roles in gene regulation, tumor progression, and potential as targets for prognosis and targeted therapies.

pmid-37575730.summary_ja: 縦隔のyolk sac tumorによる大きな腫瘍塊で、心臓の圧排と心タンポナーデを引き起こした28歳男性の症例。AFP、β-hCGの上昇を認め、化学療法と緊急心膜穿刺を実施。
pmid-37575730.summary_en: Case of 28-year-old male with large mediastinal non-seminomatous GCT (yolk sac tumor) causing cardiac displacement and tamponade. Elevated AFP and beta-hCG detected; treated with etoposide/cisplatin chemotherapy and emergency pericardiocentesis.

pmid-37575827.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の稀な腸原発例で、消化管出血と高値のβ-hCGを呈した症例報告。緊急手術で空腸病変を切除したが、術後1ヶ月で生命を脅かす再出血が生じて死亡した。
pmid-37575827.summary_en: Case report of rare primary jejunal choriocarcinoma presenting with gastrointestinal bleeding and elevated beta-hCG. Patient underwent emergency surgical resection but experienced life-threatening rebleeding one month postoperatively, leading to death.

pmid-37575996.summary_ja: プラダー・ウィリ症候群における癌リスクの全国コホート研究と遺伝子解析。小児期のジスジャーミノーマおよび卵巣性索腫瘍の増加頻度が示唆された。腫瘍DNA中のKIT遺伝子病的変異およびPWS領域における刻印喪失が同定された。
pmid-37575996.summary_en: Register-based cohort study and genomic analysis of cancer risk in Prader-Willi syndrome. Identified increased frequency of pediatric cancers including dysgerminoma and ovarian sex cord tumors. Analysis revealed pathogenic KIT mutation in dysgerminoma and locus-specific loss-of-imprinting at PWS locus.

pmid-37576158.summary_ja: 仙尾部卵黄嚢腫瘍に伴う潰瘍性大腸炎（傍腫瘍症候群）を示した1歳児の症例報告。腫瘍摘出および化学療法後に潰瘍性大腸炎症状は完全軽快し、7年間の追跡観察で再発はない。
pmid-37576158.summary_en: Case report of a 1-year-old child with sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor presenting with severe abdominal distension and concurrent ulcerative colitis as a paraneoplastic syndrome. After surgical tumor removal and chemotherapy (JEB), ulcerative colitis completely resolved with 7-year follow-up showing no recurrence.

pmid-37576351.summary_ja: 28歳女性における卵巣ジスジャーミノーマ再発に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の乳糜腹水の症例報告。食事療法（中鎖脂肪酸を含む低脂肪、高タンパク・高炭水化物食）で保存的に治療され16日で軽快した。
pmid-37576351.summary_en: Case report of chylous ascites developing after retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for recurrent ovarian dysgerminoma in a 28-year-old woman. Patient was successfully managed conservatively with dietary modification including high-protein, high-carbohydrate, low-fat diet with medium-chain fatty acids.

pmid-37577074.summary_ja: 50歳および77歳の高齢男性2例における精子細胞腫瘍症例報告。典型的に若年者(15～35歳)に発症する精巣がんと異なり、より高齢の男性に多い稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。超音波検査と病理組織学的特徴について論じた。
pmid-37577074.summary_en: Case report of spermatocytic tumors in two elderly men (ages 50 and 77), rare testicular germ cell tumors more common in older males compared to typical young-adult presentation of most testicular GCTs. Ultrasound and histopathology features are discussed with literature review.

pmid-37577076.summary_ja: 稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である純粋縦隔セミノーマの症例報告。25歳男性が持続性咳嗽と大きな前縦隔腫瘤を呈示。一次化学療法(BEPプロトコール)で90％の腫瘍縮小を達成し、残存病変は放射線療法(36Gy)で治療した。
pmid-37577076.summary_en: Case report of pure mediastinal seminoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor comprising 1-4% of mediastinal malignancies. A 25-year-old male presented with persistent cough and large anterior mediastinal mass. Primary chemotherapy (BEP protocol) achieved 90% tumor reduction with residual disease treated by radiotherapy (36 Gy).

pmid-37577346.summary_ja: サルモネラ・サンパウル感染による精巣膿瘍を伴う41歳男性の精巣セミノーマの症例報告。精巣膿瘍は稀であるが、悪性腫瘍と感染の共存の可能性を示唆し、鑑別診断の重要性を強調している。
pmid-37577346.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma accompanied by bacterial abscess caused by Salmonella saintpaul in a 41-year-old male. While testicular abscesses are rare, this case highlights the importance of considering malignancy in differential diagnosis of testicular inflammation, as tumors may coexist with infection.

pmid-37579714.summary_ja: 水腫または胎児ストレスを有する高リスク胎児仙尾部奇形腫に対する帝王切開から即時切除(CSIR)技法の後方視的研究。早期産性にもかかわらず、3つの連続した症例で100％の生存率を達成した。
pmid-37579714.summary_en: Retrospective study of cesarean section to immediate resection (CSIR) technique for high-risk fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas with hydrops or fetal distress. Three consecutive cases achieved 100% survival despite prematurity, demonstrating CSIR as a feasible alternative to standard postnatal resection.

pmid-37581115.summary_ja: 40歳女性における両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化による扁平上皮癌の症例報告。成熟卵巣奇形腫の悪性転化は1～2％で起こり、主に閉経後女性に見られる。
pmid-37581115.summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma from malignant transformation of bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas in a 40-year-old woman. Malignant transformation occurs in 1-2% of mature ovarian teratomas, predominantly in postmenopausal women, with poor prognosis when diagnosed at advanced stage.

pmid-37584159.summary_ja: 米国における精巣がん（生殖細胞腫瘍を含む）の発症率、死亡率、死亡場所の推移を1999-2020年で分析した研究。ヒスパニック系男性および25-29歳の若年男性における転移性精巣がんの増加傾向が示された。人口統計学的格差が明らかにされた。
pmid-37584159.summary_en: Comprehensive epidemiological analysis of testicular cancer (including GCTs) incidence, mortality, and place-of-death trends in the US from 1999-2020. Study identified concerning increases in metastatic disease among Hispanic men and young men aged 25-29, with evidence of racial/ethnic disparities.

pmid-37587986.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟囊胞性奇形腫内における粘液腺癌およびカルチノイド腫瘍の18歳患者における極めて稀な症例報告。良性奇形腫内での二重悪性転化の可能性を示唆し、奇形腫の悪性変化のリスクを強調している。
pmid-37587986.summary_en: Case report of mucinous adenocarcinoma and carcinoid tumor within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma in an 18-year-old woman. This represents extremely rare dual malignant transformation within a single teratoma, highlighting the potential for malignant degeneration despite benign initial presentation.

pmid-37591194.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性を示した若い女性における妊娠関連絨毛癌の症例報告。妊娠性トロホブラスト疾患の管理における子宮全摘出術の重要な役割が示されている。化学療法と手術の組み合わせで臨床・生化学的改善が得られた。
pmid-37591194.summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma in a young woman initially low-risk, treated with surgery after chemotherapy resistance. The paper illustrates hysterectomy's role in gestational trophoblastic tumor management, showing clinical and biochemical improvement following combined surgical and chemotherapeutic intervention.

pmid-37591208.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含む83例の精巣腫瘤患者を対象とした多施設後方視的研究である精巣温存手術の転帰。精巣温存手術は適切な癌制御で安全であり、88％が術後テストステロンが正常で、悪性腫瘍患者の3分の2で性機能が保存された。
pmid-37591208.summary_en: Multi-center retrospective study of testis-sparing surgery (TSS) outcomes in 83 patients with testicular masses, including germ cell tumors. TSS was safe with adequate cancer control; 88% retained normal postoperative testosterone, and sexual function was preserved in two-thirds with malignancy.

pmid-37599523.summary_ja: セミノーマと非セミノーマを含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)における新規診断・予後バイオマーカー遺伝子7つを同定するトランスクリプトーム解析。同定された遺伝子はTGCT診断と予後予測を改善する可能性がある。
pmid-37599523.summary_en: Transcriptome analysis identifying seven novel diagnostic and prognostic biomarker genes in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), including seminomatous and non-seminomatous subtypes. Identified genes showed associations with immune cell infiltration and may improve TGCT diagnosis and prognosis prediction.

pmid-37599665.summary_ja: 2歳児における耳管内成熟奇形腫の極めて稀な症例報告。慢性耳漏で発症した。耳管奇形腫は頭頸部領域でも例外的に稀であり、文献報告は限定的である。手術摘出で治癒した。
pmid-37599665.summary_en: Case report of mature teratoma in the Eustachian tube of a 2-year-old child presenting with chronic ear discharge. Eustachian tube teratomas are exceptionally rare with few published reports. Surgical removal was successful with imaging and long-term follow-up detailed.

pmid-37602541.summary_ja: 56歳女性における胃成熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告。胃奇形腫は通常幼児期に発症するが、成人での報告は極めて稀である。超音波およびCTで胃腫瘤が同定され、病理で成熟奇形腫と確認され、手術治療で治癒した。
pmid-37602541.summary_en: Case report of gastric teratoma in a 56-year-old woman, extremely rare since gastric teratomas typically occur in infancy. Imaging (ultrasound and CT) demonstrated a large gastric mass with mature teratoma confirmed on pathology. The patient recovered well following surgical resection.

pmid-37604120.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫に対する経皮的および開放手術介入の比較研究。固形腫瘍に対しては開放手術が生存率および介入成功率において優れており、囊胞成分に対しては経皮的ドレナージが有効である。周産期管理の重要な知見が示されている。
pmid-37604120.summary_en: Comparative review of percutaneous versus open fetal surgical interventions for sacrococcygeal teratomas. Results indicate open surgery is superior for solid tumors regarding survival and reduced intervention failure rates, while percutaneous cyst drainage appears effective for purely cystic lesions.

pmid-37614074.summary_ja: 肺および脳転移を伴う18歳男性の稀な縦隔原発絨毛癌の症例報告。絨毛癌は急速に進行する悪性腫瘍であり、転移性疾患で診断された場合、予後は不良である。多数の器官転移を伴う稀な症例である。
pmid-37614074.summary_en: Case report of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor, in an 18-year-old male with pulmonary and brain metastases. Choriocarcinoma is highly aggressive with rapid progression and poor prognosis, particularly when diagnosed with widespread metastatic disease at presentation.

pmid-37619591.summary_ja: 診断前ホルモンレベルと精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)リスクの関連を調査した入れ子型症例対照研究。血清FSHレベルの上昇はTGCTリスク(特にセミノーマ)の増加と関連しており、Sertoli細胞機能不全に関する仮説を支持する。
pmid-37619591.summary_en: Nested case-control study investigating associations between prediagnostic hormone levels and testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) risk. Higher follicle-stimulating hormone levels were associated with increased TGCT risk, particularly for seminoma, supporting hypotheses about Sertoli cell dysfunction in TGCT development.

pmid-37620552.summary_ja: 本論文は治療可能な癌と治療耐性癌の違いを分析している。精巣セミノーマはTP53野生型の特性を有し、発達的に誘発されたアポトーシス感受性と内在的な薬物感受性により高い治癒率を示す希少悪性腫瘍として強調されている。
pmid-37620552.summary_en: This perspective examines genetic and developmental features distinguishing curable from treatment-resistant cancers. Testicular seminoma exemplifies rare TP53 wild-type malignancies with high cure rates, characterized by developmental priming for apoptosis and intrinsic drug hypersensitivity, contrasting with common drug-resistant adult cancers.

pmid-37625143.summary_ja: Swyer症候群(46,XY)患者の混合型GCT症例。二次無月経と同時にGCT発症。XY核型患者はGCT発症リスクが高い。化学療法と手術で治療。核型診断の重要性を強調。
pmid-37625143.summary_en: Case of 46,XY patient with Swyer syndrome presenting with secondary amenorrhea and mixed GCT (dysgerminoma with gonadoblastoma). Highlights that XY karyotype patients have higher GCT incidence. Managed with chemotherapy followed by surgery.

pmid-37627198.summary_ja: 卵巣GCT84例とSCST62例の妊孕性温存治療成績。5年・10年無再発生存率91%・83%。36・60・120ヶ月の妊娠率は13.24%・20.75%・42.37%。治療後2年間は厳密な経過観察が必要。
pmid-37627198.summary_en: Outcomes of fertility-sparing surgery in 146 patients with non-epithelial ovarian cancer (GCT n=84, SCST n=62). 5- and 10-year disease-free survival were 91% and 83%. Cumulative childbearing rates at 36, 60, and 120 months were 13.24%, 20.75%, and 42.37%.

pmid-37632597.summary_ja: 195人の精巣GCT長期生存者(治療後平均11.7年)を対象に身体活動と心代謝健康を調査。高い身体活動はメタボリック症候群低下と心代謝改善と関連し、特にI-II期で顕著。
pmid-37632597.summary_en: Cross-sectional study of 195 long-term testicular germ cell tumor survivors (mean 11.7 years post-therapy) examining effects of habitual physical activity on metabolic syndrome and cardiometabolic markers. Higher physical activity associated with lower metabolic syndrome prevalence and improved profiles.

pmid-37635241.summary_ja: 32人の小児患者(平均年齢14.5歳)を対象にCT画像解析で成熟・未熟奇形腫を鑑別。成熟奇形腫は均一性が高く、未熟腫瘍は相関性と不均一性が高い。石灰化分布は治療選択に有用。
pmid-37635241.summary_en: Study of CT-based textural analysis to differentiate mature and immature ovarian teratomas in 32 pediatric patients (mean age 14.5 years). Calcification distribution showed higher homogeneity in mature teratomas; immature tumors showed higher entropy. Calcification texture is potential biomarker for treatment.

pmid-37636493.summary_ja: 多剤・avelumab耐性絨毛癌症例をペムブロリズマブ併用化学療法で治療。完全hCG奏効と陰性PET-CTを達成。チェックポイント阻害薬がGTN治療の新しい選択肢として有用。
pmid-37636493.summary_en: Case of chemotherapy and immunotherapy-resistant gestational choriocarcinoma (GTN) successfully treated with escalated etoposide/cisplatin combined with pembrolizumab. Patient had failed prior methotrexate, actinomycin-D, and avelumab. Achieved complete hCG response and negative PET-CT.

pmid-37636648.summary_ja: 成人に発生した頸部良性奇形腫の症例で、術前に誤診されていた。成人では極めてまれだが、正中の嚢胞性頸部腫脹の鑑別診断として考慮すべきである。悪性転化の可能性があるため、完全な外科的切除が推奨される。
pmid-37636648.summary_en: Case of benign teratoma of the neck in an adult, which was preoperatively misdiagnosed. Extremely rare in adults but should be considered in differential diagnosis of midline cystic neck masses. Complete surgical resection recommended due to potential malignant transformation.

pmid-37640983.summary_ja: 20,935人の精巣GCT患者を分析し年齢層別集団対照と比較。非精上皮腫III期で最大22%のOS低下。非がん死亡率はI-II期で小さいがIII期で高い。
pmid-37640983.summary_en: SEER database analysis of 20,935 testicular GCT patients (2004-2014) comparing overall survival with age-matched male population controls. Nonseminoma stage III showed greatest OS difference (22% lower). Other-cause mortality rates were marginal in stages I-II.

pmid-37641749.summary_ja: 生後5か月の女児で、体重増加不良、哺乳困難、重症閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸を呈した口咽頭奇形腫の症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で、グリア組織と腸管組織を伴う成熟奇形腫と確定した。診断の難しさと悪性転化の可能性について論じている。
pmid-37641749.summary_en: Case of oropharyngeal teratoma in a 5-month-old female presenting with failure to thrive, feeding difficulty, and severe obstructive sleep apnea. Pathology confirmed mature teratoma with glial and intestinal tissue. Discusses diagnostic challenges and malignant transformation risk.

pmid-37649372.summary_ja: 親の職業的溶剤暴露と精巣GCTリスクの関連を調査（454症例、670対照）。父親の溶剤暴露はOR 0.89で関連なし。1970年代生まれの母親の燃料暴露でリスク増加(OR 2.74)。
pmid-37649372.summary_en: French nationwide case-control study (454 cases, 670 controls) examining association between parental occupational solvent exposure and testicular germ cell tumor risk. Paternal exposure showed OR 0.89; maternal exposure in 1970s birth cohort suggested increased risk with petroleum-based solvents.

pmid-37650572.summary_ja: 精巣がん由来脳転移の治療動向を全国データベースから分析。全脳放射線療法より立体定位放射線治療(SRS)で生存率向上。5年生存率はSRS群で最高を達成。
pmid-37650572.summary_en: Analysis of treatment trends for brain metastases from testicular cancer using the National Cancer Database (2010-2015). Most patients received whole-brain radiation therapy (WBRT) rather than stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS). SRS group showed improved 5-year overall survival.

pmid-37652086.summary_ja: 成人の精索に生じた10cmの類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。類皮嚢腫は嚢腫性奇形腫の良性亜型であるが、悪性転化の稀な可能性があるため、慎重な病理学的評価が必要であった。確定診断には病理組織学的検査が不可欠であった。
pmid-37652086.summary_en: Case report of a 10 cm dermoid cyst of the spermatic cord in an adult. Benign variant of cystic teratoma requiring careful pathological evaluation due to rare risk of malignant transformation. Histopathological examination essential for definitive diagnosis.

pmid-37655742.summary_ja: 6歳女児の肩甲骨における神経原生単一性奇形腫(NMT)の症例。卵巣以外の骨発生が初めて報告された。31ヶ月無増殖。神経原生単一性奇形腫は骨にも発生し得ることを実証。
pmid-37655742.summary_en: Case report of neurogenic monodermal teratoma (NMT) with choroid plexus predominance in the scapula of a 6-year-old girl. First report of NMT occurring in bone rather than ovary. No progression at 31 months follow-up, demonstrating teratomas can arise in skeletal sites.

pmid-37656935.summary_ja: 化学療法後のリンパ節転移巣に生存可能な非奇形腫型GCTを有する117人の多施設研究。監視療法と補助化学療法間で生存率に有意差なし。生存がん細胞<10%の残存病変は良好な進行無再発生存率と関連。
pmid-37656935.summary_en: Analysis of 117 men with viable nonteratomatous GCT in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens. No significant survival difference between surveillance and adjuvant chemotherapy. Residual disease with <10% viable cancer cells associated with better progression-free survival.

pmid-37660010.summary_ja: 未熟児の仙尾部奇形腫における自発的腫瘍崩壊症候群(TLS)の症例。ラスブリケース投与と生後40時間での早期切除で対応。SCTにおけるTLS認識・治療と早期切除の重要性を強調。
pmid-37660010.summary_en: Case report of spontaneous tumor lysis syndrome (TLS) in a very preterm infant with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Managed with rasburicase and early surgical resection at 40 hours of life. Emphasizes recognition and management of TLS in SCT patients.

pmid-37660082.summary_ja: SEER登録データから44,975人の精巣がん患者を分析。3,573例の死亡例のうち38.2%が診断後1-5年で発生。精巣がん自体と他のがんが主な死因で、長期生存者では心疾患が非がん死因の最多。
pmid-37660082.summary_en: Population-based analysis of 44,975 testicular cancer patients from SEER database (2000-2018). Among 3,573 deaths, 38.2% occurred 1-5 years post-diagnosis from the cancer itself or other malignancies. Heart disease was the most common non-cancer cause in long-term survivors.

pmid-37660086.summary_ja: 34歳女性における横紋筋肉腫を含む卵管の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。外科的切除および化学療法(BEP/EP)で治療；24ヶ月の無腫瘍生存を達成し、腫瘍マーカーおよび画像フォローアップは正常。
pmid-37660086.summary_en: Case report of 34-year-old woman with mixed germ cell tumor of fallopian tube containing rhabdomyosarcoma. Treated with surgical resection and chemotherapy (BEP/EP regimens); achieved 24-month tumor-free survival with normal tumor markers and imaging follow-up.

pmid-37661873.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおける新規lncRNA由来タンパク質CAND1.11の発現を報告。正常精巣と比較してがん組織で高発現を示し、精巣がん、特にセミノーマにおける増殖・分化制御に関与する可能性のある予後バイオマーカーとして提案された。
pmid-37661873.summary_en: Study of CAND1.11, a long non-coding RNA producing a protein highly expressed in testicular cancers including seminoma. The protein is overexpressed in cancer tissues compared to normal testis, suggesting potential as a prognostic biomarker for testicular cancer proliferation.

pmid-37662626.summary_ja: 小児GCT 21例（性腺9例、腹腔外12例）のMSI分析。1例がMMRタンパク質欠損（卵黄嚢腫瘍、1歳）。全例PCRとNGSでマイクロサテライト安定性を示した。
pmid-37662626.summary_en: Analysis of microsatellite instability (MSI) in 21 pediatric GCTs (9 gonadal, 12 extragonadal). One case with mismatch repair protein deficit by immunohistochemistry (yolk sac tumor, age 1). All cases were microsatellite stable by PCR and NGS, consistent with adult GCT data.

pmid-37663426.summary_ja: 卵巣内膜症に合併した未熟奇形腫（GCT）患者の症例報告。大量化学療法と卵巣温存手術で治療。奇形腫の成熟化と卵巣機能温存を達成。
pmid-37663426.summary_en: Case report of a 34-year-old woman with immature ovarian teratoma (a malignant GCT type) associated with endometrioma and infertility. Treated with neoadjuvant high-dose chemotherapy and fertility-sparing surgery, achieving teratoma maturation and preserving ovarian function.

pmid-37664020.summary_ja: 妊娠29週前に発症した転移性絨毛癌（GCT）の症例報告。腹腔内・胸腔内出血で緊急帝王切開と止血手術を実施。EMA-CO化学療法で完全奏効を達成。
pmid-37664020.summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma developing before 29 weeks gestation with metastatic hemorrhagic complications. Emergency cesarean section and multiple surgeries performed for hemorrhage control. Achieved complete response to EMA-CO chemotherapy with favorable maternal outcome, though neonate had prematurity-related complications.

pmid-37664539.summary_ja: 42歳男性の原発性縦隔GCT（腹腔外GCT）の症例報告。化学療法抵抗性を示し、肝臓を含む多臓器転移。放射線療法・化学療法にもかかわらず進行。診断後8ヶ月で死亡。
pmid-37664539.summary_en: Case report of a 42-year-old man with primary mediastinal malignant GCT (an extragonadal GCT type) with refractory disease and multiple systemic metastases including liver involvement. Despite radiotherapy and chemotherapy modification, disease progressed with multiple organ dysfunction. Died 8 months after diagnosis.

pmid-37667763.summary_ja: 精巣GCT（肉腫形質転換奇形腫）の複数の肺および縦隔転移患者の症例報告。複数の外科治療と化学療法で8年以上の生存を達成。
pmid-37667763.summary_en: Case report of a 43-year-old man with testicular GCT (teratoma with somatic-type malignancy/rhabdomyosarcoma transformation) with pulmonary and mediastinal metastases. Multiple surgeries combined with sequential chemotherapy achieved >8 years survival despite challenging refractory disease.

pmid-37667767.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマGCT（未熟奇形腫、胚細胞癌、絨毛癌、セミノーマ）の前立腺転移症例。稀な病態（報告例10例）。腫瘍マーカー上昇と多臓器転移を示した。
pmid-37667767.summary_en: Case of a 57-year-old man with non-seminomatous testicular GCT (immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, seminoma) with concurrent prostatic metastasis. Rare presentation with only 10 cases reported. Showed elevated tumor markers and multiple organ involvement.

pmid-37668336.summary_ja: 子宮頸部の原発性腹腔外ジスジェルミノーマ（GCT）の初報告症例。46歳女性。根治的子宮摘出術とBEP化学療法を実施。14ヶ月後無再発。
pmid-37668336.summary_en: First-ever case report of primary extraovarian dysgerminoma (a female GCT type) involving the uterine cervix in a 46-year-old woman. Combined surgical approach (radical hysterectomy) and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy was effective. No recurrence at 14 months follow-up.

pmid-37668558.summary_ja: 55例の病期I セミノーマ患者を比較した後方視的研究：積極的監視、補助放射線療法、補助カルボプラチン。全アプローチで類似の3年無増悪生存率(92～100%)。全体10年全生存率は98.2%。積極的監視は安全で有効なモダリティ。
pmid-37668558.summary_en: Retrospective study of 55 stage I seminoma patients comparing surveillance, adjuvant radiotherapy, and adjuvant carboplatin. All approaches achieved similar 3-year PFS (92-100%). Overall 10-year OS was 98.2%. Surveillance safe with early detection of relapses occurring within first 24 months.

pmid-37669975.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者518例の術前性ホルモン濃度を検討した多施設研究。3つのホルモンクラスターを同定。GCT組織が性ホルモン関連遺伝子を発現し、現地合成を示唆。
pmid-37669975.summary_en: Multicenter study examining preoperative sex hormone profiles in 518 testicular GCT patients (354 seminoma, 164 NSGCT). Identified three distinct hormonal clusters ('neutral,' 'testicle,' 'pituitary') with different hormone levels. TGCT tissue expressed sex hormone-related genes suggesting in-situ synthesis.

pmid-37675557.summary_ja: 母と児の両者への転移を伴うGTN 22例の系統的レビュー。母体診断までの中央値は産後6週。化学療法感受性が高いが、予後は診断までの時間と β-hCG値に依存。
pmid-37675557.summary_en: Systematic review of 22 reported cases of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) with concurrent metastasis to both mother and baby. Median time to maternal diagnosis was 6 weeks post-partum. High chemosensitivity but prognosis dependent on time to diagnosis and β-hCG levels.

pmid-37675782.summary_ja: 精巣GCT 83例125個のコンポーネントにおけるR-10G反応抗原の発現を定量分析。胚細胞癌は強い標識、セミノーマは陰性、非EC非セミノーマ腫瘍は可変的局所発現。
pmid-37675782.summary_en: Study quantitatively analyzing R-10G-reactive antigen expression in 125 GCT components from 83 testicular specimens. Embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells showed strong R-10G labeling, most seminomas were negative, and non-EC NSGCTs showed variable focal expression, suggesting R-10G as a diagnostic marker for EC.

pmid-37679006.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌の38歳女性の症例報告である。ペムブロリズマブ投与後、パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンおよびパクリタキセルとエトポシドを交互に用いる化学療法により完全寛解を得た。免疫療法が後続の化学療法の効果を高める可能性を示している。
pmid-37679006.summary_en: Case report of a 38-year-old woman with high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma achieving complete remission after pembrolizumab followed by alternating paclitaxel/carboplatin and paclitaxel/etoposide chemotherapy. Demonstrates potential role of immunotherapy in improving subsequent chemotherapy efficacy.

pmid-37679011.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した小型成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫（GCT）の症例報告。精神症状、痙攣、呼吸不全で発症。腹腔鏡下卵巣切除術後に完全寛解。
pmid-37679011.summary_en: Case report of a 37-year-old woman with small (3 × 2.3 cm) mature cystic ovarian teratoma (a GCT type) presenting with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis manifesting as psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and acute respiratory failure. Complete recovery after laparoscopic oophorectomy.

pmid-37680664.summary_ja: 成人女性における原発性肝未熟奇形腫(性腺外胚細胞腫瘍)の症例報告であり、臨床像と画像所見の特徴を記述している。本報告は、奇形腫の発生起源と性腺外奇形腫の定義を背景として、成人の原発性肝奇形腫を提示するものである。肝奇形腫は極めて稀で、全奇形腫症例の1%未満を占め、成人よりも小児に多い。
pmid-37680664.summary_en: Case report of primary immature hepatic teratoma (an extragonadal GCT) in an adult woman. Describes clinical presentation and imaging characteristics. Hepatic teratomas are extremely rare, accounting for <1% of all teratoma cases and more common in children.

pmid-37683054.summary_ja: 病期IIセミノーマ(精巣の胚細胞腫瘍)を対象とした比較治療計画研究である。陽子線療法(IMPT)は、IMRTおよびVMATの光子線計画と比べて危険臓器への放射線線量を低減した。全体的な二次がんリスクおよびほとんどの臓器別リスクも低下させる可能性が示された。
pmid-37683054.summary_en: Comparative treatment planning study for stage II seminoma (a testicular GCT). Proton therapy (IMPT) reduced radiation dose to organs at risk compared to both IMRT and VMAT photon plans, potentially reducing overall secondary cancer risk and organ-specific risks.

pmid-37699777.summary_ja: 小児・思春期卵巣非ゲルミノーマGCTのリンパ管侵襲を分析。50.6%にLVI認め、ステージと年齢に関連。中間リスク群でEFSおよびOSに影響なし。
pmid-37699777.summary_en: Analysis of lymphovascular invasion (LVI) in pediatric and adolescent malignant ovarian nongerminomatous GCTs. LVI present in 50.6% of 83 patients with documented LVI status; more common in stage II/III disease and age >11 years. LVI did not impact EFS or OS in intermediate-risk group.

pmid-37701113.summary_ja: 術後再発した原発性肺絨毛癌患者の症例報告。カルボプラチン、パクリタキセル、ニボルマブ、イピリムマブの併用治療で12ヶ月の持続的奏効を達成。
pmid-37701113.summary_en: Case report of a 72-year-old man with post-surgery relapsed primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma (a GCT type) successfully treated with carboplatin, paclitaxel, nivolumab, and ipilimumab. Achieved sustained response for 12 months despite PD-L1 negativity, with manageable adverse events.

pmid-37705383.summary_ja: 松果体領域腫瘍に対するガンマナイフ放射線治療の系統的レビュー。76例中GCT 4例（確認2例、推定2例）。GCTの3年生存率60%、無増悪生存率33.3%。
pmid-37705383.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of primary Gamma Knife radiosurgery for pineal region tumors. Among 76 patients, 4 were GCTs (2 confirmed, 2 presumed germinomas). Three-year OS for GCTs was 60%; PFS was 33.3%. GCTs and high-grade gliomas predicted disease progression.

pmid-37713839.summary_ja: 精巣GCTにおけるミトコンドリア代謝関連遺伝子の予後相関を明らかにした。2つの分子サブタイプを同定し、異なる免疫表現型と治療応答を示した。8遺伝子リスク特性モデルを構築。
pmid-37713839.summary_en: Study identifying mitochondrial metabolism-related gene signatures in testicular GCT. Found two molecular subtypes with distinct immunophenotypes, drug sensitivity, and immunotherapy response. Developed 8-gene risk model for prognostic evaluation and personalized treatment.

pmid-37715132.summary_ja: スイスの2施設で2010〜2020年に治療された初回臨床病期I(CSI)の胚細胞腫瘍患者を後方視的に解析した。CSI患者360例のうち22.5%が再発し、再発例の大半は予後良好因子を有していた。5年全生存期間(OS)はセミノーマで100%、非セミノーマで87%であり、積極的監視により早期発見が可能で良好な生存が得られることが示された。
pmid-37715132.summary_en: Analysis of stage I testicular GCC patients with relapse after active surveillance. 22.5% relapsed with predominantly good prognosis features. Five-year OS was 100% for seminomas and 87% for non-seminomas, demonstrating early detection enables excellent survival.

pmid-37715631.summary_ja: 高用量炭プラチン化学療法を受けたGCT患者の難聴に関する研究。89%が音声周波数で中度から高度難聴を発症し、22%が補聴器が必要。基線高周波数低下が悪い転帰を予測した。
pmid-37715631.summary_en: Study of hearing loss in GCT patients receiving high-dose carboplatin chemotherapy. 89% developed moderate to profound hearing loss in speech frequencies; 22% needed hearing aids. Baseline high-frequency loss predicted worse outcomes.

pmid-37718391.summary_ja: エジプトの95人の仙尾部奇形腫患者の多施設後方視的研究（2013-2023）。74.7%がAltman type I/IIに分類、82%が良性成熟奇形腫。5年全生存期間(全生存率)および無病生存率は各94%、91%。手術アプローチと長期合併症（尿路/腸機能障害）について検討。
pmid-37718391.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective study of 95 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients in Egypt (2013-2023). 74.7% classified as Altman type I/II; 82% showed benign mature teratoma. 5-year overall and event-free survival rates 94% and 91%. Discusses surgical approaches and long-term morbidity including urinary/bowel dysfunction.

pmid-37720713.summary_ja: 26 歳女性の前縦隔奇形腫による自己免疫溶血性貧血（AIHA）症例。初期のステロイド治療は有効だったが減量時に再発。前縦隔奇形腫の外科的切除により溶血が完全に解消。
pmid-37720713.summary_en: Case of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) as complication of mediastinal teratoma in a 26-year-old female. Initial steroid treatment was successful but disease relapsed upon dose reduction. Surgical resection of mediastinal teratoma resulted in complete resolution of hemolysis.

pmid-37724661.summary_ja: 最初は鼠径陰嚢部ヘルニアと誤診された巨大精巣セミノーマ腫瘍（17×10×9 cm）で対側水瘤を伴う症例。精巣悪性腫瘍と良性陰嚢病変の鑑別診断の困難性と適切な術前計画のための追加画像検査の重要性について述べている。
pmid-37724661.summary_en: Case of giant seminomatous testicular neoplasm (17×10×9 cm) initially misdiagnosed as inguinoscrotal hernia with ipsilateral hydrocele. Discusses diagnostic challenges in distinguishing testicular malignancy from benign scrotal pathology and importance of additional radiologic imaging for proper preoperative planning.

pmid-37726478.summary_ja: GCT 由来体細胞型悪性腫瘍（STM）の分子的、エピジェネティック、プロテオミクス的な包括的特性化。癌由来 STM が yolk sac tumor に類似し、肉腫由来 STM が奇形腫に類似することを示す。FGF シグナル伝達経路変異と新規バイオマーカー（EFEMP1、MIF）を治療標的として同定。
pmid-37726478.summary_en: Comprehensive molecular, epigenetic, and proteomic characterization of GCT-related somatic-type malignancies (STM). Shows carcinoma-derived STM resemble yolk sac tumors while sarcoma-derived STM resemble teratomas. Identifies FGF signaling pathway mutations and novel biomarkers (EFEMP1, MIF) as therapeutic targets.

pmid-37726744.summary_ja: 卵巣構造疾患（卵巣甲状腺腫、甲状腺腫カルチノイド、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫）の後方視的コホート研究。卵巣甲状腺腫は卵巣奇形腫の2.14%を占め、12.0%および4.7%がそれぞれ転移する可能性がある。優れた長期生存転帰。
pmid-37726744.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of ovarian strumal diseases (struma ovarii, strumal carcinoid, malignant struma ovarii) in teratoma patients. Struma ovarii accounts for 2.14% of ovarian teratomas with 12.0% and 4.7% transforming into strumal carcinoid and malignant struma ovarii. Excellent long-term survival outcomes.

pmid-37731724.summary_ja: AFP 上昇を示す 17 歳の思春期後精巣奇形腫で巨大な後腹膜転移を伴う症例。成熟組織学的像にもかかわらず、画像と腫瘍マーカーが潜在的な悪性成分を示唆。PET/CT による転移検出と予後予測の価値を示す。
pmid-37731724.summary_en: Case of 17-year-old with postpubertal testicular teratoma showing elevated AFP and massive retroperitoneal metastasis with high FDG uptake. Despite mature histology, imaging and tumor markers suggested occult malignant components. Demonstrates value of PET/CT in detecting metastasis and predicting prognosis.

pmid-37734076.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞癌（非精上皮腫瘍）の希少な臨床発表の症例：触知可能な精巣腫瘤がない状態での鎖骨上リンパ節腫大と前縦隔転移。標準的な BEP 化学療法と化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清による診断と治療を述べる。
pmid-37734076.summary_en: Case report of testicular embryonal carcinoma (nonseminomatous GCT) with unusual presentation: supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and mediastinal metastasis without palpable testicular mass. Discusses diagnosis and treatment with standard BEP chemotherapy and post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-37739265.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者427人の30年縦断調査（1980-1994年診断）。末梢神経障害、レイノー現象、耳鳴り、難聴などの有害健康転帰を追跡。高用量シスプラチン群は有意に増加した長期合併症を示したが、全体的HrQoLは一般人口と同等。
pmid-37739265.summary_en: 30-year longitudinal follow-up of 427 testicular cancer survivors diagnosed 1980-1994. Tracks adverse health outcomes (neuropathy, Raynaud's phenomenon, tinnitus, hearing loss) and quality of life. High-dose cisplatin group shows significantly increased long-term complications but overall HrQoL comparable to general population.

pmid-37739924.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の卵巣扁平上皮癌（肉腫様亜型含む）6症例の臨床病理学的およびゲノム解析。全症例がPD-L1発現および高い腫瘍変異負荷を示した。PIK3CA、TP53、TERT、相同組換え修復遺伝子に頻出変異。免疫チェックポイント阻害薬およびPARP阻害薬の効果が示唆される。
pmid-37739924.summary_en: Clinicopathologic and genomic analysis of 6 ovarian squamous cell carcinomas (including sarcomatoid variant) arising from mature cystic teratomas. All showed PD-L1 expression and high tumor mutation burden. Identified mutations in PIK3CA, TP53, TERT, and homologous recombination genes, suggesting immunotherapy and PARP inhibitor benefits.

pmid-37744161.summary_ja: エチオピアにおける 187 例の卵巣腫瘍の組織病理学的研究。胚細胞腫瘍が 29.4% を占め、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最も一般的な良性腫瘍（良性例の 37.8%）。表面上皮腫瘍が全体で優位で、次に性索間質腫瘍が続く。
pmid-37744161.summary_en: Histopathologic study of 187 ovarian tumors in Ethiopia. Germ cell tumors account for 29.4% of cases with mature cystic teratomas as the most common benign tumor (37.8% of benign cases). Surface epithelial tumors predominate overall, followed by sex cord-stromal tumors.

pmid-37744434.summary_ja: 胎児腹部および仙尾部奇形腫と寄生胎児 60 症例の MRI 診断研究（仙尾部奇形腫 52 症例、寄生胎児 8 症例）。画像パターンと出生後転帰を分析。MRI の高い診断精度と良好な予後を示すが、IV型腫瘍は合併症が多い。
pmid-37744434.summary_en: MRI imaging study of fetal abdominal and sacrococcygeal teratomas (60 cases including 52 sacrococcygeal and 8 parasitic fetuses). Analyzes imaging patterns and postnatal outcomes. Demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy of MRI with generally favorable prognosis, though type IV tumors prone to complications.

pmid-37744627.summary_ja: ねじれに伴う自動移植を起こした成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫（皮様嚢胞）の寄生性病変の稀な症例。精巣外寄生性奇形腫の診断の困難性を述べ、通常は腹腔内腫瘤の外科的探索中に術中に診断されることを示す。
pmid-37744627.summary_en: Rare case of parasitic mature cystic ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst) with autoimplantation following torsion. Discusses diagnostic challenges in identifying extragonadal parasitic teratomas, typically discovered intraoperatively during surgical exploration.

pmid-37745561.summary_ja: 悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の血清バイオマーカーとしての miR-290-295 クラスター（ヒト miR-371-373 ホモログ）を確立したマウスモデル研究。腫瘍保有マウスの血清で検出されるが対照群では検出されない。モデルの妥当性を検証し、早期 TGCT 検出の向上の可能性を示唆。
pmid-37745561.summary_en: Mouse model study establishing miR-290-295 cluster as conserved serum biomarker for malignant testicular germ cell tumors, homologous to human miR-371-373. Detected in serum of tumor-bearing mice but not controls or mice with benign teratomas. Validates mouse model and highlights potential for improved early TGCT detection.

pmid-37747514.summary_ja: SEER データベースから 520 人の小児 yolk sac tumor 患者の人口ベース研究（2000-2018年診断）。年齢、性別、原発部位（精巣内対精巣外）、治療方法が独立した生存予測因子であることを明らかにした。小児・青年の YST リスク層別化のための予後ノモグラムを開発。
pmid-37747514.summary_en: Population-based cohort study of 520 pediatric yolk sac tumor patients from SEER database (2000-2018). Identifies age, gender, primary site (gonadal vs. extragonadal), and treatment regimen as independent survival predictors. Develops prognostic nomogram for YST risk stratification in children and adolescents.

pmid-37747782.summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍の細胞病理学的診断の35症例（32人の男性患者）の10年機関レビュー。体腔液細胞診、穿刺吸引細胞診、コア生検の高い診断精度を実証。先制化学療法の使用を考慮した初期診断の正確性の重要性を強調。
pmid-37747782.summary_en: 10-year institutional review of cytopathologic diagnosis of extragonadal germ cell tumors in 35 cases from 32 male patients. Demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy of fluid cytology, FNA, and core biopsy techniques. Emphasizes importance of initial accurate diagnosis given widespread use of neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-37753035.summary_ja: 中年女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた大腸腺癌の症例。奇形腫由来の体細胞悪性腫瘍と転移性癌の鑑別の課題を論じている。正確な同定と病期分類のための免疫組織化学と十分なサンプリングの重要性を強調している。
pmid-37753035.summary_en: Case of colorectal adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma in a middle-aged woman. Discusses diagnostic challenges in distinguishing teratoma-derived somatic malignancies from metastatic cancers. Highlights importance of immunohistochemistry and thorough sampling for correct identification and staging.

pmid-37753203.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の2%未満を占めるまれな腫瘍である卵巣甲状腺腫は良性生物学的特性を持つが、稀（3%）に悪性転化する。最も一般的な悪性転化は乳頭状甲状腺癌である。41歳女性は腹部腫瘤で来院し、濾胞性亜型の乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫および虫垂転移を有することが判明し、包括的な外科的管理が必要であった。
pmid-37753203.summary_en: Struma ovarii is a rare teratoma (<2% of ovarian teratomas) with benign biology but rare (3%) malignant transformation. Most common malignant transformation is papillary thyroid carcinoma. This 41-year-old woman presented with abdominal mass, found to have malignant struma ovarii with follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma and appendiceal metastasis requiring comprehensive surgical management.

pmid-37753549.summary_ja: 仙骨前腔は原始胚細胞を含み、腫瘍の起源となる。脊髄内伸展を伴う小児仙骨前腔腫瘍の6症例を報告。未熟および悪性仙尾部奇形腫、神経芽細胞腫などを含み、腫瘍の中心位置と骨関与のパターンなどの特性により鑑別が可能。
pmid-37753549.summary_en: The presacral space contains primitive germ cell types serving as tumor origin. This case series of six pediatric presacral tumors with intraspinal extension includes immature sacrococcygeal teratoma, malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma, and other sarcomas. Imaging features including tumor epicenter, bone involvement, and internal characteristics aid differentiation of these diverse tumors.

pmid-37758451.summary_ja: 妊娒関連絨毛がんは妊娒栄養膜疾患の5%を占める。FIGO分類で低リスクと高リスクに分類され、化学療法で治癒率が高い。局所病変は外科手術なしに化学療法で治癒でき、生殖能温存が可能である。
pmid-37758451.summary_en: Gestational choriocarcinoma accounts for 5% of gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, occurring after molar pregnancies (50%), term pregnancies (25%), or other gestational events (25%). FIGO scoring stratifies patients into low and high-risk disease. Most patients are cured with chemotherapy; <5% die from multi-drug resistance, prompting exploration of immunotherapy and novel combinations.

pmid-37759238.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は50%以上の甲状腺組織を含む稀な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、悪性転化はさらに稀。47歳女性が両側付属器腫瘤と腹壁腫瘤を示し、卵巣甲状腺腫内の乳頭状甲状腺癌と腹壁転移と頸部甲状腺癌と診断され、すべてRET/PTC1再構成を有していた。
pmid-37759238.summary_en: Struma ovarii is a rare mature cystic teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue; malignant transformation is even rarer. This case presents a 47-year-old woman with bilateral adnexal masses and abdominal wall mass revealing papillary thyroid carcinoma within struma ovarii with abdominal wall metastasis and concurrent cervical thyroid cancer—all harboring RET/PTC1 rearrangement.

pmid-37760440.summary_ja: 新補助化学療法(NACT)は進行上皮卵巣癌の高異形度漿液性癌を中心に研究。本システマティックレビューは15研究を検討し、ほとんどの患者がブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンを投与。NACTと一次減量手術の奏効率と生存転帰は同等。
pmid-37760440.summary_en: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) for advanced epithelial ovarian cancer predominantly targets high-grade serous carcinomas. This systematic review of 15 studies examined NACT efficacy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCT). Most patients received bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin. NACT and primary debulking surgery showed similar complete response rates and comparable survival outcomes.

pmid-37761387.summary_ja: 停留精巣は精巣胚細胞腫瘍発症の危険因子である。本研究では停留精巣患者、TGCT患者および対照群の精巣組織を分析し、GCT関連マーカー（POU5F1、PLAP、KIT）およびマイクロRNA（miR-371-373、miR-367）を検査した。停留精巣患者の16.7%が原位置胚細胞新生物と同様のGCT様発現パターンを示した。
pmid-37761387.summary_en: Cryptorchidism is a risk factor for testicular germ-cell tumor development. This study analyzed testicular tissues from cryptorchidism patients, TGCT patients, and controls for GCT-related markers (POU5F1, PLAP, KIT) and microRNAs (miR-371-373, miR-367). 16.7% of cryptorchidism patients showed GCT-like expression patterns similar to germ cell neoplasia in situ.

pmid-37767253.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)は最も一般的な精巣悪性腫瘍で、通常は無痛性結節として発症。本症例は25歳男性の急性陰嚢症で、精巣捻転の疑いが高かったが、外科的探査により混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、非定型的発症を示している。
pmid-37767253.summary_en: Germ cell tumors (GCT) are the most common testicular malignancies, typically presenting as painless nodule or swelling. This case presents a 25-year-old male with acute scrotum highly suspicious for testicular torsion, but surgical exploration revealed mixed germ cell tumors, demonstrating an atypical presentation requiring high clinical suspicion for accurate diagnosis.

pmid-37767307.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの胃転移は稀である。本症例は上部消化管出血として発症し、精巣セミノーマと診断された。詳細な身体診察と病歴聴取が診断に重要である。GCT転移の稀な臨床像を示す。
pmid-37767307.summary_en: Gastric metastases are infrequent; those from testicular germ cell tumors typically arise from nonseminomas. This case presents a 45-year-old man with upper gastrointestinal bleeding from gastric ulcers, elevated lactate dehydrogenase, and retroperitoneal masses, subsequently diagnosed with testicular seminoma with gastric and retroperitoneal metastases, demonstrating an unusual manifestation of GCT.

pmid-37771890.summary_ja: 奇形腫は一般的に性腺から生じるが、腎臓からの発症は稀。未熟腎内奇形腫は非常にまれで、これまで4症例が報告。本症例は新生児における初の報告例で、小児患者における性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の知見を広げる。
pmid-37771890.summary_en: Teratomas commonly originate from gonads but rarely from kidney. Immature intrarenal teratomas are exceptionally rare, with only four cases previously reported. This case presents the fifth immature intrarenal teratoma documented and the first in a neonate, expanding knowledge of extragonadal germ cell tumor presentations in pediatric patients.

pmid-37777577.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の積極的監視は臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍の推奨管理で15～30%の再発率を伴う。本IGCCCG更新データベース分析では、臨床病期Iから再発した症例と新規転移性疾患患者を比較し、同一の予後分層内では同等の生存転帰を示し、より強力な治療による不要な毒性を回避できる可能性を示唆した。
pmid-37777577.summary_en: Active surveillance after orchiectomy is preferred for clinical stage I testicular germ-cell tumors with 15-30% relapse rate. This IGCCCG database analysis compared outcomes of gonadal GCTs relapsing from stage I to de novo metastatic disease. Relapsed stage I patients showed similar survival to de novo patients of the same IGCCCG prognostic group, potentially avoiding unnecessary toxicity.

pmid-37779741.summary_ja: 奇形腫は三つの胚葉由来の構造を含む稀な胚細胞腫瘍で、ほとんどは良性だが悪性化することがある。仙尾部領域が最も一般的な部位で、頸部奇形腫は非常に稀である。本症例は12カ月齢児における巨大な頸部腫瘤で、外科切除で成功し、グレードIII未熟奇形腫と診断されて術後再発なし。
pmid-37779741.summary_en: Teratoma is a rare germ cell tumor containing structures derived from all three embryonic germ layers. While most are benign, some become malignant. Sacrococcygeal region is the most common location, with neck teratomas being very rare. This case presents a 12-month-old child with a huge neck mass found to be immature grade III teratoma, treated successfully with surgical excision.

pmid-37780078.summary_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫と奇形腫の共存は極めて稀であり、術前診断が困難である。本症例の24歳女性は両側卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と顆粒膜細胞腫を有していた。卵巣温存手術により生殖能が保存された。
pmid-37780078.summary_en: Coexistence of granulosa cell tumor with teratoma is extremely rare and cannot be diagnosed preoperatively. This 24-year-old nulligravid woman presented with bilateral adnexal masses initially imaging as teratomas. Bilateral oophorectomy for fertility preservation revealed bilateral mature cystic teratomas coexisting with granulosa cell tumors, demonstrating the importance of histopathological confirmation.

pmid-37780932.summary_ja: 妊娒関連絨毛がんは卵管妊娠として発症した場合、診断が困難である。本症例は組織診により同定され、EMA-CO化学療法により完全奏効を得た。異所性妊娠患者の組織学的確認が診断に重要である。
pmid-37780932.summary_en: Gestational choriocarcinoma is a malignant epithelial tumor of chorionic villi following pregnancy. This case presents a 34-year-old woman initially diagnosed with ruptured tubal pregnancy, but histology revealed primary tubal choriocarcinoma. Six cycles of EMA-CO chemotherapy achieved complete remission with normalized beta-hCG after three cycles, with no metastasis on follow-up.

pmid-37781070.summary_ja: 長いnon-codingRNAのCSNK1G2-AS1は、正常精巣と比較して精巣胚細胞腫瘍で有意に低下した発現を示す。本研究では、CSNK1G2-AS1過剰発現がクローン形成、浸潤および遊走を促進し、アポトーシスを阻害することをEMTおよびAKT媒介シグナル伝達経路を通じて見出し、潜在的治療標的として確立した。
pmid-37781070.summary_en: Long non-coding RNA CSNK1G2-AS1 shows significantly decreased expression in testicular germ cell tumors compared to normal testis. This study found that CSNK1G2-AS1 overexpression promoted clone formation, invasion, and migration while inhibiting apoptosis through EMT and AKT-mediated signaling pathways, establishing it as a potential therapeutic target.

pmid-37781193.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマは極めて稀な腫瘍である。本症例は両側難聴、神経障害、失調を呈した19歳男性で、高力価のanti-Hu抗体を有する縦隔セミノーマが診断された。文献上このような症例は非常に稀である。
pmid-37781193.summary_en: Primary mediastinal seminomas are exceedingly rare tumors localized to the anterior mediastinum. This case describes a 19-year-old male presenting with bilateral hearing loss, progressive neuropathy, and ataxia, subsequently found to have mediastinal seminoma with high-titer anti-Hu antibodies. Only one other case of mediastinal seminoma with anti-Hu antibodies has been reported.

pmid-37789102.summary_ja: miR-371~373およびmiR-302/367クラスターはすべての悪性胚細胞腫瘍で過剰発現される。本研究はCRISPR、ギャップマーおよび核酸阻害剤を用いてこれらのマイクロRNA(miRNA)を機能的にターゲティングした。LNA-DNA阻害は特にセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞で細胞周期破壊を通じた増殖阻害を実証し、潜在的治療アプローチを示している。
pmid-37789102.summary_en: MiR-371~373 and miR-302/367 clusters are overexpressed in all malignant germ cell tumors. This study functionally targeted these microRNAs using CRISPR, gapmer, and nucleic acid inhibitors. LNA-DNA inhibition demonstrated growth inhibition through cell cycle disruption, particularly in seminoma and yolk sac tumor cells, representing a potential therapeutic approach.

pmid-37791194.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は50%以上の甲状腺組織を有する稀な卵巣奇形腫(すべての卵巣腫瘍の0.01%)である。悪性転化は極めて稀である。本症例は卵巣甲状腺腫内の未分化甲状腺癌と併発原発性甲状腺癌を呈する唯一の症例で、報告されているPDTC卵巣甲状腺腫症例10例中では詳密な病理学的検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-37791194.summary_en: Struma ovarii is a rare ovarian teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue (0.01% of ovarian tumors). Malignant transformation is extremely rare. This case uniquely presents poorly differentiated thyroid carcinoma (PDTC) within struma ovarii with concurrent primary thyroid cancer—the only such case among 10 reported PDTC-struma ovarii cases, emphasizing the importance of meticulous pathological examination.

pmid-37791221.summary_ja: 肝転移と肺転移を呈した52歳男性の転移性卵黄嚢腫瘍症例。著明な高コレステロール血症（>800 mg/dL）とAFP>24,000 ng/mLを伴う。卵黄嚢腫瘍に関連する傍腫瘍高コレステロール血症の初報告。
pmid-37791221.summary_en: Case of 52-year-old male with metastatic yolk sac tumor (major histologic subtype of germ cell tumor) presenting with hepatomegaly, pulmonary nodules, and severe hypercholesterolemia (>800 mg/dL). AFP >24,000 ng/mL. First reported case of paraneoplastic hypercholesterolemia associated with yolk sac tumor.

pmid-37794677.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌70%、未熟奇形腫、セミノーマ30%)を呈する23歳患者が孤立性腸骨転移で提示された症例。BEP化学療法とデノスマブで治療。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)正常化と骨化回復を達成し、厳密なフォローアップで最後の化学療法から45カ月の無病生存を継続中。
pmid-37794677.summary_en: Case of 23-year-old with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (embryonic carcinoma 70%, immature teratoma, seminoma 30%) presenting with solitary iliac bone metastasis. Treated with BEP chemotherapy and denosumab. Achieved AFP normalization and ossification recovery; disease-free at 45 months with close follow-up.

pmid-37800819.summary_ja: SEER データベース分析(2000～2019年)では、小児後腹膜非臓器由来悪性腫瘍443例中、神経芽細胞腫に次いで胚細胞腫瘍が2番目に多い病理学的分類である。10年全生存率70.7%; 診断時の転移性疾患は42.9%。完全切除と早期診断が主要な予後因子である。
pmid-37800819.summary_en: SEER database analysis of 443 pediatric retroperitoneal non-organ-originated malignancies (2000-2019). Germ cell tumors were second most common histology after neuroblastoma. Overall 10-year survival 70.7%; metastatic disease present at diagnosis in 42.9%. Complete resection and early diagnosis are key prognostic factors.

pmid-37807242.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後14カ月に肺、腎、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を発症した35歳非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の症例。画像検査は腎静脈内に奇形腫成分を含む転移性病変を明らかにした。血管内侵襲の特定が外科計画において極めて重要であることを強調する。
pmid-37807242.summary_en: Case of 35-year-old with stage IS non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developing lung, kidney, and para-aortic lymph node metastases 14 months post-orchiectomy. Imaging revealed metastatic lesion with teratomatous component in renal vein. Emphasizes importance of identifying endovascular involvement for surgical planning.

pmid-37807988.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎に関連した卵巣奇形腫(胚細胞腫瘍)を有する39歳女性の症例。腹腔鏡下奇形腫摘除後、2カ月の昏睡状態を経て完全回復。卵巣奇形腫と自己免疫性脳炎との重要な関連性および迅速な腫瘍摘除の重要性を強調している。
pmid-37807988.summary_en: Case of 39-year-old woman with anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma (germ cell tumor). Laparoscopic removal of teratoma led to complete recovery after 2 months. Highlights important association between ovarian teratomas and autoimmune encephalitis and importance of prompt tumor removal.

pmid-37810313.summary_ja: 52歳女性の脊髄頸髄移行部成熟奇形腫症例。I型脊髄二分症を合併。手術的切除により症状消失。肺分化を伴う成熟囊胞奇形腫で成人での椎管内外腫瘍としては稀。
pmid-37810313.summary_en: Case of symptomatic mature teratoma at cervicomedullary junction in 52-year-old female with concurrent type I diastematomyelia. Tumor surgically resected with symptom resolution. Histopathology showed mature cystic teratoma with pulmonary differentiation, a rare intradural extramedullary presentation in adults.

pmid-37814767.summary_ja: 24歳女性が両側卵巣捻転を呈し、30 cm粘液性嚢胞腺腫、10 cm成熟奇形腫(胚細胞腫瘍)、および8 cm傍卵管嚢胞による三者構成。液体穿刺後の一塊切除で管理。両側捻転の極めて稀な発生および生殖能力保存の考慮を強調する。
pmid-37814767.summary_en: Case of 24-year-old female with bilateral ovarian torsion caused by triad of masses: 30 cm mucinous cystadenoma, 10 cm mature teratoma (germ cell tumor), and 8 cm paratubal cyst. Emergency surgery with controlled aspiration and en bloc resection. Highlights rarity of bilateral torsion and fertility preservation considerations.

pmid-37822711.summary_ja: 類上皮絨毛腫瘍の肝転移を伴う46歳女性症例。化学療法、手術、熱焼灼、ペムブロリズマブ免疫療法で治療し4年無病生存。他の妊娠絨毛性疾患と比べて稀で、hCG産生低く、診断困難で化学療法抵抗性。
pmid-37822711.summary_en: Case of 46-year-old female with epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) and hepatic metastasis treated with multimodal therapy including chemotherapy, surgery, thermoablation, and pembrolizumab. Patient disease-free at 4 years. Notes ETT's rarity, low hCG production, diagnostic challenges, and relative chemoresistance.

pmid-37822958.summary_ja: 33歳男性の未治療停留精巣に伴う胚細胞腫瘍による転移性疾患。化学療法後の膀胱後腔における残存腫瘤が転移と確認された。転移範囲と血管浸襲の正確な評価の重要性が強調される。
pmid-37822958.summary_en: Case of 33-year-old man with undescended testis complicated by germ cell tumor with metastatic spread. After chemotherapy, residual mass found in retrovesical space. Histology confirmed testicular germ cell tumor metastasis. Emphasizes importance of accurate assessment of metastatic extent and vascular involvement.

pmid-37824765.summary_ja: 若年男性における非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と乳頭状甲状腺癌の同時性症例。両悪性腫瘍にRAS遺伝子とBRAF遺伝子の共通の遺伝的変異があり、BRAF-V600Eが両者で陽性であることから遺伝的素因の可能性が示唆される。
pmid-37824765.summary_en: Case of synchronous non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and papillary thyroid carcinoma in young male. Discusses shared genetic alterations in RAS and BRAF genes suggesting common pathogenetic background. BRAF-V600E positive in both malignancies, indicating genetic predisposition rather than treatment-related oncogenesis.

pmid-37829125.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛がんに関する撤回論文。妊娠絨毛性疾患の稀な悪性腫瘍で集学的治療を要する。細胞増殖の分子機構を検討。注：論文は撤回されている（DOI: 10.1155/2022/7155525）。
pmid-37829125.summary_en: Retracted study on gestational choriocarcinoma, a rare malignant gestational trophoblastic disease requiring multidisciplinary treatment. Examined molecular mechanisms of cell proliferation in gestational choriocarcinoma. Note: This article has been retracted (DOI: 10.1155/2022/7155525).

pmid-37829264.summary_ja: 65歳の閉経後女性における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化による高分化扁平上皮癌の症例。高齢、巨大な腫瘍サイズ、多量の固形成分が悪性転化の危険因子。標準的治療ガイドラインが不足していることが課題。
pmid-37829264.summary_en: Case of 65-year-old postmenopausal woman with malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma to well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma.
