Emphasizes need for high suspicion of malignancy in elderly patients with large tumors and significant solid components. Notes rarity of SCC from MCT and lack of standard treatment guidelines.

pmid-37833000.summary_ja: 精巣がん若年患者の未充たされた包括的ニーズのレビュー。90%以上の治癒率で30-50年の生存期間が期待され、生存期間全体を通じた専門的支援が必要。独特のニーズに対応する戦略が重要。
pmid-37833000.summary_en: Clinical review of unmet holistic needs of younger men with testicular cancer survivors. High cure rates (>90% with early detection) result in 30-50 year life expectancy, requiring specialized support across survivorship. Emphasizes need for provider strategies addressing unique psychosocial and physical needs.

pmid-37834953.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫を有する女性の26.5%が子宮内膜症を併存。卵巣予備能や妊娠能に影響を与える可能性があり、術前カウンセリングで両疾患の認識と生殖能保存オプション説明が重要。
pmid-37834953.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 985 women with endometriosis and 83 with ovarian dermoid cysts (mature teratomas/germ cell tumors). Found 22 women with both conditions; 26.5% of women with dermoid cysts also had endometriosis. Emphasizes need for awareness and fertility preservation counseling.

pmid-37835511.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の放射線療法の役割を検討したナラティブレビュー。侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に対する化学療法、手術、放射線療法の多学科的プロトコール。既存研究は小規模で後方視的であり、最新技術評価が必要。
pmid-37835511.summary_en: Narrative review of radiotherapy role in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (invasive moles, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumors). Discusses multidisciplinary protocols combining chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy. Notes most studies are small and retrospective; modern techniques need further evaluation.

pmid-37837953.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者27,143例の死因分析。肺・大腸がん、第二悪性腫瘍、心疾患、事故、自殺が主要死因。局所進行例は一般人口より非がん死亡リスク低い。転移例はがん関連死亡高率。
pmid-37837953.summary_en: Analysis of causes of death in 27,143 testicular cancer patients. Leading causes included lung/colon cancers, second malignancies, cardiac disease, accidents, and suicide. Localized TC patients had lower non-cancer mortality than general population; metastatic cases had higher TC-related deaths.

pmid-37840845.summary_ja: Li-Fraumeni症候群患者の成熟卵巣囊胞奇形腫からの二次性神経膠芽腫発生の初報告。MCTから神経膠芽腫が発生した場合の遺伝的素因調査の重要性。IDH1野生型で攻撃的経過。
pmid-37840845.summary_en: First reported case of secondary somatic glioblastoma arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma in patient with Li-Fraumeni syndrome. Highlights importance of investigating genetic predisposition when glioblastoma develops from mature teratoma. Demonstrates aggressive behavior with wild-type IDH1 status.

pmid-37845684.summary_ja: 24歳患者の巨大未熟縦隔奇形腫（190×150×140 mm）症例。化学療法と胸部切開で治療。未熟縦隔奇形腫の稀少性と診断における放射線学的・病理学的評価の重要性を強調。
pmid-37845684.summary_en: Case of 24-year-old with massive (190×150×140 mm) immature mediastinal teratoma treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by thoracotomy. Highlights rarity of immature mediastinal teratomas and importance of radiological and pathological assessment for diagnosis.

pmid-37846273.summary_ja: 新生児では一般的だが成人での発症は極めて稀な仙尾部奇形腫（胚細胞腫瘍）の56歳女性症例。大多数が良性嚢胞性であり悪性転化は1～2%のみ。診断は放射線検査で偶発的、治療は完全な手術切除が標準。
pmid-37846273.summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma (germ cell tumor) in 56-year-old female. SCT most common in newborns but rarely in adults. Majority are benign cystic lesions with only 1-2% malignant transformation. Complete surgical excision is standard treatment.

pmid-37848723.summary_ja: 35例の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍（成熟奇形腫24例、セミノーマ4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍5例、混合型2例）をPET/CT分析。SUVmaxは良性と悪性の区別と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍識別に有用、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)レベルと相関。
pmid-37848723.summary_en: Study of 35 mediastinal germ cell tumor patients using PET/CT imaging. Analyzed 24 mature teratomas, 4 seminomas, 5 yolk sac tumors, and 2 mixed GCTs. SUVmax showed highest discriminative ability between benign and malignant mediastinal GCTs and correlated with AFP levels.

pmid-37852093.summary_ja: 帝王切開時に偶然発見された右卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例。組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の乳頭状甲状腺癌と診断。TTFおよびサイログロブリン陽性で甲状腺分化を確認。追加治療なく術後7年で再発なし。
pmid-37852093.summary_en: Case of a 37-year-old woman incidentally found to have right ovarian mature cystic teratoma (20×20×10mm) during cesarean section. Histological examination revealed papillary thyroid carcinoma arising within the teratoma. Immunohistochemistry confirmed thyroid differentiation (TTF1, Thyroglobulin positive). No additional treatment given; patient remains disease-free 7 years post-surgery.

pmid-37854862.summary_ja: 胸痛と発熱で発症した21歳女性の肺動脈原発絨毛癌の症例。当初肺炎と誤診され診断が遅延。PET/CTで高代謝病変を検出；hCG-β値が著しく高値で絨毛癌と確定診断。化学療法に良好に奏効。過去15例の報告のみであり稀少性を強調。
pmid-37854862.summary_en: Case report of a 21-year-old fertile woman with primary pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma presenting with chest pain and fever. Initial misdiagnosis as pneumonia delayed diagnosis. PET/CT revealed hypermetabolic lesion; markedly elevated hCG-β subunit confirmed choriocarcinoma. Patient underwent chemotherapy with good response. Literature review identified only 15 previously reported cases.

pmid-37864665.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内の異所性甲状腺組織（ストルマオバリ）内に発生する悪性腫瘍のレビュー。乳頭状甲状腺癌、ストルマルカルチノイド、濾胞甲状腺癌など一般的な悪性腫瘍について論じている。TTF1免疫染色による悪性病変と周囲産婦人科上皮の鑑別と診断援助を強調。
pmid-37864665.summary_en: Review of malignant neoplasms arising within struma ovarii (ectopic thyroid tissue within mature ovarian teratomas). Discusses common malignancies including papillary thyroid carcinoma, strumal carcinoid, follicular thyroid carcinoma, and other thyroid carcinomas. Emphasizes TTF1 immunostaining utility in differentiating malignant lesions from surrounding gynecologic epithelium to assist diagnosis.

pmid-37868445.summary_ja: 頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍(性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の稀な提示)を呈した25歳患者の症例報告。1年間の左側頸部腫脹で発症。細針吸引細胞診で胚細胞腫瘍を示唆。診断後、化学療法と広範囲局所切除を施行し、病理組織学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍を確認。
pmid-37868445.summary_en: Case report of a 25-year-old patient with endodermal sinus tumor (yolk sac tumor) of the neck, a rare presentation of extragonadal germ cell tumor (EGCT). Patient presented with painful left-sided neck swelling for one year. Fine needle aspiration cytology suggested GCT. Following diagnosis, patient received chemotherapy and underwent wide local excision with histologic confirmation of endodermal sinus tumor.

pmid-37873049.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内の甲状腺組織（ストルマオバリ）が濾胞甲状腺癌に悪性転化した28歳女性の症例。右下腹部激痛で発症。両側卵管卵巣摘除術、網嚢摘除術、子宮全摘術施行。稀少性と不十分なガイドラインのため管理に課題がある。
pmid-37873049.summary_en: Case of a 28-year-old woman with struma ovarii (thyroid tissue in mature ovarian teratoma) that underwent malignant transformation to follicular thyroid carcinoma. Patient presented with severe right iliac fossa pain. Treatment included bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, and hysterectomy. Diagnosis confirmed by biopsy; management remains challenging due to rarity.

pmid-37873788.summary_ja: 妊娠21週の胎児に診断された右後縦隔の成熟三胚葉嚢胞性奇形腫（グレード0）の症例。3cm大嚢胞性腫瘤は周囲組織の対側シフトを引き起こした。組織学的に透明軟骨、平滑筋、神経組織、呼吸上皮など三胚葉誘導体が認められた。
pmid-37873788.summary_en: Case report of a 21-week gestation fetus with mature cystic teratoma (grade 0) in right posterior mediastinum. The 3cm cystic mass caused contralateral displacement of surrounding structures. Histological examination revealed derivatives of three germ layers: hyaline cartilage, smooth muscle, nervous tissue, and respiratory epithelium. Discusses prenatal diagnosis and differential diagnosis of fetal mediastinal masses.

pmid-37876879.summary_ja: 外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍のSMARCB1/INI-1欠損症例報告。SMARCB1変異が体細胞コピー数異常によってNGSで過小報告される可能性を指摘。診断戦略として病理検討、INI1免疫組織化学検査、NGS過小報告の認識が提案されている。
pmid-37876879.summary_en: Case report of vulvar yolk sac tumor with SMARCB1/INI-1 deficiency, highlighting underreporting of SMARCB1 alterations by next-generation sequencing due to somatic copy number variations. Proposes diagnostic strategy: careful pathology review for rhabdoid cells, INI1 immunohistochemistry confirmation in NGS-negative cases, and awareness of potential NGS underreporting.

pmid-37881126.summary_ja: METTL3がmiR-935/GJA1経路を介して絨毛癌進行を促進するメカニズム研究。miR-935は絨毛癌組織で上昇し、細胞増殖、遊走、侵襲、血管新生を促進。METTL3はm6Aメチル化を介してmiR-935成熟を促進。絨毛癌治療における新規治療標的の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-37881126.summary_en: Molecular study investigating METTL3's role in choriocarcinoma progression through the miR-935/GJA1 axis. MiR-935 was upregulated in choriocarcinoma tissues and promoted cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and angiogenesis. METTL3 promoted miR-935 maturation through m6A methylation, identifying a novel therapeutic target for choriocarcinoma management.

pmid-37883882.summary_ja: 進行期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対する術前化学療法(NACT)の治療例。24歳女性患者がNACTと手術により腫瘍サイズ、組織学的検査、腫瘍マーカーにおいて完全寛解を達成。文献レビューで111篇から2症例のみが詳細評価対象となり、進行期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対するNACTの有用性が示唆された。
pmid-37883882.summary_en: Case report of a 24-year-old woman with advanced ovarian yolk sac tumor treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by surgery. Patient achieved complete response in tumor size, histopathology, and tumor markers. Literature review of 111 manuscripts identified only 2 additional cases with similar presentation, highlighting rarity and potential benefit of NACT for advanced ovarian yolk sac tumors.

pmid-37888320.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者122例の後方視的研究。CTベースラジオミクス機械学習モデルで化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清前の病理組織学(線維化/壊死、奇形腫、生存腫瘍)を予測。最適AUC 0.945。若年患者の過度/過少治療リスク低減の有望なツール。
pmid-37888320.summary_en: Retrospective study of 122 metastatic non-seminomatous testicular GCT patients. CT-based radiomics machine learning models integrated clinical predictors to predict histopathology (fibrosis/necrosis, teratoma, viable tumor) before post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Support Vector Machine model achieved optimal AUC of 0.945, potentially reducing over/under-treatment in young patients.

pmid-37889308.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん患者を対象とした無作為化試験の後方視的分析。BEP化学療法中の運動は化学療法後の運動と比較して肺機能(FVC、FEV1、DLCO)をより良く保持し、血管内皮機能障害マーカー(vWF、因子VIII)を低減。1年フォローアップでも有益。
pmid-37889308.summary_en: Post hoc analysis of a randomized trial examining physical exercise effects during or after BEP chemotherapy in metastatic testicular cancer patients. Exercise initiated during chemotherapy better preserved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, DLCO) and reduced vascular endothelial dysfunction markers (vWF, factor VIII) compared to post-chemotherapy exercise, with benefits sustained at one-year follow-up.

pmid-37899082.summary_ja: 卵巣未成熟奇形腫（グレード3）とanti-NMDAR自己免疫脳炎を合併した思春期女性の症例。腫瘍切除後、免疫療法と化学療法の同時投与を受けた。術後フォローアップで再発なし。卵巣奇形腫患者において同時性自己免疫脳炎の認識と適切な管理の重要性が強調された。
pmid-37899082.summary_en: Case of an adolescent female with grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma concurrent with anti-NMDAR autoimmune encephalitis. Following tumor resection, the patient received combined immunotherapy and chemotherapy. Post-operative follow-up showed no recurrence or sequelae, emphasizing the importance of recognizing concurrent autoimmune encephalitis in patients with ovarian teratoma, particularly immature variants.

pmid-37900463.summary_ja: 胃における卵黄嚢腫瘍と腺癌成分の共存症例報告(73歳男性)。消化管における稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で、根治的切除と化学療法後に良好な長期生存を達成。
pmid-37900463.summary_en: Case report of yolk sac tumor coexisting with adenocarcinoma components in stomach of 73-year-old male. Rare extragonadal germ cell tumor in gastrointestinal tract with favorable outcome after curative resection and chemotherapy.

pmid-37900513.summary_ja: 救急部門に陰嚢痛の急性発症で呈した転移性精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍症例報告。非典型的な臨床提示にもかかわらず高い臨床的疑いが診断に重要であることを示す症例。
pmid-37900513.summary_en: Case report of metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor presenting with acute posterior scrotal pain to emergency department. Demonstrates importance of clinical suspicion despite atypical presentation.

pmid-37900803.summary_ja: 性腺外縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者における全身型リンパ管異常の症例報告。化学療法中に溶骨性病変が放射線学的に認められ、複数の生検により異常なリンパ管増殖が病理学的に確認された。骨溶解性病変は多くの異なる病因を持ち、腫瘍性病変に似たものもあるため、特に若年成人患者においてGLAの臨床的疑診が診断アプローチの第一段階であることが強調されている。
pmid-37900803.summary_en: Case report of generalized lymphatic anomaly (GLA) diagnosed in patient with extragonadal mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who developed lytic lesions during chemotherapy. Highlights GLA in differential diagnosis.

pmid-37900809.summary_ja: 左尿管圧迫による水尿管症で発症した乳幼児の後腹膜未熟奇形腫症例。小児腹腔内腫瘍の鑑別診断を検討。
pmid-37900809.summary_en: Case report of large retroperitoneal immature teratoma (grade 3) in infant presenting with unilateral hydronephrosis from mass effect on ureter. Discusses differential diagnosis of abdominal masses in children.

pmid-37900852.summary_ja: 小児の巨大成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。2003年から2023年の16例の文献レビューを含めて、大型腫瘍の外科的治療を検討。
pmid-37900852.summary_en: Case report of giant mature cystic ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst) in 10-year-old girl with diameter >15 cm. Reviews 16 additional cases from 2003-2023 and discusses surgical management of large pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-37900855.summary_ja: 病期IIIC非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（不良予後）がCOVID-19を合併した症例報告である。BEP化学療法を継続しながらソトロビマブで同時治療管理した結果、重篤な合併症なく化学療法を完了し、腫瘍マーカー正常化と部分奏効を達成した。免疫抑制下でも治療可能性が高い疾患の同時治療が可能であることを強調している。
pmid-37900855.summary_en: Case report of stage IIIC non-seminoma testicular germ cell tumor (poor prognosis) patient treated with BEP chemotherapy while managing concurrent COVID-19 with sotrovimab. Demonstrates successful completion of curative therapy despite immunosuppression.

pmid-37901019.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（TMGCT）の症例報告であり、典型的な精巣腫大と疼痛ではなく、反復性発熱と左鎖骨上リンパ節腫大で呈現した稀な症例である。病理組織学的特徴と免疫組織化学的検査結果を報告することで、胚細胞腫瘍の認識における診断上の課題と早期診断の重要性を強調した。
pmid-37901019.summary_en: Case report of testicular mixed germ cell tumor (TMGCT) with atypical presentation of recurrent fever and left supraclavicular lymphadenopathy rather than typical testicular pain. Highlights diagnostic challenges in GCT recognition.

pmid-37903968.summary_ja: 先天的尿道膣瘻と水性腟液貯留を合併した新生児の仙尾部奇形腫症例。腫瘍による圧迫に基づく尿路合併症を詳述している。
pmid-37903968.summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal teratoma with associated urethrovaginal fistula and hydrocolpos in 1-day-old neonate. Discusses tumor pathogenesis and urological complications resulting from mass effects.

pmid-37909181.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫155例の予後因子と補助化学療法の役割を検討した研究。腫瘍マーカーと臨床進行期が予後を規定することを示している。
pmid-37909181.summary_en: Retrospective study of 155 pure ovarian immature teratoma patients examining prognostic factors and role of adjuvant chemotherapy. Demonstrates positive postoperative tumor markers and FIGO stage II-IV as prognostic factors.

pmid-37913592.summary_ja: 古代エジプト新王国時代の埋葬地から発見された成熟卵巣奇形腫の古病理学的報告。アフリカ大陸における最古の成熟卵巣奇形腫症例である。
pmid-37913592.summary_en: Paleopathological case report of mature ovarian teratoma recovered from 18-21-year-old female buried at New Kingdom Amarna, Egypt (~1345 BCE). Oldest known example of mature ovarian teratoma from Pharaonic Egypt and Africa.

pmid-37915675.summary_ja: サウジアラビア癌レジストリの10年間分析における絨毛癌成分を有する混合型胚細胞腫瘍33症例の検討。大多数が若年グループ（18～45歳）で発生し、45.5%が診断時に高悪性度病変と遠隔転移を呈現した。全体死亡率は15%で、不良予後と攻撃的な臨床経過を示した。
pmid-37915675.summary_en: 10-year Saudi Cancer Registry analysis of 33 cases of mixed germ cell tumors with choriocarcinoma components. Demonstrates aggressive behavior with 45.5% high-grade/metastatic presentation and 15% mortality rate.

pmid-37915688.summary_ja: 乳幼児における巨大仙尾部奇形腫（性腺外未熟奇形腫）の症例報告。出生体重5 kgのうち2.5 kgを占める巨大腫瘤を呈現した新生児。完全切除を行い、病理組織学的検査で性腺外未熟奇形腫を確認。仙尾部奇形腫の組織学的分類と外科的管理について述べ、早期診断の重要性を強調。
pmid-37915688.summary_en: Case report of large sacrococcygeal teratoma (immature extragonadal germ cell tumor) in neonate weighing 5 kg with 2.5 kg tumor mass. Discusses classification, histopathology, and surgical management of rare embryonal tumor.

pmid-37927659.summary_ja: 性腺外縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が縦隔腫瘍症候群による心停止を合併した症例報告。陽圧換気開始直後に致命的な心停止が発生したが、適切な蘇生処置により成功裏に回復した。学際的アプローチと適時な化学療法開始の重要性を強調し、生命危機的なGCT合併症の管理戦略を示した。
pmid-37927659.summary_en: Case report of extragonadal mediastinal germ cell tumor complicated by mediastinal mass syndrome with resulting cardiac arrest. Highlights importance of multidisciplinary approach for managing life-threatening GCT complications.

pmid-37927849.summary_ja: 進行中の妊娠と共存する妊娠関連栄養膜疾患の症例分析。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌を含む管理戦略と産前後の監視方法を詳述している。
pmid-37927849.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of five cases of gestational trophoblastic disease coexisting with progressing pregnancy, including hydatidiform moles and invasive moles with choriocarcinoma. Discusses prenatal and postnatal monitoring and management strategies.

pmid-37928866.summary_ja: 腎動脈仮性動脈瘤破裂による後腹膜血腫で発症した妊娠関連栄養膜疾患の症例。GTNの非典型的な発症形式と血管合併症を強調している。
pmid-37928866.summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma) with unusual complication of acute retroperitoneal hematoma from renal artery pseudoaneurysm rupture. Emphasizes atypical presentations and vascular complications of GTN.

pmid-37931975.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における妊孕性温存手術後の妊孕性転帰についての調査研究（77例）。85%の妊娠率と80.4%の生児出産率を報告した。手術単独群と化学療法併用群で妊孕性転帰に統計的有意差を認めず、化学療法投与量と妊孕性転帰の間に相関関係もなかった。
pmid-37931975.summary_en: Survey study of 77 women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors with fertility-sparing surgery. Reports 85% conception rate and 80.4% live birth rate with no significant difference between surgery-only and chemotherapy groups.

pmid-37936993.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮を呈現した稀な症例報告である。非セミノーマ性の純粋胎児性癌が全体的に壊死した状態で精巣摘出術で発見された。転移性疾患を伴わない原発腫瘍の自然退縮は稀であり、このような呈現を示す症例は特に注目される。
pmid-37936993.summary_en: Case report of regressed testicular germ cell tumor, specifically non-seminomatous pure embryonal carcinoma showing spontaneous regression and necrosis. Rare presentation of primary tumor regression without metastatic disease.

pmid-37948362.summary_ja: 良性成熟卵巣奇形腫および悪性卵巣奇形腫（未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の悪性変性を含む）の画像所見と組織病理学的相関を包括的に検討する論文。放射線科医による診断が多学科治療の指針となる。
pmid-37948362.summary_en: Comprehensive review of imaging findings and histopathologic correlation of benign mature teratomas and malignant ovarian teratomas, including immature teratomas and malignant degeneration. Emphasizes radiologist's role in guiding interdisciplinary care and improving outcomes.

pmid-37952494.summary_ja: 14歳女性の19cm右前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。呼吸困難症状で発見、重要構造圧迫。血管鉗子法による完全摘出で予後良好。巨大縦隔奇形腫に対する外科的マネジメント。
pmid-37952494.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl presented with dyspnea from a 19 cm right anterior mediastinal mass compressing vital structures. Imaging confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Using hemiclamshell approach with contents aspiration for improved mobilization, complete en bloc resection was achieved. Postoperative course was uneventful with complete symptom resolution, demonstrating surgical management of giant mediastinal teratoma.

pmid-37954076.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと卵巣ジスジェルミノーマの生物学的同等性を実証。同一形態、遺伝子異常（KIT/RAS、12p増幅）、多能性マーカー共通。白金化学療法で生存率>90%だが長期毒性課題。臨床試験統合と化学療法減量戦略を提案。
pmid-37954076.summary_en: This comprehensive review demonstrates that testicular seminoma and ovarian dysgerminoma are biologically analogous diseases sharing identical morphology, genetic features (KIT/RAS mutations, chromosome 12p amplification), and pluripotency markers. Both achieve >90% survival with BEP chemotherapy but face significant lifelong toxicity. The authors propose unified clinical trials and chemotherapy de-escalation strategies.

pmid-37957624.summary_ja: 非妊娠関連絨毛がんのPDXモデル初樹立。原発腫瘍と同様のhCG発現と遺伝子発現プロファイルを維持。シスプラチン、MTX感受性を示し、臨床効果予測とGCT新規治療開発に有用。
pmid-37957624.summary_en: Researchers established the first patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model of non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGC). The PDX retained morphological features, elevated hCG expression, and gene expression profiles similar to the primary tumor. RNA sequencing identified 568 dysregulated genes. The model demonstrated sensitivity to cisplatin and methotrexate, predicting clinical drug response.

pmid-37957930.summary_ja: 若年絨毛がん患者の妊孕性温存治療成績。第一選択化学療法の奏効率72.22%、二次治療後全体的88.88%。出産率22.22%で、6児とも正期産で先天異常なし。
pmid-37957930.summary_en: This study evaluated fertility-sparing treatment in 18 young patients (≤40 years) with gestational choriocarcinoma (GC). Complete response to first-line chemotherapy was 72.22%; salvage treatment achieved response in progressive cases. Overall complete response was 88.88% with 2 deaths. Birth rate was 22.22% with 6 children born at term and no congenital abnormalities detected.

pmid-37958463.summary_ja: 小児・若年成人の卵巣悪性GCT 61例を検討。5年全生存率98.3%、無増悪生存率84.9%。減量ブレオマイシンで生存率変わらず、3ヶ月以内の腫瘍マーカー正常化が良好予後と関連。
pmid-37958463.summary_en: This study analyzed 61 pediatric and young adult patients (≤39 years) with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Five-year overall survival was 98.3% and event-free survival was 84.9%. Reduced bleomycin dose did not compromise survival. Rapid tumor marker normalization within 3 months predicted better outcomes. Long-term toxicity was minimal with manageable peripheral neuropathy.

pmid-37964422.summary_ja: 出生前診断仙尾部奇形腫の予後因子を検討。全体死亡率34.9%。心肥大、高血管性、充実性腫瘍、胎児水腫、胎盤腫大、TFR>0.12が不良予後と関連。
pmid-37964422.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated prognostic factors in prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) from 11 studies involving 447 patients. Overall mortality was 34.9%. Poor prognostic factors included cardiomegaly, hypervascular tumor, solid morphology, fetal hydrops, placentomegaly, and tumor-to-fetal-weight ratio >0.12 before 24 weeks.

pmid-37968167.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのpN0病変（後腹膜リンパ節郭清で陰性）の発生率0-22%を検証。小さいリンパ節やmiRNA-371陰性が関連。治療効率化と診断精度向上の課題。
pmid-37968167.summary_en: This systematic review examined pN0 (pathologically node-negative) disease in testicular seminoma patients undergoing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection despite enlarged nodes. pN0 rates ranged 0-22% across studies. Associations with smaller lymph nodes and negative serum miRNA-371 were identified, highlighting potential historical overtreatment and opportunities to improve staging accuracy.

pmid-37969673.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患39例の治療成績。WHO危険度層別化に基づく化学療法（MTX/actinomycin D またはEMACO）で、低危険度85.7%、高危険度87.5%の奏効率。二次治療の成功例も報告。
pmid-37969673.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 39 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients used WHO risk stratification. Low-risk patients (n=14) received single-agent methotrexate/actinomycin D with 85.7% response rate; high-risk patients (n=25) received EMACO with 87.5% response rate. Salvage therapy achieved response in nonresponders, with outcomes dependent on WHO score and metastasis location.

pmid-37975918.summary_ja: 精巣GCTの治療成績>95%、病理用語統一、IGCCCG危険度層別化、腫瘍マーカー（AFP、hCG）、マイクロRNAバイオマーカーを総説。診断・治療モニタリングの進展。
pmid-37975918.summary_en: This review comprehensively discusses testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs), which now achieve >95% overall cure rates. It covers standardized pathological terminology, the IGCCCG risk stratification model, prognostic determinants including serum markers (AFP, hCG), and emerging microRNA biomarkers for noninvasive diagnosis and treatment monitoring of seminomas and non-seminomatous GCTs.

pmid-37976717.summary_ja: 15歳女性の卵巣ジスジェルミノーマ（FIGO IC）症例。腫瘍マーカー上昇と腹膜転移を伴い、妊孕性温存化学療法で良好な転帰。若年卵巣GCT患者の管理戦略。
pmid-37976717.summary_en: A 15-year-old female presented with ovarian dysgerminoma (FIGO IC), elevated CA-125 levels, and peritoneal involvement. After right adnexectomy and fertility-sparing polychemotherapy, the patient achieved satisfactory disease progression. The case demonstrates clinical management strategies and favorable outcomes in young patients with ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-37979002.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの放射線療法の役割と最新治療戦略を検証。従来の術後照射から化学放射線療法や手術併用への転換、二次発がんリスク軽減戦略を紹介。治癒率95%以上。
pmid-37979002.summary_en: This review evaluates radiation therapy advances for testicular seminoma, a highly radiosensitive and curable GCT. Recent developments include combined chemoradiation and surgical approaches for clinical stage II disease, with strategies to reduce secondary malignancy risk while maintaining cure rates exceeding 90%. Discussion of shifting from adjuvant RT to surveillance in stage I disease.

pmid-37986051.summary_ja: 付属器腫瘤診断におけるO-RADS超音波分類と主観的判断を比較。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫などの良性病変鑑別能が改善され、特に若手医師の診断精度向上に有効。
pmid-37986051.summary_en: This study compared O-RADS ultrasound risk stratification with subjective clinical judgment for diagnosing adnexal masses in 616 patients. O-RADS demonstrated superior sensitivity in detecting malignant tumors (84.4-91.2%) and better discrimination of benign lesions including mature cystic teratoma, particularly compensating for junior clinicians' diagnostic limitations.

pmid-37986544.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に高発現するグリピカン3ペプチドに対するCD8+T細胞免疫療法を検討。cGAS/STING経路の活性化を介した腫瘍縮小効果を示し、ペプチドワクチン療法の有効性を実証。
pmid-37986544.summary_en: This study evaluated glypican-3 (GPC3) peptide-based immunotherapy for testicular yolk sac tumor (TYST), which highly expresses this antigen. GPC3-specific CD8+ T cells demonstrated potent cytotoxicity through enhanced cGAS/STING signaling, with adoptive cell transfer and peptide treatment significantly inhibiting tumor growth, suggesting GPC3 vaccination as a promising treatment strategy.

pmid-37994745.summary_ja: 本レビューは、20～35歳の男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍である精巣がんを検証し、原癌遺伝子、腫瘍抑制遺伝子、DNA修復遺伝子における遺伝子変異に焦点を当てている。バイオマーカーおよび治療標的を特定するための、ゲノミクス、トランスクリプトミクス、プロテオミクス、メタボロミクスを含むオミックス方法について論じている。
pmid-37994745.summary_en: This review examines testicular cancer, the most common malignancy in males aged 20-35, focusing on genetic mutations in oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and DNA repair genes. Omics methods including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics are discussed for identifying biomarkers and therapeutic targets to improve diagnosis and management of testicular cancer.

pmid-37995507.summary_ja: 45歳女性が悪性卵巣甲状腺腫（甲状腺組織を有する単胚葉卵巣奇形腫）、肺腺がん、乳頭状甲状腺癌を含む3つの同時性一次性がんで発症した。卵巣摘除術、甲状腺摘除術、肺切除を含む多領域管理により、完全な治療と良好な転帰を達成した。
pmid-37995507.summary_en: A 45-year-old woman presented with three synchronous primary cancers including malignant Struma Ovarii (monodermal ovarian teratoma with thyroid tissue), lung adenocarcinoma, and papillary thyroid carcinoma. Multi-disciplinary management including ovariectomy, thyroidectomy, and lung resection achieved complete treatment with favorable outcomes.

pmid-37996954.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるCXCR4/CXCR7シグナル伝達およびCXCR4標的ナノボディ-薬物複合体(NDC)の治療効果を調査する研究。CXCR4-NDCはセミノーマおよび卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞においてアポトーシスを誘導；CXCL12刺激は増殖/遊走を増加させ、CXCR4阻害薬で可逆的；CXCR4-NDCはGCTの潜在的治療選択肢を示す。
pmid-37996954.summary_en: Study investigating CXCR4/CXCR7 signaling in germ cell tumors and therapeutic efficacy of CXCR4-targeting nanobody-drug-conjugate (NDC). CXCR4-NDC induced apoptosis in seminoma and yolk-sac tumor cells; CXCL12 stimulation enhanced proliferation/migration reversible by CXCR4 inhibitors; CXCR4-NDC represents potential therapeutic option for GCT.

pmid-37998008.summary_ja: 北イタリアの385精巣がん症例(1996-2020)の研究。発生率増加(APC 1.6%)、特にセミノーマ(APC 2.3%)。5年生存率95%(セミノーマ99%、非セミノーマ88%)。死亡率は常に低く、37例が精巣がん診断前後の一次精巣外腫瘍が記録された。
pmid-37998008.summary_en: Study of 385 testicular cancer cases in northern Italy (1996-2020) showing increasing incidence (APC 1.6%), particularly in seminomas (APC 2.3%). Overall 5-year survival was 95% (99% seminoma, 88% non-seminoma). Mortality remained constantly low; 37 cases documented with primary extratesticular tumors before or after testicular cancer diagnosis.

pmid-38001671.summary_ja: 1007例の小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の後方視的分析(2010-2019)：奇形腫70.11%、悪性胚細胞腫瘍29.89%。児童の約50%が3歳未満；年齢が解剖学的位置と病理学的型を決定。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の5年無増悪生存率/全生存期間は82.33%/94.13%。縦隔部位およびαフェトプロテイン≥10,000 ng/mLは独立した不良予後因子であった。
pmid-38001671.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 1007 pediatric extracranial GCTs (2010-2019): 70.11% teratomas, 29.89% malignant GCTs. ~50% of children <3 years; age determines anatomical location and pathology. 5-year event-free/overall survival for malignant GCTs were 82.33%/94.13%. Mediastinal site and AFP≥10,000 ng/mL were independent adverse prognostic factors.

pmid-38004082.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における診断/予後バイオマーカーおよび治療標的としてのマイクロRNAのナラティブレビュー。miR-371a-3pは一次診断で84-89%の感度および90-99%の特異度を有して最も有望を示す。疾患モニタリング、治療反応評価、残存病変検出、再発予測の有用性について論じている。
pmid-38004082.summary_en: Narrative review of microRNAs as diagnostic/prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in testicular germ cell tumors. MiR-371a-3p shows highest promise with 84-89% sensitivity and 90-99% specificity for primary diagnosis. Discusses utility for disease monitoring, treatment response assessment, residual disease detection, and relapse prediction.

pmid-38006835.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する小児、思春期および若年成人患者の外科治療における重要な要素をレビューした。悪性腫瘍に対する鼠径部根治的精巣摘除術、血清腫瘍マーカーが正常な思春期前腫瘍に対する部分的精巣摘除術、および化学療法後に残存後腹膜腫瘤を有する患者における後腹膜リンパ節郭清の適切な使用の重要性を強調している。
pmid-38006835.summary_en: Review of critical surgical elements for children, adolescents, and young adults with testicular germ cell tumors. Emphasizes importance of inguinal radical orchiectomy for malignant tumors, partial orchiectomy for prepubertal tumors with normal serum markers, and appropriate use of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-38010764.summary_ja: 羊膜穿破による胎児母体間出血を伴う胎盤内絨毛癌19例の系統的レビュー。周産期死亡率36.8%、75%で転移、母体死亡率5.5%、7例に化学療法が必要であった。非特異的症状による診断遅延を強調し、転移例においても生殖能保持的アプローチの有用性を指摘している。
pmid-38010764.summary_en: Systematic review of 19 cases of intraplacental choriocarcinoma complicated by fetomaternal hemorrhage (2000-March 2023). Perinatal mortality 36.8%; 75% had metastases; maternal mortality 5.5%; chemotherapy needed in seven cases. Emphasizes delayed diagnosis due to aspecific symptoms and benefits of fertility-sparing approaches even with metastasis.

pmid-38020885.summary_ja: KPT6566（Pin1阻害剤）が精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)細胞の増殖を抑制し、アポトーシスを誘導することを示した。活性酸素の産生とOct-4およびSox2の低下によるもので、P19細胞異種移植片における腫瘍容積および質量が減少した。Pin1阻害剤がTGCTの潜在的治療法の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-38020885.summary_en: Study demonstrating that KPT6566, a Pin1 inhibitor, suppresses proliferation and induces apoptosis in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cells. Treatment reduced tumor volume and mass in P19 cell xenografts by generating reactive oxygen species and downregulating Oct-4 and Sox2. Suggests Pin1 inhibitors as potential therapeutic approach for TGCTs.

pmid-38022303.summary_ja: 正常妊娠経過後に肺転移を伴う妊娠絨毛癌と診断された31歳女性の症例。吸引搔爬術後、6サイクルの化学療法で著効を得た。18ヶ月後に妊娠・出産に成功し、合併症なく経過している。
pmid-38022303.summary_en: Case of 31-year-old woman diagnosed with gestational choriocarcinoma with pulmonary metastasis following uncomplicated full-term pregnancy. After suction evacuation and curettage, underwent six chemotherapy cycles with excellent response. Patient subsequently conceived and delivered healthy baby 18 months later without complications.

pmid-38022859.summary_ja: 先天性口蓋奇形腫と広い口蓋裂を有する生後25日の女児の気道管理症例。MRIで挿管困難が予測されたが、多職種チームアプローチにより通常ラリンジョスコピーで挿管成功し、腫瘍完全切除を達成した。新生児気道管理の課題を示す症例である。
pmid-38022859.summary_en: Case report of difficult airway management in 25-day-old girl with large congenital palate teratoma and wide cleft palate. Despite predicted impossible intubation on MRI, patient successfully intubated by conventional laryngoscopy under sevoflurane anesthesia with multidisciplinary team approach; tumor was successfully resected.

pmid-38023162.summary_ja: 27歳女性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例で、複数の肝臓腫瘤とhCG高値を認めた。18F-FDG PET/CTで胃竇と肝臓に環形の強い集積を認め、骨盤領域に転移なし。病理検査で原発性胃絨毛癌と診断され、診断および病期分類のためのPET/CTの重要性を示している。
pmid-38023162.summary_en: Case of primary gastric choriocarcinoma in 27-year-old female with multiple liver masses and markedly elevated hCG levels. 18F-FDG PET/CT showed ring-shaped intense uptake in gastric sinus and liver with no pelvic involvement. Histopathology confirmed primary gastric choriocarcinoma, illustrating importance of PET/CT for diagnosis and staging.

pmid-38024429.summary_ja: 病期IIA/IIB非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のロボット支援化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-rRPLND)33例の後方視的研究。42.4%が成熟奇形腫、中央手術時間180分、前向性射精が75.8%で保存され、中央26ヶ月フォローアップで3例の再発を認めた。
pmid-38024429.summary_en: Retrospective study of 33 patients undergoing robot-assisted post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-rRPLND) for Stage IIA/IIB non-seminomatous GCTs. 42.4% had mature teratoma at histology; median operative time 180 minutes; anterograde ejaculation preserved in 75.8%; three recurrences during median 26-month follow-up.

pmid-38024999.summary_ja: 妊娠後期に初めて検出された巨大心膜成熟奇形腫の出生前診断症例。初診では先天性肺気道奇形と診断されたが、術中所見で心膜原発が明らかになり、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と確認された。妊娠後期の新規病変では他の鑑別診断を考慮する必要性を示唆している。
pmid-38024999.summary_en: Antenatal case of huge pericardial mature teratoma detected in late third trimester, initially misdiagnosed as congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM). Intraoperative findings revealed pericardial origin; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma. Case emphasizes need for considering differential diagnoses when lesions appear for first time in late pregnancy.

pmid-38025990.summary_ja: 妊娠滋養膜疾患80例・158測定値を対象とした総hCGと遊離β-サブユニットhCGの診断能比較研究。総hCGは遊離β-hCGが検出感度以下の59例で疾患検出可能であり、GTD管理における総hCGの優位性を実証している。
pmid-38025990.summary_en: Study comparing total hCG and free β-subunit hCG as diagnostic markers for gestational trophoblastic disease in 80 patients with 158 measurements. Total hCG detected disease in 59 cases where free β-hCG fell below sensitivity threshold, demonstrating superior sensitivity of total hCG for GTD management.

pmid-38026742.summary_ja: 腸間膜根部の後腹膜成熟奇形腫からの慢性皮膚瘻に対するRoux-en-Y転向術の症例。主要血管関与により根治的腫瘍切除は不可能であったが、嚢胞十二指腸吻合による瘻の転向と瘻孔切除により症状の改善を達成した。
pmid-38026742.summary_en: Novel surgical case of Roux-en-Y diversion for chronic cutaneous fistula from irresectable retroperitoneal mature teratoma in mesenteric root. Major vessel involvement precluded radical tumor resection, but fistula diversion via cystojejunostomy with tract excision successfully resolved distressing fistula symptoms.

pmid-38033015.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍43例の拡散強調画像検査の特性を評価した。純粋な奇形腫は他の悪性胚細胞腫瘍より高いADC値(1403.50±161.76 x10⁻³ mm²/s)を示した。ADC値1179 x10⁻³ mm²/sで感度95.8%、特異度92.9%で純粋な奇形腫と他の組織型を区別できた。
pmid-38033015.summary_en: Study of 43 pediatric extracranial GCT patients evaluating diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) features. Pure teratomas showed higher mean ADC values (1403.50±161.76 x10⁻³ mm²/s) than malignant GCTs. ADC cutoff of 1179 x10⁻³ mm²/s differentiated pure teratomas from other histologies with 95.8% sensitivity and 92.9% specificity.

pmid-38033414.summary_ja: 48歳男性のセミノーマの初回診断から25年後に頸部リンパ節と腎臓に転移が出現した症例報告。本症例は、治療終了後の患者に晩期遠隔再発の可能性と、その後の疾患出現時に医師への報告の重要性を強調している。
pmid-38033414.summary_en: Case report of 48-year-old male with seminoma metastases to cervical lymph nodes and kidney presenting 25 years after initial diagnosis. Case emphasizes necessity of informing discharged patients about possibility of late remote relapse and importance of reporting any subsequent illness to physician.

pmid-38034416.summary_ja: 23歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出術中に破裂し、2年後に腹部トロカル創部に扁平上皮癌が出現した症例。初回手術時は良性だったが、新補助化学療法と腫瘍減量手術により疾患制御が可能となり、診断後3年の生存を達成している。
pmid-38034416.summary_en: Case of 23-year-old female with ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) that leaked during laparoscopic cystectomy and later presented with trocar-site squamous cell carcinoma with peritoneal and bladder invasion. Despite benign initial pathology, successful neoadjuvant chemotherapy and tumor reduction surgery achieved disease control, with survival to 3 years after diagnosis.

pmid-38039829.summary_ja: 小児および思春期卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の手術治療における重要な要素をレビューした。治療の毒性を最小化しながら治癒を優先する最適な治療を確保するために、腫瘍破裂と溢出を避けながら同側卵巣摘除術による完全切除と初期腫瘍切除時の完全な腹腔内病期分類が重要である。
pmid-38039829.summary_en: Review of critical operative elements for pediatric and adolescent ovarian germ cell tumors, emphasizing importance of optimal therapy for cure while minimizing toxicities. Covers complete ipsilateral oophorectomy with tumor spillage avoidance and complete intraperitoneal staging at time of initial resection.

pmid-38039830.summary_ja: 小児仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍は小児期の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の中で最も一般的で、小児奇形腫の約70%を占める。新生児の外向性腫瘍から骨盤内悪性腫瘍を有する高齢乳幼児まで、さまざまなプレゼンテーション全体にわたる完全腫瘍切除の技術的側面を提示する。
pmid-38039830.summary_en: Review of critical surgical elements for pediatric sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors, the most common extragonadal GCT in children accounting for ~70% of childhood teratomas. Presents technical aspects of complete tumor resection across presentations, from neonatal exophytic tumors to older infants with pelvic malignancies.

pmid-38044499.summary_ja: 精巣がん認識キャンペーンにおけるユーモアベースのメッセージング戦略の有効性に関する比較的批判的レビュー。6つの研究分析から、ユーモアを用いた戦略は精巣自己検診の知識を向上させ、検出への不安を軽減したが、長期的な行動変化への影響については証拠が限定的である。
pmid-38044499.summary_en: Comparative critical review of humor-based messaging in testicular cancer awareness campaigns. Analysis of six studies found that humor-based strategies enhanced knowledge of TC and testicular self-examination procedures, reduced anxiety about detection, though limited evidence exists on long-term behavioral impacts.

pmid-38044780.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者37例を対象とした研究で、原発腫瘍周辺の衛星GCNIS病変を評価し、精巣温存手術における安全な切除マージンを決定した。最遠GCNIS距離の平均は5.08±2.77mm、75.6%の患者で7mm未満であり、7mmのマージンが大部分の患者で衛星病変を切除できることを示唆している。
pmid-38044780.summary_en: Study of 37 testicular cancer specimens examining satellite GCNIS lesions around primary tumors to establish safe surgical margins. Mean furthest GCNIS distance was 5.08±2.77mm; 75.6% had lesions <7mm, suggesting 7mm safety margin would excise satellite lesions in approximately 75% of patients undergoing testis-sparing surgery.

pmid-38045429.summary_ja: 29歳男性の縦隔原発性絨毛癌の症例で、女性化乳房、両肺転移、下垂体微腺腫、著しく上昇したhCG値を呈した。化学療法と免疫療法の併用治療にもかかわらず、診断後6ヶ月で死亡。女性化乳房を呈する男性における絨毛癌の可能性を考慮することの重要性を示唆している。
pmid-38045429.summary_en: Case of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma in 29-year-old male presenting with gynecomastia, lung metastases, and pituitary microadenoma with markedly elevated hCG levels. Despite chemotherapy combined with immunotherapy, patient died 6 months after diagnosis. Case highlights need for considering choriocarcinoma in males presenting with gynecomastia.

pmid-38046261.summary_ja: 異なる組織型の転移性双側精巣GCT症例。右側セミノーマ後、3.5年で左側混合GCT（未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胚細胞癌）を発生。
pmid-38046261.summary_en: Case report of metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histopathology: right seminoma followed 3.5 years later by left mixed germ cell tumor with immature teratoma, yolk sac tumor, and embryonic carcinoma components.

pmid-38046966.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの頭蓋骨単独転移の稀な症例。Tc-99m MDPシンチグラフィで検出。セミノーマの骨転移は極めて稀。
pmid-38046966.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma with isolated skull bone metastasis detected on Tc-99m MDP scintigraphy with SPECT/CT. Bone metastases, particularly isolated presentation, are extremely rare in seminoma.

pmid-38058586.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍901症例のMRI診断アルゴリズムに関する研究。成熟嚢胞奇形腫の診断精度が高く、良性・悪性腫瘍の鑑別が可能であることを示した。
pmid-38058586.summary_en: Retrospective study of 901 patients under 50 years with ovarian tumors using MRI-based diagnostic algorithm. High diagnostic accuracy achieved for ovarian mature cystic teratoma (OMCT), effectively differentiating benign from borderline/malignant lesions.

pmid-38060735.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ（pT1b）の前立腺単独転移の稀な症例。初期経過観察後、BEP化学療法により完全奏効を得、5年無病生存中。
pmid-38060735.summary_en: Rare case of isolated prostate metastasis from testicular seminoma (pT1bN0M0S0 with rete testis invasion) in 32-year-old male treated with active surveillance. Achieved complete response to BEP chemotherapy with 5-year disease-free survival.

pmid-38069192.summary_ja: 精巣GCT救済療法のバイオマーカーについての文献レビュー。マイクロRNA、遺伝子発現プロファイル、免疫関連バイオマーカーについて論述。
pmid-38069192.summary_en: Comprehensive review of prognostic and predictive biomarkers for salvage therapy in testicular germ cell tumors. Discusses microRNAs, gene expression profiles, and immune-related biomarkers for improved risk stratification and treatment selection in recurrent disease.

pmid-38069214.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおけるPTTG1相互作用体の解析。SPTBN1がPTTG1を細胞質に局在させ、核転位と浸潤能を抑制。セミノーマ予後因子の候補。
pmid-38069214.summary_en: Investigation of PTTG1 interactome in seminoma cells identifying SPTBN1 as a novel securin interactor anchoring PTTG1 in cytoplasm. SPTBN1 downregulation promotes PTTG1 nuclear translocation and invasive capability, suggesting both as potential seminoma prognostic factors.

pmid-38073742.summary_ja: 女性生殖器の稀な部位に発生した成熟嚢胞奇形腫の2症例。後腹膜嚢胞と子宮頸部発生例を報告。GCTの稀な局在についての重要な報告。
pmid-38073742.summary_en: Case reports of benign cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) at unusual locations in female genital tract: posterior cul-de-sac and cervical canal. Demonstrates rare anatomical presentations of mature teratomas in non-gonadal sites.

pmid-38074010.summary_ja: 小児・思春期精巣GCT患者32名のBEP化学療法治療成績。無病生存率63.7%、全生存率76.1%。11歳以上で予後不良を示した。
pmid-38074010.summary_en: Observational study of 32 children and adolescents with testicular germ cell tumors treated with BEP chemotherapy. Event-free survival 63.7% with overall survival 76.1% at median 9.1-year follow-up. Patients over 11 years showed adverse histology and higher mortality.

pmid-38074016.summary_ja: 性腺外非妊娠性絨毛癌（腎由来の可能性）の症例。脳、腎、肺、肝、膵など広範転移を有し、複数の化学療法に抵抗性。稀有疾患の治療の課題を議論。
pmid-38074016.summary_en: Case report of extragonadal non-gestational choriocarcinoma, possibly renal origin, in 24-year-old female with widespread metastases (brain, kidneys, lungs, liver, pancreas). Discusses diagnostic criteria, pathogenesis, and treatment challenges of this rare malignancy.

pmid-38074183.summary_ja: 精巣NSGCT患者9名のRPLND後長期成績を検討。5年全生存率66%、無病生存中央値21ヶ月。卵黄嚢腫瘍と胚細胞癌が最多組織型。
pmid-38074183.summary_en: Retrospective study of 9 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors undergoing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection post-chemotherapy. Overall 5-year survival was 66% with disease-free survival 21 months median, yolk sac and embryonal carcinoma most common.

pmid-38075548.summary_ja: 非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍を有する18歳女性の症例。初回温存手術後に急速進行したが、EMA-CO化学療法により21ヶ月間完全奏効を維持中。
pmid-38075548.summary_en: Case report of stage IIB non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor component in 18-year-old nulliparous female. Despite initial fertility-preserving surgery, disease progressed rapidly; completion surgery and EMA-CO chemotherapy achieved complete response.

pmid-38078466.summary_ja: Y染色体を有する性分化疾患患者の性腺GCT発症率を検討。全体25%のGCT有病率、ジェルミノーマが最多。年齢18歳以上と先天異常が独立した危険因子。
pmid-38078466.summary_en: Retrospective study of 54 patients with disorders of sexual differentiation with Y chromosome examining prevalence and risk factors for gonadal germ cell tumors. Dysgerminoma was most common malignant type, with 25% overall prevalence of gonadal GCTs.

pmid-38084546.summary_ja: 成人男性の肝成熟嚢胞奇形腫の症例。肝奇形腫は全奇形腫の1%未満と極めて稀。完全切除が最善の治療法である。
pmid-38084546.summary_en: Case report of mature cystic teratoma of liver in 27-year-old male presenting with abdominal pain. Hepatic teratomas are extremely rare, comprising <1% of all teratomas with fewer than 50 adult cases reported in literature.

pmid-38090032.summary_ja: 縦隔巨大腫瘍（10cm以上）の文献レビュー。奇形腫を含む種々の腫瘍型の組織学的・免疫組織学的特性を記述。GCTの縦隔発症について言及。
pmid-38090032.summary_en: Literature review of giant mediastinal tumors (≥10 cm), including histopathological and immunohistochemical features. Discusses mediastinal teratomas among various benign and malignant lesions that can present as large masses.

pmid-38090034.summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例。修正された剣状突起下胸腔鏡下手術により治療。合併症なく軽快し、extragonadal GCTの手術治療例。
pmid-38090034.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old female with anterior mediastinal mature teratoma discovered incidentally, treated with modified subxiphoid thoracoscopic thymectomy without perioperative complications.

pmid-38090535.summary_ja: 双胎妊娠における頸部奇形腫を含む気道閉塞性病変に対するEXIT-to-airway手術。一卵性双胎での実施可能性を示し、両児の安全な分娩方法を報告。
pmid-38090535.summary_en: EXIT-to-airway procedures for twin pregnancies with fetal neck masses, including a case of giant cervical teratoma in monochorionic pregnancy. Reports successful intubation and delivery methodology for both affected and unaffected twins.

pmid-38096801.summary_ja: Growing teratoma syndromeは化学療法奏効中も奇形腫病変が増大する現象。広範転移卵巣GTS13症例の超拡大手術成績を検討。69.2%でR0切除達成、周術期リスク高いが良好な生存成績得られた。
pmid-38096801.summary_en: Growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) is a paradoxical phenomenon where teratomatous masses enlarge despite chemotherapy response. This retrospective study of 13 patients with extensive metastatic ovarian GTS demonstrates satisfactory survival with ultra-radical surgery, achieving R0 resection in 69.2% despite significant perioperative risks.

pmid-32720553.summary_ja: 先天性未分化仙骨尾側類皮嚢胞摘出後の新生児における鞘膜神経膠腫症。類皮嚢胞に関連した組織学的所見で後腹膜未分化外性腺類皮嚢胞に伴う。
pmid-32720553.summary_en: Case report of tunica vaginalis gliomatosis in 6-month-old following excision of immature sacrococcygeal teratoma. Gliomatosis peritonei, typically associated with ovarian teratomas, occurred in extragonadal congenital immature teratoma setting.

pmid-32780684.summary_ja: ターナー症候群女性105例のコホート研究。Y染色体モザイク9例は予防的性腺摘出を施行。性腺芽腫/異性生殖腫は認めず。全悪性腫瘍リスクは増加しないが中枢神経系腫瘍が多い。
pmid-32780684.summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 105 Turner syndrome women assessing overall malignancy risk and specifically gonadoblastoma/dysgerminoma risk in Y chromosome mosaicism. Nine Y-mosaic patients underwent prophylactic gonadectomy with no gonadoblastoma/dysgerminoma detected. CNS tumors were more frequent than in general population.

pmid-33041185.summary_ja: 単剤カルボプラチンAUC10で治療された転移性セミノーマ216例の多施設研究。3年PFSは96.5%、5年DSSは98.3%であった。主な毒性は骨髄抑制(グレードIII好中球減少37%)であった。カルボプラチンAUC10が標準治療の選択肢として確立されることが示された。
pmid-33041185.summary_en: Multi-institutional study of 216 metastatic seminoma patients treated with single-agent carboplatin AUC10. Three-year PFS was 96.5% and five-year disease-specific survival was 98.3%. Major toxicity was myelosuppression (37% grade III neutropenia). Establishes carboplatin AUC10 as standard treatment option.

pmid-33063585.summary_ja: 仙骨尾側類皮嚢胞10例の分子解析。成熟型では免疫エフェクター関連遺伝子が未分化型より過剰発現。免疫細胞浸潤は成熟上皮要素周囲に優位。
pmid-33063585.summary_en: Molecular analysis of 10 sacrococcygeal teratomas with different histologic elements (mature, immature, neuroglial). Genes involved in immune effector processes were overexpressed in mature vs immature SCTs. Immune cell infiltration predominantly surrounded mature epithelial elements.

pmid-33402570.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患患者111例の治療成績。低リスク群は初回化学療法奏効率48.5%でも5年生存率100%。メトトレキサート8日間投与は週1回投与より高い奏効率を示した。高リスク群の生存率は79.3%。
pmid-33402570.summary_en: Study of 111 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients. Low-risk patients achieved 100% five-year overall survival even when initial MTX or ActD failed. Five-year survival was significantly lower in high-risk patients (79.3% vs 100%). MTX-FA 8-day regimen showed higher response than weekly schedule.

pmid-33557577.summary_ja: 健常対照者、ムンプス精巣炎患者、セミノーマ患者のADC値を比較したDWI-MRI研究。セミノーマでは平均ADC値が有意に低かった(0.43 vs 0.85×10⁻³mm²/s)。0.54×10⁻³mm²/sのADCカットオフ値により、感度99%でセミノーマとムンプス精巣炎を鑑別した。
pmid-33557577.summary_en: DWI-MRI study comparing ADC values in healthy controls, mumps orchitis patients, and seminoma patients. Seminoma showed significantly lower mean ADC values (0.43 vs 0.85 × 10⁻³ mm²/s). ADC cutoff of 0.54 × 10⁻³ mm²/s differentiated seminoma from mumps orchitis with 99% sensitivity.

pmid-33588700.summary_ja: 単睾丸のセミノーマ患者11例を対象に、精巣温存手術後の補助放射線療法の安全性と有効性を検討した研究である。中央値21か月のフォローアップで局所・遠隔の再発は認められず、54.5%でホルモン機能が維持された。治療前のテストステロン値が高いほど、外因性アンドロゲン補充の必要性が低い関連が示された。
pmid-33588700.summary_en: Study evaluates testis-sparing surgery with adjuvant radiotherapy for seminoma in monorchid patients. Among 11 patients followed for median 21 months, local control was achieved without relapse and hormonal function was preserved in 54.5%. Higher baseline testosterone reduced risk of androgen replacement need.

pmid-33632056.summary_ja: 34歳男性、眼瞼腫脹と眼瞼下垂で発症。精巣原発の絨毛膜癌眼窩転移。双側精巣腫瘤と播種性転移。集学的化学療法施行。不良予後の播種性GCT。
pmid-33632056.summary_en: Case of 34-year-old man presenting with eyelid swelling and ptosis found to have metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma. MRI showed right superior rectus enlargement; biopsy demonstrated metastatic choriocarcinoma positive for pan-cytokerratins, beta-HCG, and GATA3. Bilateral testicular masses with disseminated metastatic disease. Patient underwent intensive chemotherapy.

pmid-33750683.summary_ja: スウェーデン・ノルウェーの非セミノーマGCT 213例の人口ベース研究。化学療法後10-49mm残存腫瘤。65%が一側転移、対側転移リスク1.6-2.6%、再発リスク0-4%。一側廓清の検討可能性を支持。
pmid-33750683.summary_en: Population-based prospective observational study (RETROP) of 213 nonseminoma GCT patients in Sweden/Norway with 10-49mm residual retroperitoneal tumor undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND (2007-2014). 65% had unilateral retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Unilateral metastases associated with low risk of contralateral disease (1.6-2.6%) and recurrence.

pmid-33770056.summary_ja: 当初胎盤奇形腫と診断された症例のDNA遺伝子型判定研究である。「奇形腫」と正常胎盤組織の遺伝子プロファイルが同一であったことから、真の奇形腫ではなく、一卵性の無心体(無形)双胎と確立された。分子遺伝子型判定による誤診回避の重要性が示されている。
pmid-33770056.summary_en: DNA genotyping study of case initially diagnosed as placental teratoma. Genetic analysis revealed identical microsatellite polymorphism profiles between "teratoma" and normal placental tissue, establishing diagnosis as monozygotic acardiac (amorphous) twin, not true teratoma. Demonstrates importance of molecular genotyping to avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-33770060.summary_ja: 子宮癌肉腫内に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍。上皮成分は子宮内膜様および漿液性、肉腫成分は均質。卵黄嚢腫瘍は主に腺性配置。免疫染色でHER2検査実施。
pmid-33770060.summary_en: Case report of yolk sac tumor (YST) arising within uterine carcinosarcoma containing endometrioid and serous carcinomatous components plus homologous sarcomatous component. YST showed predominantly glandular configuration. Extensive immunostaining performed including HER-2 testing for therapeutic assessment.

pmid-33770061.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫10例（成熟9例、未熟1例）内の気管支様構造の報告。気管支周囲に腺組織と平滑筋層。TTF1、Napsin A陽性で肺由来を確認。低倍でしばしば浸潤性で腺がんと誤診の危険性。
pmid-33770061.summary_en: Case series of 10 ovarian teratomas (9 mature, 1 immature) with previously unreported bronchus-like structures. Structures consisted of well-formed bronchus surrounded by glandular tissue with variable smooth muscle, sized 2.5-10mm. TTF1 and Napsin A immunostaining confirmed pulmonary cell lineage. Follow-up showed no recurrence.

pmid-33782342.summary_ja: 55歳女性の不規則性器出血。子宮内膜掻爬で粘液性上皮、低悪性度腫瘍を疑う。子宮全摘で成熟奇形腫と診断。子宮下部成熟囊胞性奇形腫は極めて稀。粘液性要素での悪性腫瘍誤診の可能性。
pmid-33782342.summary_en: Case report of 55-year-old woman with irregular perimenopausal bleeding. Endometrial curettage showed mucinous epithelium suggesting low-grade mucinous malignancy, but hysterectomy revealed diagnosis of mature uterine teratoma. Mature cystic teratoma of lower uterine segment is very rare; keratin element can lead to carcinoma misdiagnosis.

pmid-33888026.summary_ja: 新生児期に冠動脈を包み込んだ巨大心膜内奇形腫の外科的管理に関する症例報告。心膜内奇形腫はまれな良性腫瘍で、心肺合併症の可能性があるため新生児期の外科的切除が必要となる。腫瘍が冠動脈を覆い隠す場合の技術的な困難さを強調している。
pmid-33888026.summary_en: Case report of surgical management of giant intrapericardial teratoma encasing coronary artery in neonatal period. Intrapericardial teratomas are rare benign tumors requiring neonatal surgical resection due to potential cardiorespiratory complications. Highlights technical challenges when tumor obscures coronary vasculature.

pmid-33904194.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、リンパ管腫、粘膜貯留嚢胞、髄膜瘤を含む口腔内腫瘤を有する胎児6例を対象とした後方視的研究。出生前超音波検査および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により病変を効果的に同定・特徴づけることができた。MRIは下咽頭へのマス効果と気道閉塞を明らかにし、2例で子宮外分娩中治療が必要となった。
pmid-33904194.summary_en: Retrospective study of 6 fetuses with oral masses including mature teratoma, immature teratoma, lymphangiomas, mucosal retention cysts, and meningocele. Prenatal ultrasound and MRI effectively identified and characterized lesions, with MRI clarifying mass effect on hypopharynx and airway obstruction in 2 cases requiring ex-utero intrapartum therapy.

pmid-33940178.summary_ja: 腫瘍の配偶子形成関連仮説を更新する理論的総説。原始生殖細胞、胚性幹細胞、胚性胚細胞が、生殖腺および異所性部位で奇形腫/奇形癌腫を形成しうることを論じている。体細胞の無性的減数分裂性胚のサイクルとp53阻害の役割を含む新たなモデルを提案している。
pmid-33940178.summary_en: Theoretical review proposing updated gametogenesis-related hypothesis of tumors. Discusses evidence that primordial germ cells, embryonic stem cells, and embryonic germ cells can develop teratomas/teratocarcinomas in gonads and ectopic sites. Proposes novel model involving somatic asexual meiotic embryonic cycle and p53 inhibition role.

pmid-33944655.summary_ja: 胎盤内絨毛膜癌に伴う大量胎児母体間出血の症例報告。新生児重症貧血および母児転移を伴う。胞状奇胎関連疾患として極めて稀な合併症。β-hCG監視の重要性を強調。
pmid-33944655.summary_en: Case report of massive fetomaternal hemorrhage associated with intraplacental choriocarcinoma (ICC), resulting in severe neonatal anemia and metastatic disease in both mother and infant. ICC is rare but important diagnosis to consider in massive fetomaternal hemorrhage. Highlights importance of β-hCG monitoring.

pmid-33975708.summary_ja: 小児精巣GCTの総説。初期評価、外科および医学的管理、リスク層別化、協調グループ試験の成績を記載。国際協力とクリニカルトライアルへの登録による希少腫瘍転帰改善を強調。
pmid-33975708.summary_en: Comprehensive review of pediatric testicular germ cell tumors, including initial evaluation, surgical and medical management, risk stratification, and outcomes from recent cooperative group studies. Emphasizes international collaboration and enrollment in clinical trials to enhance knowledge and improve outcomes for these rare tumors.

pmid-33982173.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対して141例のロボット支援RPLNDを後方視的に検討した。初回手術が23.4%、化学療法後が76.6%であった。手術時間中央値は525分、出血量は200 mlであった。生存腫瘍は63%、奇形腫は33.3%で検出され、フォローアップ中央値31.3か月、補助化学療法は行われなかった。
pmid-33982173.summary_en: Retrospective review of 141 robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) procedures for testicular cancer: 33 primary (23.4%) and 108 post-chemotherapy (76.6%). Median operative time 525 minutes, blood loss 200ml. Viable tumor detected in 63%, teratoma in 33.3%, with median 31.3-month follow-up and no adjuvant chemotherapy given.

pmid-34048755.summary_ja: 胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍の肺転移が動静脈瘻と自然気胸をきたした稀有症例。胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍は子宮に限局されることが一般的だが肺への転移は報告される。肺動静脈瘻形成は極めて稀。
pmid-34048755.summary_en: Case report of metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor presenting with pulmonary arteriovenous malformations and spontaneous pneumothorax. Gestational trophoblastic disease metastases commonly affect lungs, but arteriovenous malformations from such lesions are extremely rare, representing unusual presentation of disseminated gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-34130302.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者146例の後方視的解析。精巣摘除標本の18%に奇形腫成分が認められ、臨床病期2C～3、内臓転移の頻度が高く、再発のない生存期間が有意に短かった。奇形腫を含む腫瘍では化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の実施率も高かった。
pmid-34130302.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 146 metastasized testicular GCT patients. 18% showed teratomatous elements in orchiectomy specimens associated with higher clinical-stage 2C-3 disease, visceral metastases, and significantly reduced relapse-free survival. Teratoma-containing GCT showed higher rate of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-34146155.summary_ja: 1984年から2017年に単一施設で治療した小児後腹膜奇形腫14例の後方視的症例集積。全例で完全な外科的切除が行われ、血管損傷（40%）や腎摘出（6.7%）などの周術期合併症がみられた。全例で疾患の消失が確認された。
pmid-34146155.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 14 pediatric patients with retroperitoneal teratomas (RPTs, mean age <1 year). All underwent complete surgical resection. Perioperative complications included vessel injuries (40%), nephrectomy (6.7%), and unilateral renal dysfunction (20%). All patients disease-free at follow-up.

pmid-34152083.summary_ja: オーストラリアにおける1990～2013年の609例のGCT患者（96.9%が精巣原発）を対象とした大規模後方視的研究。年齢中央値33歳、純粋セミノーマ54.8%、NSGCT 45.2%。病期Iでの補助放射線療法の使用は減少し、積極的監視は増加した。10年全生存率は93%、GCT特異的生存率は97%で、GCTによる死亡は3%であった。
pmid-34152083.summary_en: Large retrospective study of 609 GCT patients (96.9% testicular) in Australia 1990-2013. Median age 33 years, 54.8% pure seminoma, 45.2% NSGCT. Declining adjuvant radiotherapy use and increased active surveillance for stage I. 10-year overall survival 93%, GCT-specific survival 97%, with 3% mortality from GCT.

pmid-34216455.summary_ja: 帝王切開瘢痕妊娠2カ月後に診断された非典型的胎盤部位絨毛膜腫瘍の症例。急速な増殖と筋層浸潤を示した。超音波検査による鑑別診断と管理の役割を検討。
pmid-34216455.summary_en: Case report of atypical placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) diagnosed two months after caesarean scar pregnancy. Tumor demonstrated rapid growth and myometrial involvement, complicating diagnosis. Ultrasound imaging was valuable for characterizing the lesion and differential diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-34254305.summary_ja: 卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの20歳女性の症例報告。凍結保存した卵子から作製された胚は、母親を代理母として移植され、妊娠が成立した。卵巣癌が活動性の状態で、このような世代間代理出産が行われたのは、著者らの知る限り初の症例である。
pmid-34254305.summary_en: Case report of a 20-year-old woman with ovarian dysgerminoma who underwent oocyte cryopreservation before hysterectomy and oophorectomy. Embryos created from cryopreserved oocytes were transferred to the patient's mother, resulting in successful pregnancy, representing first intergenerational gestational surrogacy in active ovarian cancer patient.

pmid-34255554.summary_ja: 膀胱尿路上皮がんで主要成分をなすヨークサック腫瘍型分化を示す62歳男性の症例。典型的なYST形態を示すが12p異常を欠く体細胞由来YST。遺伝的不安定性に基づく。
pmid-34255554.summary_en: Case report of somatic-type yolk sac tumor as predominant component in bladder urothelial carcinoma of a 62-year-old male with remote lung cancer history. Showed typical YST morphology and immunophenotype but lacked chromosome 12p abnormalities, supporting somatic germ cell differentiation.

pmid-34265804.summary_ja: 25-34歳の外陰部ヨークサック腫瘍3例のSMARCB1欠損と分子特性の解析。典型的なYST形態（SALL4+、glypican-3+）を示すが12p異常なし。3例中2例が再発・転移。
pmid-34265804.summary_en: Study of three vulvar yolk sac tumors (ages 25-34) demonstrating SMARCB1 deficiency but lacking chromosome 12p abnormalities typical of gonadal germ cell tumors. Cases showed typical YST morphology and immunophenotype but exhibited aggressive behavior with recurrence/metastasis in 2 of 3 patients.

pmid-34293822.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍、特に胎児性癌におけるCD24の制御と機能を検討した分子研究である。CD24の発現はエピジェネティックな機序により制御され、胚細胞プログラムを抑制し外胚葉分化を促進する。CD24の阻害はシスプラチン感受性を高めた。
pmid-34293822.summary_en: Molecular study investigating CD24 regulation and function in testicular germ cell tumors, specifically embryonal carcinomas. CD24 expression is controlled by epigenetic mechanisms and suppresses the germ cell program while promoting ectodermal differentiation. CD24 blockade enhanced cisplatin sensitivity.

pmid-34320530.summary_ja: 女性生殖器の稀な奇形腫2例の症例報告。子宮未分化奇形腫と卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う良性濾胞過誤腫。女性生殖器奇形腫の形態学的スペクトラムを拡大。
pmid-34320530.summary_en: Case reports of two unusual gynecologic teratomas: immature uterine teratoma and benign follicular hamartoma arising in association with mature cystic ovarian teratoma. These rare variants expand the recognized morphologic spectrum and pathologic associations of teratomas in the female genital tract.

pmid-34334690.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の体細胞型悪性腫瘍63例（精巣22例、転移41例）の臨床病理学的分析。精巣ではサルコーマ優位、転移ではカルシノーマ優位。転移症例の5年生存率35%で精巣症例（87%）より悪い。
pmid-34334690.summary_en: Clinicopathologic study of 63 testicular germ cell tumors with somatic-type malignancies (22 testicular, 41 metastatic). Sarcomas predominated in primary tumors while carcinomas were most common in metastases. Patients with metastatic somatic malignancies had significantly worse prognosis than those in testis (5-year survival 35% vs 87%).

pmid-34339078.summary_ja: オーストラリア・クイーンズランド州のanti-NMDA受容体脳炎患者31例の誘因分析。5例が卵巣奇形腫関連、3例がHSV脳炎関連、23例は特定の誘因なし。奇形腫関連症例はより重症の経過。
pmid-34339078.summary_en: Queensland cohort analysis of 31 anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis cases identifying triggering events. Five cases triggered by ovarian teratoma, 3 by herpes simplex virus encephalitis, and 23 had no identifiable trigger. Teratoma-associated cases experienced more severe disease but responded to immunotherapy.

pmid-34343562.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者201例の精子凍結保存前処置の格差に関する後向きコホート研究。民間大学病院と公立医療機関で比較。民間病院での実施率が著しく高い（OR 5.60）。保険状況による生殖能温存アクセスの格差を示唆。
pmid-34343562.summary_en: Comparative study of 201 testicular cancer patients examining disparities in pre-orchiectomy sperm cryopreservation between private tertiary-care (n=95) and public safety-net (n=106) hospitals. Private hospital patients significantly more likely to undergo cryopreservation (OR 5.60), highlighting healthcare disparities.

pmid-34348845.summary_ja: 中央値14.5歳の小児女性23例の大型卵巣嚢胞性病変の管理。成熟奇形腫11例、ムチン産生囊胞腺腫5例、漿液性嚢胞3例、ムチン産生囊胞腺がん2例。卵巣温存嚢胞切除術17/23例で良好転帰。
pmid-34348845.summary_en: Series of 23 pediatric and adolescent girls (median age 14.5 years) with large ovarian cystic masses managed with controlled aspiration enabling cosmetic Pfannenstiel incision. Pathology included 11 mature teratomas, 5 mucinous cystadenomas, 3 serous cysts, and 2 mucinous cystadenocarcinomas with excellent outcomes.

pmid-34380971.summary_ja: 28歳女性において、生殖細胞系列のDICER1病的バリアントを伴う卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の初症例を報告した。非典型的な腸型卵黄嚢腫瘍で、体細胞のホットスポット変異も同時に認められた。当初は粘液性腺癌と誤診されており、診断の難しさが強調されている。
pmid-34380971.summary_en: First case of ovarian germ cell tumor with germline DICER1 pathogenic variant in a 28-year-old woman with unusual enteric variant yolk sac tumor. Additional somatic DICER1 hotspot mutation identified; initial misdiagnosis as mucinous adenocarcinoma highlighted diagnostic challenges.

pmid-34390620.summary_ja: 3026人のトランス女性を対象とした性別肯定ホルモン治療下での精巣がん発症の大規模コホート研究。標準化発症率は0.8で、長期追跡（5年以上）では症例なし。ホルモン療法は精巣がん発症リスク増加させない。
pmid-34390620.summary_en: Nationwide cohort study of 3,026 trans women using gender-affirming hormonal treatment examining testicular cancer incidence. Two testicular cancers observed (standardized incidence ratio 0.8) with no cases during long-term follow-up (>5 years), indicating prolonged hormonal treatment does not increase testicular cancer risk.

pmid-34392267.summary_ja: 正常妊娠11年後に発見された49歳女性の絨毛膜上皮腫瘍と胎盤部位絨毛膜腫瘍の混合例。2年後にETTのみが無症状で再発。混合栄養膜腫瘍36例の文献レビューでETT・PSTT組み合わせは4例のみ。
pmid-34392267.summary_en: Case of mixed epithelioid and placental site trophoblastic tumors in a 49-year-old woman diagnosed 11 years after normal pregnancy with asymptomatic ETT recurrence at 2 years without PSTT recurrence. Literature review of 36 mixed gestational trophoblastic neoplasms revealed ETT-PSTT combination in only 4 cases.

pmid-34392286.summary_ja: 抗両親媒性抗体関連の傍腫瘍性前庭小脳症候群と後腹膜外性胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例。FDG PET検査が脳病変と腫瘍の早期発見に有用。
pmid-34392286.summary_en: A case report of paraneoplastic vestibulocerebellar syndrome with antiamphiphysin antibodies and associated extragonadal germ cell tumor in the retroperitoneum. FDG PET/CT imaging helped with topographic localization of the brain lesion and early detection of the GCT.

pmid-34417773.summary_ja: 27歳女性が卵巣奇形腫摘出1ヶ月後に遅発性眼球運動失調筋クローヌス症候群を発症。手術時の抗原暴露が誘因。ステロイド、免疫グロブリン、リツキシマブで寛解し30ヶ月観察期間中に再発なし。
pmid-34417773.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman developed delayed opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome one month after ovarian teratoma resection, likely triggered by antigen exposure during surgery. Treated with intravenous methylprednisolone, immunoglobulins, and rituximab with complete neurologic recovery and no recurrence at 30-month follow-up.

pmid-34420180.summary_ja: 55歳男性の上顎洞由来のSMARCB1欠損癌でヨークサック腫瘍分化を示す稀例。新規化学療法、根治手術および補助療法で治療。ヨークサック分化を伴う同疾患としては6番目の報告例。
pmid-34420180.summary_en: A 55-year-old male with sinonasal SMARCB1-deficient carcinoma displaying yolk sac tumor differentiation was treated with neoadjuvant therapy, radical surgery, and adjuvant treatment. This case represents the sixth reported occurrence of this rare entity combining SMARCB1 deficiency with yolk sac tumor differentiation.

pmid-34423664.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う小児神経脊髄炎視神経炎スペクトラム障害。抗AQP4抗体陽性で、奇形腫摘出後に抗体陰性化。維持免疫療法なしで再発なし。
pmid-34423664.summary_en: Pediatric case of neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder with anti-AQP4 antibodies associated with ovarian teratoma. Aquaporin-4 identified in pathological specimens as antigenic trigger; achieved negative AQP4 status after teratoma removal without maintenance immunotherapy.

pmid-34446941.summary_ja: MEN2B患者における卵巣囊胞性奇形腫の新規臨床的特性を報告。RET M918T変異を伴う2症例。早期診断には非内分泌症状の認識が重要と強調。
pmid-34446941.summary_en: Reports cystic ovarian teratoma as novel tumor manifestation in Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia type 2B patients. Two case reports with de novo RET M918T mutations; emphasizes importance of early recognition of nonendocrine MEN2B features.

pmid-34469331.summary_ja: 卵巣ヒト絨毛膜性腺癌150例の臨床病理学的大規模検討。網状および囊胞パターンが最多で、AFP上昇を伴い急速に増大する腫瘍。
pmid-34469331.summary_en: Large series of 150 ovarian yolk sac tumors with comprehensive clinicopathological analysis. Predominantly affects adolescents and young adults; most common histologic pattern is reticular with irregular cystic spaces; associated with elevated AFP.

pmid-34479792.summary_ja: 22歳女性が吸気時胸痛と発熱を主訴に救急外来を受診し、重度の心膜液貯留を伴う心膜炎を呈した症例報告である。縦隔奇形腫が心膜炎を引き起こすことはまれであり、原因は縦隔奇形腫であった。原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のまれで非典型的な合併症であることを示している。
pmid-34479792.summary_en: Case report of 22-year-old female presenting with severe pericardial effusion and pericarditis caused by mediastinal teratoma. Highlights unusual and rare complication of primary mediastinal germ cell tumor.

pmid-34486207.summary_ja: ドナー肝からの転移性絨毛癌を移植8か月後に発症した青年の症例報告。化学療法と外科的切除により治療され、11年間再発なく寛解を維持している。
pmid-34486207.summary_en: Case report of adolescent who developed metastatic choriocarcinoma from donor liver graft 8 months post-transplant. Successfully managed with chemotherapy and surgical resection; achieved 11-year remission without further relapse.

pmid-34486553.summary_ja: 3歳児の仙尾部胚細胞奇形腫に伴い、傍腫瘍性の自己免疫性溶血性貧血を呈した症例報告。腫瘍切除後に溶血性貧血は速やかに消失した。
pmid-34486553.summary_en: Case report of sacrococcygeal germ cell teratoma in 3-year-old with paraneoplastic autoimmune hemolytic anemia. Autoimmune hemolytic anemia resolved rapidly after tumor excision, a rare paraneoplastic presentation.

pmid-34486564.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の患者196例を対象とした後方視的解析。化学療法後に完全寛解に至った患者の5年EFSは85%であり、部分奏効では70%、無効では6%であった。残存病変の外科的切除により転帰が改善した。
pmid-34486564.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 196 pediatric extracranial germ cell tumor patients. Five-year EFS was 67%; complete remission after chemotherapy showed 85% EFS versus 70% partial response and 6% no response. Surgical resection improved outcomes.

pmid-34493450.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および性索-間質性腫瘍に対する術後の補助療法についての総説。病期I期の疾患では、未熟奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍を含め、積極的監視が検討されることを論じている。
pmid-34493450.summary_en: Review of adjuvant management for ovarian germ cell tumors and sex cord-stromal tumors post-surgery. Discusses active surveillance for stage I disease, including immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor.

pmid-34504308.summary_ja: 精索浸潤を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍46例を対象とした国際多施設研究。精索への不連続な浸潤は進行病期と関連しており、AJCC病期分類に従って転移性疾患と定めることを支持する結果が得られた。
pmid-34504308.summary_en: International multi-institutional study of 46 testicular germ cell tumors with spermatic cord involvement. Discontinuous cord involvement was associated with advanced disease; findings support its designation as metastatic disease per AJCC staging.

pmid-34506648.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学と分子解析を用いた原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の診断アルゴリズム研究。セミノーマ、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌に特徴的な染色パターンが同定され、27例中24例(89%)でi(12p)が検出された。
pmid-34506648.summary_en: Diagnostic algorithm study for primary mediastinal germ cell tumors (PMGCT) using immunohistochemical markers and molecular analysis. Identified specific staining patterns for seminoma, teratoma, yolk sac tumor, and choriocarcinoma; detected i(12p) in 89%.

pmid-34515813.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫を伴う腰仙部非終末型脊髄空洞瘻を呈した乳児の症例報告。腫瘍は嚢胞の一部ではなく脊髄中心板に付着していた。
pmid-34515813.summary_en: Case report of infant with lumbosacral non-terminal myelocystocele associated with mature teratoma. Tumor was attached to the placode rather than forming part of the sac itself.

pmid-34518930.summary_ja: 血清マーカー(AFPおよびβ-hCG)が上昇した晩期再発胚細胞腫瘍37例の後方視的研究。再発標本の54%に生存癌、43%に奇形腫が認められた。77%が再発または病勢進行を経験し、予後不良であった。
pmid-34518930.summary_en: Retrospective study of 37 patients with late-relapsing germ cell tumors and elevated serum markers (AFP, β-hCG). Analysis shows 54% had viable cancer and 43% had teratoma in relapse specimens; poor prognosis with 77% experiencing further relapse.

pmid-34528518.summary_ja: セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を含む精巣病変の特性評価における造影超音波(CEUS)の検討。CEUSは従来の超音波検査と比較して、感度100%、特異度93.8%、正確度97.9%と高い性能を示した。
pmid-34528518.summary_en: Study of contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) for characterizing testicular lesions including seminomas and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. CEUS showed superior sensitivity (100%), specificity (93.8%), and accuracy (97.9%) compared to conventional ultrasound.

pmid-34544220.summary_ja: Nijmegen breakage症候群で性腺異形成を有する患者に生じた両側卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(ディスジャーミノーマおよび性腺芽細胞腫)の初めての報告例。性腺異形成の病態とNBS罹患女性における腫瘍性変化について考察している。
pmid-34544220.summary_en: First reported case of bilateral ovarian germ cell tumors (dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma) in Nijmegen Breakage Syndrome patient with gonadal dysgenesis. Discusses pathogenesis of gonadal dysgenesis and neoplastic transformation in NBS-affected females.

pmid-34553465.summary_ja: 同一のKIT D816V変異を両組織に有する、小児の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と全身性肥満細胞症の併発例を報告。胚発生中の生殖細胞移動の段階で生じた共通の前駆細胞に由来すると示唆し、独特の疾患単位であると提唱している。
pmid-34553465.summary_en: Describes pediatric patient with concurrent ovarian germ cell tumor and systemic mastocytosis, both harboring identical KIT D816V mutation. Suggests these entities originate from common progenitor cells during embryonic germ cell migration, presenting a unique disease entity.

pmid-34560684.summary_ja: 性分化疾患患者（7〜36歳、平均20歳）における悪性性腺胚細胞腫瘍（純粋ジャーミノーマを除く）21例の症例集積。ほとんどが表現型女性で、核型は46,XYであった。主な構成成分は卵黄嚢腫瘍（10例）、ジャーミノーマ（9例）、胎児性癌（5例）、絨毛癌（4例）であった。腺様および肝様分化を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍の頻度が高いことを報告している。
pmid-34560684.summary_en: Case series of 21 malignant gonadal germ cell tumors (other than pure germinoma) in DSD patients (7-36 years, mean 20 years). Most were phenotypic females (46,XY). Common components: yolk sac tumor (10), germinoma (9), embryonal carcinoma (5), choriocarcinoma (4). High frequency of YST with glandular and hepatoid differentiation.

pmid-34561860.summary_ja: SNPアレイとコピー数中立型ヘテロ接合性消失(CN-LOH)を用いて、84例の胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生起源を解析した分子遺伝学的研究。卵巣奇形腫および胚細胞腫瘍全般について5つの組織発生型を同定し、発生の順序が異なることを示した。組織学的領域間のゲノム差異や衝突腫瘍の証拠も見出している。
pmid-34561860.summary_en: Molecular genetic study analyzing histogenic origins of 84 germ cell tumors using SNP arrays and copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity (CN-LOH). Identified five histogenic types in ovarian teratomas and GCTs generally, with different development sequences. Found intratumoral genomic differences between histologic areas and evidence for collision tumors.

pmid-34582333.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者1676例（NSGCT 569例、セミノーマ1107例）を対象とした集団ベースの研究で、画像監視がガイドラインに一致しているかを検討した。NSGCTでは、監視1〜3年目の遵守率が低く（26〜37%、過少使用）、4〜5年目では高かった（過剰使用）。セミノーマの遵守率はより安定していた。近年は過少使用が増加していた。
pmid-34582333.summary_en: Population-based study of 1676 testicular cancer patients (569 NSGCT, 1107 seminoma) examining imaging surveillance concordance with guidelines. NSGCT showed low adherence years 1-3 (26-37%, underuse) and high years 4-5 (overuse). Seminoma adherence more stable. Recent years showed increased underuse.

pmid-34592009.summary_ja: HIVに感染した胚細胞癌患者89名(92件：セミノーマ64件、非セミノーマ28件)の国際共同研究。多剤併用抗レトロウイルス療法の時代において、5年および10年の全生存率は91%および85%、無増悪生存率は81%および73%であり、HIV陰性例と同程度の転帰であった。
pmid-34592009.summary_en: International collaborative study of 89 men with HIV and germ cell cancer (92 GCCs: 64 seminomas, 28 nonseminomas). With modern combination antiretroviral therapy, 5-year and 10-year overall survival rates were 91% and 85%; progression-free survival 81% and 73%. Outcomes similar to HIV-negative GCC patients.

pmid-34599283.summary_ja: DICER1腫瘍素因症候群と関連腫瘍の包括的レビュー。胸膜肺芽腫のほか、横紋筋肉腫、特に奇形腫（頸椎甲状腺、仙骨前悪性奇形腫様）を含む複数腫瘍。第二体細胞DICER1変異を特徴。多くが囊胞期から高悪性度腫瘍への進行。
pmid-34599283.summary_en: Comprehensive review of DICER1 tumor predisposition syndrome and associated neoplasms. Beyond pleuropulmonary blastoma, discusses multiple tumors including embryonal rhabdomyosarcomas and notably teratomas (cervical-thyroid, presacral malignant teratoid). Each characterized by second somatic DICER1 mutation; many show progression from cystic stage to high-grade neoplasm.

pmid-34599350.summary_ja: 化学療法後の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清100例(RA-RPLND対O-RPLND)の周術期転帰を比較した研究。ロボット支援手術では、出血量(50対400mL)、手術時間(150対195分)、在院日数(1対5日)、射精不能の発生率が低減された。
pmid-34599350.summary_en: Comparative study of perioperative outcomes in 100 consecutive post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RA-RPLND vs O-RPLND) for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Robot-assisted approach showed reduced blood loss (50 vs 400 mL), operative time (150 vs 195 min), hospital stay (1 vs 5 days), and anejaculation rates.

pmid-34610440.summary_ja: 2歳女児の子宮卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告と文献レビュー。腟出血と骨盤腫瘤で発症。新補助化学療法後に腹腔鏡下子宮摘出術施行。術後さらに化学療法サイクルを追加。18ヶ月フォローアップで無病状態。子宮原発YSTの稀有性。
pmid-34610440.summary_en: Case report and literature review of uterine yolk sac tumor in 2-year-old presenting with vaginal bleeding and pelvic mass. After neoadjuvant chemotherapy (cisplatin/etoposide/bleomycin), laparoscopic hysterectomy was performed with additional postoperative cycles. Patient remained disease-free at 18-month follow-up. Highlights rarity of uterine YST.

pmid-34618214.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫における前立腺組織発見（46,XX核型）の症例報告と文献レビュー。PSAとアンドロゲンレセプターが陽性。文献では同様症例の74%が妊娠中・流産・閉経期・不妊状態で、ホルモン不平衡が卵巣奇形腫の男性分化を促進。
pmid-34618214.summary_en: Case report and systematic review of unexpected prostatic tissue in mature ovarian teratoma (46,XX karyotype). Immunohistochemistry confirmed PSA and androgen receptor positivity. Literature review showed 74% of similar cases were pregnant, miscarrying, menopausal, or infertile, suggesting imbalanced hormone status facilitates male differentiation.

pmid-34655305.summary_ja: 臨床病期II期セミノーマの治療選択肢に関する総説。従来は放射線療法と化学療法に限られ、生存率は良好であるものの心血管・肺・神経毒性や二次性悪性腫瘍のリスクがあった。低容積の転移病変に対しては後腹膜リンパ節郭清が第一選択として提案されており、関連する試験の初期データは有望であるとしている。
pmid-34655305.summary_en: Review of management options for clinical stage II seminoma. Historically limited to radiotherapy and chemotherapy with excellent survival but significant long-term toxicities (cardiovascular, pulmonary, neurologic) and secondary malignancy risk. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection proposed as first-line alternative for low-volume metastatic disease.

pmid-34665989.summary_ja: 90例の小児GCT患者を対象とした10年間の後方視的解析で、カルボプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン(CEb)とシスプラチン基盤(PEb)の化学療法を比較した。5年全生存率は全体で77%、無イベント生存率は73%であり、レジメン間に有意差はなかった。性腺原発および病期4でない疾患が、より良好な生存と関連していた。
pmid-34665989.summary_en: 10-year retrospective analysis of 90 pediatric GCT patients comparing carboplatin-etoposide-bleomycin (CEb) versus cisplatin-based (PEb) chemotherapy. 5-year overall survival 77% and event-free survival 73% overall; no significant difference between regimens. Gonadal origin and non-stage 4 disease predicted better survival.

pmid-34673996.summary_ja: 女性の脂肪を含む骨盤内腫瘤に関する画像診断のレビューである。肉眼的脂肪は、卵巣腫瘍として最も一般的な奇形腫の特徴であり、超音波、CT、MRIでそれぞれ特徴的な所見を示す。未熟卵巣奇形腫など微量脂肪を含む病変の診断の難しさと、鑑別におけるMRIの有用性が述べられている。
pmid-34673996.summary_en: Radiological review of fat-containing pelvic masses in females. Macroscopic fat characterizes teratomas, the most common ovarian neoplasms, with specific imaging patterns on ultrasound, CT, and MRI. Addresses diagnostic challenges of immature teratomas and related lesions with microscopic fat, highlighting MRI utility in differentiation.

pmid-34674451.summary_ja: 精巣内でのセミノーマと慢性リンパ性白血病の極めて稀な同時発生の症例。59歳男性、無痛性精巣腫瘤で根治的精巣摘除術施行。腫瘍中央部はセミノーマ、周辺部はCD20/CD5陽性のCLL浸潤。
pmid-34674451.summary_en: Rare case report of concurrent seminoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia in the same testis. A 59-year-old presented with painless testicular mass; orchiectomy revealed 5-cm seminoma with diffuse CLL infiltration in peripheral region. Immunophenotyping and flow cytometry confirmed CLL diagnosis. Important differential for classic seminoma with extensive lymphoid response.

pmid-34694152.summary_ja: 上昇腫瘍マーカーを有するGCT患者153例の化学療法後残存腫瘍摘出。生存可能腫瘍はサルベージ群49% vs初治群16%。AFP≥30は生存可能腫瘍を予測。初治群で高マーカーと不良予後が関連。
pmid-34694152.summary_en: Retrospective study of 153 germ cell tumor patients with elevated serum tumor markers (HCG >2.0, AFP >7.0) undergoing post-chemotherapy residual tumor resection. Viable cancer more common in salvage (49%) versus first-line (16%) setting. AFP ≥30 predicts viable cancer; markers ≥30/20 predicted poor survival in first-line group.

pmid-34695605.summary_ja: 2021年WHO分類の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に関する更新点を、診断と分子の両面から概説している。遺伝子転座、免疫組織化学的特徴、PD-L1高発現の表現型について論じ、病理医、放射線科医、外科医、腫瘍医向けの包括的な資料を提供している。
pmid-34695605.summary_en: Overview of 2021 WHO classification updates for mediastinal germ cell tumors including diagnostic and molecular advances. Discusses genetic translocations, immunohistochemical characterization, and PD-L1 high phenotype. Provides comprehensive resource for pathologists, radiologists, surgeons, and oncologists on classification and management.

pmid-34712578.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術を受けていないトランスジェンダー女性に生じた、精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の初の症例報告である。トランスジェンダー女性における継続的な発がんリスク、医療者への教育、適切な身体診察と患者への自己検査指導の重要性が述べられている。
pmid-34712578.summary_en: First reported case of testicular mixed germ cell tumor in a transgender woman. Emphasizes ongoing cancer risk for transgender women who have not undergone orchiectomy. Discusses importance of provider education on transgender health, appropriate physical examination techniques, and patient self-exam counseling.

pmid-34724334.summary_ja: 2005年から2020年に単一の経験豊富な外科医によりRPLNDを受けた精巣がん患者94例の後方視的症例集積。患者の92.6%が化学療法後RPLNDを受け、中央値47.5か月の追跡で無再発生存率は91.5%、全生存率は92.6%であった。周術期の罹患率は国際的な高症例数施設と同程度に低かった。
pmid-34724334.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 94 testicular cancer patients undergoing RPLND (2005-2020) by single experienced surgeon. Median age 29.5 years; 92.6% underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND. Recurrence-free survival 91.5%, overall survival 92.6% at median 47.5-month follow-up. Low perioperative morbidity comparable to international high-volume centers.

pmid-34729873.summary_ja: 妊娠26週の35歳女性の膵粘液嚢胞腫瘍と左卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の合併症例。膵腫瘤が横隔膜を圧迫、卵巣捻転を認め、手術施行。妊娠中の両腫瘍同時発症は稀。
pmid-34729873.summary_en: Case of 35-year-old pregnant woman (26 weeks gestation) with dual pathology: pancreatic mucinous cystic neoplasm and left ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Underwent distal pancreatectomy, splenectomy, and left ovarian cystectomy due to mass effect and adnexal torsion. Rare simultaneous presentation during pregnancy.

pmid-34731264.summary_ja: 化学療法後RPLNDを受けた精巣がん患者78例の後方視的研究。16例(20.5%)が大血管手術を必要とした。大動脈および下大静脈と腫瘍の接触角、ならびに不良なIGCCCGスコアが独立した予測因子であり、PPV 100%、NPV 87%、精度88%であった。
pmid-34731264.summary_en: Retrospective study of 78 testicular cancer patients undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND. 16 (20.5%) required major vascular surgery. Aorta-tumor contact angle ≥64° and cava-tumor contact angle ≥98° plus poor IGCCCG score were independent predictors (PPV 100%, NPV 87%, accuracy 88%).

pmid-34734394.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性生殖細胞腫瘍17例の化学療法後修正型一側後腹膜リンパ節廓清。残存腫瘤中央値41mm。病理：壊死線維化6例、奇形腫11例、生存可能腫瘍なし。中央値10.5ヶ月で再発なし。逆行性射精維持率改善。
pmid-34734394.summary_en: Retrospective study of 17 NSGCT patients undergoing modified template unilateral post-chemotherapy RPLND. Median residual mass 41mm; pathology showed 6 with necrosis/fibrosis, 11 with teratoma, no viable tumor. No deaths or relapses at median 10.5-month follow-up; improved antegrade ejaculation preservation.

pmid-34743192.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍469例の8研究メタレビュー。両側腫瘍、非セミノーマ、生殖細胞上皮内腫瘍、進行期、停留精巣既往が無精子症に関連。精子形成に対する直接的精巣機能障害を示唆。
pmid-34743192.summary_en: Systematic review of 8 studies (469 men with testicular tumors) examining associations between tumor characteristics and preorchiectomy azoospermia. Bilateral tumors, nonseminoma, GCNIS, advanced stage, and undescended testis history more common in azoospermic men, suggesting direct effect on spermatogenesis.

pmid-34772865.summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後の積極的監視を重視した臨床病期I精巣がんの管理に関するレビュー。低線量CTによる再発の早期検出を用いており、治療毒性を抑えるためにRPLNDが検討されている。積極的監視は、不要な治療曝露を減らしつつ優れた生存成績を維持するとされている。
pmid-34772865.summary_en: Review of stage I testicular cancer management emphasizing active surveillance following radical orchiectomy. Uses low-dose CT imaging for early detection of relapse; RPLND being investigated to minimize treatment toxicity. Active surveillance maintains excellent survival while reducing unnecessary treatment exposure.

pmid-34773394.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある46歳男性のGTS症例で、穿刺吸引生検では転移性腺癌と誤診された。GTSと転移性がんの鑑別の難しさを示している。細胞学的、組織学的、臨床的、画像所見を統合して評価することの重要性が述べられている。
pmid-34773394.summary_en: Case report of growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in a 46-year-old GCT survivor misdiagnosed as metastatic adenocarcinoma on fine-needle aspiration biopsy. Demonstrates diagnostic challenges in distinguishing GTS from metastatic cancer and importance of integrating cytologic, histologic, clinical, and radiographic findings.

pmid-34775512.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣GCT患者153例でマイクロRNA-371a-3pと進展リスク因子の関連を検討。術前M371レベルはリンパ管侵襲、腫瘍サイズ、胚細胞癌成分と関連したが、術後レベルは予測性を持たなかった。
pmid-34775512.summary_en: Study of 153 nonseminomatous testicular GCT patients examining microRNA-371a-3p (M371) associations with risk factors including lymphovascular invasion and >50% embryonal carcinoma. Preoperative M371 associated with LV1, tumor size, EC component, and teratoma presence; postoperative M371 was not predictive.

pmid-34779882.summary_ja: CS IIA/IIBセミノーマ患者5049例の治療（放射線療法vs化学療法）のシステマティックレビュー。CS IIAでは再発率同等だが、CS IIBでは化学療法が優位。5年生存率90%超だが、二次悪性腫瘍が課題。
pmid-34779882.summary_en: Systematic review of 5049 seminoma patients with CS IIA/IIB disease comparing radiotherapy versus chemotherapy. Similar relapse rates in CS IIA (0-4.8% RT, 0% CT) but chemotherapy more effective in CS IIB. 5-year overall survival exceeded 90%; secondary malignancy risk identified as key survivorship concern.

pmid-34779884.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の画像診断の進歩に関する総説である。小さな病変には超音波エラストグラフィ、造影超音波、MRIが、リンパ節評価にはFDG-PET-CTや新技術が検討されている。化学療法後の残存腫瘤にはCTと腫瘍マーカーが標準であり、拡散強調MRIやラジオミクスが研究中である。臨床病期Iのフォローアップでは、MRIがCTに対して非劣性とされる。
pmid-34779884.summary_en: Review of imaging advances for testicular germ cell tumors. Discusses elastography, contrast-enhanced ultrasound, and MRI for small lesions; FDG-PET-CT and lymphotropic nanoparticle MRI for lymph node staging; diffusion-weighted MRI and radiomics for post-chemotherapy residual mass assessment.
