pmid-34794813.summary_ja: 新生児咽頭部先天性腫瘤62例の研究。奇形腫は38.6%を占める。周産期集中治療、複数回手術、気道管理を要した。予後は重要解剖学的構造への浸潤程度に依存。
pmid-34794813.summary_en: Retrospective study of 62 prenatally diagnosed oropharyngeal masses in children; teratomas were second most common pathology (38.6%). Most required intensive perinatal care, multiple surgeries, and artificial airway support. Long-term prognosis depended on involvement of critical anatomical structures.

pmid-34812503.summary_ja: 9歳女児の卵巣成熟奇形腫とグリオーマ症腹膜炎の症例。CTとUSで卵巣大腫瘤と腹水を認め、病理診断で成熟奇形腫にグリオーマ症腹膜炎を伴うことが確認。手術後、腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。
pmid-34812503.summary_en: Case report of ovarian mature teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei in a 9-year-old girl. Imaging revealed large ovarian mass with ascites; pathology confirmed mature teratoma with gliomatosis peritonei. Post-surgical removal resulted in normalized tumor markers at 3-month follow-up.

pmid-34813838.summary_ja: 精巣摘除を必要とする精巣腫瘍患者13名を対象とした豪州の後方視的多施設研究。7例がGCT患者。GCT患者の精子採取成功率は86%（6/7）。凍結保存・新鮮精子を用いて6件の妊娠（生児5例）を達成。生殖能温存におけるoncoTESEの臨床的有用性を示唆。
pmid-34813838.summary_en: Retrospective multicenter Australian study of onco-testicular sperm extraction (oncoTESE) in 13 patients with testicular tumors requiring orchiectomy. Seven patients had germ cell tumors (GCTs). Sperm retrieval was successful in 6 of 7 GCT patients (86%). Cryopreserved/fresh sperm facilitated 6 pregnancies including 5 live births, demonstrating clinical utility for fertility preservation.

pmid-34837232.summary_ja: 新規白金(IV)錯体とレスベラトロールの絨毛癌（JEG-3）細胞に対する抗増殖作用、抗遊走作用、酸化ストレス誘導作用を検討した研究。白金錯体はシスプラチンと比較して優れた抗増殖作用を示した。レスベラトロール併用は正常細胞への毒性軽減と癌細胞への抗癌作用増強を達成。
pmid-34837232.summary_en: Study evaluated antiproliferative, antimigratory, and prooxidative effects of novel platinum(IV) complexes and resveratrol on choriocarcinoma (JEG-3) and breast cancer cell lines. Platinum complexes demonstrated superior antiproliferative effects compared to cisplatin. Combined treatment with resveratrol enhanced anticancer effects on choriocarcinoma while protecting normal lung fibroblasts.

pmid-34837545.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学的研究により、26例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるMAGE-A2発現を、セミノーマと非セミノーマで比較した。胎児性癌では、MAGE-A2の核発現が高いほどpT病期の進行、血管浸潤、精細管網への浸潤と関連していた。MAGE-A2は胎児性癌の予後を予測するバイオマーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
pmid-34837545.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study examined MAGE-A2 expression in 26 testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), comparing seminomas and non-seminomas. High nuclear MAGE-A2 expression correlated with advanced pT stage, vascular invasion, and rete testis involvement in embryonal carcinomas. Findings suggest MAGE-A2 may serve as predictive biomarker for embryonal carcinoma prognosis.

pmid-34839102.summary_ja: カリフォルニア州のTGCT患者381例と対照群762例を対象とした登録ベース症例対照研究（1997-2011年、15-19歳）。出生前の住環境農薬曝露を検討。アセフェイトとマラチオンはラテン系人口でTGCTリスク増加、カルバリルは非ラテン系人口で増加。
pmid-34839102.summary_en: Registry-based case-control study of 381 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 762 matched controls in California (1997-2011, ages 15-19), examining prenatal residential proximity to endocrine-disrupting pesticides. Acephate and malathion exposure increased TGCT risk among Latinos; carbaryl increased risk among non-Latinos. Results suggest environmental chemical exposures may contribute to rising TGCT incidence.

pmid-34842332.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫患者350名を対象とした全国的後方視的研究。5%が診断時に両側性病変を認めた。全体の8.3%（29例）が中央値30.5ヶ月で第2次イベントを経験。大きな腫瘤、両側性病変、術中破裂がリスク因子。卵巣温存手術と最初の5年間の厳密なフォローアップをサポート。
pmid-34842332.summary_en: Nationwide retrospective study of 350 children with ovarian mature teratomas (OMT). 5% presented with synchronous bilateral disease. Overall second event rate was 8.3% over median 30.5 months (ipsilateral: 8 cases; contralateral: 18 cases; both ovaries: 3 cases). Large palpable mass, bilateral presentation, and perioperative rupture increased second event risk. Results support ovarian-sparing surgery with close follow-up during first 5 years.

pmid-34850169.summary_ja: 限局性セミノーマ患者151名（3～21歳）を対象とした第II相試験。化学療法後の反応に基づく減量放射線療法を評価。18 Gy全脳照射の非劣性基準は満たされなかったが、Kaplan-Meier法による3年無増悪生存率は18 Gy群94.5%、24 Gy群93.75%。
pmid-34850169.summary_en: Phase II trial of 151 patients (ages 3-21) with localized germinoma evaluating simplified chemotherapy (carboplatin/etoposide) followed by response-based dose-reduced irradiation. Although the study failed to meet noninferiority endpoint for 18 Gy whole-brain irradiation, Kaplan-Meier-based 3-year progression-free survival rates were 94.5% and 93.75% for 18 Gy and 24 Gy groups respectively.

pmid-34853884.summary_ja: 北欧3ヶ国の8,112人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした登録ベース症例対照研究。出生前の親の木材関連職業曝露とリスクの関連を検討。母親の木材曝露はリスク無関連で父親曝露はリスク低下と関連。
pmid-34853884.summary_en: Registry-based case-control study of 8,112 testicular germ cell tumor cases and matched controls across Finland, Norway, and Sweden, examining prenatal parental occupational exposures in wood-related work. Maternal wood exposure showed no association with TGCT risk, while paternal wood exposure was associated with decreased risk. Large-scale analysis provided no evidence of increased TGCT risk from parental wood exposures.

pmid-34854948.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における臨床ステージIS症例43名（全体の1.6%）の後方視的多施設研究。精巣摘除後の腫瘍マーカー上昇が持続する症例。治療はactive surveillance、カルボプラチン単剤療法またはBEP化学療法。5年無再発生存率88.9%で良好な長期予後。
pmid-34854948.summary_en: Retrospective multicenter study of 43 patients (1.6% of cohort) with clinical stage IS (CSIS) testicular germ cell tumors, defined by persistently elevated tumor markers after orchiectomy. Treatment included active surveillance, carboplatin monotherapy, or BEP chemotherapy. Five-year relapse-free survival was 88.9% with excellent outcomes across all treatment approaches.

pmid-34855100.summary_ja: ロピバカインが絨毛癌細胞のOGFRP1/miR-4731-5p/HIF3Aシグナル軸を介して作用することを検討した研究。濃度および時間依存的に生存能、遊走能、浸潤能を抑制。絨毛癌の予防・治療への新規戦略の可能性を示唆。
pmid-34855100.summary_en: Study investigated ropivacaine's effects on choriocarcinoma cells through the OGFRP1/miR-4731-5p/HIF3A regulatory axis. Ropivacaine inhibited choriocarcinoma cell viability, migration, and invasion in dose- and time-dependent manner. Findings suggest ropivacaine may offer novel therapeutic strategy for choriocarcinoma treatment and prevention.

pmid-34863950.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫が原因となった抗NMDAR脳炎の14歳少女の症例報告。血清および脳脊髄液の抗NMDAR抗体陽性により診断された。患者は免疫療法を受け、腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢胞摘出術を施行された。病理組織学的検査では神経膠成分を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫が認められた。術後1年で完全に回復した。
pmid-34863950.summary_en: Case report of a 14-year-old girl with anti-NMDAR encephalitis caused by mature ovarian teratoma. Diagnosis confirmed via positive serum and cerebrospinal fluid anti-NMDAR antibodies. Patient received immunotherapy and underwent laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy. Histopathology revealed mature cystic teratoma with glial component. Complete recovery achieved one year post-surgery.

pmid-34864837.summary_ja: 26例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍、21例の精巣内胚細胞腫瘍性病変、17例の非浸潤背景精巣を対象に、PRAMEの免疫組織化学的発現を検討した研究。PRAMEはセミノーマ性GCTで非セミノーマ性GCTよりも強く発現していた。PRAMEは鑑別診断マーカーであり、疾患移行のバイオマーカーとなる可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-34864837.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study examined PRAME expression in 26 testicular germ cell tumors (GCTs), 21 germ cell neoplasia in situ, and 17 uninvolved background testes. PRAME was more strongly expressed in seminomatous versus nonseminomatous GCTs. Findings suggest PRAME as useful diagnostic marker and potential biomarker for disease transition.

pmid-34866303.summary_ja: 再発・難治性悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者の臨床試験において、中央病理レビューで卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された2症例が膵房細胞癌およびαフェトプロテイン産生胃腺癌に診断訂正された。難治例の組織学的再評価の重要性を示唆。
pmid-34866303.summary_en: Prospective phase II clinical trial of targeted therapy for recurrent/refractory malignant germ cell tumors with central pathology review. Two cases initially diagnosed as yolk sac tumor were revised to pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma and AFP-secreting gastric adenocarcinoma, emphasizing importance of histologic re-evaluation in refractory cases.

pmid-34871792.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞摘出術後に留置された止血剤が術後超音波検査で残存・再発性奇形腫と誤認された症例報告。再腹腔鏡検査で止血剤であることが判明。手術計画と生殖能温存に臨床的意義を示唆。
pmid-34871792.summary_en: Case report describing a flowable hemostatic agent placed during ovarian cystectomy that mimicked residual or recurrent ovarian teratoma on postoperative ultrasound imaging. Repeat laparoscopy revealed the hemostatic agent rather than teratoma recurrence, highlighting diagnostic importance for surgical planning and fertility preservation.

pmid-34872133.summary_ja: 組織病理確認済み卵巣奇形腫患者163名における抗NMDA受容体脳炎の有病率を検討した後方視的コホート研究。NMDARE発症率は3.07%。NMDARE患者の奇形腫容積は有意に小さかった。
pmid-34872133.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study identified prevalence of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis (NMDARE) in 163 pediatric patients with histopathology-confirmed ovarian teratomas. 3.07% had NMDARE. Teratoma volume was significantly smaller in NMDARE patients compared to non-NMDARE, suggesting potential association between tumor size and antibody development.

pmid-34873956.summary_ja: 小児の頭皮・頭蓋骨の病理確認済み皮様嚢胞14例のMRI検査を後方視的に検討。約半数が均質なT1低信号・T2高信号を示した。大多数が縁辺造影と正中線近接位置を認めた。
pmid-34873956.summary_en: Retrospective study of 14 pathology-proven dermoid cysts (teratomas) of the pediatric scalp and skull using conventional and diffusion-weighted MRI. Half were homogeneous T1-hypointense/T2-hyperintense. Most showed rim enhancement and located at midline adjacent to sutures, providing imaging guidance for diagnosis.

pmid-34875536.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞における細胞表面LAMP-2の発現と機能を検討した研究。細胞表面LAMP-2はN-グリカンを介した細胞外マトリックスガレクチンとの相互作用により、細胞接着と浸潤を促進した。
pmid-34875536.summary_en: Study investigated lysosome-associated membrane glycoprotein 2 (LAMP-2) expression in choriocarcinoma cells. Cell surface LAMP-2 promoted cell adhesion and invasion through N-glycan interactions with extracellular matrix galectins. Findings elucidate molecular mechanisms contributing to choriocarcinoma malignancy and progression.

pmid-34890801.summary_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準用量化学療法と大量化学療法＋造血幹細胞移植を比較した文献レビューおよび単一施設の経験。大量化学療法では長期寛解率が高かった。2年全生存率は、大量化学療法で47.5%、標準用量化学療法で36.4%であった。
pmid-34890801.summary_en: Literature review and single-center experience comparing standard-dose vs high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation for relapsed germ cell tumors. High-dose chemotherapy achieved higher long-term remission rates. Two-year overall survival was 47.5% with high-dose versus 36.4% with standard-dose chemotherapy.

pmid-34893575.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者44名の化学療法前後の体組成変化を検討した研究。皮下脂肪と内臓脂肪は化学療法開始3ヶ月後から有意に増加し24ヶ月後も前値に戻らなかった。骨格筋は治療終了時に減少したが12ヶ月以内に回復した。
pmid-34893575.summary_en: Study of 44 testicular germ cell tumor patients examined body composition changes up to 24 months after chemotherapy. Subcutaneous and visceral fat increased significantly at 3 months and remained elevated at 24 months, while skeletal muscle decreased during treatment but recovered within 12 months, suggesting obesity as major long-term complication.

pmid-34898881.summary_ja: 37歳男性の左肺内成熟奇形腫(縦隔成分なし)。進行性咳嗽で発症。CT検査で不規則嚢胞性病変を認めた。左全肺切除術を施行。病理で毛髪喀出が特徴的。
pmid-34898881.summary_en: Case of 37-year-old male with entirely intrapulmonary mature teratoma in left upper lobe (no mediastinal component), presenting with progressive cough. CT showed irregular cystic lesion. Total left pneumonectomy performed. Pathology confirmed mature teratoma with squamous epithelium, hair, sebaceous glands, and fibromuscular tissue.

pmid-34906570.summary_ja: MRKH症候群を伴う24歳女性の巨大前縦隔成熟奇形腫。全血胸郭を占有し肺全体whiteout認めた。外科的切除を施行。MRKH症候群と前縦隔奇形腫の同時診断は珍しい。
pmid-34906570.summary_en: Case of giant mediastinal mature teratoma in 24-year-old Syrian woman with Mayer-Rokitansky-Küster-Hauser (MRKH) syndrome, occupying entire hemithorax with complete lung whiteout. Surgical resection performed. Simultaneous diagnosis of MRKH syndrome and mediastinal teratoma is unusual.

pmid-34912073.summary_ja: stage I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性33例を対象とした前向き研究で、積極的監視中の再発マーカーとしての血清miR-371a-3pを評価した。再発した10例全例で値の上昇が見られ、再発のなかった患者では正常範囲を維持した。miR-371a-3pは標準的画像検査より中央値2か月早く再発を検出した。
pmid-34912073.summary_en: Prospective study of 33 men with stage I testicular GCT evaluating miR-371a-3p as recurrence marker during active surveillance. All 10 recurring patients showed increasing miR-371a-3p levels; non-recurring patients maintained normal levels. MiR-371a-3p detected recurrences median 2 months earlier than standard imaging.

pmid-34918879.summary_ja: シスプラチンで治療された精巣がん生存者38名を対象に、精液および血清中の白金濃度を測定した研究。白金は血液より精液で高濃度に検出された。精子濃度は最終投与からの期間と相関したが、白金濃度とは相関しなかった。妊孕性評価にはさらなる研究が必要である。
pmid-34918879.summary_en: Study of cisplatin-treated testicular cancer survivors measuring semen and serum platinum levels. 38 patients enrolled with median cumulative cisplatin dose 301 mg/m². Platinum detected higher in semen than blood. Sperm concentration correlated with time from last cisplatin dose but not platinum levels. Further study needed for fertility assessment.

pmid-34931350.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と嚢胞腺腫/嚢胞腺癌の衝突腫瘍25例。O-RADSスコアリングでほとんど良性(2-4)。悪性1例は多房液体で固形成分と腹水伴う。典型的dermoid cystは良性衝突腫瘍を示唆。
pmid-34931350.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 25 ovarian collision tumors combining mature cystic teratomas with cystadenomas/cystadenocarcinomas. Using O-RADS scoring system, most were benign (O-RADS 2-4), with one malignant tumor showing multilocular features with solid components and ascites. Typical dermoid cyst signified benign collision tumor.

pmid-34935941.summary_ja: 不妊症診断中に検出された46例精巣腫瘍の後方視的検討。23例が悪性腫瘍(セミノーマ22例)。凍結切片検査は悪性腫瘍とLeydig細胞腫に有用だが線維性病変での信頼性は低い。
pmid-34935941.summary_en: Retrospective study of 46 testicular tumors diagnosed during infertility evaluation. 23 cases were malignant (22 seminomas). Frozen section examination was accurate for malignancies and Leydig cell tumors but unreliable for fibrous lesions, which were often associated with regressed tumors.

pmid-34936913.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の患者56例を対象とした後方視的研究で、切除可能性予測のための術前CT画像を評価した。無増悪生存と全生存に有意な予後因子は完全切除のみであった。術前CTで主要動脈が腫瘍に取り囲まれている所見は、不完全切除を予測した。
pmid-34936913.summary_en: Retrospective study of 56 patients with mediastinal germ cell tumors (MGCT) evaluating preoperative CT imaging for resectability prediction. Complete resection was only significant prognostic factor for progression-free and overall survival. Tumor encasement of major arteries on preoperative CT predicted incomplete resection.

pmid-34950391.summary_ja: 抗NMDAR脳炎を有する28歳女性が悪性症候群様の症状を呈した症例。両側卵巣奇形腫が認められ、大量メチルプレドニゾロン療法、両側卵巣嚢腫摘出術、免疫グロブリン療法により症状が改善した。文献検討で同様の10例を検討した。
pmid-34950391.summary_en: Case of 28-year-old female with anti-NMDAR encephalitis presenting with neuroleptic malignant syndrome symptoms. Bilateral ovarian teratomas identified on imaging. Treated with high-dose methylprednisolone, bilateral oophorocystectomy, and intravenous immunoglobulin with symptom resolution. Literature review of 10 similar cases.

pmid-34952309.summary_ja: 原発不明の転移性絨毛膜癌の症例。小腸出血で発症し肝転移と脳転移を伴った。回盲部切除と小腸切除後に化学療法を施行し肝脳転移は完全奏効。
pmid-34952309.summary_en: Case of metastatic choriocarcinoma of unknown primary presenting with lower GI bleeding, with metastases to jejunum, ileum, liver, and brain. Underwent ileocecal resection and small bowel resection, followed by chemotherapy with complete response in liver and brain metastases.

pmid-34952488.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の単一層型亜型であるstruma ovariiが捻転と破裂で複雑化した症例。MRI、超音波所見の特徴を記載。病理像との対比あり。
pmid-34952488.summary_en: Case of struma ovarii, a monodermal subtype of mature cystic teratoma involving thyroid tissue, complicated by torsion and rupture. MRI and ultrasound imaging characteristics described with histologic correlation. Discusses typical imaging features and potential complications of this rare teratoma variant.

pmid-34954626.summary_ja: 37歳男性の右上葉肺内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫。咳嗽と胸痛で発症。病理では毛囊、皮脂腺を含む扁平上皮を認めた。右肺は極めて稀で既報告は左肺が大多数。毛髪喀出が特徴的。
pmid-34954626.summary_en: Case report of right upper lobe intrapulmonary mature cystic teratoma in 37-year-old male with chronic cough and chest pain. Pathology revealed squamous epithelium with hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and fatty tissue. Extremely rare in right lung; most prior reports in left lung. Trichoptysis noted as distinguishing feature.

pmid-34954707.summary_ja: 妊娠女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に高度に発達した小脳を認めた稀な症例。葉折構造と脳幹・脳室構造を伴う。通常の無秩序な配置と異なり組織が整然配置。
pmid-34954707.summary_en: Case of ovarian mature cystic teratoma in pregnant female showing remarkably well-developed posterior fossa structures including lobated and foliated cerebellum with associated brainstem and ventricular structures. Unusually organized embryonic tissue arrangement compared to typical haphazard distribution.

pmid-34955058.summary_ja: 転移性精巣奇形腫を背景に生じた血管肉腫（二次性悪性腫瘍）の32歳男性の症例報告。MYC増幅がないにもかかわらず強いMYC免疫組織化学染色が認められた。FISHで8番染色体ポリソミーがMYC過剰発現の原因と判明した。胚細胞腫瘍では新規の所見である。
pmid-34955058.summary_en: Case report of angiosarcoma (secondary malignancy) arising in metastatic testicular teratoma background in 32-year-old male. Strong MYC immunohistochemistry expression found without MYC amplification; FISH revealed chromosome 8 polysomy accounting for MYC overexpression—novel finding in germ cell tumors.

pmid-34958924.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍を有する18歳女性の症例。化学療法を受けた10か月後に、攻撃性の腹腔内線維腫症を発症した。40×20cmの腹部腫瘤を切除したが急速に再発した。メトトレキサートとビンブラスチンによる化学療法は奏効せず、患者は2サイクル目の後に死亡した。
pmid-34958924.summary_en: Case of 18-year-old with ovarian germ cell malignancy treated with chemotherapy who developed aggressive intra-abdominal fibromatosis 10 months later. Large abdominal mass (40×20 cm) was resected but rapidly recurred. Chemotherapy with methotrexate and vinblastine was unsuccessful. Patient died after second chemotherapy cycle.

pmid-34968016.summary_ja: ルーマニア児童134人における性腺腫瘍と腫瘍マーカー検討。卵黄嚢腫瘍30例全例でAFP上昇。混合GCT症例ではYST 80%、胎児癌72%の高頻度。AFP+β-hCGの感度特異度が最良。
pmid-34968016.summary_en: Retrospective study of AFP and β-hCG in 134 Romanian children with gonadal/paragonadal tumors. Elevated markers correlated with malignancy in 48 patients. All 30 yolk sac tumor patients had elevated AFP. Combined AFP+β-hCG showed highest accuracy for GCT detection and tumor-type determination.

pmid-34975294.summary_ja: 絨毛膜癌関連の胎盤部位絨毛膜癌(PSTT)のlncRNAとmRNA発現プロファイルをマイクロアレイで検討。正常絨毛と比較して1247個の上昇、1013個の低下するlncRNAを同定。GO/KEGGパス解析により免疫応答が最大の関与ターム。
pmid-34975294.summary_en: Microarray study of long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) and mRNA expression profiles in placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT) compared to normal placental tissue. Identified 1247 upregulated and 1013 downregulated lncRNAs. GO/KEGG pathway analyses revealed alterations in immune response and protein targeting mechanisms.

pmid-34976255.summary_ja: 新生児の腰椎領域に生じた珍しい胎児型奇形腫の症例報告。CT検査で肢に似た整理された骨格構造が認められた。胎児寄生体との重要な鑑別点は軸椎がないこと。外科的切除が治療方法。
pmid-34976255.summary_en: Case report of rare fetiform teratoma (highly differentiated variant) in a 1-day-old neonate with lumbar mass containing well-organized skeletal structures resembling an extremity. Differentiated from fetus in fetu by absence of axial skeleton. Surgical excision is definitive treatment.

pmid-34978466.summary_ja: 精巣非精細胞腫瘍患者1,376例の後腹膜リンパ節郭清術に関する研究。摘出リンパ節数が多いほど5年生存率が高く、転移陽性患者を同定しやすいことが示された。
pmid-34978466.summary_en: National Cancer Database analysis of 1,376 men with clinical stage I-II nonseminomatous testicular GCT undergoing primary retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPLND). Men with >20 lymph nodes removed had significantly higher 5-year overall survival (99.1% vs 96.4%). Higher lymph node count increased detection of positive disease and improved outcomes.

pmid-34986057.summary_ja: 大腸腺がん内視鏡的切除後3年での再発時に卵黄嚢腫成分が認められた症例。血清AFPが上昇し、遺伝子解析で原発巣と再発巣のAPCおよびTP53変異が共通していることが確認された。
pmid-34986057.summary_en: Recurrent colorectal cancer 3 years after endoscopic mucosal resection showed undifferentiated carcinoma and yolk sac tumor (YST) components with elevated AFP (42 ng/mL). Genetic analysis confirmed shared APC and TP53 mutations between primary and recurrent tumors, establishing metachronous relationship.

pmid-34986675.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍成分を伴う稀な胃腺がんの症例。血清AFP上昇を伴い、病理学的に腺がんと胚細胞腫瘍成分の混在を認めた。根治的手術が治療の中心である。
pmid-34986675.summary_en: Rare case of gastric adenocarcinoma with germ cell tumor components presenting with elevated serum AFP. 10cm tumor removed by gastrectomy with D2 lymphadenectomy and splenectomy. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed mixed adenocarcinoma and GCT features. Radical surgery is primary treatment.

pmid-34989351.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎に関連した卵巣奇形腫の症例。初回精神病エピソードで提示されたが、免疫検査と画像診断により診断が確定され、手術的摘出で改善した。
pmid-34989351.summary_en: A 27-year-old female with psychotic and cognitive symptoms diagnosed with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. Serum and CSF testing confirmed anti-NMDA antibodies. Endovaginal ultrasound revealed ovarian teratoma which was surgically removed. Case highlights importance of recognizing autoimmune etiology in early psychosis evaluation.

pmid-34993564.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者における腹膜播種の多施設レジストリ研究。全患者の0.77%に認められ、ほとんどが転移性疾患であった。シスプラチン耐性疾患と関連し、予後は不良であった。
pmid-34993564.summary_en: Multicenter registry analysis of 29 GCT patients with peritoneal carcinosis (PC), representing 0.77% of 3,767 GCT patients. Most (93%) presented with metastatic disease. Median cancer-specific survival from PC detection was 10.5 months with 30% 2-year survival, primarily associated with cisplatin-refractory disease.

pmid-34996497.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対するエピジェネティック阻害剤の効果を調査。シスプラチン耐性株を含むGCT細胞株に対する有効性が示され、複数の経路が関与していることが明らかになった。
pmid-34996497.summary_en: Study of seven epigenetic inhibitors targeting histone deacetylases, methyltransferases, readers, and polycomb complexes showed efficacy against GCT cell lines including cisplatin-resistant subclones. RNA sequencing revealed common deregulations in gene expression related to ion transport and DNA-binding pathways.

pmid-34999805.summary_ja: 縦隔成熟奇形腫が膿胸と誤診された症例。胸腔鏡検査により診断が確定された。胸膜液貯留の鑑別診断における奇形腫の認識が重要である。
pmid-34999805.summary_en: A mediastinal mature teratoma was initially misdiagnosed as encapsulated empyema in a female patient. The diagnosis was confirmed via thoracoscopy during treatment for presumed empyema. Case emphasizes importance of recognizing mediastinal teratoma in differential diagnosis of pleural effusions.

pmid-35005474.summary_ja: 6年前に顕微鏡下精巣内精子採取術を受けた35歳日本人男性が、病期Iの精巣セミノーマと診断された。病理検査では胚細胞上皮内腫瘍が認められた。本症例は、日本の不妊男性では精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高まる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-35005474.summary_en: A 35-year-old Japanese male presented with stage I testicular seminoma 6 years after undergoing microdissection testicular sperm extraction for infertility. Pathological examination showed germ cell neoplasia in situ. Case suggests infertile men in Japan may have increased testicular GCT risk.

pmid-35018826.summary_ja: 糖尿病治療のための幹細胞治療後に発生した未熟奇形腫の症例。通常の未熟奇形腫と異なり、急速増殖、リンパ節転移、化学療法耐性を示した。幹細胞治療の安全性の懸念を強調している。
pmid-35018826.summary_en: Immature teratoma developed after iPSC-derived beta cell injection for diabetes treatment showed rapid growth, lymph node metastasis, and chemotherapy resistance, distinguishing it from typical immature teratomas. Case emphasizes serious safety concerns with iPSC-derived cell therapy requiring standardized clinical trials.

pmid-35020653.summary_ja: 前立腺癌の画像検査として18F-コリンPET/CTを受けた80歳男性に、右精巣への偶発的な限局性集積が認められた。精巣摘除術により古典的セミノーマと確認された。本症例は、精巣がんの病期分類および残存腫瘤の評価におけるFDG PET/CTの有用性を示している。
pmid-35020653.summary_en: An 80-year-old man undergoing prostate cancer imaging with 18F-choline PET/CT incidentally showed focal uptake in the right testicle, subsequently confirmed as classic seminoma by orchiectomy. Case illustrates utility of 18F-FDG PET/CT in testicular cancer staging and residual mass evaluation.

pmid-35022142.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者における遺伝的変異の調査により、複数の悪性腫瘍や家族歴を有するハイリスク患者が変異を有する確率が低リスク患者の2倍であることが明らかになった。
pmid-35022142.summary_en: Germline genetic testing in 187 testicular cancer patients showed high-risk patients (with additional malignancies or family history) carried pathogenic variants at twice the rate of low-risk patients (29.9% vs 13.5%). Findings support genetic evaluation for testicular cancer patients with additional risk factors.

pmid-35022523.summary_ja: 精細胞腫瘍の転移に関連する遺伝子発現パターンを分析し、転移性腫瘍ではIL-6シグナリングが最も有意に上昇していることを示した。将来の個別化治療の標的となる可能性がある。
pmid-35022523.summary_en: Transcriptome analysis of seminomatous testicular GCTs comparing invasive tumor fronts with tumor centers revealed enriched inflammatory and cancer-related pathways in metastatic tumors. IL-6 signaling was most significantly upregulated in metastatic versus non-metastatic tumors, suggesting potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-35025788.summary_ja: 縦隔良性奇形腫が68Ga-FAPI PET/CTで高い取り込みを示し、悪性腫瘍と誤診される可能性があった。良性奇形腫もFAPI活性が高いことを認識することが重要である。
pmid-35025788.summary_en: Benign mediastinal teratoma showed intense 68Ga-FAPI PET/CT uptake, potentially leading to misdiagnosis as malignancy. Recognition that benign teratomas can display high FAPI activity is important to avoid false-positive imaging interpretations in mediastinal masses.

pmid-35027045.summary_ja: 尿膜に発生した稀な卵黄嚢腫の症例報告。尿路上皮癌と誤診されたが、免疫組織化学と手術所見により卵黄嚢腫と確定診断された。胚細胞腫瘍の正確な診断には慎重な病理学的評価が必要である。
pmid-35027045.summary_en: Rare case of urachal yolk sac tumor (YST), an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting with hematuria. Initially misdiagnosed as urothelial carcinoma but immunohistochemistry and surgical findings confirmed urachal YST origin. Careful histological and immunohistochemical evaluation is essential for YST diagnosis.

pmid-35034041.summary_ja: 20例の肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍の配列決定と病理解析。60%の症例でTP53やRIF1変異などの体細胞変異を検出。組織学的特性に基づく段階分類が病気固有の転帰を予測。
pmid-35034041.summary_en: Study of 20 sarcomatoid yolk sac tumors using sequencing and pathologic analysis. Found somatic mutations in 60% of cases, including recurrent TP53 and RIF1 mutations. Grading system based on histologic features predicted disease outcomes.

pmid-35034398.summary_ja: TGCT生存者147,935例を含む19研究のメタ解析である。プールした標準化発生比は、皮膚癌で1.93倍、黒色腫で1.81倍のリスク増加を示した。一般集団と比較して、TGCT生存者は皮膚癌と黒色腫のリスクが高いことが示された。
pmid-35034398.summary_en: Meta-analysis of 19 studies including 147,935 testicular germ cell tumor survivors. Pooled standardized incidence rates showed 1.93-fold increased risk for skin cancer and 1.81-fold for melanoma compared to general population.

pmid-35036289.summary_ja: 生後3ヶ月の乳幼児の縦隔奇形腫による気道圧迫。進行する呼吸困難と症候性。緊急手術で腫瘍を完全摘除。組織学的に成熟奇形腫を確認。
pmid-35036289.summary_en: Case of 3-month-old infant with life-threatening mediastinal teratoma causing progressive dyspnea and cyanosis with tracheal compression. Emergency surgical removal completed successfully with histology confirming mature teratoma.

pmid-35036305.summary_ja: 重度の貧血と肺・脳への遠隔転移を呈した精巣絨毛癌の症例報告。絨毛癌は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の中で最も侵襲性が高く、他の精巣腫瘍より治癒率が低いことが示されている。
pmid-35036305.summary_en: Case report of testicular choriocarcinoma, the rarest and most aggressive non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, presenting with severe anemia and distant metastases to lung and brain. Lower cure rate than other testicular neoplasms.

pmid-35037965.summary_ja: 精巣がんのフォローアップにおけるMRIとCTを比較したシステマティックレビューである。102例の患者に基づくエビデンスは、後腹膜リンパ節転移の検出において、腹骨盤MRIがCTに代わり放射線被曝を減らせることを示唆している。ただし、経験豊富な放射線科医が必要である。
pmid-35037965.summary_en: Systematic review of MRI versus CT imaging for testicular cancer follow-up. Evidence from 102 patients suggests abdominopelvic MRI can replace CT for detecting retroperitoneal lymph node metastases, reducing radiation exposure.

pmid-35038949.summary_ja: 絨毛性癌細胞におけるメトトレキサート耐性とLGALS3BPの役割を検討。MTX耐性細胞株を樹立。LGALS3BPのノックダウンが耐性を逆転。治療標的の可能性。
pmid-35038949.summary_en: Study investigating LGALS3BP role in methotrexate resistance in choriocarcinoma cells. MTX-resistant cell lines established with LGALS3BP upregulation. Knockdown of LGALS3BP reversed resistance, suggesting therapeutic target.

pmid-35044085.summary_ja: 精巣がん細胞株におけるシスプラチン耐性とhCGの糖鎖化の変化を分析。特定レクチン(DBA)がシスプラチン感受性と耐性細胞株を識別可能。耐性患者同定の可能性。
pmid-35044085.summary_en: Study analyzing hCG glycosylation changes in cisplatin-resistant versus sensitive testicular cancer cell lines. Specific lectin (DBA) discriminated resistant from sensitive lines with potential for identifying cisplatin-resistant patients.

pmid-35055362.summary_ja: ゲルミノーマと頭咽頭腫の鑑別診断を目的とした機械学習モデルの開発研究。放射線学的モデルはT1強調画像で0.91、T2強調画像で0.88のAUCを達成。松果体領域腫瘍の術前診断に有用。
pmid-35055362.summary_en: Study developing machine learning models to differentiate germinoma from craniopharyngioma in pineal region tumors. Radiomics-based models achieved AUCs of 0.91 on T1WI and 0.88 on T2WI for reliable preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-35063252.summary_ja: 18人の仙尾部奇形腫小児患者の研究。尿禁制と生活の質の相関を検討。良好な尿禁制はより良好な生活の質と関連。禁制改善介入により患者中心転帰が向上する可能性。
pmid-35063252.summary_en: Study of 18 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma examining relationship between continence and quality of life. Continence correlated with better quality of life and reduced family impact. Continence interventions may improve outcomes.

pmid-35064036.summary_ja: 新生児の甲状腺奇形腫の症例報告。生後13日目に手術で病変を摘除し気道圧迫が解消。病理組織学的確認により奇形腫と診断。12ヶ月間で再発なし。
pmid-35064036.summary_en: Case report of newborn girl with thyroid teratoma presenting with respiratory distress. Surgical excision on day 13 of life resulted in resolution of airway compromise. Pathology confirmed teratoma with no recurrence at 12 months.

pmid-35067571.summary_ja: 1,410人の精巣がん生存者を対象とした研究。シスプラチン誘発性聴覚障害に関連する因子を検討。高齢、累積シスプラチン用量、高血圧が聴力喪失と関連。患者報告と実測値の乖離を確認。
pmid-35067571.summary_en: Study of 1,410 testicular cancer survivors examining cisplatin-induced ototoxicity. Older age, higher cumulative cisplatin dose, and hypertension associated with greater hearing loss. Discrepancies between patient-reported and measured hearing loss identified.

pmid-35068164.summary_ja: 化学療法未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者353名を対象とした後方視的研究で、低分子量ヘパリンによる予防を評価した。VTEの発生率は4.0%で、予防の有無による有意差はなかった。LMWHは日常的な使用が推奨されないと結論づけられた。
pmid-35068164.summary_en: Retrospective study of 353 chemotherapy-naive testicular germ cell tumor patients evaluating low-molecular-weight heparin prophylaxis. VTE incidence 4.0% with no significant difference between prophylaxis groups. LMWH not recommended routinely.

pmid-35068347.summary_ja: 162人の若年精巣がん生存者を対象とした研究。友人・家族からの社会的制約が生活の質に与える影響を調査。単身者において社会的制約がより強く生活の質低下に関連していた。
pmid-35068347.summary_en: Study of 162 young adult testicular cancer survivors examining relationship between social constraints and cancer-related quality of life. Social constraints more strongly related to lower quality of life for single survivors compared to partnered survivors.

pmid-35070285.summary_ja: 精子細胞性セミノーマは精巣がんの2%未満を占める稀な腫瘍である。80歳男性患者が鼠径部精巣摘除術を受け、補助療法なしで治療された。12ヶ月のフォローアップで転移の兆候なし。
pmid-35070285.summary_en: Case report of an 80-year-old man with spermatocytic seminoma, a rare testicular tumor representing less than 2% of testicular cancers. Patient underwent inguinal orchiectomy without adjuvant therapy with no metastasis at 12-month follow-up.

pmid-35070316.summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマ患者の高カルシウム血症とカルシトリオール上昇に関する症例報告及び文献レビュー。卵巣腫瘍患者の右卵巣卵管摘除後にカルシウムとカルシトリオールが正常化。文献から14例の類似症例を同定し、メカニズム解明にはさらなる症例報告が必要。
pmid-35070316.summary_en: Case report of a 27-year-old woman with dysgerminoma presenting with hypercalcemia and elevated calcitriol. Review of literature identified 14 additional cases. Mechanism underlying calcitriol elevation remains unclear.

pmid-35070726.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮例。思春期後男性で腫瘍マーカー上昇と典型的超音波所見。
pmid-35070726.summary_en: Case report of regressed (burned-out) testicular germ cell tumor in post-pubertal male without distant metastases but with elevated tumor markers and suspicious ultrasound findings following scrotal trauma. Discusses diagnostic criteria and histopathologic evaluation.

pmid-35071534.summary_ja: 耳管成熟奇形腫の症例報告。48歳男性で完全切除後2年間再発なし。稀な部位の腫瘍。
pmid-35071534.summary_en: Case report of mature teratoma involving Eustachian tube and temporal bone in 48-year-old male with chronic otitis history. CT/MRI identified lesion; complete surgical resection via mastoidectomy performed. Excellent 2-year follow-up with no recurrence.

pmid-35073631.summary_ja: 45歳男性に生じた、成人の副鼻腔原発卵黄嚢腫瘍（内胚葉性洞腫瘍）の症例報告。病理組織学的に純粋なYSTであり、SALL4およびαフェトプロテインが陽性であった。性腺外の発生としてまれな提示を示し、成人の副鼻腔YSTの他の症例を併せて検討している。
pmid-35073631.summary_en: Case report of rare primary adult yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus tumor) in sinonasal region in 45-year-old male. Pure YST histology with positive SALL4 and alpha-fetoprotein immunostaining. Reviews other adult sinonasal YST cases; emphasizes rarity of presentation outside gonadal sites.

pmid-35074992.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内粘液性カルチノイド。稀な悪性転化例で、被膜完全、血管侵襲なし。
pmid-35074992.summary_en: Case report of rare primary ovarian mucinous carcinoid arising within mature cystic teratoma. Intact tumor capsule with no vascular invasion or abdominal involvement. Discusses rarity of neoplastic transformation within teratomas and management considerations.

pmid-35074993.summary_ja: 卵巣・卵管メラノーシス5例の報告。成熟奇形腫を含む。鑑別診断の重要性を論述。
pmid-35074993.summary_en: Case series of tubo-ovarian melanosis (rare benign pigmentation). Five cases including mature teratoma and serous cystadenoma with fallopian tube involvement. Discusses embryologic origin and importance of recognizing this entity in differential diagnosis.

pmid-35077082.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫内脂腺癌の症例。初のMSH2遺伝子変異報告。Lynch症候群スクリーニング推奨。
pmid-35077082.summary_en: Case report of sebaceous carcinoma arising in ovarian teratoma (14th reported case) with novel germline MSH2 gene mutation. First report of germline mutation in this tumor type. Discusses Lynch syndrome screening and MMR protein immunohistochemistry.

pmid-35077441.summary_ja: 急性心膜炎で発症した縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍。20歳男性で高AFP値、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍として化学療法施行。
pmid-35077441.summary_en: Case report of anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor (non-seminomatous germ cell tumor) presenting with acute pericarditis in 20-year-old male. Markedly elevated AFP; biopsy/immunohistochemistry confirmed high-grade malignant YST. Emphasizes importance of thorough diagnostic evaluation.

pmid-35079370.summary_ja: ゲスタショナル絨毛癌の症例報告。35歳女性で異所性妊娠と誤診。高hCGと転移を認め予後不良。
pmid-35079370.summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma initially misdiagnosed as ovarian ectopic pregnancy in 35-year-old multiparous woman. Elevated β-hCG and imaging findings suggested GTD; exploratory surgery revealed ovarian mass with metastases. Patient died after chemotherapy.

pmid-35079377.summary_ja: 4歳女児の仙骨尾骨領域節外性混合胚細胞腫瘍。AFP上昇、手術と化学療法を施行。
pmid-35079377.summary_en: Case report of rare extragonadal mixed germ cell tumor of sacrococcygeal region in 4-year-old female with elevated alpha-fetoprotein. Large heterogeneous midline mass displaced rectum; surgical excision with coccygenectomy and subsequent chemotherapy performed.

pmid-35082515.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のハブ遺伝子12個を生物情報学的に同定。細胞周期と免疫浸潤に関連。診断・予後価値を検討。
pmid-35082515.summary_en: Bioinformatics analysis identifying 12 hub genes involved in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) development: PLK4, TRIP13, TPR, KIF18A, CDKN3, HMMR, PBK, PTTG1, CKS2, SYCP1, HSPA2, MKI67. Associated with cell cycle and immune infiltration; TPR and PLK4 identified as research targets.

pmid-35083348.summary_ja: 化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清が予定された非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者9例で、センチネルリンパ節マッピングの実現可能性を検討した。検出率は66％、偽陰性率は0％であり、有望な手法と示唆された。より大規模な研究により検出率の向上と標準化が必要である。
pmid-35083348.summary_en: Study of sentinel lymph node mapping feasibility in nonseminomatous testicular cancer patients undergoing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection post-chemotherapy. Nine cases showed 66% detection rate and 0% false-negative rate, suggesting promising technique for surgical staging.

pmid-35085173.summary_ja: 精巣混合胚細胞腫瘍の自然退縮例。20歳男性で隠蔽された精巣原発巣と転移を認めた稀な症例。
pmid-35085173.summary_en: Case report of spontaneously regressed (burned-out) testicular mixed germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma in 20-year-old male. 18F-FDG PET/CT showed metastases; imaging revealed covert primary testicular lesion. Illustrates rare phenomenon of testicular GCT spontaneous regression.

pmid-35086492.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫を伴うJCV脳炎の症例報告。奇形腫がリンパ球減少を誘発しPML発症に関与。予後不良例。
pmid-35086492.summary_en: Case report of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) with comorbid mediastinal teratoma in 73-year-old female. Teratoma induced lymphopenia triggering JCV infection. Demonstrates how mediastinal teratoma-related immunosuppression can manifest as PML.

pmid-35089125.summary_ja: 28研究(41症例)を対象とした先天性鼻咽頭腫瘤の新生児に関する系統的文献レビュー。最も多い診断は奇形腫(78%)で、女性と男性の比は2.5:1であった。臨床症状、画像診断、外科的管理を整理し、気道確保を重視している。
pmid-35089125.summary_en: Systematic literature review of congenital nasopharyngeal masses in newborns from 28 studies (41 cases). Teratoma was most common diagnosis (78%). Female-to-male ratio 2.5:1. Discusses clinical presentation, imaging, and surgical management with focus on airway protection.
